// Procedural animation for monster rigs (see monsterRenderer.js).
//
// One function animates any species: it restores each pivot to its rest pose
// and layers breathing, blinking, a movement style (hop, waddle, fly, swim,
// roll...), attack telegraphs, reactions and personality "quirks" on top.
// Called from a single central update loop (no per-monster timers).
//
// anim state per monster instance (st):
//   pose: 'idle' | 'move' | 'flee' | 'windup' | 'strike' | 'stunned' | 'defeated'
//         | 'sleep' | 'carried' | 'dropped' | 'celebrate' | 'quirk' | 'recover'
//   speed, attackKind, windupMs, poseT (seconds in this pose), hurtT, quirk (name)

import * as THREE from 'three';

const TAU = Math.PI * 2;

function saveRest(o) {
  if (!o.userData.rest) {
    o.userData.rest = { p: o.position.clone(), r: o.rotation.clone(), s: o.scale.clone() };
  }
}

function restore(o) {
  const r = o.userData.rest;
  if (!r) return;
  o.position.copy(r.p);
  o.rotation.copy(r.r);
  o.scale.copy(r.s);
}

function prepare(rig) {
  if (rig.prepared) return;
  rig.prepared = true;
  const list = [rig.bodyPivot, rig.body, rig.head, rig.mouth, rig.jaw, rig.crest, rig.shell, rig.spout, rig.flames, rig.halo, rig.tailFlame, rig.coin];
  for (const e of rig.eyes) list.push(e.inner, e.group);
  for (const e of rig.ears) list.push(e.pivot);
  for (const s of rig.tail) list.push(s);
  for (const l of rig.legs) list.push(l.pivot);
  for (const a of rig.arms) list.push(a.pivot);
  for (const w of rig.wings) list.push(w.pivot);
  for (const a of rig.antennae) list.push(a);
  for (const s of rig.spin) list.push(s.obj);
  rig.animNodes = list.filter(Boolean);
  for (const o of rig.animNodes) saveRest(o);
  rig.seed = Math.random() * 100;
  rig.blinkAt = 1 + Math.random() * 3;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ fx bits

let FX = null;
function fxGeo() {
  if (FX) return FX;
  const star = new THREE.Shape();
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    const r = i % 2 ? 0.45 : 1;
    const a = (i / 10) * TAU + Math.PI / 2;
    if (i === 0) star.moveTo(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r);
    else star.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r);
  }
  const heart = new THREE.Shape();
  heart.moveTo(0, -0.9);
  heart.bezierCurveTo(-1.2, 0, -0.9, 1, 0, 0.45);
  heart.bezierCurveTo(0.9, 1, 1.2, 0, 0, -0.9);
  FX = {
    star: new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(star, { depth: 0.25, bevelEnabled: false }),
    heart: new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(heart, { depth: 0.25, bevelEnabled: false }),
    starMat: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffe14a }),
    heartMat: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff5a9a }),
    zMat: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9 }),
    zGeo: (() => {
      const s = new THREE.Shape();
      s.moveTo(-0.5, 0.5); s.lineTo(0.5, 0.5); s.lineTo(0.5, 0.3); s.lineTo(-0.15, -0.3);
      s.lineTo(0.5, -0.3); s.lineTo(0.5, -0.5); s.lineTo(-0.5, -0.5); s.lineTo(-0.5, -0.3);
      s.lineTo(0.15, 0.3); s.lineTo(-0.5, 0.3); s.closePath();
      return new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: 0.12, bevelEnabled: false });
    })(),
  };
  return FX;
}

function decor(rig, kind) {
  rig.decor = rig.decor || {};
  if (rig.decor[kind]) return rig.decor[kind];
  const f = fxGeo();
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  if (kind === 'stars') {
    for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
      const m = new THREE.Mesh(f.star, f.starMat);
      m.scale.setScalar(0.18);
      g.add(m);
    }
  } else if (kind === 'hearts') {
    for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
      const m = new THREE.Mesh(f.heart, f.heartMat);
      m.scale.setScalar(0.2);
      g.add(m);
    }
  } else if (kind === 'zzz') {
    for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
      const m = new THREE.Mesh(f.zGeo, f.zMat);
      m.scale.setScalar(0.2 + k * 0.07);
      g.add(m);
    }
  } else if (kind === 'sweat') {
    const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.1, 8, 6), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x8fd8ff }));
    m.scale.set(1, 1.5, 1);
    g.add(m);
  }
  g.visible = false;
  rig.root.add(g);
  rig.decor[kind] = g;
  return g;
}

function showDecor(rig, kind, on, t) {
  const d = on || rig.decor?.[kind] ? decor(rig, kind) : null;
  if (!d) return;
  d.visible = on;
  if (!on) return;
  const top = rig.headTop + 0.55;
  d.children.forEach((m, k) => {
    if (kind === 'stars') {
      const a = t * 3 + (k / 3) * TAU;
      m.position.set(Math.cos(a) * 0.55, top, Math.sin(a) * 0.55);
      m.rotation.y = t * 4;
    } else if (kind === 'hearts') {
      const p = (t * 0.8 + k / 3) % 1;
      m.position.set((k - 1) * 0.45, top + p * 1.2, 0.2);
      m.scale.setScalar(0.12 + 0.12 * Math.sin(p * Math.PI));
    } else if (kind === 'zzz') {
      const p = (t * 0.45 + k / 3) % 1;
      m.position.set(0.3 + p * 0.5, top + p * 1.1, 0.1);
      m.material.opacity = 1 - p;
    } else if (kind === 'sweat') {
      const p = (t * 1.5) % 1;
      m.position.set(0.55, rig.headTop - 0.1 - p * 0.3, 0.35);
    }
  });
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ quirks

const QUIRKS = {
  chomp(rig, k, t) {
    if (rig.jaw) rig.jaw.position.y -= Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 14)) * 0.12;
    if (rig.mouth) rig.mouth.scale.y *= 1 + Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 14)) * 0.25;
    rig.bodyPivot.position.y += Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 7)) * 0.08;
  },
  bounce(rig, k, t) {
    const h = Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 7));
    rig.bodyPivot.position.y += h * 0.45;
    rig.bodyPivot.scale.y *= 1 + (h - 0.5) * 0.12;
  },
  lookaround(rig, k, t) {
    rig.head.rotation.y += Math.sin(t * 1.6) * 0.55;
    rig.head.rotation.x += Math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.08;
  },
  sleepy(rig, k, t) {
    for (const e of rig.eyes) e.inner.scale.y *= 0.35 + 0.3 * Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * 0.8));
    rig.head.rotation.x += 0.2 + Math.sin(t * 1.4) * 0.12;
    rig.bodyPivot.rotation.z += Math.sin(t * 1.4) * 0.06;
  },
  sniff(rig, k, t) {
    rig.head.rotation.x += 0.3 + Math.sin(t * 16) * 0.05;
    rig.bodyPivot.rotation.x += 0.12;
  },
  sparks(rig, k, t) {
    rig.bodyPivot.position.x += Math.sin(t * 40) * 0.03;
    for (const e of rig.ears) e.pivot.rotation.z += Math.sin(t * 30) * 0.1;
    rig.sparking = true;
  },
  tailchase(rig, k, t) {
    rig.bodyPivot.rotation.y += t * 7;
    rig.bodyPivot.position.y += Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 14)) * 0.08;
    for (const s of rig.tail) s.rotation.y += Math.sin(t * 20) * 0.3;
  },
  puff(rig, k, t) {
    const p = (t * 0.7) % 1;
    rig.head.scale.multiplyScalar(1 + Math.sin(Math.min(1, p * 2) * Math.PI) * 0.08);
    rig.puffing = p > 0.45 && p < 0.6;
  },
  preen(rig, k, t) {
    rig.head.rotation.z += Math.sin(t * 2) * 0.35;
    rig.head.rotation.x += 0.15;
    for (const w of rig.wings) w.pivot.rotation.z += w.side * (0.3 + Math.sin(t * 6) * 0.15);
  },
  wave(rig, k, t) {
    const arm = rig.waveArm || rig.arms.find((a) => a.side === 1)?.pivot;
    if (arm) {
      arm.rotation.z += 2.4;
      arm.rotation.x += Math.sin(t * 9) * 0.4;
    }
    rig.head.rotation.z += Math.sin(t * 3) * 0.1;
  },
  spin(rig, k, t) {
    rig.bodyPivot.rotation.y += t * 5;
  },
  curl(rig, k, t) {
    const c = Math.min(1, Math.sin(Math.min(1, k * 1.4) * Math.PI) * 1.4);
    rig.bodyPivot.scale.multiplyScalar(1 - c * 0.12);
    rig.head.position.y -= c * 0.3;
    rig.head.position.z -= c * 0.25;
    for (const l of rig.legs) l.pivot.scale.multiplyScalar(1 - c * 0.9);
  },
  yawn(rig, k, t) {
    const y = Math.sin(Math.min(1, k * 1.3) * Math.PI);
    rig.head.rotation.x -= y * 0.35;
    if (rig.mouth) rig.mouth.scale.y *= 1 + y * 1.4;
    if (rig.mouthOpen) rig.mouthOpen.visible = y > 0.3;
    if (rig.jaw) rig.jaw.position.y -= y * 0.15;
    for (const e of rig.eyes) e.inner.scale.y *= 1 - y * 0.8;
  },
  intimidate(rig, k, t) {
    rig.bodyPivot.scale.multiplyScalar(1.08);
    rig.bodyPivot.rotation.x -= 0.15;
    if (rig.mouthOpen) rig.mouthOpen.visible = true;
    if (rig.jaw) rig.jaw.position.y -= 0.1;
    for (const e of rig.eyes) e.inner.scale.y *= 0.65;
    rig.bodyPivot.position.x += Math.sin(t * 25) * 0.02;
  },
  hover(rig, k, t) {
    rig.bodyPivot.position.y += Math.sin(t * 2.5) * 0.18;
  },
  flap(rig, k, t) {
    for (const a of rig.arms) a.pivot.rotation.z += a.side * (0.6 + Math.sin(t * 16) * 0.5);
    rig.bodyPivot.position.y += Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 8)) * 0.15;
  },
  howl(rig, k, t) {
    const h = Math.sin(Math.min(1, k * 1.2) * Math.PI);
    rig.head.rotation.x -= h * 0.7;
    if (rig.mouthOpen) rig.mouthOpen.visible = h > 0.4;
    if (rig.mouth) rig.mouth.scale.y *= 1 + h;
  },
  bubble(rig, k, t) {
    rig.blowing = true;
    rig.head.rotation.x -= 0.1;
  },
  hide(rig, k, t) {
    const h = Math.sin(Math.min(1, k * 1.2) * Math.PI);
    rig.body.position.y -= h * 0.25;
    for (const e of rig.eyes) e.group.position.y -= h * 0.4;
    for (const a of rig.arms) a.pivot.scale.multiplyScalar(1 - h * 0.8);
  },
  spout(rig, k, t) {
    rig.spouting = true;
    rig.bodyPivot.position.y += Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 4)) * 0.1;
  },
  headtilt(rig, k, t) {
    rig.head.rotation.z += Math.sin(t * 1.2) > 0 ? 0.35 : -0.35;
  },
  hang(rig, k, t) {
    rig.bodyPivot.rotation.z += Math.PI * Math.min(1, k * 3) * (k < 0.85 ? 1 : (1 - k) / 0.15);
    rig.bodyPivot.position.y += 0.8;
  },
  shy(rig, k, t) {
    rig.bodyPivot.rotation.y += Math.PI * 0.8 * Math.sin(Math.min(1, k * 1.2) * Math.PI);
    for (const a of rig.arms) a.pivot.rotation.x -= 1.4;
    rig.bodyPivot.scale.multiplyScalar(0.94);
  },
  stretch(rig, k, t) {
    const s = Math.sin(Math.min(1, k * 1.2) * Math.PI);
    rig.bodyPivot.rotation.x += s * 0.3;
    rig.head.rotation.x -= s * 0.4;
    for (const l of rig.legs) if (l.front > 0) l.pivot.rotation.x -= s * 0.7;
    if (rig.mouth) rig.mouth.scale.y *= 1 + s * 0.8;
  },
  regal(rig, k, t) {
    rig.head.rotation.x -= 0.18;
    rig.head.rotation.y += Math.sin(t * 0.6) * 0.25;
    for (const e of rig.eyes) e.inner.scale.y *= 0.75;
  },
  stomp(rig, k, t) {
    const s = Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 5));
    rig.bodyPivot.position.y += s * 0.15;
    rig.bodyPivot.rotation.z += Math.sin(t * 5) * 0.08;
    for (const l of rig.legs) l.pivot.rotation.x += Math.sin(t * 5 + l.side) * 0.4;
  },
  flower(rig, k, t) {
    rig.head.rotation.x += 0.35;
    rig.head.rotation.y += Math.sin(t * 2) * 0.3;
  },
  dig(rig, k, t) {
    rig.bodyPivot.rotation.x += 0.3;
    for (const a of rig.arms) a.pivot.rotation.x += Math.sin(t * 18 + a.side) * 0.7;
    for (const l of rig.legs) if (l.front >= 0) l.pivot.rotation.x += Math.sin(t * 18 + l.side) * 0.7;

  },
  roar(rig, k, t) {
    const r = Math.sin(Math.min(1, k * 1.3) * Math.PI);
    rig.head.rotation.x -= r * 0.4;
    if (rig.mouthOpen) rig.mouthOpen.visible = r > 0.3;
    if (rig.mouth) rig.mouth.scale.y *= 1 + r * 1.2;

  coil(rig, k, t) {
    rig.tail.forEach((s, i) => {
      s.rotation.y += Math.sin(t * 2 + i) * 0.5 + 0.3;
    });
  },
  glitch(rig, k, t) {
    if (Math.sin(t * 13) > 0.85) {
      rig.bodyPivot.position.x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6;
      rig.bodyPivot.scale.y *= 0.6 + Math.random() * 0.8;
    }
    rig.bodyPivot.rotation.z += Math.sin(t * 3) > 0.9 ? Math.PI : 0;
  },
};

export const QUIRK_NAMES = Object.keys(QUIRKS);

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ main

export function animateMonster(rig, st, dt, t) {
  prepare(rig);
  for (const o of rig.animNodes) restore(o);
  rig.sparking = rig.blowing = rig.spouting = rig.puffing = rig.digging = false;
  const sp = rig.species;
  const move = sp.ai.move;
  const time = t + rig.seed;
  st.poseT = (st.poseT || 0) + dt;
  const B = rig.bodyPivot;
  const H = rig.head;
  const pose = st.pose || 'idle';
  const flying = move === 'fly' || move === 'flutter' || move === 'serpent';
  const inMouthOpen = rig.mouthOpen;
  if (inMouthOpen) inMouthOpen.visible = false;
  for (const x of rig.eyeX) x.visible = false;
  for (const e of rig.eyes) e.inner.visible = true;

  // breathing
  const breath = Math.sin(time * (pose === 'sleep' ? 1.4 : 2.4));
  B.scale.y *= 1 + breath * 0.025;
  B.scale.x *= 1 - breath * 0.012;
  B.scale.z *= 1 - breath * 0.012;

  // blinking
  rig.blinkAt -= dt;
  let blink = 1;
  if (rig.blinkAt < 0) {
    blink = 0.08;
    if (rig.blinkAt < -0.12) rig.blinkAt = 2 + Math.random() * 3.5;
  }
  for (const e of rig.eyes) e.inner.scale.y *= blink;

  // ears twitch, tails wag, antennae bob
  const happy = pose === 'celebrate' || pose === 'move';
  rig.ears.forEach((e, i) => {
    e.pivot.rotation.z += Math.sin(time * 1.3 + i) * 0.05 + (Math.sin(time * 0.37 + i * 2) > 0.97 ? e.side * 0.25 : 0);
  });
  rig.tail.forEach((s, i) => {
    const wag = happy ? 0.35 : 0.18;
    s.rotation.y += Math.sin(time * (happy ? 9 : 3) - i * 0.6) * wag;
    if (rig.serpent) {
      s.rotation.y += Math.sin(time * 3 - i * 0.9) * 0.28;
      s.rotation.x += Math.sin(time * 2.2 - i * 0.7) * 0.1;
    }
  });
  rig.antennae.forEach((a, i) => {
    a.rotation.x += Math.sin(time * 3 + i) * 0.12;
    a.rotation.z += Math.sin(time * 2.3 + i * 1.7) * 0.08;
  });
  for (const s of rig.spin) s.obj.rotation[s.axis] += 0; // driven below
  rig.spinAngle = (rig.spinAngle || 0) + dt;
  for (const s of rig.spin) s.obj.rotation[s.axis] = rig.spinAngle * s.speed;
  if (rig.flames) rig.flames.scale.y *= 1 + Math.sin(time * 14) * 0.12;
  if (rig.tailFlame) rig.tailFlame.scale.y *= 1 + Math.sin(time * 16) * 0.18;
  if (rig.halo) rig.halo.position.y += Math.sin(time * 2) * 0.05;
  if (rig.coin) rig.coin.rotation.z = time * 3;
  for (const m of rig.glow) m.emissiveIntensity = (m.userData.baseEI ??= m.emissiveIntensity) * (0.85 + Math.sin(time * 3) * 0.2);

  // hover species float
  if (flying || move === 'float') {
    B.position.y += Math.sin(time * 2.6) * 0.14;
    for (const w of rig.wings) {
      const fast = w.style === 'bug' ? 40 : w.style === 'bat' || w.style === 'moth' ? 12 : 9;
      const amp = w.style === 'moth' ? 0.5 : 0.7;
      w.pivot.rotation.y += w.side * Math.sin(time * fast) * amp;
      w.pivot.rotation.z += w.side * Math.sin(time * fast) * amp * 0.6;
    }
  } else {
    for (const w of rig.wings) w.pivot.rotation.z += w.side * (Math.sin(time * 1.5) * 0.08 + 0.05);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------- poses
  const speed = st.speed || 0;
  switch (pose) {
    case 'move':
    case 'flee':
    case 'recover':
      animateMove(rig, st, dt, time, speed * (pose === 'flee' ? 1.3 : 1));
      if (pose === 'flee') {
        for (const e of rig.eyes) e.inner.scale.multiplyScalar(1.15);
        showDecor(rig, 'sweat', true, time);
      }
      H.rotation.y += Math.sin(time * 1.1) * 0.08;
      break;
    case 'windup': {
      const w = Math.min(1, st.poseT / Math.max(0.15, (st.windupMs || 600) / 1000));
      const kind = st.attackKind;
      if (kind === 'slam') {
        B.position.y += w * 0.9;
        B.scale.y *= 1 + w * 0.12;
        for (const a of rig.arms) a.pivot.rotation.z += a.side * w * 2.2;
      } else if (kind === 'lunge') {
        B.scale.y *= 1 - w * 0.2;
        B.scale.x *= 1 + w * 0.1;
        B.rotation.y += Math.sin(time * 30) * 0.08 * w;
        B.rotation.x += w * 0.15;
      } else if (kind === 'breath' || kind === 'projectile') {
        B.scale.multiplyScalar(1 + w * 0.1);
        H.rotation.x -= w * 0.35;
        H.scale.multiplyScalar(1 + w * 0.08);
      } else {
        B.rotation.x -= w * 0.25;
      }
      if (rig.mouth) rig.mouth.scale.y *= 1 + w * 0.6;
      if (inMouthOpen) inMouthOpen.visible = w > 0.3;
      if (rig.jaw) rig.jaw.position.y -= w * 0.18;
      for (const e of rig.eyes) e.inner.scale.y *= 1 - w * 0.35;
      if (flying) animateMove(rig, st, dt, time, 0);
      break;
    }
    case 'strike': {
      const k = Math.min(1, st.poseT / 0.3);
      const out = Math.sin(k * Math.PI);
      B.position.z += out * 0.5;
      B.rotation.x += out * 0.25;
      if (rig.mouth) rig.mouth.scale.y *= 1 + (1 - k) * 0.8;
      if (inMouthOpen) inMouthOpen.visible = k < 0.5;
      if (rig.jaw) rig.jaw.position.y -= (1 - k) * 0.15;
      if (st.attackKind === 'slam') {
        B.position.y += (1 - k) * 0.4;
        B.scale.y *= 1 - out * 0.2;
      }
      if (st.dashing) animateMove(rig, st, dt, time, 20);
      break;
    }
    case 'stunned':
      B.rotation.z += Math.sin(time * 10) * 0.15;
      for (const e of rig.eyes) e.inner.rotation.z = time * 8;
      showDecor(rig, 'stars', true, time);
      break;
    case 'defeated': {
      const k = Math.min(1, st.poseT / 0.5);
      B.rotation.z += k * 1.45;
      B.position.y -= k * 0.15 * rig.width;
      B.position.x += k * 0.25;
      for (const e of rig.eyes) e.inner.visible = false;
      for (const x of rig.eyeX) x.visible = true;
      for (const l of rig.legs) l.pivot.rotation.x += Math.sin(time * 1.5) * 0.05;
      showDecor(rig, 'stars', true, time);
      break;
    }
    case 'sleep':
      for (const e of rig.eyes) e.inner.scale.y = 0.06;
      H.rotation.x += 0.25;
      B.position.y -= 0.06;
      if (flying) B.position.y -= 0.6;
      showDecor(rig, 'zzz', true, time);
      break;
    case 'carried':
      B.rotation.z += Math.sin(time * 14) * 0.3;
      B.rotation.x += Math.sin(time * 9) * 0.15;
      for (const l of rig.legs) l.pivot.rotation.x += Math.sin(time * 22 + l.side * 2) * 0.9;
      for (const a of rig.arms) a.pivot.rotation.z += a.side * (1.5 + Math.sin(time * 20) * 0.5);
      for (const e of rig.eyes) e.inner.scale.multiplyScalar(1.15);
      if (inMouthOpen) inMouthOpen.visible = true;
      if (rig.mouth) rig.mouth.scale.y *= 1.4;
      showDecor(rig, 'sweat', true, time);
      break;
    case 'dropped':
      B.rotation.y += time * 2.5;
      B.position.y += Math.abs(Math.sin(st.poseT * 9)) * Math.max(0, 0.8 - st.poseT * 0.6);
      for (const e of rig.eyes) e.inner.rotation.z = time * 6;
      showDecor(rig, 'stars', true, time);
      break;
    case 'celebrate':
      B.position.y += Math.abs(Math.sin(st.poseT * 8)) * 0.9;
      B.rotation.y += st.poseT * 6;
      for (const e of rig.eyes) e.inner.scale.y *= 0.45;
      for (const a of rig.arms) a.pivot.rotation.z += a.side * 2;
      showDecor(rig, 'hearts', true, time);
      break;
    case 'quirk': {
      const q = QUIRKS[st.quirk] || QUIRKS.lookaround;
      const dur = st.quirkDur || 3.5;
      q(rig, Math.min(1, st.poseT / dur), time);
      break;
    }
    default:
      // idle: slow look around
      H.rotation.y += Math.sin(time * 0.7) * 0.32;
      H.rotation.x += Math.sin(time * 0.43) * 0.06;
      if (st.lookAt !== undefined && st.lookAt !== null) H.rotation.y = st.lookAt;
  }
  if (pose !== 'stunned' && pose !== 'defeated' && pose !== 'dropped') showDecor(rig, 'stars', false, time);
  if (pose !== 'sleep') showDecor(rig, 'zzz', false, time);
  if (pose !== 'celebrate') showDecor(rig, 'hearts', false, time);
  if (pose !== 'carried' && pose !== 'flee') showDecor(rig, 'sweat', false, time);

  // hurt recoil overlay
  if (st.hurtT !== undefined && st.hurtT < 0.35) {
    const h = 1 - st.hurtT / 0.35;
    B.rotation.x -= h * 0.3;
    B.scale.multiplyScalar(1 - h * 0.08);
    for (const e of rig.eyes) e.inner.scale.y *= 1 - h * 0.6;
  }
  if (rig.glitch && Math.random() < 0.02) B.position.x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
}

function animateMove(rig, st, dt, time, speed) {
  const sp = rig.species;
  const move = sp.ai.move;
  const B = rig.bodyPivot;
  st.phase = (st.phase || 0) + dt * Math.min(16, 3 + speed * 0.9);
  const ph = st.phase;
  const legSwing = (amp, offset = 0) => {
    for (const l of rig.legs) {
      if (l.tentacle) {
        l.pivot.rotation.x += Math.sin(ph + l.side) * 0.3;
        continue;
      }
      const diag = l.front === 0 ? l.side : l.side * (l.front > 0 ? 1 : -1);
      l.pivot.rotation.x += Math.sin(ph + offset + (diag > 0 ? 0 : Math.PI)) * amp;
    }
    for (const a of rig.arms) a.pivot.rotation.x += Math.sin(ph + (a.side > 0 ? Math.PI : 0)) * amp * 0.6;
  };
  switch (move) {
    case 'hop':
    case 'bounce': {
      const hop = Math.abs(Math.sin(ph * 0.55));
      B.position.y += hop * (move === 'hop' ? 0.65 : 0.35);
      B.scale.y *= 0.88 + hop * 0.2;
      B.scale.x *= 1.06 - hop * 0.08;
      for (const l of rig.legs) l.pivot.rotation.x += hop * 0.5 * (l.front >= 0 ? -1 : 1);
      for (const a of rig.arms) a.pivot.rotation.z += a.side * hop * 0.6;
      for (const e of rig.ears) e.pivot.rotation.x += (1 - hop) * 0.25;
      break;
    }
    case 'waddle':
      B.rotation.z += Math.sin(ph) * 0.16;
      B.position.y += Math.abs(Math.sin(ph)) * 0.08;
      legSwing(0.45);
      break;
    case 'roll':
      if (speed > 3) {
        B.position.y -= 0.15;
        rig.body.rotation.x += ph * 1.5;
        rig.head.position.y -= 0.3;
        rig.head.position.z -= 0.35;
        for (const l of rig.legs) l.pivot.scale.multiplyScalar(0.05);
        if (rig.head !== rig.body) rig.head.scale.multiplyScalar(0.6);
      } else legSwing(0.5);
      break;
    case 'fly':
    case 'flutter':
    case 'serpent':
      B.rotation.x += Math.min(0.35, speed * 0.03);
      for (const w of rig.wings) w.pivot.rotation.y += w.side * Math.sin(time * 20) * 0.4;
      if (move === 'flutter') B.position.y += Math.abs(Math.sin(ph * 0.5)) * 0.5;
      break;
    case 'swim':
    case 'float':
      B.rotation.y += Math.sin(ph) * 0.12;
      B.position.y += Math.abs(Math.sin(ph * 0.5)) * 0.25;
      for (const w of rig.wings) w.pivot.rotation.z += w.side * Math.sin(ph * 1.5) * 0.5;
      for (const s of rig.tail) s.rotation.y += Math.sin(ph * 1.5) * 0.45;
      legSwing(0.4);
      break;
    case 'stomp':
      B.position.y += Math.abs(Math.sin(ph)) * 0.12;
      B.rotation.z += Math.sin(ph) * 0.07;
      legSwing(0.55);
      break;
    case 'scuttle':
      B.position.y += Math.abs(Math.sin(ph * 2)) * 0.04;
      B.rotation.y += Math.sin(ph * 2) * 0.06;
      legSwing(0.7);
      break;
    case 'glitch':
      if (Math.sin(ph * 3) > 0.8) B.position.x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4;
      legSwing(0.6);
      break;
    case 'trot':
      B.position.y += Math.abs(Math.sin(ph)) * 0.16;
      B.rotation.x += Math.sin(ph * 2) * 0.04;
      legSwing(0.75);
      for (const e of rig.ears) e.pivot.rotation.x += Math.sin(ph * 2) * 0.12;
      break;
    default:
      // walk
      B.position.y += Math.abs(Math.sin(ph)) * 0.08;
      legSwing(0.6);
      for (const e of rig.ears) e.pivot.rotation.x += Math.sin(ph * 2) * 0.08;
  }
}

// Sound effects synthesised with the Web Audio API (no audio files needed).
// Every sound is a named hook: play('coin'), play('hit', {pitch}). To use
// recorded sounds instead, register a buffer with setSample(name, url).

export class Audio {
  constructor() {
    this.ctx = null;
    this.master = null;
    this.volume = 0.6;
    this.samples = new Map();
    this.last = new Map();
  }

  unlock() {
    if (this.ctx) {
      if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume();
      return;
    }
    const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AC) return;
    this.ctx = new AC();
    this.master = this.ctx.createGain();
    this.master.gain.value = this.volume;
    this.master.connect(this.ctx.destination);
  }

  setVolume(v) {
    this.volume = v;
    if (this.master) this.master.gain.value = v;
  }

  async setSample(name, url) {
    if (!this.ctx) return;
    const buf = await (await fetch(url)).arrayBuffer();
    this.samples.set(name, await this.ctx.decodeAudioData(buf));
  }

  tone(freq, dur, { type = 'sine', vol = 0.3, slide = 0, delay = 0, attack = 0.005 } = {}) {
    const c = this.ctx;
    const t = c.currentTime + delay;
    const o = c.createOscillator();
    const g = c.createGain();
    o.type = type;
    o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
    if (slide) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(30, freq * slide), t + dur);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol, t + attack);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur);
    o.connect(g).connect(this.master);
    o.start(t);
    o.stop(t + dur + 0.02);
  }

  noise(dur, { vol = 0.2, freq = 2000, q = 1, delay = 0, type = 'bandpass', sweep = 0 } = {}) {
    const c = this.ctx;
    const t = c.currentTime + delay;
    const len = Math.max(1, Math.floor(c.sampleRate * dur));
    const buf = c.createBuffer(1, len, c.sampleRate);
    const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) d[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (1 - i / len);
    const src = c.createBufferSource();
    src.buffer = buf;
    const f = c.createBiquadFilter();
    f.type = type;
    f.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
    if (sweep) f.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq * sweep, t + dur);
    f.Q.value = q;
    const g = c.createGain();
    g.gain.value = vol;
    src.connect(f).connect(g).connect(this.master);
    src.start(t);
  }

  play(name, opts = {}) {
    if (!this.ctx || this.volume <= 0) return;
    const now = performance.now();
    if (now - (this.last.get(name) || 0) < (opts.minGap ?? 40)) return;
    this.last.set(name, now);
    const sample = this.samples.get(name);
    if (sample) {
      const s = this.ctx.createBufferSource();
      s.buffer = sample;
      s.connect(this.master);
      s.start();
      return;
    }
    const p = opts.pitch || 1;
    switch (name) {
      case 'swing': this.noise(0.16, { vol: 0.18, freq: 900, sweep: 3, q: 2 }); break;
      case 'hit': this.tone(180 * p, 0.12, { type: 'square', vol: 0.12, slide: 0.5 }); this.noise(0.08, { vol: 0.2, freq: 1200 }); break;
      case 'crit': this.tone(520, 0.1, { type: 'square', vol: 0.12 }); this.tone(780, 0.15, { type: 'square', vol: 0.1, delay: 0.05 }); break;
      case 'cry': this.tone(520 * p, 0.18, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.12, slide: 1.4 }); this.tone(700 * p, 0.12, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.08, delay: 0.1, slide: 0.8 }); break;
      case 'defeat': this.tone(600 * p, 0.5, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.14, slide: 0.35 }); break;
      case 'hurt': this.tone(140, 0.2, { type: 'sawtooth', vol: 0.12, slide: 0.6 }); break;
      case 'dodge': this.noise(0.22, { vol: 0.12, freq: 600, sweep: 4, q: 1.5 }); break;
      case 'jump': this.tone(300, 0.12, { type: 'sine', vol: 0.08, slide: 1.8 }); break;
      case 'coin': this.tone(988, 0.08, { type: 'square', vol: 0.08 }); this.tone(1319, 0.2, { type: 'square', vol: 0.08, delay: 0.07 }); break;
      case 'recruit': [523, 659, 784, 1047].forEach((f, i) => this.tone(f, 0.22, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.14, delay: i * 0.09 })); break;
      case 'capture': this.tone(260, 0.9, { type: 'sine', vol: 0.1, slide: 4 }); this.noise(0.8, { vol: 0.06, freq: 3000, sweep: 3, q: 3 }); break;
      case 'caught': this.tone(1047, 0.12, { type: 'square', vol: 0.08 }); [784, 1047, 1319, 1568].forEach((f, i) => this.tone(f, 0.25, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.12, delay: 0.08 + i * 0.07 })); break;
      case 'levelup': [392, 523, 659, 784, 1047].forEach((f, i) => this.tone(f, 0.25, { type: 'square', vol: 0.08, delay: i * 0.08 })); break;
      case 'lucky': [784, 988, 1175, 1568, 1976].forEach((f, i) => this.tone(f, 0.18, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.1, delay: i * 0.06 })); this.noise(0.4, { vol: 0.08, freq: 6000, delay: 0.1 }); break;
      case 'laser': this.tone(110, 0.5, { type: 'sawtooth', vol: 0.08, slide: 2 }); break;
      case 'alarm': for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { this.tone(880, 0.14, { type: 'square', vol: 0.09, delay: i * 0.3 }); this.tone(660, 0.14, { type: 'square', vol: 0.09, delay: i * 0.3 + 0.15 }); } break;
      case 'grab': this.tone(400, 0.15, { type: 'triangle', vol: 0.12, slide: 1.6 }); break;
      case 'bonk': this.tone(220, 0.08, { type: 'square', vol: 0.15, slide: 0.4 }); this.noise(0.1, { vol: 0.15, freq: 400 }); break;
      case 'freeze': this.noise(0.4, { vol: 0.1, freq: 5000, q: 4, sweep: 0.5 }); break;
      case 'teleport': this.tone(300, 0.4, { type: 'sine', vol: 0.12, slide: 4 }); break;
      case 'click': this.tone(700, 0.05, { type: 'square', vol: 0.05 }); break;
      case 'error': this.tone(200, 0.15, { type: 'square', vol: 0.08 }); this.tone(150, 0.2, { type: 'square', vol: 0.08, delay: 0.1 }); break;
      case 'event': [523, 659, 784, 659, 784, 1047].forEach((f, i) => this.tone(f, 0.2, { type: 'square', vol: 0.09, delay: i * 0.12 })); break;
      case 'discover': [659, 880, 1175].forEach((f, i) => this.tone(f, 0.3, { type: 'sine', vol: 0.12, delay: i * 0.12 })); break;
      case 'projectile': this.tone(500 * p, 0.15, { type: 'sine', vol: 0.06, slide: 0.6 }); break;
      case 'slam': this.tone(80, 0.35, { type: 'sine', vol: 0.25, slide: 0.5 }); this.noise(0.3, { vol: 0.15, freq: 300 }); break;
      default: break;
    }
  }
}

// Player bases: monster pads, the monsters standing on them, the security
// laser gate, the Money collector, lock pad, upgrade terminal and the owner's
// sign. Driven by 'base' messages from the server.

import * as THREE from 'three';
import { SPECIES_BY_ID } from '#shared/monsters.js';
import { CONFIG } from '#shared/config.js';
import { buildMonster, setRigDetail } from './monsterRenderer.js';
import { animateMonster, QUIRK_NAMES } from './animationSystem.js';
import { makeLabel, disposeLabel } from './labels.js';
import { boxCollider } from '#shared/collision.js';
import { buildDecor } from './decorModels.js';

const TMP_COLOR = new THREE.Color();
const PALETTE = [0x3a7ae0, 0xe84a5f, 0x3fbf5a, 0xffb02a, 0x9a5ae0, 0x2ac8c8, 0xff7ab8, 0x5a5a6a];

function std(color, o = {}) {
  return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color, roughness: 0.5, ...o });
}

const PAD_GEO = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.45, 1.6, 0.5, 24);
const PAD_MAT = std(0xffffff);
const RING_GEO = new THREE.TorusGeometry(1.5, 0.12, 6, 28);
const TOWER_TOP = CONFIG.bases.floors * CONFIG.bases.floorHeight;
const RING_MAT = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff });

// distance tiers (from the camera to the base center)
const NEAR_LABELS = 70;   // pad / lock / upgrade / Money labels
const HI_MONSTERS = 40;   // detailed monster rigs closer than this
const SHOW_MONSTERS = 175;
const SHOW_BASE = 290;
const PAD_LABEL_DIST = 10; // from the local player

export class BasesView {
  constructor(scene, world, effects, audio) {
    this.scene = scene;
    this.world = world;
    this.effects = effects;
    this.audio = audio;
    this.views = world.bases.map((b) => this.buildBase(b));
    this.states = new Array(world.bases.length).fill(null);
    this.myIndex = -1;
  }

  buildBase(b) {
    const g = new THREE.Group();
    this.scene.add(g);
    const view = { base: b, group: g, pads: [], monsters: new Map(), lasers: [], labels: [], decor: new Array(b.decor.length).fill(null), state: null };
    // all pads on every floor (and their colored rings) are two instanced draws
    const n = b.slots.length;
    view.padMesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(PAD_GEO, PAD_MAT, n);
    view.ringMesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(RING_GEO, RING_MAT, n);
    view.padMesh.receiveShadow = true;
    const m4 = new THREE.Matrix4();
    const flat = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), Math.PI / 2);
    const none = new THREE.Quaternion();
    const one = new THREE.Vector3(1, 1, 1);
    b.slots.forEach((s, i) => {
      view.padMesh.setMatrixAt(i, m4.compose(new THREE.Vector3(s.x, b.y + s.y + 0.25, s.z), none, one));
      view.ringMesh.setMatrixAt(i, m4.compose(new THREE.Vector3(s.x, b.y + s.y + 0.52, s.z), flat, one));
      view.pads.push({ slot: i, label: null, labelKey: '' });
    });
    g.add(view.padMesh, view.ringMesh);
    view.pads.forEach((p) => this.padStyle(view, p, false, null));
    // collector
    const col = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(2.4, 2.6, 0.4, 28), std(0xffd23a, { metalness: 0.4, roughness: 0.3, emissive: 0x3a2a00 }));
    col.position.set(b.collector.x, b.y + 0.2, b.collector.z);
    g.add(col);
    const coin = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.9, 0.9, 0.25, 24), std(0xffe14a, { metalness: 0.6, roughness: 0.25, emissive: 0x4a3a00 }));
    coin.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    coin.position.set(b.collector.x, b.y + 2.2, b.collector.z);
    g.add(coin);
    view.coin = coin;
    // lock pad (big red button)
    const lockBase = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.5, 1.7, 0.4, 20), std(0x3a3a4a));
    lockBase.position.set(b.lockPad.x, b.y + 0.2, b.lockPad.z);
    const lockBtn = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.0, 1.1, 0.4, 20), std(0xff3a4a, { emissive: 0x4a0000 }));
    lockBtn.position.set(b.lockPad.x, b.y + 0.55, b.lockPad.z);
    g.add(lockBase, lockBtn);
    view.lockBtn = lockBtn;
    const lockLabel = makeLabel('🔒 LOCK', { scale: 0.016, bg: '#d8384a', color: '#ffffff' });
    lockLabel.position.set(b.lockPad.x, b.y + 2.3, b.lockPad.z);
    g.add(lockLabel);
    view.labels.push(lockLabel);
    // terminal
    const term = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.6, 2.6, 1.0), std(0x4a5a7a));
    term.position.set(b.terminal.x, b.y + 1.3, b.terminal.z);
    term.rotation.y = b.yaw;
    const screen = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.3, 1.0), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x5affd8 }));
    screen.position.set(b.terminal.x + Math.sin(b.yaw) * 0.51, b.y + 1.9, b.terminal.z + Math.cos(b.yaw) * 0.51);
    screen.rotation.y = b.yaw;
    g.add(term, screen);
    const termLabel = makeLabel('⬆ UPGRADES', { scale: 0.016, bg: '#3a4a7a', color: '#ffffff' });
    termLabel.position.set(b.terminal.x, b.y + 3.6, b.terminal.z);
    g.add(termLabel);
    view.labels.push(termLabel);
    // laser gate: red bars across the door (one instanced draw)
    const doorHalf = CONFIG.bases.doorWidth / 2;
    const laserMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff2a3a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.85 });
    const nBars = 13;
    const bars = new THREE.InstancedMesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.11, 0.11, 6, 6), laserMat, nBars);
    for (let k = 0; k < nBars; k++) {
      const p = b.toWorld(-doorHalf + 0.4 + (k * (doorHalf * 2 - 0.8)) / (nBars - 1), b.half);
      bars.setMatrixAt(k, m4.compose(new THREE.Vector3(p.x, b.y + 3.05, p.z), none, one));
    }
    bars.visible = false;
    g.add(bars);
    view.lasers.push(bars);
    const glow = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(doorHalf * 2 + 0.5, 6.2), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff3a4a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.14, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false }));
    glow.position.set(b.door.x, b.y + 3.1, b.door.z);
    glow.rotation.y = b.yaw;
    glow.visible = false;
    g.add(glow);
    view.laserGlow = glow;
    // dynamic collider used by the local player's physics when lasers are on
    view.gateCollider = boxCollider(b.door.x, b.door.z, doorHalf + 0.4, 0.6, Math.atan2(b.tu.z, b.tu.x), b.y - 2, b.y + 10);
    view.gateCollider.br = doorHalf + 1;
    // banner flag on the roof
    const pole = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.15, 0.15, 9, 6), std(0xd8d8e0));
    const flagPos = b.toWorld(b.half - 2, -b.half + 2);
    pole.position.set(flagPos.x, b.y + TOWER_TOP + 1.6 + 4.5, flagPos.z);
    const flag = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(3.2, 2), std(0xcccccc, { side: THREE.DoubleSide }));
    flag.position.set(flagPos.x - b.tu.x * 1.6, b.y + TOWER_TOP + 1.6 + 7.8, flagPos.z - b.tu.z * 1.6);
    flag.rotation.y = b.yaw + Math.PI / 2;
    g.add(pole, flag);
    view.flag = flag;
    // wooden name board above the door (like a shop sign)
    const board = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(9.5, 2, 0.35), std(0x9a5a32, { roughness: 0.8 }));
    const bp = b.toWorld(0, b.half + 0.75);
    board.position.set(bp.x, b.y + 7.6, bp.z);
    board.rotation.y = b.yaw;
    g.add(board);
    view.boardCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    view.boardCanvas.width = 512;
    view.boardCanvas.height = 108;
    view.boardTex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(view.boardCanvas);
    view.boardTex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    const face = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(9.1, 1.8), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: view.boardTex }));
    face.position.set(bp.x + b.tv.x * 0.19, b.y + 7.6, bp.z + b.tv.z * 0.19);
    face.rotation.y = b.yaw;
    g.add(face);
    this.drawBoard(view, 'Base', '#ffffff');
    this.setSign(view, `Plot ${b.index + 1}\nFREE`, '#ffffff', '#5a5a6a');
    return view;
  }

  drawBoard(view, text, color) {
    if (view.boardText === text) return;
    view.boardText = text;
    const c = view.boardCanvas;
    const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
    ctx.fillStyle = '#9a5a32';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#6e3c1e';
    ctx.lineWidth = 8;
    ctx.strokeRect(4, 4, c.width - 8, c.height - 8);
    ctx.font = '900 58px "Trebuchet MS", system-ui, sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    let size = 58;
    while (ctx.measureText(text).width > c.width - 40 && size > 24) {
      size -= 4;
      ctx.font = `900 ${size}px "Trebuchet MS", system-ui, sans-serif`;
    }
    ctx.lineWidth = 8;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#4a2410';
    ctx.strokeText(text, c.width / 2, c.height / 2 + 3);
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.fillText(text, c.width / 2, c.height / 2 + 3);
    view.boardTex.needsUpdate = true;
  }

  setSign(view, text, color, bg) {
    if (view.sign) {
      view.group.remove(view.sign);
      disposeLabel(view.sign);
    }
    const b = view.base;
    view.sign = makeLabel(text, { scale: 0.015, color, bg, border: '#ffffff' });
    const p = b.toWorld(0, b.half + 0.5);
    view.sign.position.set(p.x, b.y + TOWER_TOP + 5, p.z);
    view.group.add(view.sign);
  }

  colorOf(st) {
    return Number.isInteger(st.color) ? st.color : PALETTE[(st.pn || 0) % PALETTE.length];
  }

  apply(st) {
    const view = this.views[st.index];
    if (!view) return;
    const prev = view.state;
    view.state = st.empty ? null : st;
    this.states[st.index] = view.state;
    this.setDecor(view, st.empty ? [] : st.decor || []);
    if (st.empty) {
      this.setSign(view, `Plot ${st.index + 1}\nFREE`, '#ffffff', '#5a5a6a');
      this.drawBoard(view, 'Base', '#ffffff');
      view.flag.material.color.setHex(0xcccccc);
      for (const [id, m] of view.monsters) this.removeMonster(view, id, m);
      view.pads.forEach((p) => this.padStyle(view, p, false, null));
      this.setLasers(view, false);
      this.setFacilities(view, 0);
      return;
    }
    this.setFacilities(view, st.guardLevel || 0);
    const color = this.colorOf(st);
    const hex = '#' + color.toString(16).padStart(6, '0');
    if (!prev || prev.name !== st.name || prev.color !== st.color || prev.level !== st.level) {
      this.setSign(view, `${st.name}'s Base\nLv ${st.level}`, '#ffffff', hex);
      this.drawBoard(view, `${st.name}'s Base`, '#ffffff');
    }
    view.flag.material.color.setHex(color);
    view.pads.forEach((p, i) => this.padStyle(view, p, i < st.slots, color));
    // monsters on pads
    const wanted = new Map(st.monsters.filter((m) => !m.away).map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    for (const [id, m] of view.monsters) {
      const w = wanted.get(id);
      if (!w || w.slot !== m.slot) this.removeMonster(view, id, m, !w);
    }
    for (const m of wanted.values()) {
      if (!view.monsters.has(m.id)) this.addMonster(view, m);
    }
    for (const p of view.pads) {
      const m = st.monsters.find((x) => x.slot === p.slot);
      const key = m ? `${m.species}|${m.level}|${m.away}` : '';
      if (key !== p.labelKey) {
        if (p.label) {
          view.group.remove(p.label);
          disposeLabel(p.label);
          p.label = null;
        }
        if (m) {
          const sp = SPECIES_BY_ID[m.species];
          p.label = makeLabel(m.away ? `${sp.name}\n⚠ BEING STOLEN!` : `${sp.name} Lv ${m.level}\n$${m.income}/s`, { scale: 0.013, colors: ['#ffffff', m.away ? '#ff6a7a' : '#7ef06a'] });
          const s = view.base.slots[p.slot];
          p.label.position.set(s.x, view.base.y + s.y + 4.4, s.z);
          p.label.visible = false;
          p.alert = !!m.away;
          view.group.add(p.label);
        }
        p.labelKey = key;
      }
    }
    this.setLasers(view, st.lockedUntil > 0);
    if (prev && !(prev.lockedUntil > 0) && st.lockedUntil > 0) this.audio.play('laser');
    this.setStored(view, st.stored);
  }

  // Security that grows with the guard level: a "GUARDED" sign (1+), a guard
  // booth (3+), a barrier at the door (5+), a helipad on the roof (7+) and
  // sweeping searchlights (9+).
  setFacilities(view, level) {
    if (view.facLevel === level) return;
    view.facLevel = level;
    if (view.fac) {
      view.group.remove(view.fac);
      view.fac = null;
      view.searchlights = null;
    }
    if (!level) return;
    const b = view.base;
    const g = new THREE.Group();
    const put = (mesh, u, v, y) => {
      const p = b.toWorld(u, v);
      mesh.position.set(p.x, b.y + y, p.z);
      mesh.rotation.y = b.yaw;
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      g.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    };
    const sign = makeLabel(`💂 GUARDED · Lv ${level}`, { scale: 0.022, color: '#ffffff', bg: level >= 10 ? '#c89a10' : '#2a3a8a', border: '#ffffff' });
    put(sign, 0, b.half + 0.8, 10.5);
    if (level >= 3) {
      put(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(3.2, 3.6, 3.2), std(0xd8dde6)), -9.5, b.half + 5, 1.8);
      put(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(3.6, 0.4, 3.6), std(0x2a3a8a)), -9.5, b.half + 5, 3.8);
      put(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.2, 1.2, 0.1), std(0x8fd8ff, { emissive: 0x1a3a5a })), -9.5, b.half + 6.62, 2.4);
    }
    if (level >= 5) {
      for (const s of [-1, 1]) put(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.6, 2.4, 0.6), std(0x3a3f4a)), s * 6, b.half + 10, 1.2);
      for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
        put(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(2, 0.35, 0.35), std(k % 2 ? 0xffffff : 0xd8384a)), -5 + k * 2, b.half + 10, 2.1);
      }
    }
    if (level >= 7) {
      const top = CONFIG.bases.floors * CONFIG.bases.floorHeight + 0.65;
      put(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(7, 7, 0.1, 32), std(0x3a3f4a)), 0, 0, top);
      const ring = put(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(6, 0.25, 6, 32), std(0xffd23a, { emissive: 0x4a3a00 })), 0, 0, top + 0.08);
      ring.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
      const h = makeLabel('H', { font: '900 120px system-ui', scale: 0.05, color: '#ffffff' });
      put(h, 0, 0, top + 1.5);
    }
    if (level >= 9) {
      view.searchlights = [];
      for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
        put(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.25, 0.35, 10, 8), std(0x3a3f4a)), s * 12.5, b.half + 2, 5);
        const head = put(new THREE.Group(), s * 12.5, b.half + 2, 10.2);
        head.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.6, 0.8, 1.2, 10), std(0x22262c)));
        const beam = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(4, 24, 16, 1, true), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xfff6c0, transparent: true, opacity: 0.18, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide }));
        beam.position.y = -12;
        const arm = new THREE.Group();
        arm.rotation.x = -1.0;
        arm.add(beam);
        head.add(arm);
        view.searchlights.push({ head, s });
      }
    }
    view.group.add(g);
    view.fac = g;
  }

  // Your own base: a tall light beam and a "YOUR BASE" sign you can spot from
  // anywhere nearby (the on-screen 🏠 pointer covers longer distances).
  setMine(index) {
    if (this.myIndex === index && this.mine) return;
    if (this.mine) {
      this.scene.remove(this.mine.group);
      disposeLabel(this.mine.label);
      this.mine = null;
    }
    this.myIndex = index;
    const view = this.views[index];
    if (!view) return;
    const b = view.base;
    const g = new THREE.Group();
    const p = b.toWorld(0, -11.5);
    const beam = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.1, 2.0, 90, 16, 1, true),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffe14a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.2, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide, fog: false }),
    );
    beam.position.set(p.x, b.y + TOWER_TOP + 1.6 + 45, p.z);
    const label = makeLabel('🏠 YOUR BASE', { scale: 0.032, bg: '#3fbf5a', color: '#ffffff', border: '#ffffff' });
    label.position.set(b.x, b.y + TOWER_TOP + 10, b.z);
    g.add(beam, label);
    this.scene.add(g);
    this.mine = { group: g, beam, label };
  }

  // Decorations on the wall spots: rebuild only the spots that changed.
  setDecor(view, list) {
    view.decor.forEach((cur, i) => {
      const want = list[i] || null;
      if ((cur?.id || null) === want) return;
      if (cur) view.group.remove(cur.obj);
      view.decor[i] = null;
      const obj = want ? buildDecor(want) : null;
      if (!obj) return;
      const spot = view.base.decor[i];
      obj.position.set(spot.x, view.base.y, spot.z);
      obj.rotation.y = spot.yaw;
      view.group.add(obj);
      view.decor[i] = { id: want, obj };
      if (cur) this.effects.burst(spot.x, view.base.y + 1, spot.z, 10, { color: [0xffe14a, 0xffffff], speed: 3 });
    });
  }

  padStyle(view, p, unlocked, color) {
    TMP_COLOR.setHex(unlocked ? 0x63e070 : 0x5d6068); // green pads, grey while locked
    view.padMesh.setColorAt(p.slot, TMP_COLOR);
    TMP_COLOR.setHex(unlocked && color ? color : 0x6a6f7a);
    view.ringMesh.setColorAt(p.slot, TMP_COLOR);
    view.padMesh.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
    view.ringMesh.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
  }

  setLasers(view, on) {
    for (const l of view.lasers) l.visible = on;
    view.laserGlow.visible = on;
    view.locked = on;
  }

  setStored(view, amount) {
    if (view.storedAmount === amount) return;
    view.storedAmount = amount;
    if (view.storedLabel) {
      view.group.remove(view.storedLabel);
      disposeLabel(view.storedLabel);
    }
    const b = view.base;
    view.storedLabel = makeLabel(`$${Math.floor(amount).toLocaleString()}`, { scale: 0.022, color: '#7ef06a', font: '900 46px "Trebuchet MS", system-ui, sans-serif' });
    view.storedLabel.position.set(b.collector.x, b.y + 3.8, b.collector.z);
    view.storedLabel.visible = view.near !== false;
    view.group.add(view.storedLabel);
  }

  setStoredAll(list) {
    for (const [i, amount] of list) if (this.views[i] && this.views[i].state) this.setStored(this.views[i], amount);
  }

  addMonster(view, m) {
    const sp = SPECIES_BY_ID[m.species];
    if (!sp) return;
    const rig = buildMonster(sp.id);
    const s = Math.min(sp.size, 3.3 / rig.height);
    rig.root.scale.setScalar(s);
    const slot = view.base.slots[m.slot];
    rig.root.position.set(slot.x, view.base.y + slot.y + 0.5, slot.z);
    rig.root.rotation.y = view.base.yaw;
    rig.baseYaw = view.base.yaw;
    rig.st = { pose: 'celebrate', poseT: 0 };
    rig.nextQuirk = 2 + Math.random() * 6;
    this.scene.add(rig.root);
    view.monsters.set(m.id, { rig, rigHi: rig, rigLo: null, slot: m.slot, species: sp });
    this.effects.burst(slot.x, view.base.y + 1.5, slot.z, 14, { color: [0xffe14a, 0xffffff, 0xff9fd8], speed: 4 });
  }

  removeMonster(view, id, m, poof = true) {
    this.scene.remove(m.rig.root);
    view.monsters.delete(id);
    if (poof) {
      const p = m.rig.root.position;
      this.effects.burst(p.x, p.y + 1, p.z, 10, { color: [0xffffff, 0xd8d8ff], speed: 3 });
    }
  }

  // colliders for the local player (closed laser gates of other bases)
  resolveGates(pos, myIndex) {
    for (const view of this.views) {
      if (!view.locked || view.base.index === myIndex) continue;
      const c = view.gateCollider;
      const dx = pos.x - c.x;
      const dz = pos.z - c.z;
      if (dx * dx + dz * dz > 100) continue;
      const lu = dx * c.ax + dz * c.az;
      const lv = -dx * c.az + dz * c.ax;
      const r = 0.9;
      if (Math.abs(lu) < c.hw + r && Math.abs(lv) < c.hd + r) {
        // push out along the door normal
        const push = (c.hd + r - Math.abs(lv)) * (Math.sign(lv) || 1);
        pos.x += -c.az * push;
        pos.z += c.ax * push;
      }
    }
  }

  // Far bases drop their small labels and show low-poly monsters; very far
  // ones are hidden (the walls are part of the static world mesh).
  applyDistance(view, camPos) {
    const b = view.base;
    const d = Math.hypot(camPos.x - b.x, camPos.z - b.z);
    view.dist = d;
    view.group.visible = d < SHOW_BASE;
    const near = d < NEAR_LABELS;
    if (near !== view.near) {
      view.near = near;
      for (const l of view.labels) l.visible = near;
      if (view.storedLabel) view.storedLabel.visible = near;
    }
    // the big owner sign is for spotting bases from afar; up close it would
    // hide the monsters behind it
    if (view.sign) view.sign.visible = d > b.half + 20;
    for (const [id, m] of view.monsters) {
      const wantLo = m.rig.lod === 'lo' ? d > HI_MONSTERS - 6 : d > HI_MONSTERS;
      if (wantLo !== (m.rig.lod === 'lo')) {
        const from = m.rig;
        let to = wantLo ? m.rigLo : m.rigHi;
        if (!to) {
          to = buildMonster(m.species.id, { lod: 'lo' });
          m.rigLo = to;
        }
        to.root.position.copy(from.root.position);
        to.root.rotation.copy(from.root.rotation);
        to.root.scale.copy(from.root.scale);
        to.baseYaw = from.baseYaw;
        to.st = from.st;
        to.nextQuirk = from.nextQuirk;
        this.scene.remove(from.root);
        this.scene.add(to.root);
        m.rig = to;
      }
      if (m.rig.lod === 'hi') setRigDetail(m.rig, d < 24);
      m.rig.root.visible = d < SHOW_MONSTERS;
    }
  }

  update(dt, t, players, camPos) {
    this.frame = (this.frame || 0) + 1;
    const me = players[0];
    if (this.mine) {
      const v = this.views[this.myIndex];
      // the sign would only get in the way inside your own base
      this.mine.label.visible = (v.dist ?? 99) > v.base.half + 14;
      this.mine.beam.material.opacity = 0.16 + Math.sin(t * 2) * 0.05;
      const st = v.state;
      if (st) this.mine.beam.material.color.setHex(this.colorOf(st));
    }
    for (const view of this.views) {
      if (camPos) this.applyDistance(view, camPos);
      if (!view.state) continue;
      // pad labels (name, level, income) only for the pads you walk up to
      for (const p of view.pads) {
        if (!p.label) continue;
        const s = view.base.slots[p.slot];
        const sameFloor = !!me && Math.abs((me.y ?? view.base.y) - (view.base.y + s.y)) < 3;
        p.label.visible = view.near && (p.alert || (sameFloor && Math.hypot(me.x - s.x, me.z - s.z) < PAD_LABEL_DIST));
      }
      if (view.searchlights) for (const sl of view.searchlights) sl.head.rotation.y = view.base.yaw + Math.sin(t * 0.7 + sl.s) * 1.2;
      view.coin.rotation.z = t * 2;
      view.coin.position.y = view.base.y + 2.2 + Math.sin(t * 2) * 0.2;
      if (view.locked) {
        for (const l of view.lasers) l.material.opacity = 0.65 + Math.sin(t * 20) * 0.25;
        view.lockBtn.material.emissive.setHex(0x00aa44);
        view.lockBtn.material.color.setHex(0x3fd85a);
      } else {
        view.lockBtn.material.emissive.setHex(0x4a0000);
        view.lockBtn.material.color.setHex(0xff3a4a);
        view.lockBtn.position.y = view.base.y + 0.55 + Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * 4)) * 0.08;
      }
      const far = view.dist > HI_MONSTERS;
      if (view.dist > SHOW_MONSTERS) continue;
      if (far && (this.frame + view.base.index) % 3 !== 0) continue;
      const adt = far ? dt * 3 : dt;
      for (const m of view.monsters.values()) {
        const rig = m.rig;
        const st = rig.st;
        // look at the closest player nearby, with personality idles in between
        let look = null;
        let bestD = 15;
        for (const p of players) {
          const d = Math.hypot(p.x - rig.root.position.x, p.z - rig.root.position.z);
          if (d < bestD) {
            bestD = d;
            look = p;
          }
        }
        rig.nextQuirk -= adt;
        if (st.pose === 'celebrate' && st.poseT > 1.6) {
          st.pose = 'idle';
          st.poseT = 0;
        } else if (st.pose === 'quirk' && st.poseT > 3.5) {
          st.pose = 'idle';
          st.poseT = 0;
        } else if (st.pose === 'idle' && rig.nextQuirk < 0) {
          const idles = m.species.personality.idles;
          st.pose = 'quirk';
          st.quirk = Math.random() < 0.75 ? idles[Math.floor(Math.random() * idles.length)] : QUIRK_NAMES[Math.floor(Math.random() * QUIRK_NAMES.length)];
          st.quirkDur = 3.5;
          st.poseT = 0;
          rig.nextQuirk = 5 + Math.random() * 8;
        }
        if (look && st.pose === 'idle') {
          const want = Math.atan2(look.x - rig.root.position.x, look.z - rig.root.position.z);
          let d = want - rig.root.rotation.y;
          while (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
          while (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
          rig.root.rotation.y += d * Math.min(1, adt * 3);
        } else {
          let d = rig.baseYaw - rig.root.rotation.y;
          while (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
          while (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
          rig.root.rotation.y += d * Math.min(1, adt * 1.5);
        }
        animateMonster(rig, st, adt, t);
        if (rig.sparking && Math.random() < adt * 10) this.effects.aura('spark', rig.root.position.x, rig.root.position.y + 2, rig.root.position.z);
        if (rig.blowing && Math.random() < adt * 3) this.effects.aura('bubble', rig.root.position.x, rig.root.position.y + 2, rig.root.position.z);
      }
    }
  }

  // placed monster nearest to a position (for stealing prompts)
  nearestPlaced(pos, maxD, exceptIndex) {
    let best = null;
    let bd = maxD;
    for (const view of this.views) {
      if (!view.state || view.base.index === exceptIndex) continue;
      for (const [id, m] of view.monsters) {
        const s = view.base.slots[m.slot];
        if (Math.abs(pos.y - (view.base.y + s.y)) > 3) continue; // another floor
        const d = Math.hypot(pos.x - s.x, pos.z - s.z);
        if (d < bd) {
          bd = d;
          best = { id, view, m, slot: s };
        }
      }
    }
    return best;
  }
}

// Save storage for the in-browser game (single-player): profiles and the
// ownership ledger in localStorage, with the previous copy kept as a backup.
// Same interface as server/storage.js.

const PREFIX = 'sam_save_';

function read(key) {
  const raw = localStorage.getItem(PREFIX + key);
  return raw === null ? null : JSON.parse(raw);
}

function write(key, data) {
  const k = PREFIX + key;
  const prev = localStorage.getItem(k);
  if (prev !== null) localStorage.setItem(`${k}.bak`, prev);
  localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(data));
}

export class BrowserStore {
  async loadProfile(id) {
    try {
      return read(`profile_${id}`);
    } catch {
      // damaged save: fall back to the previous copy
      const bak = localStorage.getItem(`${PREFIX}profile_${id}.bak`);
      if (bak === null) throw new Error('Your saved progress could not be loaded.');
      return JSON.parse(bak);
    }
  }

  async saveProfile(id, data) {
    write(`profile_${id}`, data);
  }

  async loadLedger() {
    try {
      return read('ledger') || {};
    } catch {
      return {};
    }
  }

  async saveLedger(data) {
    write('ledger', data);
  }
}

// Third-person orbit camera that follows the player and avoids the ground.

import * as THREE from 'three';
import { WATER_Y } from '#shared/world.js';

export class ThirdPersonCamera {
  constructor(camera, world) {
    this.camera = camera;
    this.world = world;
    this.yaw = Math.PI;      // camera looks along -yaw direction toward the player
    this.pitch = 0.32;
    this.distance = 15;
    this.target = new THREE.Vector3();
    this.smoothed = new THREE.Vector3();
    this.shake = 0;
    this.invertY = false;
  }

  // yaw convention: the camera sits behind the player at angle `yaw`;
  // "forward" for movement is (sin(yaw+PI), cos(yaw+PI)).
  forward() {
    return { x: -Math.sin(this.yaw), z: -Math.cos(this.yaw) };
  }

  addShake(amount) {
    this.shake = Math.min(1.5, this.shake + amount);
  }

  // indoor: { base, floorY } while the player is inside a base tower: the
  // camera then stays inside the walls and under the ceiling of that floor.
  update(dt, focus, look, zoom, indoor = null) {
    this.yaw -= look.x * 0.0042;
    this.pitch += (this.invertY ? -1 : 1) * look.y * 0.0036;
    this.pitch = Math.max(-0.35, Math.min(1.35, this.pitch));
    this.distance = Math.max(6, Math.min(34, this.distance + zoom * 1.6));
    this.target.set(focus.x, focus.y + 3.6, focus.z);
    if (this.smoothed.lengthSq() === 0) this.smoothed.copy(this.target);
    this.smoothed.lerp(this.target, Math.min(1, dt * 14));
    const cp = Math.cos(this.pitch);
    let d = this.distance;
    const pos = new THREE.Vector3(
      this.smoothed.x + Math.sin(this.yaw) * cp * d,
      this.smoothed.y + Math.sin(this.pitch) * d,
      this.smoothed.z + Math.cos(this.yaw) * cp * d,
    );
    // keep the camera above the terrain (pull in if a hill is in the way)
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const g = Math.max(this.world.groundHeight(pos.x, pos.z), WATER_Y - 0.5) + 1.2;
      if (pos.y >= g) break;
      d *= 0.8;
      pos.set(
        this.smoothed.x + Math.sin(this.yaw) * cp * d,
        this.smoothed.y + Math.sin(this.pitch) * d,
        this.smoothed.z + Math.cos(this.yaw) * cp * d,
      );
    }
    const g = Math.max(this.world.groundHeight(pos.x, pos.z), WATER_Y - 0.5) + 1.2;
    if (pos.y < g) pos.y = g;
    if (indoor) this.keepInside(pos, indoor);
    if (this.shake > 0) {
      pos.x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * this.shake * 0.5;
      pos.y += (Math.random() - 0.5) * this.shake * 0.5;
      this.shake = Math.max(0, this.shake - dt * 3);
    }
    this.camera.position.copy(pos);
    this.camera.lookAt(this.smoothed);
  }

  keepInside(pos, { base, floorY, floorHeight }) {
    const lim = base.half - 1.4;
    const dx = pos.x - base.x;
    const dz = pos.z - base.z;
    let u = dx * base.tu.x + dz * base.tu.z;
    let v = dx * base.tv.x + dz * base.tv.z;
    u = Math.max(-lim, Math.min(lim, u));
    v = Math.max(-lim, Math.min(lim, v));
    pos.x = base.x + base.tu.x * u + base.tv.x * v;
    pos.z = base.z + base.tu.z * u + base.tv.z * v;
    pos.y = Math.max(floorY + 1.2, Math.min(floorY + floorHeight - 0.9, pos.y));
  }
}

FILE: public/client/captureFx.js

// The capture animation after a recruit is paid for (purely visual; the
// server has already moved the monster into the player's collection):
//   1. a glowing ring rises around the monster inside a beam of light while
//      the monster spins and shrinks (monstersView animates the monster),
//   2. it turns into a glowing orb that flies in an arc to the player,
//   3. the orb pops on the player: sparkles, "CAUGHT!", a cheer, and the
//      monster hops out next to them as a follower (playersView).

import * as THREE from 'three';
import { glowSprite } from './labels.js';

export const CAPTURE_SHRINK = 0.9; // seconds the monster spins and shrinks
const SHRINK = CAPTURE_SHRINK;
const FLIGHT = 0.6;   // seconds the orb flies

const ringGeo = new THREE.TorusGeometry(1, 0.09, 8, 40);
const beamGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 24, 1, true);
const orbGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.42, 16, 12);

export class CaptureFx {
  constructor(scene, effects, audio) {
    this.scene = scene;
    this.effects = effects;
    this.audio = audio;
    this.list = [];
  }

  // from: monster position (feet), height: monster height, color: rarity
  // colour, target(): where the catcher is now (a Vector3 at the feet)
  start({ from, height, color, target, name, mine, onLand }) {
    const c = new THREE.Color(color);
    const ringMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: c, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9, depthWrite: false });
    const beamMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: c, transparent: true, opacity: 0.25, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending });
    const orbMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, emissive: c, emissiveIntensity: 1.4, roughness: 0.2 });
    const r = Math.max(1.4, height * 0.75);
    const ring = new THREE.Mesh(ringGeo, ringMat);
    ring.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    ring.scale.setScalar(r);
    ring.position.copy(from);
    const ring2 = ring.clone();
    ring2.material = ringMat;
    const beam = new THREE.Mesh(beamGeo, beamMat);
    beam.scale.set(r * 0.9, 14, r * 0.9);
    beam.position.set(from.x, from.y + 7, from.z);
    const orb = new THREE.Group();
    orb.add(new THREE.Mesh(orbGeo, orbMat));
    const halo = glowSprite(color, 3.2, 0.9);
    orb.add(halo);
    orb.visible = false;
    this.scene.add(ring, ring2, beam, orb);
    this.list.push({ t: 0, from: from.clone(), height, r, ring, ring2, beam, orb, ringMat, beamMat, orbMat, color: c.getHex(), target, name, mine, onLand, landed: false });
    if (this.audio) this.audio.play('capture');
  }

  update(dt) {
    for (let i = this.list.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const f = this.list[i];
      f.t += dt;
      const k = Math.min(1, f.t / SHRINK);
      // rings rise up the monster and pulse; the beam fades in, then out
      const ease = 1 - (1 - k) ** 2;
      f.ring.position.y = f.from.y + 0.2 + ease * f.height * 0.9;
      f.ring2.position.y = f.from.y + 0.2 + ease * f.height * 0.35;
      f.ring.rotation.z += dt * 4;
      f.ring.scale.setScalar(f.r * (1 - 0.45 * ease));
      f.ring2.scale.setScalar(f.r * (1.1 - 0.3 * ease));
      f.ringMat.opacity = f.t < SHRINK ? 0.9 : Math.max(0, 0.9 - (f.t - SHRINK) * 3);
      f.beamMat.opacity = f.t < SHRINK ? 0.28 * Math.min(1, f.t * 4) : Math.max(0, 0.28 - (f.t - SHRINK) * 0.8);
      if (f.t < SHRINK && Math.random() < 0.6) {
        const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        this.effects.spawn(f.from.x + Math.cos(a) * f.r, f.from.y + Math.random() * f.height, f.from.z + Math.sin(a) * f.r, {
          vx: -Math.cos(a) * 2, vz: -Math.sin(a) * 2, vy: 2, life: 0.5, size: 0.16, grav: 0, color: [f.color, 0xffffff],
        });
      }
      // the orb
      if (f.t >= SHRINK && !f.landed) {
        const q = Math.min(1, (f.t - SHRINK) / FLIGHT);
        const start = new THREE.Vector3(f.from.x, f.from.y + f.height * 0.6, f.from.z);
        const to = f.target ? f.target() : null;
        if (!to) {
          f.landed = true;
        } else {
          const end = new THREE.Vector3(to.x, to.y + 3, to.z);
          const dist = start.distanceTo(end);
          // an arc: up and over, a bit higher for longer throws
          const p = start.clone().lerp(end, q);
          p.y += Math.sin(q * Math.PI) * (2.5 + dist * 0.25);
          f.orb.position.copy(p);
          f.orb.visible = true;
          f.orb.scale.setScalar(1 + Math.sin(f.t * 30) * 0.08);
          if (Math.random() < 0.8) this.effects.spawn(p.x, p.y, p.z, { speed: 0.6, up: 0.2, life: 0.4, size: 0.18, grav: 0, color: [f.color, 0xffffff] });
          if (q >= 1) {
            f.landed = true;
            f.orb.visible = false;
            this.effects.burst(end.x, end.y, end.z, 26, { color: [f.color, 0xffffff, 0xff9fd8, 0xffe14a], speed: 7, up: 1, life: 0.9, size: 0.24, grav: 6 });
            this.effects.number(f.mine ? `CAUGHT ${f.name}!` : 'CAUGHT!', new THREE.Vector3(end.x, end.y + 3.2, end.z), 'crit');
            if (this.audio && f.mine) this.audio.play('caught');
            if (f.onLand) f.onLand();
          }
        }
      }
      if (f.landed && f.t > SHRINK + FLIGHT + 0.5) {
        this.scene.remove(f.ring, f.ring2, f.beam, f.orb);
        f.ringMat.dispose();
        f.beamMat.dispose();
        f.orbMat.dispose();
        f.orb.children[1]?.material?.dispose();
        this.list.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
  }
}

// Procedural 3D models for base decorations (shared/decor.js).
// Each model is built once from shared geometries and materials, then cloned.
// The front of every model faces +z; basesView turns it to face into the base.

import * as THREE from 'three';

const geo = {
  box: new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1),
  sphere: new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 16, 12),
  hemi: new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 16, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2),
  cyl: new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 16),
  cone: new THREE.ConeGeometry(1, 1, 12),
  torus: new THREE.TorusGeometry(1, 0.35, 10, 24),
  octa: new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(1, 0),
  cup: new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 0.55, 1, 16, 1, true),
};

const matCache = new Map();
function mat(color, o = {}) {
  const key = `${color}|${o.emissive || 0}|${o.ei ?? ''}|${o.metal || 0}|${o.rough ?? 0.6}|${o.side || 0}`;
  if (!matCache.has(key)) {
    matCache.set(key, new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color,
      emissive: o.emissive || 0,
      emissiveIntensity: o.emissive ? (o.ei ?? 0.8) : 0,
      metalness: o.metal || 0,
      roughness: o.rough ?? 0.6,
      side: o.side || THREE.FrontSide,
    }));
  }
  return matCache.get(key);
}

function part(g, geometry, material, [x, y, z], [sx, sy, sz], rot) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
  m.position.set(x, y, z);
  m.scale.set(sx, sy, sz);
  if (rot) m.rotation.set(rot[0], rot[1], rot[2]);
  m.castShadow = true;
  g.add(m);
  return m;
}

const BUILDERS = {
  flower_bed(g) {
    part(g, geo.box, mat(0x8a5a3a), [0, 0.2, 0], [2.4, 0.4, 1.3]);
    part(g, geo.box, mat(0x5a3a22), [0, 0.42, 0], [2.2, 0.06, 1.1]);
    const colors = [0xff5a8a, 0xffd23a, 0xa86bff, 0xff8a3a, 0x5ac8ff, 0xff7ad8];
    colors.forEach((c, i) => {
      const x = -0.85 + (i % 3) * 0.85;
      const z = i < 3 ? -0.25 : 0.25;
      part(g, geo.cyl, mat(0x3fae44), [x, 0.75, z], [0.05, 0.6, 0.05]);
      part(g, geo.sphere, mat(c), [x, 1.1, z], [0.22, 0.16, 0.22]);
      part(g, geo.sphere, mat(0xfff3a0), [x, 1.14, z + 0.12], [0.08, 0.08, 0.05]);
    });
  },
  snack_bowl(g) {
    const bowl = part(g, geo.hemi, mat(0x5ac8ff, { rough: 0.3, side: THREE.DoubleSide }), [0, 0.75, 0], [0.9, 0.6, 0.9]);
    bowl.rotation.x = Math.PI;
    part(g, geo.cyl, mat(0x3a9ad8), [0, 0.1, 0], [0.5, 0.2, 0.5]);
    [[0, 0.75, 0, 0xff7a3a], [0.3, 0.72, 0.2, 0xffd23a], [-0.3, 0.72, 0.15, 0xff5a8a], [0.1, 0.8, -0.3, 0x8fd46b], [-0.15, 0.85, -0.05, 0xc46bff]].forEach(([x, y, z, c]) => {
      part(g, geo.sphere, mat(c), [x, y, z], [0.2, 0.2, 0.2]);
    });
  },
  lantern(g) {
    part(g, geo.cyl, mat(0x5a3a22), [0, 1.3, 0], [0.08, 2.6, 0.08]);
    part(g, geo.box, mat(0x5a3a22), [0, 2.55, 0.35], [0.1, 0.1, 0.8]);
    part(g, geo.cyl, mat(0x3a2a1a), [0, 2.4, 0.7], [0.02, 0.3, 0.02]);
    part(g, geo.sphere, mat(0xff4a3a, { emissive: 0xff5a2a }), [0, 1.95, 0.7], [0.42, 0.52, 0.42]);
    part(g, geo.cyl, mat(0xffc23a, { metal: 0.6, rough: 0.3 }), [0, 2.45, 0.7], [0.22, 0.08, 0.22]);
    part(g, geo.cyl, mat(0xffc23a, { metal: 0.6, rough: 0.3 }), [0, 1.45, 0.7], [0.22, 0.08, 0.22]);
  },
  monster_bed(g) {
    part(g, geo.torus, mat(0xff8fc8, { rough: 0.9 }), [0, 0.35, 0], [1.0, 1.0, 0.9], [Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]);
    part(g, geo.cyl, mat(0xfff0f6, { rough: 0.95 }), [0, 0.2, 0], [0.95, 0.25, 0.95]);
    part(g, geo.sphere, mat(0xfff0f6, { rough: 0.95 }), [0.3, 0.45, -0.3], [0.35, 0.18, 0.25]);
  },
  mushroom_lamp(g) {
    part(g, geo.cyl, mat(0xf3ead6), [0, 0.8, 0], [0.28, 1.6, 0.28]);
    part(g, geo.hemi, mat(0x9a5aff, { emissive: 0x7a3aff }), [0, 1.55, 0], [1.1, 0.8, 1.1]);
    [[0.5, 1.95, 0.4], [-0.45, 1.9, 0.45], [0, 2.25, -0.1], [0.2, 1.85, -0.75], [-0.6, 1.8, -0.35]].forEach((p) => {
      part(g, geo.sphere, mat(0xfff3ff, { emissive: 0xffd8ff }), p, [0.16, 0.08, 0.16]);
    });
  },
  fountain(g) {
    part(g, geo.cyl, mat(0xcfd8e8, { rough: 0.5 }), [0, 0.3, 0], [1.25, 0.6, 1.25]);
    part(g, geo.cyl, mat(0x3fb4ff, { emissive: 0x1a6aaa, rough: 0.05 }), [0, 0.56, 0], [1.08, 0.06, 1.08]);
    part(g, geo.cyl, mat(0xcfd8e8, { rough: 0.5 }), [0, 1.0, 0], [0.22, 1.0, 0.22]);
    part(g, geo.cyl, mat(0xcfd8e8, { rough: 0.5 }), [0, 1.5, 0], [0.6, 0.15, 0.6]);
    part(g, geo.sphere, mat(0x8fe0ff, { emissive: 0x3a9ad8, rough: 0.05 }), [0, 1.75, 0], [0.22, 0.3, 0.22]);
    [[0.6, 0.8, 0.3], [-0.5, 0.9, -0.4], [0.2, 1.1, -0.6]].forEach((p) => {
      part(g, geo.sphere, mat(0xd8f4ff, { emissive: 0x6ac8ff, rough: 0.05 }), p, [0.12, 0.12, 0.12]);
    });
  },
  crystal_cluster(g) {
    part(g, geo.sphere, mat(0x6a5a5a, { rough: 0.95 }), [0, 0.15, 0], [0.9, 0.35, 0.8]);
    [[0, 1.0, 0, 0.35, 1.0, 0, 0xc46bff], [0.45, 0.7, 0.2, 0.25, 0.7, -0.35, 0x6af0ff], [-0.45, 0.65, 0.15, 0.25, 0.6, 0.4, 0xff6af0], [0.1, 0.6, -0.45, 0.22, 0.55, 0.3, 0x8f9aff]].forEach(([x, y, z, w, h, tilt, c]) => {
      part(g, geo.octa, mat(c, { emissive: c, rough: 0.1 }), [x, y, z], [w, h, w], [tilt, 0, -tilt * 0.6]);
    });
  },
  gold_statue(g) {
    // low metalness: there is no environment map, so very metallic looks dark
    const gold = mat(0xffc23a, { metal: 0.3, rough: 0.3, emissive: 0x5a3a00 });
    part(g, geo.box, mat(0xd8d2c0, { rough: 0.8 }), [0, 0.35, 0], [1.5, 0.7, 1.5]);
    part(g, geo.sphere, gold, [0, 1.35, 0], [0.62, 0.6, 0.55]);   // body
    part(g, geo.sphere, gold, [0, 2.15, 0.12], [0.55, 0.5, 0.5]);   // head
    part(g, geo.sphere, gold, [0, 2.0, 0.55], [0.26, 0.2, 0.2]);    // snout
    part(g, geo.cone, gold, [0.25, 2.65, 0], [0.1, 0.3, 0.1], [0, 0, -0.3]);
    part(g, geo.cone, gold, [-0.25, 2.65, 0], [0.1, 0.3, 0.1], [0, 0, 0.3]);
    part(g, geo.cone, gold, [0.6, 1.6, -0.2], [0.35, 0.7, 0.08], [0.3, 0, -1.0]); // wings
    part(g, geo.cone, gold, [-0.6, 1.6, -0.2], [0.35, 0.7, 0.08], [0.3, 0, 1.0]);
    part(g, geo.sphere, mat(0x2a1a10), [0.2, 2.22, 0.55], [0.09, 0.11, 0.05]);    // eyes
    part(g, geo.sphere, mat(0x2a1a10), [-0.2, 2.22, 0.55], [0.09, 0.11, 0.05]);
  },
  trophy(g, color) {
    const metal = mat(color, { metal: 0.35, rough: 0.25, emissive: new THREE.Color(color).multiplyScalar(0.25).getHex() });
    part(g, geo.box, mat(0x3a2a4a, { rough: 0.7 }), [0, 0.25, 0], [0.9, 0.5, 0.9]);
    part(g, geo.cyl, metal, [0, 0.75, 0], [0.12, 0.5, 0.12]);
    part(g, geo.cyl, metal, [0, 1.0, 0], [0.32, 0.08, 0.32]);
    part(g, geo.cup, metal, [0, 1.5, 0], [0.55, 0.9, 0.55]);
    part(g, geo.torus, metal, [0.6, 1.55, 0], [0.22, 0.25, 0.22]);
    part(g, geo.torus, metal, [-0.6, 1.55, 0], [0.22, 0.25, 0.22]);
    part(g, geo.sphere, mat(0xff5a8a, { emissive: 0xaa2a4a }), [0, 2.1, 0], [0.12, 0.12, 0.12]);
  },
  trophy_bronze(g) { BUILDERS.trophy(g, 0xc97a3a); },
  trophy_silver(g) { BUILDERS.trophy(g, 0xdfe6ee); },
  trophy_gold(g) { BUILDERS.trophy(g, 0xffc23a); },
};

const templates = new Map();

export function buildDecor(id) {
  if (!BUILDERS[id] || id === 'trophy') return null;
  if (!templates.has(id)) {
    const g = new THREE.Group();
    BUILDERS[id](g);
    templates.set(id, g);
  }
  return templates.get(id).clone(true);
}
