// Visual effects: pooled blocky particles (one InstancedMesh), floating
// damage numbers (DOM), attack telegraphs on the ground, and projectiles.
// Everything is capped so effects can never pile up.

import * as THREE from 'three';

const MAX_PARTICLES = 700;
const MAX_NUMBERS = 40;

const AURA_COLORS = {
  leaf: [0x7ad85a, 0xa8ef7a], spark: [0xfff27a, 0xffffff], ember: [0xff8a2a, 0xffd23a], glitter: [0xffffff, 0xffc2f4],
  snow: [0xffffff, 0xd8f6ff], bubble: [0xbff1ff, 0xffffff], dust: [0xc9a27a, 0xe8d0b0], glow: [0xfff27a, 0x7affd8],
  shadow: [0x9a6bff, 0x3a2a6a], petal: [0xff9fd8, 0xffe27a], star: [0xfff7a8, 0xb48cff], rune: [0x5fe3c0, 0xbffff0],
  pixel: [0xff3df2, 0x3dfff2], coin: [0xffd23a, 0xfff27a],
  holy: [0xfff6c0, 0xffffff, 0xffd23a], thunder: [0xfff27a, 0xffffff, 0x8fb8ff], cosmic: [0xff7ae0, 0x7affd8, 0xfff27a],
};

// how each Legend power's particles move (elementBurst)
const ELEMENT_MOTION = {
  fire: { grav: -3, up: 1.2, life: 0.8, size: 0.32 },
  ice: { grav: 10, up: 1.4, life: 0.8, size: 0.26 },
  lightning: { grav: 0, up: 0.4, life: 0.28, size: 0.18, speed: 2.2 },
  shadow: { grav: -0.8, up: 0.4, life: 1.1, size: 0.45, speed: 0.6 },
  light: { grav: -1.5, up: 1, life: 1.0, size: 0.22 },
  cosmic: { grav: 0, up: 0.5, life: 1.0, size: 0.24, speed: 1.3 },
};
const Y_AXIS = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);

const ease = (k) => 1 - (1 - k) ** 3;

export class Effects {
  constructor(scene, camera) {
    this.scene = scene;
    this.camera = camera;
    const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);
    const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.95, depthWrite: false });
    this.mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, mat, MAX_PARTICLES);
    this.mesh.frustumCulled = false;
    this.mesh.instanceMatrix.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
    this.mesh.setColorAt(0, new THREE.Color());
    this.mesh.count = 0;
    this.mesh.renderOrder = 4;
    scene.add(this.mesh);
    this.p = [];
    this.free = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_PARTICLES; i++) {
      this.p.push({ alive: false, x: 0, y: 0, z: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, vz: 0, life: 0, max: 1, size: 0.2, grav: 0, color: new THREE.Color(), spin: 0, rot: 0 });
      this.free.push(MAX_PARTICLES - 1 - i);
    }
    this.m4 = new THREE.Matrix4();
    this.q = new THREE.Quaternion();
    this.numbers = [];
    this.numberRoot = document.body;
    this.telegraphs = [];
    this.projectiles = new Map();
    this.tmpV = new THREE.Vector3();
    this.shapes = []; // short-lived meshes: slash waves, blast rings, lightning
    this.timers = []; // staged effects (later)
  }

  // run fn after `sec` seconds (effects that come in stages)
  later(sec, fn) {
    if (sec <= 0) fn();
    else this.timers.push({ t: sec, fn });
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ costume powers

  addShape(mesh, dur, step) {
    mesh.renderOrder = 5;
    this.scene.add(mesh);
    this.shapes.push({ mesh, t: 0, dur, step });
    step(mesh, 0);
    if (this.shapes.length > 90) this.dropShape(0);
  }

  dropShape(i) {
    const s = this.shapes[i];
    this.scene.remove(s.mesh);
    s.mesh.geometry.dispose();
    s.mesh.material.dispose();
    this.shapes.splice(i, 1);
  }

  // a glowing crescent that flies forward (Black Spy's Master Power)
  slashWave(x, y, z, yaw, range, arcDeg, color) {
    const arc = (arcDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
    const geo = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.75, 1, 40, 1, Math.PI / 2 - arc / 2, arc);
    const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color, transparent: true, opacity: 0.95, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, toneMapped: false });
    const core = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
    core.rotation.set(-Math.PI / 2, 0, -yaw);
    core.position.set(x, y + 2.2, z);
    this.addShape(core, 0.6, (m, k) => {
      const r = 1.5 + k * range;
      m.scale.set(r, r, 1);
      m.material.opacity = 0.95 * (1 - k * k);
    });
    // a second, dark inner edge for the spy look
    const geo2 = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.6, 0.78, 40, 1, Math.PI / 2 - arc / 2, arc);
    const dark = new THREE.Mesh(geo2, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x14141c, transparent: true, opacity: 0.8, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false }));
    dark.rotation.copy(core.rotation);
    dark.position.copy(core.position);
    this.addShape(dark, 0.6, (m, k) => {
      const r = 1.5 + k * range;
      m.scale.set(r, r, 1);
      m.material.opacity = 0.8 * (1 - k);
    });
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
      const a = yaw + (Math.random() - 0.5) * arc;
      const sp = range * (1.6 + Math.random() * 0.8);
      this.spawn(x, y + 1.6 + Math.random() * 1.4, z, { vx: Math.sin(a) * sp, vz: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: 0.4, grav: 0, life: 0.5, size: 0.22, color: [color, 0xffffff, 0x14141c] });
    }
  }

  // a flat ring that grows around you (fire, blizzard, sweet hug)
  ringBlast(x, y, z, radius, colors) {
    const geo = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.85, 1, 48);
    const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: colors[0], transparent: true, opacity: 0.9, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, toneMapped: false });
    const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
    m.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    m.position.set(x, y + 0.4, z);
    this.addShape(m, 0.5, (mm, k) => {
      const r = 0.5 + k * radius;
      mm.scale.set(r, r, 1);
      mm.material.opacity = 0.9 * (1 - k);
    });
    const n = 48;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2;
      const sp = radius / 0.45;
      this.spawn(x, y + 0.8, z, { vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vz: Math.sin(a) * sp, vy: 2 + Math.random() * 2, life: 0.55, size: 0.3, grav: 2, color: colors });
    }
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ Legend Master

  // a glowing crescent left by a sword move. roll 0: flat (a sideways
  // slash), PI/2: upright (a chop). dir: which way it sweeps.
  slashArc(x, y, z, yaw, o = {}) {
    const radius = o.radius ?? 4.5;
    const arc = ((o.arc ?? 160) * Math.PI) / 180;
    const roll = o.roll ?? 0;
    const dir = o.dir ?? 1;
    const dur = o.dur ?? 0.34;
    const width = o.width ?? 0.3;
    const fwd = o.fwd ?? 0;
    const cols = o.colors || [0xffffff, 0xffffff];
    // basis: x = forward, y = across the slash plane, z = its normal
    const f = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1);
    const side = new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(roll), Math.sin(roll), 0);
    const nrm = new THREE.Vector3().crossVectors(f, side);
    const base = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromRotationMatrix(new THREE.Matrix4().makeBasis(f, side, nrm));
    const q = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(Y_AXIS, yaw).multiply(base);
    const cx = x + Math.sin(yaw) * fwd;
    const cz = z + Math.cos(yaw) * fwd;
    const cy = y + (o.height ?? 2.4);
    const spin = new THREE.Quaternion();
    const layer = (inner, color, opacity, grow) => {
      const geo = new THREE.RingGeometry(inner, 1, Math.max(24, Math.round(arc * 12)), 1, -arc / 2, arc);
      const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color, transparent: true, opacity, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, toneMapped: false }));
      m.position.set(cx, cy, cz);
      this.addShape(m, dur, (mm, k) => {
        // sweeps through, grows a little and fades
        spin.setFromAxisAngle(nrm, dir * (1 - ease(Math.min(1, k * 2.2))) * -arc * 0.6);
        mm.quaternion.copy(q).multiply(spin);
        const r = radius * (0.8 + grow * k);
        mm.scale.set(r, r, r);
        mm.material.opacity = opacity * (k < 0.35 ? 1 : 1 - (k - 0.35) / 0.65);
      });
    };
    layer(1 - width, cols[0], 0.85, 0.45);
    layer(1 - width * 0.3, cols[1] ?? 0xffffff, 1, 0.4);
    // sparks thrown off the edge
    const n = o.sparks ?? 26;
    const p = new THREE.Vector3();
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = (Math.random() - 0.5) * arc;
      p.set(Math.cos(a), Math.sin(a), 0).applyQuaternion(q).multiplyScalar(radius);
      const sp = 4 + Math.random() * 5;
      this.spawn(cx + p.x, cy + p.y, cz + p.z, { vx: (p.x / radius) * sp, vy: (p.y / radius) * sp + 1, vz: (p.z / radius) * sp, grav: 3, life: 0.45, size: 0.2, color: cols });
    }
  }

  // a column of light (from the sky or out of the ground)
  pillar(x, y, z, color, height = 26, radius = 1.4, dur = 0.8) {
    const geo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radius, radius * 1.15, height, 18, 1, true);
    const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color, transparent: true, opacity: 0.6, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, toneMapped: false }));
    m.position.set(x, y + height / 2, z);
    this.addShape(m, dur, (mm, k) => {
      const w = k < 0.15 ? 0.3 + (k / 0.15) * 0.9 : 1.2 - (k - 0.15) * 1.3;
      mm.scale.set(Math.max(0.02, w), 1, Math.max(0.02, w));
      mm.material.opacity = 0.6 * (1 - k * k);
    });
    const core = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radius * 0.35, radius * 0.35, height, 10, 1, true), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 1, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, toneMapped: false }));
    core.position.copy(m.position);
    this.addShape(core, dur * 0.7, (mm, k) => {
      mm.material.opacity = 0.75 * (1 - k);
    });
    this.burst(x, y + 0.5, z, 14, { color: [color, 0xffffff], speed: 6, up: 1.2, life: 0.6, size: 0.25, grav: 6 });
  }

  // ice spikes bursting out of the ground in a ring
  iceSpikes(x, y, z, radius, n, color = 0x9fe8ff) {
    const geo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.7, 4.2, 5);
    geo.translate(0, 2.1, 0);
    const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9, toneMapped: false });
    const m = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, mat, n);
    const m4 = new THREE.Matrix4();
    const q = new THREE.Quaternion();
    const e = new THREE.Euler();
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.random() * 0.3;
      const r = radius * (0.85 + Math.random() * 0.3);
      e.set((Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6, 0, (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6 + Math.cos(a) * 0.35);
      q.setFromEuler(e);
      const s = 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.7;
      m4.compose(new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(a) * r, 0, Math.sin(a) * r), q, new THREE.Vector3(s, s * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.8), s));
      m.setMatrixAt(i, m4);
      this.burst(x + Math.cos(a) * r, y + 0.5, z + Math.sin(a) * r, 3, { color: [0xffffff, color], speed: 4, up: 1.5, life: 0.6, size: 0.22, grav: 10 });
    }
    m.position.set(x, y - 0.2, z);
    this.addShape(m, 1.6, (mm, k) => {
      const g = k < 0.1 ? k / 0.1 : 1;
      mm.scale.set(1, Math.max(0.01, g * (k > 0.8 ? 1 - (k - 0.8) / 0.2 : 1)), 1);
      mm.material.opacity = k > 0.7 ? 0.9 * (1 - (k - 0.7) / 0.3) : 0.9;
    });
  }

  // a sphere that bursts outwards (or collapses inwards)
  sphereBlast(x, y, z, radius, color, dur = 0.7, implode = false) {
    const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 24, 16), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color, transparent: true, opacity: 0.7, depthWrite: false, blending: implode ? THREE.NormalBlending : THREE.AdditiveBlending, toneMapped: false }));
    m.position.set(x, y, z);
    this.addShape(m, dur, (mm, k) => {
      const e = ease(k);
      const r = implode ? radius * (1 - e) + 0.3 : 0.5 + radius * e;
      mm.scale.setScalar(Math.max(0.05, r));
      mm.material.opacity = implode ? 0.85 * Math.min(1, k * 4) : 0.7 * (1 - k);
    });
  }

  // a spear of light thrust forward
  beam(x, y, z, yaw, length, colors) {
    const dirV = new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(yaw), 0, Math.cos(yaw));
    const geo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.55, length, 12, 1, true);
    geo.rotateX(Math.PI); // the point in front
    const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: colors[0], transparent: true, opacity: 0.9, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, toneMapped: false }));
    m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, -1, 0), dirV);
    m.position.set(x + dirV.x * (length / 2 + 0.8), y + 2.3, z + dirV.z * (length / 2 + 0.8));
    this.addShape(m, 0.35, (mm, k) => {
      mm.scale.set(1 - k * 0.7, 0.3 + ease(Math.min(1, k * 3)) * 0.7, 1 - k * 0.7);
      mm.material.opacity = 0.9 * (1 - k);
    });
    const tip = { x: x + dirV.x * (length + 0.8), y: y + 2.3, z: z + dirV.z * (length + 0.8) };
    this.later(0.08, () => this.burst(tip.x, tip.y, tip.z, 22, { color: [...colors, 0xffffff], speed: 8, life: 0.45, size: 0.24, grav: 2 }));
  }

  // lightning straight down from the sky
  skyBolt(x, y, z, color) {
    this.lightning([{ x: x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6, y: y + 38, z: z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6 }, { x, y: y + 0.3, z }], color, 3.2, 14);
    this.pillar(x, y, z, color, 30, 0.7, 0.4);
    this.burst(x, y + 0.5, z, 18, { color: [color, 0xffffff, 0x8fb8ff], speed: 9, up: 1.2, life: 0.4, size: 0.2, grav: 6 });
  }

  // the particles of a Legend power: embers rise, ice shards fall, sparks
  // flicker, darkness drifts, light floats up, stars swirl
  elementBurst(element, x, y, z, n, colors, speed = 6) {
    const mo = ELEMENT_MOTION[element] || ELEMENT_MOTION.fire;
    this.burst(x, y, z, n, { color: colors, speed: speed * (mo.speed ?? 1), up: mo.up, life: mo.life, size: mo.size, grav: mo.grav });
  }

  // a spiral of particles rising around a point (charging up)
  spiral(x, y, z, radius, colors, n = 40) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = (i / n) * Math.PI * 6;
      const r = radius * (1 - i / n);
      this.later(i * 0.008, () => this.spawn(x + Math.cos(a) * r, y + (i / n) * 4, z + Math.sin(a) * r, { vx: -Math.cos(a) * 2, vz: -Math.sin(a) * 2, vy: 3, grav: 0, life: 0.6, size: 0.26, color: colors }));
    }
  }

  // the whole screen flashes (the strongest powers)
  flash(color = 0xffffff, strength = 0.6) {
    if (!this.flashEl) {
      this.flashEl = document.createElement('div');
      this.flashEl.className = 'screen-flash';
      document.body.appendChild(this.flashEl);
    }
    this.flashEl.style.background = `#${color.toString(16).padStart(6, '0')}`;
    this.flashT = 0;
    this.flashMax = strength;
    this.flashEl.style.opacity = String(strength);
  }

  // jagged lightning between points (Thunder Hero)
  lightning(points, color, jitter = 0.9, steps = 7) {
    if (points.length < 2) return;
    const pos = [];
    for (let i = 1; i < points.length; i++) {
      const a = points[i - 1];
      const b = points[i];
      let prev = a;
      for (let k = 1; k <= steps; k++) {
        const t = k / steps;
        const j = k === steps ? 0 : jitter;
        const p = { x: a.x + (b.x - a.x) * t + (Math.random() - 0.5) * j, y: a.y + (b.y - a.y) * t + (Math.random() - 0.5) * j, z: a.z + (b.z - a.z) * t + (Math.random() - 0.5) * j };
        pos.push(prev.x, prev.y, prev.z, p.x, p.y, p.z);
        prev = p;
      }
      this.burst(b.x, b.y, b.z, 14, { color: [color, 0xffffff, 0x8fb8ff], speed: 7, life: 0.4, size: 0.2, grav: 4 });
    }
    const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
    const line = new THREE.LineSegments(geo, new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color, transparent: true, opacity: 1, toneMapped: false }));
    this.addShape(line, 0.35, (m, k) => {
      m.material.opacity = Math.random() < 0.3 ? 0.2 : 1 - k;
    });
  }

  spawn(x, y, z, o = {}) {
    if (!this.free.length) return;
    const i = this.free.pop();
    const p = this.p[i];
    p.alive = true;
    p.x = x; p.y = y; p.z = z;
    const sp = o.speed ?? 4;
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const up = o.up ?? 0.6;
    p.vx = (o.vx ?? Math.cos(a) * sp * Math.random());
    p.vz = (o.vz ?? Math.sin(a) * sp * Math.random());
    p.vy = o.vy ?? (up * sp * (0.5 + Math.random()));
    p.life = 0;
    p.max = o.life ?? 0.7 + Math.random() * 0.4;
    p.size = o.size ?? 0.18 + Math.random() * 0.12;
    p.grav = o.grav ?? 9;
    p.color.setHex(Array.isArray(o.color) ? o.color[Math.floor(Math.random() * o.color.length)] : o.color ?? 0xffffff);
    p.spin = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10;
    p.rot = Math.random() * 6;
    p.shrink = o.shrink ?? true;
  }

  burst(x, y, z, n, o) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) this.spawn(x, y, z, o);
  }

  // Galaxy Sword star nova: a ring of stars racing outwards along the ground
  nova(x, z, r, y) {
    const n = 36;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = (i / n) * Math.PI * 2;
      const sp = r / 0.45;
      this.spawn(x, y + 0.8, z, { vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vz: Math.sin(a) * sp, vy: 1.5, life: 0.45, size: 0.3, grav: 0, color: [0xb48cff, 0xfff27a, 0xffffff] });
    }
    this.burst(x, y + 1.5, z, 16, { color: [0xfff27a, 0xb48cff], speed: 4, up: 2, life: 0.8, size: 0.25, grav: 3 });
  }

  hitSpark(x, y, z, crit) {
    this.burst(x, y, z, crit ? 16 : 9, { color: crit ? [0xffe14a, 0xffffff, 0xff8a2a] : [0xffffff, 0xffe9a0], speed: crit ? 9 : 6, life: 0.4, size: 0.2, grav: 6 });
  }

  aura(kind, x, y, z, color) {
    const cols = AURA_COLORS[kind] || [color || 0xffffff];
    const rise = kind === 'ember' || kind === 'glow' || kind === 'bubble' || kind === 'star' || kind === 'rune' || kind === 'spark' || kind === 'glitter' || kind === 'shadow' || kind === 'pixel';
    this.spawn(x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4, y, z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.4, {
      color: cols, speed: 0.6, vy: rise ? 1 + Math.random() : -0.2, grav: rise ? -0.5 : kind === 'snow' || kind === 'leaf' || kind === 'petal' ? 0.6 : 2,
      life: 1.2 + Math.random(), size: kind === 'bubble' ? 0.18 : 0.12,
    });
  }

  confetti(x, y, z, n = 40) {
    this.burst(x, y, z, n, { color: [0xff5aa5, 0xffd93a, 0x5fd35a, 0x3fa6ff, 0xb48cff, 0xffffff], speed: 10, up: 1.2, life: 1.6, size: 0.22, grav: 7 });
  }

  coins(x, y, z, n = 12) {
    this.burst(x, y, z, n, { color: [0xffd23a, 0xffe97a], speed: 6, up: 1.4, life: 1.0, size: 0.25, grav: 14 });
  }

  // floating numbers / words at a world position
  number(text, pos, cls = '') {
    if (this.numbers.length >= MAX_NUMBERS) {
      const old = this.numbers.shift();
      old.el.remove();
    }
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = `dmg ${cls}`;
    el.textContent = text;
    this.numberRoot.appendChild(el);
    this.numbers.push({ el, pos: pos.clone ? pos.clone() : new THREE.Vector3(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z), t: 0, jitter: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30 });
  }

  // ground warning for a monster attack
  telegraph(kind, x, y, z, yaw, size, durMs, arc = 1, color = 0xff3a4a) {
    let geo;
    if (kind === 'slam') geo = new THREE.RingGeometry(size * 0.15, size, 40);
    else if (kind === 'breath') geo = new THREE.CircleGeometry(size, 24, -arc / 2, arc);
    else if (kind === 'lunge') geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.6, size);
    else return;
    const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color, transparent: true, opacity: 0.35, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
    const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
    m.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    // local +x (breath) / +y (lunge) is turned to face the monster's yaw
    if (kind === 'breath') m.rotation.z = yaw - Math.PI / 2;
    if (kind === 'lunge') {
      m.rotation.z = yaw;
      x += Math.sin(yaw) * size / 2;
      z += Math.cos(yaw) * size / 2;
    }
    m.position.set(x, y + 0.15, z);
    m.renderOrder = 2;
    this.scene.add(m);
    this.telegraphs.push({ m, t: 0, dur: durMs / 1000 });
    if (this.telegraphs.length > 20) this.removeTelegraph(this.telegraphs.shift());
  }

  removeTelegraph(tg) {
    this.scene.remove(tg.m);
    tg.m.geometry.dispose();
    tg.m.material.dispose();
  }

  projectile(d, serverNow) {
    const color = new THREE.Color(d.color || '#ffffff');
    const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(Math.max(0.35, d.r * 0.7), 1), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color }));
    m.position.set(d.x, d.y, d.z);
    this.scene.add(m);
    this.projectiles.set(d.id, { m, d, born: serverNow, color: color.getHex() });
    if (this.projectiles.size > 60) this.endProjectile(this.projectiles.keys().next().value);
  }

  endProjectile(id, hit) {
    const p = this.projectiles.get(id);
    if (!p) return;
    this.projectiles.delete(id);
    this.burst(p.m.position.x, p.m.position.y, p.m.position.z, hit ? 12 : 6, { color: p.color, speed: 5, life: 0.4 });
    this.scene.remove(p.m);
    p.m.geometry.dispose();
    p.m.material.dispose();
  }

  update(dt, serverNow) {
    // particles
    let n = 0;
    const s = new THREE.Vector3();
    const pos = new THREE.Vector3();
    for (let i = 0; i < MAX_PARTICLES; i++) {
      const p = this.p[i];
      if (!p.alive) continue;
      p.life += dt;
      if (p.life >= p.max) {
        p.alive = false;
        this.free.push(i);
        continue;
      }
      p.vy -= p.grav * dt;
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.z += p.vz * dt;
      p.vx *= 1 - dt * 0.8;
      p.vz *= 1 - dt * 0.8;
      p.rot += p.spin * dt;
      const k = p.shrink ? 1 - p.life / p.max : 1;
      s.setScalar(Math.max(0.001, p.size * k));
      pos.set(p.x, p.y, p.z);
      this.q.setFromAxisAngle(this.tmpV.set(0.4, 1, 0.2).normalize(), p.rot);
      this.m4.compose(pos, this.q, s);
      this.mesh.setMatrixAt(n, this.m4);
      this.mesh.setColorAt(n, p.color);
      n++;
    }
    this.mesh.count = n;
    this.mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
    if (this.mesh.instanceColor) this.mesh.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;

    // numbers
    const w = window.innerWidth;
    const h = window.innerHeight;
    for (let i = this.numbers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const num = this.numbers[i];
      num.t += dt;
      if (num.t > 0.95) {
        num.el.remove();
        this.numbers.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      const v = this.tmpV.copy(num.pos).project(this.camera);
      if (v.z > 1) {
        num.el.style.display = 'none';
        continue;
      }
      num.el.style.display = '';
      num.el.style.left = `${(v.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * w + num.jitter}px`;
      num.el.style.top = `${(-v.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * h}px`;
    }

    // staged effects
    if (this.timers.length) {
      const due = [];
      this.timers = this.timers.filter((tm) => {
        tm.t -= dt;
        if (tm.t <= 0) due.push(tm.fn);
        return tm.t > 0;
      });
      for (const fn of due) fn();
    }
    if (this.flashEl && this.flashT !== undefined) {
      this.flashT += dt;
      const o = Math.max(0, this.flashMax * (1 - this.flashT / 0.45));
      this.flashEl.style.opacity = String(o);
      if (o === 0) this.flashT = undefined;
    }

    // power shapes
    for (let i = this.shapes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const sh = this.shapes[i];
      sh.t += dt;
      const k = Math.min(1, sh.t / sh.dur);
      sh.step(sh.mesh, k);
      if (k >= 1) this.dropShape(i);
    }

    // telegraphs
    for (let i = this.telegraphs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const tg = this.telegraphs[i];
      tg.t += dt;
      const k = tg.t / tg.dur;
      tg.m.material.opacity = 0.2 + 0.35 * Math.min(1, k) + Math.sin(tg.t * 20) * 0.05;
      if (k >= 1.1) {
        this.removeTelegraph(tg);
        this.telegraphs.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }

    // projectiles move along their straight line
    for (const [id, p] of this.projectiles) {
      const age = (serverNow - p.born) / 1000;
      if (age * 1000 > p.d.life + 300) {
        this.endProjectile(id);
        continue;
      }
      p.m.position.set(p.d.x + p.d.vx * age, p.d.y + Math.sin(age * 10) * 0.1, p.d.z + p.d.vz * age);
      p.m.rotation.y += dt * 8;
      if (Math.random() < 0.5) this.spawn(p.m.position.x, p.m.position.y, p.m.position.z, { color: p.color, speed: 0.5, life: 0.35, size: 0.14, grav: 0 });
    }
  }
}

FILE: public/client/fb.js

// The Firebase connection used by online accounts (accounts.js) and online
// rooms (rooms.js). Loaded only when needed.

import { FIREBASE_CONFIG } from '../firebase-config.js';

// The config from firebase-config.js, or one saved in this browser (used by
// the automated tests to point at the local Firebase emulators).
export function firebaseConfig() {
  try {
    const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('sam_firebase') || 'null');
    if (o && o.databaseURL) return o;
  } catch { /* ignore */ }
  return FIREBASE_CONFIG && FIREBASE_CONFIG.databaseURL ? FIREBASE_CONFIG : null;
}

let fbPromise = null;
export function firebase() {
  if (!fbPromise) {
    fbPromise = (async () => {
      const cfg = firebaseConfig();
      if (!cfg) throw new Error('Online play is not set up yet (firebase-config.js is empty).');
      const fb = await import('../vendor/firebase.js');
      const app = fb.initializeApp(cfg, 'steal-a-monster');
      const db = fb.getDatabase(app);
      const auth = fb.initializeAuth(app, { persistence: [fb.indexedDBLocalPersistence, fb.browserLocalPersistence] });
      if (cfg.emulator) {
        const [host, port] = String(cfg.emulator).split(':');
        fb.connectDatabaseEmulator(db, host, Number(port));
      }
      if (cfg.authEmulator) fb.connectAuthEmulator(auth, `http://${cfg.authEmulator}`, { disableWarnings: true });
      // wait until a saved log-in (if any) is restored
      await new Promise((resolve) => {
        const stop = fb.onAuthStateChanged(auth, () => {
          stop();
          resolve();
        });
      });
      return { fb, db, auth };
    })();
    fbPromise.catch(() => { fbPromise = null; });
  }
  return fbPromise;
}

FILE: public/client/gallery.js

// Monster gallery: every species side by side, animated. Useful for checking
// the models and as a showcase. Query params: ?pose=move&only=draklet&cols=6
// &island=cute (one monster island; without it: the mainland monsters)
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { SPECIES, RARITIES } from '#shared/monsters.js';
import { ISLANDS } from '#shared/islands.js';
import { buildMonster } from './monsterRenderer.js';
import { animateMonster } from './animationSystem.js';
import { makeLabel } from './labels.js';

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const only = params.get('only');
const island = params.get('island');
const list = only ? SPECIES.filter((s) => only.split(',').includes(s.id))
  : island ? SPECIES.filter((s) => s.island === island)
    : SPECIES.filter((s) => !s.island);

// area links: the mainland and every island
const areas = document.getElementById('areas');
if (areas) {
  const link = (id, name) => {
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    const u = new URL(location.href);
    u.searchParams.delete('only');
    if (id) u.searchParams.set('island', id);
    else u.searchParams.delete('island');
    a.href = u.toString();
    a.textContent = name;
    if ((island || null) === id && !only) a.className = 'on';
    areas.appendChild(a);
  };
  link(null, 'Mainland');
  for (const isl of ISLANDS) link(isl.id, isl.name.replace(' Island', ''));
}
const cols = Number(params.get('cols')) || Math.min(8, Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(list.length * 1.6)));
let pose = params.get('pose') || 'idle';

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas: document.getElementById('c'), antialias: true, preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(2, devicePixelRatio));
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xb9e3ff);
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x8ab070, 1.4));
const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff4e0, 2.4);
sun.position.set(-20, 40, 30);
sun.castShadow = true;
sun.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
Object.assign(sun.shadow.camera, { left: -60, right: 60, top: 60, bottom: -60 });
scene.add(sun);
const ground = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(400, 400), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x8fd65a, roughness: 0.9 }));
ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
ground.receiveShadow = true;
scene.add(ground);

const spacing = only && list.length <= 3 ? 6 : 5.2;
const rows = Math.ceil(list.length / cols);
const items = list.map((sp, i) => {
  const rig = buildMonster(sp.id, { shadows: true });
  const c = i % cols;
  const r = Math.floor(i / cols);
  const x = (c - (cols - 1) / 2) * spacing;
  const z = (r - (rows - 1) / 2) * spacing * 1.15;
  rig.root.position.set(x, 0, z);
  const fit = Math.min(1, 3.4 / (rig.height * sp.size));
  rig.root.scale.setScalar(sp.size * fit);
  scene.add(rig.root);
  const label = makeLabel(`${sp.name}\n${RARITIES[sp.rarity].name}`, { scale: 0.0085, colors: ['#ffffff', RARITIES[sp.rarity].color] });
  label.position.set(x, 0.15, z + 1.9);
  label.material.depthTest = false;
  scene.add(label);
  return { rig, st: { pose, poseT: 0, speed: 6, attackKind: sp.attacks[0].kind, windupMs: 900, quirk: sp.personality.idles[0], quirkDur: 3 } };
});

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(only ? 30 : 34, 1, 0.1, 500);
function frame() {
  const w = innerWidth;
  const h = innerHeight;
  renderer.setSize(w, h, false);
  camera.aspect = w / h;
  const span = Math.max(cols * spacing, (rows * spacing * 1.15) * camera.aspect * 0.9);
  const dist = (span / 2) / Math.tan((camera.fov * Math.PI) / 360) / camera.aspect + 4;
  camera.position.set(0, dist * 0.42, dist * 0.92);
  camera.lookAt(0, 0.8, 0.6);
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
}
frame();
addEventListener('resize', frame);

for (const b of document.querySelectorAll('[data-pose]')) {
  b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.pose === pose);
  b.onclick = () => {
    pose = b.dataset.pose;
    for (const o of document.querySelectorAll('[data-pose]')) o.classList.toggle('on', o === b);
    for (const it of items) { it.st.pose = pose; it.st.poseT = 0; }
  };
}
for (const it of items) it.st.pose = pose;

let last = performance.now();
let t = Number(params.get('t')) || 0;
function loop() {
  const now = performance.now();
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
  last = now;
  t += dt;
  for (const it of items) {
    if (it.st.pose === 'quirk' && it.st.poseT > 3) {
      const q = it.rig.species.personality.idles;
      it.st.quirk = q[(q.indexOf(it.st.quirk) + 1) % q.length];
      it.st.poseT = 0;
    }
    if (it.st.pose === 'windup' && it.st.poseT > 1.2) { it.st.pose = 'strike'; it.st.poseT = 0; }
    else if (it.st.pose === 'strike' && it.st.poseT > 0.6 && pose === 'windup') { it.st.pose = 'windup'; it.st.poseT = 0; }
    animateMonster(it.rig, it.st, dt, t);
  }
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
window.__galleryReady = true;

FILE: public/client/guardsView.js

// Base guards and their helicopters (server/services/guards.js), drawn from
// the 'g' list of every snapshot: uniformed guards with swords (better
// uniforms and swords at higher levels) and armed helicopters circling the
// towers from level 7.

import * as THREE from 'three';
import { Humanoid, ANIM } from './humanoid.js';
import { GUARD_LOOKS, guardLevel } from '#shared/guards.js';
import { InterpBuffer } from './net.js';
import { HealthBar, blobShadow } from './monstersView.js';

const GS = { idle: 0, walk: 1, chase: 2, windup: 3, strike: 4, down: 7, fly: 8 };

function std(color, o = {}) {
  return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color, roughness: o.rough ?? 0.5, metalness: o.metal ?? 0.2, emissive: o.emissive ?? 0, transparent: !!o.opacity, opacity: o.opacity ?? 1 });
}

function buildHeli(level) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  const body = level >= 10 ? 0xf3c234 : level >= 9 ? 0x1a1c24 : 0x3a4a3a;
  const trim = level >= 10 ? 0xffffff : 0xd8384a;
  const m = std(body, { metal: 0.5, rough: 0.35 });
  const hull = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(1.6, 3.6, 6, 12), m);
  hull.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
  const glass = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1.45, 14, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2), std(0x8fd8ff, { metal: 0.1, rough: 0.05, opacity: 0.75 }));
  glass.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
  glass.position.set(0, 0.25, 2.3);
  const tail = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.5, 0.6, 5.2), m);
  tail.position.set(0, 0.5, -4.6);
  const fin = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.15, 1.6, 1.1), std(trim));
  fin.position.set(0, 1.2, -7);
  const stripe = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(3.3, 0.3, 1.2), std(trim));
  stripe.position.set(0, 0.2, 0.3);
  const rotor = new THREE.Group();
  rotor.position.y = 2.1;
  for (const r of [0, Math.PI / 2]) {
    const blade = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(11, 0.08, 0.5), std(0x22262c));
    blade.rotation.y = r;
    rotor.add(blade);
  }
  const hub = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.3, 0.3, 0.6, 10), std(0x22262c));
  hub.position.y = 1.8;
  const tailRotor = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.06, 2.2, 0.25), std(0x22262c));
  tailRotor.position.set(0.35, 1.0, -7);
  for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
    const skid = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.15, 0.15, 5), std(0x22262c));
    skid.position.set(s * 1.3, -2.0, 0);
    g.add(skid);
    const leg = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.12, 0.8, 0.12), std(0x22262c));
    leg.position.set(s * 1.2, -1.6, 0.8);
    g.add(leg);
  }
  // the gun under the nose
  const gun = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.16, 0.2, 1.8, 8), std(0x111111, { metal: 0.8 }));
  gun.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
  gun.position.set(0, -1.3, 2.8);
  const light = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.22, 8, 6), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff3a3a }));
  light.position.set(0, -0.6, -7.2);
  g.add(hull, glass, tail, fin, stripe, rotor, hub, tailRotor, gun, light);
  g.traverse((o) => {
    if (o.isMesh) o.castShadow = true;
  });
  g.userData = { rotor, tailRotor, light, gun };
  return g;
}

export class GuardsView {
  constructor(scene, world, effects, audio) {
    this.scene = scene;
    this.world = world;
    this.effects = effects;
    this.audio = audio;
    this.map = new Map();
    this.tmp = {};
    this.tracers = [];
  }

  create(id, kind, level, baseIndex) {
    const v = { id, kind, level, baseIndex, buf: new InterpBuffer(), pos: new THREE.Vector3(), yaw: 0, state: 0, hp: 100, lastSeen: 0, flashT: 0 };
    if (kind === 0) {
      const L = guardLevel(level);
      const look = GUARD_LOOKS[L.look];
      v.h = new Humanoid(look.colors.jacket, { skin: [0xffd27a, 0xe8b07a, 0xc8865a, 0x8a5a3a][id % 4] });
      v.h.setOutfit(look);
      v.h.setSword(L.sword);
      v.h.root.traverse((o) => {
        if (o.isMesh) o.castShadow = true;
      });
      v.root = v.h.root;
      v.bar = new HealthBar(2.4);
      v.bar.group.visible = false;
      this.scene.add(v.bar.group);
      v.shadow = blobShadow();
      v.shadow.scale.setScalar(3);
      this.scene.add(v.shadow);
    } else {
      v.root = buildHeli(level);
    }
    this.scene.add(v.root);
    this.map.set(id, v);
    return v;
  }

  applySnapshot(t, rows = []) {
    for (const r of rows) {
      const [id, baseIndex, kind, x, y, z, yaw, state, hp, level] = r;
      let v = this.map.get(id);
      if (v && v.level !== level) {
        this.remove(v);
        v = null;
      }
      if (!v) {
        v = this.create(id, kind, level, baseIndex);
        v.pos.set(x, y, z);
        v.yaw = yaw;
      }
      v.buf.push(t, x, y, z, yaw);
      if (v.state !== state && state === GS.down) this.knockOut(v);
      if (v.state === GS.down && state !== GS.down) v.h?.setDown(false);
      v.state = state;
      if (hp < v.hp) v.showBarUntil = performance.now() + 5000;
      v.hp = hp;
      v.lastSeen = t;
    }
  }

  knockOut(v) {
    if (!v.h) return;
    this.effects.burst(v.pos.x, v.pos.y + 2, v.pos.z, 16, { color: [0xffe14a, 0xffffff], speed: 5, life: 0.6 });
    this.audio.play('defeat', { pitch: 0.7 });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- events

  onAttack(d) {
    const v = this.map.get(d.id);
    if (v?.h) v.h.startSwing(Math.random() < 0.3);
  }

  onStrike(d) {
    const v = this.map.get(d.id);
    if (!v) return;
    this.effects.burst(v.pos.x + Math.sin(v.yaw) * 1.6, v.pos.y + 2.4, v.pos.z + Math.cos(v.yaw) * 1.6, 8, { color: [0xffffff, 0xd8dde6], speed: 4, life: 0.3 });
    this.audio.play('swing', { minGap: 60 });
  }

  onDown(d) {
    const v = this.map.get(d.id);
    if (v && v.state !== GS.down) {
      v.state = GS.down;
      this.knockOut(v);
    }
  }

  onUp(d) {
    const v = this.map.get(d.id);
    if (!v) return;
    v.state = GS.idle;
    v.h?.setDown(false);
    this.effects.burst(v.pos.x, v.pos.y + 2, v.pos.z, 12, { color: [0x5ab8ff, 0xffffff], speed: 4 });
  }

  onGone(d) {
    const v = this.map.get(d.id);
    if (v) this.remove(v);
  }

  // a helicopter shot: muzzle flash, a tracer and the impact
  onShot(d) {
    const v = this.map.get(d.id);
    if (v) v.recoil = 1;
    this.effects.burst(d.x, d.y - 1.4, d.z, 6, { color: [0xffe14a, 0xff8a2a], speed: 3, life: 0.2 });
    const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([new THREE.Vector3(d.x, d.y - 1.3, d.z), new THREE.Vector3(d.tx, d.ty, d.tz)]);
    const line = new THREE.Line(geo, new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffe14a, transparent: true, opacity: 1, toneMapped: false }));
    this.scene.add(line);
    this.tracers.push({ line, t: 0 });
    if (d.hit) this.effects.burst(d.tx, d.ty, d.tz, 12, { color: [0xff8a2a, 0xffe14a, 0xffffff], speed: 6, life: 0.4 });
    else this.effects.burst(d.tx + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3, d.ty - 2, d.tz + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3, 8, { color: [0xc9a27a, 0xffffff], speed: 3, life: 0.4 });
    this.audio.play('projectile', { minGap: 80, pitch: 1.6 });
  }

  onHit(h) {
    const v = this.map.get(h.id);
    if (!v) return;
    v.flashT = 0.1;
    v.hp = h.hp;
    v.showBarUntil = performance.now() + 5000;
    this.effects.number(h.crit ? `${h.dmg}!` : `${h.dmg}`, new THREE.Vector3(v.pos.x, v.pos.y + 5.6, v.pos.z), h.crit ? 'crit' : '');
    this.effects.hitSpark(v.pos.x, v.pos.y + 2.4, v.pos.z, h.crit);
  }

  remove(v) {
    this.map.delete(v.id);
    this.scene.remove(v.root);
    if (v.bar) {
      this.scene.remove(v.bar.group);
      v.bar.dispose();
    }
    if (v.shadow) this.scene.remove(v.shadow);
  }

  clear() {
    for (const v of [...this.map.values()]) this.remove(v);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- frame

  update(dt, renderT, time, camPos) {
    const nowMs = performance.now();
    for (const v of [...this.map.values()]) {
      if (renderT - v.lastSeen > 1500) {
        this.remove(v);
        continue;
      }
      const prev = v.pos.clone();
      if (v.buf.sample(renderT, this.tmp)) {
        v.pos.set(this.tmp.x, this.tmp.y, this.tmp.z);
        v.yaw = this.tmp.yaw;
      }
      const speed = Math.hypot(v.pos.x - prev.x, v.pos.z - prev.z) / Math.max(dt, 1e-3);
      const far = camPos.distanceTo(v.pos) > 190;
      v.root.visible = !far;
      if (far) continue;
      v.root.position.copy(v.pos);
      v.root.rotation.y = v.yaw;
      if (v.kind === 1) {
        const u = v.root.userData;
        u.rotor.rotation.y += dt * 28;
        u.tailRotor.rotation.x += dt * 40;
        v.root.rotation.z = Math.sin(time * 1.3 + v.id) * 0.06;
        v.root.rotation.x = 0.08 + (v.recoil || 0) * 0.08;
        v.recoil = Math.max(0, (v.recoil || 0) - dt * 5);
        u.light.visible = Math.sin(time * 6 + v.id) > 0;
        continue;
      }
      const down = v.state === GS.down;
      v.h.setDown(down);
      const anim = down ? ANIM.idle : speed > 9 ? ANIM.run : speed > 0.6 ? ANIM.walk : ANIM.idle;
      v.h.update(dt, anim, speed, false, time);
      if (v.flashT > 0) v.flashT -= dt;
      v.shadow.position.set(v.pos.x, Math.max(v.pos.y, 0) + 0.06, v.pos.z);
      const showBar = !down && nowMs < (v.showBarUntil || 0);
      v.bar.group.visible = showBar;
      if (showBar) {
        v.bar.set(v.hp / 100);
        v.bar.group.position.set(v.pos.x, v.pos.y + 5.6, v.pos.z);
      }
    }
    for (let i = this.tracers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const tr = this.tracers[i];
      tr.t += dt;
      tr.line.material.opacity = Math.max(0, 1 - tr.t / 0.18);
      if (tr.t > 0.18) {
        this.scene.remove(tr.line);
        tr.line.geometry.dispose();
        tr.line.material.dispose();
        this.tracers.splice(i, 1);
      }
    }
  }
}

FILE: public/client/humanoid.js

// Blocky player avatars, procedural sword models and hats.

import * as THREE from 'three';
import { glowSprite } from './labels.js';
import { RoundedBoxGeometry } from 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js';
import { SWORD_BY_ID } from '#shared/weapons.js';
import { COSMETIC_BY_ID } from '#shared/lucky.js';
import { COSTUME_BY_ID, costumeWithPower } from '#shared/costumes.js';

export const ANIM = { idle: 0, walk: 1, run: 2, air: 3, swim: 4, dodge: 5 };

const mats = new Map();
function mat(color, opts = {}) {
  const key = `${color}|${opts.emissive || 0}|${opts.ei || 1}|${opts.rough ?? 0.6}|${opts.metal || 0}|${opts.opacity || 1}`;
  if (mats.has(key)) return mats.get(key);
  const m = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color, roughness: opts.rough ?? 0.6, metalness: opts.metal || 0,
    emissive: opts.emissive || 0, emissiveIntensity: opts.ei || 1,
    transparent: (opts.opacity || 1) < 1, opacity: opts.opacity || 1,
  });
  mats.set(key, m);
  return m;
}

const RBOX = new RoundedBoxGeometry(1, 1, 1, 3, 0.12);
const BOX = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1);

function part(geo, material, sx, sy, sz, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, material);
  m.scale.set(sx, sy, sz);
  m.position.set(x, y, z);
  m.castShadow = true;
  return m;
}

let faceTex = null;
function faceTexture() {
  if (faceTex) return faceTex;
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = c.height = 128;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a1a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.ellipse(42, 54, 9, 13, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.ellipse(86, 54, 9, 13, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(45, 49, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.arc(89, 49, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#1a1a1a';
  ctx.lineWidth = 6;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(64, 74, 20, 0.2 * Math.PI, 0.8 * Math.PI);
  ctx.stroke();
  faceTex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  faceTex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  return faceTex;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ swords

export function buildSword(id) {
  const def = SWORD_BY_ID[id] || SWORD_BY_ID.wooden;
  const c = def.colors;
  const L = def.length;
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  const glow = c.glow ? { emissive: c.glow, ei: 0.8 } : {};
  const bladeMat = mat(c.blade, { rough: def.tier >= 3 ? 0.25 : 0.7, metal: def.tier >= 3 && def.tier <= 4 ? 0.6 : 0.1, ...glow });
  const edgeMat = mat(c.edge, { rough: 0.2, metal: 0.3, ...(c.glow ? { emissive: c.glow, ei: 1.2 } : {}) });
  const grip = part(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.11, 0.11, 0.7, 8), mat(c.grip), 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0);
  const pommel = part(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.16, 10, 8), mat(c.guard, { metal: 0.4, rough: 0.4 }), 1, 1, 1, 0, -0.42, 0);
  const guard = part(BOX, mat(c.guard, { metal: 0.4, rough: 0.4 }), def.tier >= 9 ? 1.1 : 0.85, 0.16, 0.26, 0, 0.38, 0);
  g.add(grip, pommel, guard);
  const w = 0.2 + def.tier * 0.012;
  if (id === 'crystal' || id === 'celestial') {
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const s = 1 - i * 0.14;
      const shard = part(new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(1, 0), bladeMat, w * 1.3 * s, L * 0.16, 0.08, 0, 0.5 + L * 0.13 + i * L * 0.2, 0);
      g.add(shard);
    }
  } else if (id === 'candy') {
    // red and white stripes with a candy-cane hook at the top
    const n = 7;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) g.add(part(BOX, i % 2 ? edgeMat : bladeMat, w * 1.5, (L / n) * 1.02, 0.16, 0, 0.45 + ((i + 0.5) * L) / n, 0));
    const hook = part(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.3, w * 0.75, 6, 12, Math.PI), edgeMat, 1, 1, 1, -0.3, 0.45 + L, 0);
    g.add(hook);
  } else if (id === 'rainbow') {
    const cols = [0xff4a5a, 0xff9a2a, 0xffe23a, 0x5fd35a, 0x3fa6ff, 0xa86bff];
    cols.forEach((c, i) => g.add(part(BOX, mat(c, { emissive: c, ei: 0.35, rough: 0.3 }), w * 1.6, (L / cols.length) * 1.02, 0.1, 0, 0.45 + ((i + 0.5) * L) / cols.length, 0)));
    const tip = part(new THREE.ConeGeometry(w * 0.8, 0.45, 4), mat(0xffffff, { emissive: 0xffffff, ei: 0.6 }), 1, 1, 0.25, 0, 0.45 + L + 0.2, 0);
    tip.rotation.y = Math.PI / 4;
    g.add(tip);
  } else {
    const blade = part(BOX, id === 'bubble' ? mat(c.blade, { opacity: 0.7, rough: 0.1, emissive: c.glow, ei: 0.4 }) : bladeMat, w * 1.6, L, 0.08, 0, 0.45 + L / 2, 0);
    const edge = part(BOX, edgeMat, w * 0.5, L * 0.96, 0.1, 0, 0.45 + L / 2, 0);
    const tip = part(new THREE.ConeGeometry(w * 0.8, 0.45, 4), bladeMat, 1, 1, 0.2, 0, 0.45 + L + 0.2, 0);
    tip.rotation.y = Math.PI / 4;
    g.add(blade, edge, tip);
    if (id === 'flame' || id === 'dragon') {
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const fin = part(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.12, 0.45, 4), edgeMat, 1, 1, 0.4, (i % 2 ? 1 : -1) * w * 0.9, 0.7 + i * L * 0.22, 0);
        fin.rotation.z = (i % 2 ? -1 : 1) * 0.9;
        g.add(fin);
      }
    }
    if (id === 'bubble') {
      const bub = mat(0xe8fbff, { opacity: 0.55, rough: 0.05, emissive: 0x8fe8ff, ei: 0.5 });
      [[0.22, 0.25, 0.16], [-0.2, 0.45, 0.12], [0.18, 0.68, 0.1], [-0.16, 0.85, 0.14], [0.05, 1.05, 0.2]].forEach(([x, f, r]) => {
        g.add(part(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 10, 8), bub, r, r, r, x, 0.45 + L * f, 0.05));
      });
    }
    if (id === 'frost') {
      const ice = mat(0xe8ffff, { emissive: 0x9fe8ff, ei: 0.6, rough: 0.1 });
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const side = i % 2 ? 1 : -1;
        const shard = part(new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(1, 0), ice, 0.12, 0.3, 0.08, side * w * 0.85, 0.75 + i * L * 0.17, 0);
        shard.rotation.z = side * -0.6;
        g.add(shard);
      }
    }
    if (id === 'lucky') {
      // a four-leaf clover on the guard
      const leaf = mat(0x3fae44, { rough: 0.5, emissive: 0x1a5a1a, ei: 0.4 });
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const a = (i / 4) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.PI / 4;
        g.add(part(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 10, 8), leaf, 0.15, 0.15, 0.06, Math.cos(a) * 0.15, 0.38 + Math.sin(a) * 0.15, 0.16));
      }
    }
    if (id === 'galaxy') {
      const star = mat(0xfff7d8, { emissive: 0xfff27a, ei: 1.4 });
      [[0.06, 0.15], [-0.07, 0.3], [0.05, 0.47], [-0.04, 0.62], [0.07, 0.78], [-0.05, 0.92]].forEach(([x, f], i) => {
        const st = part(new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(1, 0), star, 0.07 + (i % 2) * 0.03, 0.07 + (i % 2) * 0.03, 0.05, x, 0.45 + L * f, 0.06);
        g.add(st);
      });
      const ring = part(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.42, 0.05, 6, 20), mat(c.guard, { emissive: c.guard, ei: 0.6 }), 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.38, 0);
      g.add(ring);
    }
    if (id === 'thunder') {
      const bolt = part(BOX, mat(0x3a3f8f, { emissive: 0x3a3f8f }), 0.1, L * 0.7, 0.11, 0, 0.45 + L * 0.45, 0);
      bolt.rotation.z = 0.12;
      g.add(bolt);
    }
  }
  if (id === 'celestial') {
    const star = part(new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.28, 0), mat(0xfff27a, { emissive: 0xfff27a, ei: 1.5 }), 1, 1, 0.5, 0, -0.42, 0);
    g.add(star);
  }
  if (c.glow) {
    const glow = glowSprite(c.glow, 2.2, 0.45);
    glow.position.y = 0.5 + L / 2;
    g.add(glow);
  }
  g.userData.length = L;
  return g;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ hats

export function buildHat(id) {
  const def = COSMETIC_BY_ID[id];
  if (!def) return null;
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  const m = mat(def.color, { rough: 0.5 });
  switch (id) {
    case 'party_hat': {
      const cone = part(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.45, 1.1, 14), m, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.55, 0);
      const ball = part(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.15, 8, 6), mat(0xffe14a), 1, 1, 1, 0, 1.12, 0);
      g.add(cone, ball);
      break;
    }
    case 'lucky_crown': {
      const band = part(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.55, 0.55, 0.35, 16, 1, true), mat(0xffd23a, { metal: 0.6, rough: 0.3, emissive: 0x3a2a00 }), 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.18, 0);
      band.material.side = THREE.DoubleSide;
      g.add(band);
      for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
        const a = (k / 5) * Math.PI * 2;
        const spike = part(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.12, 0.35, 4), band.material, 1, 1, 1, Math.cos(a) * 0.52, 0.5, Math.sin(a) * 0.52);
        g.add(spike);
      }
      g.add(part(new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.12), mat(0x4fd85a, { emissive: 0x2a8a2a }), 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.2, 0.56));
      break;
    }
    case 'flower_crown': {
      g.add(part(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.55, 0.07, 6, 18), mat(0x4fae44), 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.1, 0));
      g.children[0].rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
      const cols = [0xff7ab8, 0xffe14a, 0xffffff, 0xb48cff];
      for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
        const a = (k / 8) * Math.PI * 2;
        g.add(part(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.12, 8, 6), mat(cols[k % 4]), 1, 0.7, 1, Math.cos(a) * 0.55, 0.15, Math.sin(a) * 0.55));
      }
      break;
    }
    case 'monster_ears':
      for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
        const ear = part(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.22, 0.6, 4), m, 1, 1, 0.45, s * 0.38, 0.3, 0);
        ear.rotation.z = -s * 0.3;
        g.add(ear);
      }
      break;
    case 'halo': {
      const t = part(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.45, 0.06, 8, 24), mat(0xfff7a8, { emissive: 0xfff27a, ei: 1.5 }), 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.7, 0);
      t.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
      g.add(t);
      break;
    }
    case 'top_hat':
      g.add(part(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.7, 0.7, 0.08, 18), m, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.04, 0));
      g.add(part(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.42, 0.42, 0.8, 18), m, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.45, 0));
      g.add(part(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.43, 0.43, 0.12, 18), mat(0xd8384a), 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.15, 0));
      break;
    case 'propeller': {
      g.add(part(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.58, 14, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2), m, 1, 0.6, 1, 0, 0, 0));
      const prop = new THREE.Group();
      prop.position.y = 0.45;
      prop.add(part(BOX, mat(0xffe14a), 1.2, 0.04, 0.16), part(BOX, mat(0xff5a7a), 0.16, 0.04, 1.2));
      g.add(prop);
      g.userData.spin = prop;
      break;
    }
    case 'horns':
      for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
        const h = part(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.14, 0.6, 8), m, 1, 1, 1, s * 0.35, 0.3, 0.05);
        h.rotation.z = -s * 0.5;
        g.add(h);
      }
      break;
    default:
      break;
  }
  return g;
}


// ------------------------------------------------------------------ costumes

// At night the Black Spy's bone lines and LEDs light up (main.js sets this).
let nightGlow = false;
export function setNightGlow(on) {
  nightGlow = !!on;
}

let logoTex = null;
function logoTexture() {
  if (logoTex) return logoTex;
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = c.height = 256;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  // a round badge with a little monster face and the game's initials
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5ff3ff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(128, 128, 120, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#101016';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(128, 128, 106, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5ff3ff';
  for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(128 + s * 70, 70);
    ctx.lineTo(128 + s * 40, 40);
    ctx.lineTo(128 + s * 30, 84);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(128 + s * 34, 104, 13, 17, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#5ff3ff';
  ctx.lineWidth = 8;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(128, 124, 30, 0.25 * Math.PI, 0.75 * Math.PI);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.font = '900 46px "Trebuchet MS", system-ui, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillText('S·A·M', 128, 208);
  logoTex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  logoTex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  return logoTex;
}

let boltTex = null;
function boltTexture() {
  if (boltTex) return boltTex;
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = c.height = 128;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a3a8a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(64, 64, 60, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff27a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(72, 10);
  ctx.lineTo(34, 70);
  ctx.lineTo(60, 70);
  ctx.lineTo(50, 118);
  ctx.lineTo(94, 52);
  ctx.lineTo(68, 52);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  boltTex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  boltTex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  return boltTex;
}

function decal(tex, w, h, glow = 0) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w, h), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    map: tex, transparent: true, roughness: 0.5, emissive: glow ? 0xffffff : 0, emissiveMap: glow ? tex : null, emissiveIntensity: glow,
  }));
  return m;
}

const glowMats = new Map();
function glowMat(color) {
  if (!glowMats.has(color)) glowMats.set(color, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color, toneMapped: false }));
  return glowMats.get(color);
}

// Builds the costume pieces onto the avatar's limbs, so they move with it.
function dressUp(h, c) {
  const col = c.colors;
  const look = c.look;
  const parts = [];
  const glows = [];   // lines that only light up at night
  const leds = [];
  const add = (parent, mesh, list = parts) => {
    parent.add(mesh);
    list.push(mesh);
    if (list !== parts) parts.push(mesh);
    return mesh;
  };
  const jacket = mat(col.jacket, { rough: c.style === 'knight' ? 0.25 : 0.55, metal: c.style === 'knight' ? 0.5 : 0 });
  const pants = mat(col.pants, { rough: 0.7 });
  const shoes = mat(col.shoes, { rough: 0.4 });
  const gloves = mat(col.gloves, { rough: 0.5 });
  const trim = mat(col.trim, { rough: 0.5 });
  const hatMat = mat(col.hat, { rough: 0.5 });
  // jacket, sleeves, gloves, trousers, shoes
  add(h.torso, part(RBOX, jacket, 1.9, 1.88, 1.0, 0, 0.9, 0));
  add(h.torso, part(RBOX, trim, 1.92, 0.22, 1.02, 0, 0.12, 0)); // belt / hem
  for (const arm of h.arms) {
    add(arm, part(RBOX, jacket, 0.88, 1.15, 0.88, 0, -0.42, 0));
    add(arm, part(RBOX, gloves, 0.86, 0.62, 0.86, 0, -1.36, 0));
  }
  for (const leg of h.legs) {
    add(leg, part(RBOX, pants, 0.92, 1.5, 0.92, 0, -0.74, 0));
    add(leg, part(RBOX, shoes, 0.98, 0.44, 1.14, 0, -1.6, 0.09));
  }
  // the style's own pieces
  if (look.logo) {
    const front = add(h.torso, decal(logoTexture(), 0.62, 0.62, 0.25));
    front.position.set(0.44, 1.32, 0.506);
    const back = add(h.torso, decal(logoTexture(), 1.3, 1.3, 0.25));
    back.position.set(0, 1.0, -0.506);
    back.rotation.y = Math.PI;
    add(h.torso, part(RBOX, trim, 1.2, 0.2, 1.04, 0, 1.78, 0)); // collar
  }
  if (look.hat === 'fedora') {
    const hat = new THREE.Group();
    hat.position.y = 1.12;
    hat.add(part(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.92, 0.92, 0.07, 22), hatMat, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.04, 0));
    hat.add(part(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.5, 0.6, 0.55, 18), hatMat, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.32, 0));
    hat.add(part(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.61, 0.61, 0.13, 18), trim, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.13, 0));
    hat.rotation.x = -0.08;
    add(h.head, hat);
  }
  if (look.glasses) {
    add(h.head, part(RBOX, mat(0x050507, { rough: 0.15, metal: 0.4 }), 1.02, 0.24, 0.08, 0, 0.7, 0.585));
    add(h.head, part(BOX, mat(0x5ff3ff, { emissive: 0x2a8a9a, ei: 0.6, rough: 0.1 }), 0.3, 0.04, 0.02, 0.22, 0.76, 0.63));
  }
  if (look.hat === 'headband') {
    add(h.head, part(RBOX, hatMat, 1.22, 0.2, 1.2, 0, 0.92, 0));
    for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
      const tail = add(h.head, part(BOX, hatMat, 0.14, 0.62, 0.06, s * 0.12, 0.62, -0.68));
      tail.rotation.z = s * 0.35;
      tail.userData.flap = s;
    }
  }
  if (look.mask) add(h.head, part(RBOX, mat(0x1a0c0e), 1.2, 0.46, 1.18, 0, 0.3, 0.01));
  if (look.scarf) {
    add(h.torso, part(RBOX, mat(col.glow, { emissive: 0xff4a10, ei: 0.4 }), 1.3, 0.3, 1.1, 0, 1.75, 0));
    const end = add(h.torso, part(BOX, mat(col.glow, { emissive: 0xff4a10, ei: 0.4 }), 0.35, 1.2, 0.08, 0.35, 1.2, -0.6));
    end.userData.flap = 1;
  }
  if (look.hat === 'helmet') {
    add(h.head, part(RBOX, mat(col.hat, { rough: 0.2, metal: 0.6 }), 1.32, 1.28, 1.3, 0, 0.6, 0));
    add(h.head, part(BOX, mat(0x0a1a2a), 0.95, 0.14, 0.06, 0, 0.7, 0.66));
    const plume = add(h.head, part(RBOX, mat(col.trim, { emissive: 0x1a4a8a, ei: 0.4 }), 0.2, 0.6, 1.2, 0, 1.45, -0.1));
    plume.rotation.x = 0.2;
  }
  if (look.armor) {
    add(h.torso, part(RBOX, mat(col.armor ?? 0xe8f6ff, { rough: 0.15, metal: 0.7 }), 1.7, 1.1, 1.08, 0, 1.15, 0));
    for (const arm of h.arms) add(arm, part(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.62, 12, 8), mat(col.trim, { rough: 0.2, metal: 0.6 }), 1, 0.7, 1, 0, 0.05, 0));
  }
  if (look.hat === 'mask') add(h.head, part(RBOX, hatMat, 1.2, 0.26, 1.18, 0, 0.72, 0.01));
  // guard uniforms (shared/guards.js)
  if (look.hat === 'cap') {
    add(h.head, part(RBOX, hatMat, 1.22, 0.36, 1.22, 0, 1.12, 0));
    add(h.head, part(BOX, hatMat, 0.9, 0.06, 0.5, 0, 1.0, 0.72));
    add(h.head, part(BOX, mat(col.trim, { metal: 0.5, rough: 0.3 }), 0.22, 0.2, 0.04, 0, 1.15, 0.62));
  }
  if (look.badge) add(h.torso, part(BOX, mat(col.trim, { metal: 0.6, rough: 0.25, emissive: col.trim, ei: 0.15 }), 0.28, 0.32, 0.05, -0.45, 1.35, 0.52));
  if (look.vest) add(h.torso, part(RBOX, mat(look.vest, { rough: 0.8 }), 1.96, 1.3, 1.06, 0, 1.0, 0));
  if (look.visor) add(h.head, part(BOX, mat(look.visor, { emissive: look.visor, ei: 0.9, rough: 0.2 }), 1.0, 0.18, 0.06, 0, 0.7, 0.67));
  if (look.bolt) {
    const b = add(h.torso, decal(boltTexture(), 0.9, 0.9, 0.3));
    b.position.set(0, 1.1, 0.506);
  }
  if (look.cape) {
    const cape = new THREE.Group();
    cape.position.set(0, 1.75, -0.52);
    const legend = c.style === 'legend';
    cape.add(part(BOX, mat(typeof look.cape === 'number' ? look.cape : 0xd8384a, { rough: 0.8 }), legend ? 2.2 : 1.9, legend ? 3.4 : 2.7, 0.08, 0, legend ? -1.7 : -1.35, 0));
    if (legend) {
      // a glowing hem and the power's sign on the back
      const hem = part(BOX, glowMat(col.glow), 2.24, 0.14, 0.1, 0, -3.36, 0);
      hem.castShadow = false;
      cape.add(hem);
      const sign = part(new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.45), glowMat(col.glow), 1, 1.4, 0.2, 0, -1.4, -0.08);
      sign.castShadow = false;
      cape.add(sign);
    }
    cape.userData.cape = true;
    add(h.torso, cape);
  }
  if (look.hat === 'bunny') {
    add(h.head, part(RBOX, hatMat, 1.32, 1.3, 1.0, 0, 0.66, -0.2)); // the hood
    for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
      const ear = add(h.head, part(RBOX, hatMat, 0.3, 1.25, 0.18, s * 0.32, 1.75, -0.2));
      ear.rotation.z = -s * 0.15;
      ear.userData.ear = s;
      add(ear, part(RBOX, mat(0xffffff), 0.6, 0.8, 0.5, 0, 0.0, 0.3));
    }
  }
  if (look.pompom) add(h.torso, part(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.32, 12, 10), mat(0xffffff, { rough: 0.9 }), 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.15, -0.55));

  // Legend Master: a crown, big pauldrons, a glowing gem, glowing lines that
  // are always on (in the colour of the chosen power) and orbs circling you
  const pulses = []; // glow materials that breathe
  const orbs = [];
  if (look.hat === 'crown') {
    const gold = mat(col.hat, { rough: 0.2, metal: 0.85, emissive: col.hat, ei: 0.15 });
    const crown = new THREE.Group();
    crown.position.y = 1.12;
    crown.add(part(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.66, 0.62, 0.32, 18, 1, true), gold, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.12, 0));
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      const a = (i / 7) * Math.PI * 2;
      const tall = i === 0 ? 0.75 : 0.45;
      const spike = part(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.13, tall, 6), gold, 1, 1, 1, Math.sin(a) * 0.62, 0.28 + tall / 2, Math.cos(a) * 0.62);
      crown.add(spike);
      crown.add(part(new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.1), glowMat(col.glow), 1, 1.3, 1, Math.sin(a) * 0.66, 0.13, Math.cos(a) * 0.66));
    }
    add(h.head, crown);
  }
  if (c.style === 'legend') {
    const metal = mat(col.armor ?? col.trim, { rough: 0.18, metal: 0.8 });
    for (const [i, arm] of h.arms.entries()) {
      const s = i === 0 ? -1 : 1;
      const pad = add(arm, part(RBOX, metal, 1.15, 0.5, 1.15, s * 0.12, 0.25, 0));
      pad.rotation.z = s * -0.35;
      add(arm, part(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.16, 0.6, 6), metal, 1, 1, 1, s * 0.35, 0.65, 0));
    }
    add(h.torso, part(RBOX, metal, 1.96, 0.28, 1.08, 0, 0.12, 0)); // belt
    for (const leg of h.legs) add(leg, part(RBOX, metal, 0.98, 0.5, 0.98, 0, -1.25, 0.02)); // greaves
    const gem = add(h.torso, part(new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.26), glowMat(col.glow), 1, 1.3, 0.6, 0, 1.25, 0.62));
    gem.castShadow = false;
    gem.userData.pulse = true;
  }
  if (look.glowLines) {
    const g = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: col.glow, toneMapped: false, transparent: true, opacity: 1 });
    const line = (parent, w, hh, x, y, z) => {
      const m = add(parent, part(BOX, g, w, hh, 0.05, x, y, z));
      m.castShadow = false;
      return m;
    };
    line(h.torso, 0.1, 1.1, 0.42, 0.75, 0.56);
    line(h.torso, 0.1, 1.1, -0.42, 0.75, 0.56);
    line(h.torso, 1.5, 0.08, 0, 1.75, 0.55);
    for (const arm of h.arms) {
      line(arm, 0.1, 0.62, 0, -1.3, 0.45);
      line(arm, 0.62, 0.08, 0, -0.95, 0.45);
    }
    for (const leg of h.legs) {
      line(leg, 0.1, 0.9, 0, -0.62, 0.47);
      line(leg, 0.7, 0.08, 0, -1.55, 0.6);
    }
    pulses.push(g);
    // three glowing orbs circling the body
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const orb = add(h.body, part(new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(0.22, 1), glowMat(col.glow), 1, 1, 1, 0, 3, 0));
      orb.castShadow = false;
      orb.userData.orbit = i;
      orbs.push(orb);
    }
  }

  // Black Spy at night: glowing stickman lines along the bones + LEDs
  if (look.nightLines) {
    const g = glowMat(col.glow);
    const line = (parent, w, hh, x, y, z) => add(parent, part(BOX, g, w, hh, 0.04, x, y, z), glows);
    line(h.torso, 0.09, 1.55, 0, 0.92, 0.512);   // spine
    line(h.torso, 1.5, 0.09, 0, 1.62, 0.512);    // shoulders
    line(h.torso, 0.85, 0.09, 0, 0.2, 0.512);    // hips
    for (const arm of h.arms) {
      line(arm, 0.09, 0.85, 0, -0.42, 0.448);    // upper arm
      line(arm, 0.09, 0.62, 0, -1.25, 0.438);    // forearm
    }
    for (const leg of h.legs) {
      line(leg, 0.09, 0.75, 0, -0.42, 0.468);    // thigh
      line(leg, 0.09, 0.7, 0, -1.18, 0.468);     // shin
    }
    const ring = add(h.head, part(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.5, 0.045, 6, 28), g, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.58, 0.6), glows); // stickman head
    ring.castShadow = false;
    line(h.head, 0.09, 0.22, 0, -0.02, 0.5);     // neck
    for (const m of glows) m.castShadow = false;
  }
  if (look.leds) {
    const spots = [
      [h.torso, 0.8, 1.68, 0.52], [h.torso, -0.8, 1.68, 0.52], [h.torso, 0.6, 0.12, 0.53], [h.torso, -0.6, 0.12, 0.53],
      [h.torso, -0.45, 1.3, 0.52], [h.torso, 0, 1.8, -0.53], [h.arms[0], 0, -1.08, 0.45], [h.arms[1], 0, -1.08, 0.45],
      [h.legs[0], 0, -0.82, 0.48], [h.legs[1], 0, -0.82, 0.48], [h.legs[0], 0, -1.6, 0.67], [h.legs[1], 0, -1.6, 0.67],
    ];
    spots.forEach(([parent, x, y, z], i) => {
      const led = add(parent, part(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.07, 8, 6), glowMat(col.led[i % col.led.length]), 1, 1, 1, x, y, z), leds);
      led.castShadow = false;
      led.userData.phase = i * 0.7;
    });
  }
  return { parts, glows, leds, pulses, orbs };
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ legend moves

// The Legend Master's 10 sword moves, one after the other (then again).
// p goes 0 -> 1 over the move; returns arm (lx, lz, rx, rz), torso (tx, ty)
// and body (by spin, y lift, z lunge, flip) poses.
export const LEGEND_MOVE_DUR = [0.3, 0.3, 0.38, 0.4, 0.4, 0.32, 0.46, 0.56, 0.52, 0.62];
export const LEGEND_MOVE_NAMES = ['Crescent Slash', 'Return Slash', 'Sky Splitter', 'Rising Dragon', 'Cyclone Cut', 'Piercing Light', 'Cross Strike', 'Meteor Drop', 'Whirlwind', 'Legend Break'];
const ease = (k) => 1 - (1 - Math.min(1, Math.max(0, k))) ** 3;
const ramp = (p, a, b) => Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (p - a) / (b - a)));

function legendMove(move, p) {
  switch (move) {
    case 0: { // Crescent Slash: wide from the right to the left
      const w = ramp(p, 0, 0.25);
      const k = ease(ramp(p, 0.25, 0.6));
      return { rx: -1.5 * w, rz: 1.3 * w - 2.4 * k, ty: 0.55 * w - 1.2 * k, lz: 0.6 };
    }
    case 1: { // Return Slash: backhand from the left to the right, with a hop
      const w = ramp(p, 0, 0.25);
      const k = ease(ramp(p, 0.25, 0.6));
      return { rx: -1.5 * w, rz: -1.1 * w + 2.6 * k, ty: -0.6 * w + 1.3 * k, y: Math.sin(p * Math.PI) * 0.4, lz: 0.5 };
    }
    case 2: { // Sky Splitter: two hands overhead, straight down
      const w = ramp(p, 0, 0.3);
      const k = ease(ramp(p, 0.3, 0.6));
      const x = -0.5 - 2.6 * w + 2.4 * k;
      return { rx: x, lx: x, rz: -0.25, lz: 0.25, tx: -0.2 * w + 0.5 * k, y: Math.sin(Math.min(1, p / 0.6) * Math.PI) * 0.7 };
    }
    case 3: { // Rising Dragon: from the ground up into the sky
      const w = ramp(p, 0, 0.25);
      const k = ease(ramp(p, 0.25, 0.65));
      return { rx: 0.6 * w - 3.7 * k, rz: -0.1, lx: 0.4, tx: 0.3 * w - 0.6 * k, y: k * 1.8 * (1 - ramp(p, 0.7, 1)) };
    }
    case 4: { // Cyclone Cut: a full spin with the blade out
      const k = ease(ramp(p, 0.1, 0.85));
      return { rx: -1.45, rz: 1.35, lx: -1.2, lz: -1.2, by: -k * Math.PI * 2 };
    }
    case 5: { // Piercing Light: pull back, then a lunging stab
      const w = ramp(p, 0, 0.35);
      const k = ease(ramp(p, 0.35, 0.55));
      const back = ramp(p, 0.75, 1);
      return { rx: 0.6 * w - 1.0 * k, rz: -0.08, lx: 0.5 * k, lz: 0.4, ty: 0.5 * w - 0.6 * k, tx: 0.3 * k, z: (1.6 * k) * (1 - back) - 0.3 * w * (1 - k) };
    }
    case 6: { // Cross Strike: two diagonal slashes, an X
      const k1 = ease(ramp(p, 0.05, 0.4));
      const k2 = ease(ramp(p, 0.5, 0.85));
      if (p < 0.45) return { rx: -2.8 + 2.4 * k1, rz: 1.1 - 2.0 * k1, ty: 0.4 - 0.9 * k1, lz: 0.5 };
      return { rx: -2.8 + 2.4 * k2, rz: -0.9 + 2.0 * k2, ty: -0.5 + 0.9 * k2, lz: 0.5 };
    }
    case 7: { // Meteor Drop: jump, front flip, smash the ground
      const up = ramp(p, 0, 0.55);
      const k = ease(ramp(p, 0.55, 0.7));
      const x = -3.0 + 2.6 * k;
      return { rx: x, lx: x, rz: -0.2, lz: 0.2, y: Math.sin(up * Math.PI * 0.5) * 3.2 * (1 - k) - 0.3 * k, flip: -ease(ramp(p, 0.1, 0.55)) * Math.PI * 2, tx: 0.45 * k };
    }
    case 8: { // Whirlwind: two spins rising up
      const k = ease(ramp(p, 0, 0.9));
      return { rx: -1.5, rz: 1.4, lx: -1.5, lz: -1.4, by: k * Math.PI * 4, y: Math.sin(p * Math.PI) * 1.6 };
    }
    default: { // Legend Break: gather the power overhead, then a huge chop
      const w = ramp(p, 0, 0.4);
      const k = ease(ramp(p, 0.4, 0.55));
      const x = -0.5 - 2.7 * w + 2.9 * k;
      return { rx: x, lx: x, rz: -0.15, lz: 0.15, y: 1.2 * w * (1 - k) - 0.45 * k, tx: -0.3 * w + 0.6 * k, by: 0 };
    }
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ avatar

export class Humanoid {
  constructor(color = 0x3a7ae0, opts = {}) {
    this.root = new THREE.Group();
    const skin = mat(opts.skin || 0xffd27a, { rough: 0.55 });
    const shirt = mat(color, { rough: 0.7 });
    const pantsColor = new THREE.Color(color).multiplyScalar(0.45).getHex();
    const pants = mat(opts.pants || pantsColor, { rough: 0.8 });
    this.body = new THREE.Group();
    this.root.add(this.body);
    // legs
    this.legs = [-1, 1].map((s) => {
      const pivot = new THREE.Group();
      pivot.position.set(s * 0.45, 1.8, 0);
      pivot.add(part(RBOX, pants, 0.86, 1.8, 0.86, 0, -0.9, 0));
      this.body.add(pivot);
      return pivot;
    });
    this.torso = new THREE.Group();
    this.torso.position.y = 1.8;
    this.body.add(this.torso);
    this.torso.add(part(RBOX, shirt, 1.8, 1.8, 0.92, 0, 0.9, 0));
    // arms
    this.arms = [-1, 1].map((s) => {
      const pivot = new THREE.Group();
      pivot.position.set(s * 1.32, 1.62, 0);
      pivot.add(part(RBOX, shirt, 0.8, 0.6, 0.8, 0, -0.2, 0));
      pivot.add(part(RBOX, skin, 0.76, 1.3, 0.76, 0, -1.0, 0));
      this.torso.add(pivot);
      return pivot;
    });
    // head with a face
    this.head = new THREE.Group();
    this.head.position.y = 1.8;
    this.torso.add(this.head);
    const headMesh = part(RBOX, skin, 1.15, 1.12, 1.12, 0, 0.6, 0);
    this.head.add(headMesh);
    const face = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1, 1), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: faceTexture(), transparent: true, roughness: 0.6 }));
    face.position.set(0, 0.6, 0.565);
    this.head.add(face);
    this.hatAnchor = new THREE.Group();
    this.hatAnchor.position.y = 1.16;
    this.head.add(this.hatAnchor);
    // hand anchor for the sword
    this.hand = new THREE.Group();
    this.hand.position.set(0, -1.6, 0);
    this.arms[1].add(this.hand);
    this.carryAnchor = new THREE.Group();
    this.carryAnchor.position.set(0, 5.7, 0);
    this.root.add(this.carryAnchor);
    this.swordId = null;
    this.hatId = null;
    this.swing = 0;
    this.swingDir = 1;
    this.walkPhase = 0;
    this.dodge = 0;
    this.color = color;
    this.fxGroup = new THREE.Group();
    this.root.add(this.fxGroup);
  }

  setSword(id) {
    if (id === this.swordId) return;
    this.swordId = id;
    this.hand.clear();
    if (!id) return;
    const s = buildSword(id);
    s.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
    s.position.set(0, 0, 0.1);
    this.hand.add(s);
    this.sword = s;
  }

  // A costume from the Costume Shop (null: your normal clothes). It brings
  // its own idle, attack, dodge and teleport animations (see update).
  // power: the chosen power of a Legend Master (its colours and effects)
  setCostume(id, power = null) {
    const key = `${id}|${power}`;
    if (key === (this.costumeKey ?? 'null|null')) return;
    this.costumeKey = key;
    this.costumeId = id;
    const c = COSTUME_BY_ID[id] || null;
    this.element = c?.choosePower ? costumeWithPower(c, power).element : null;
    this.setOutfit(c ? costumeWithPower(c, power) : null);
  }

  // any costume-like outfit { style, colors, look } (costumes, guard uniforms)
  setOutfit(c) {
    for (const m of this.dress?.parts || []) m.parent?.remove(m);
    this.dress = null;
    this.style = c ? c.style : null;
    this.hatAnchor.visible = !c; // the outfit's own headwear replaces the hat
    if (c) this.dress = dressUp(this, c);
  }

  // arriving after a teleport (H, portals...): the costume's entrance
  startTeleport() {
    this.tpT = 0;
  }

  // Z: the costume's master power
  startPower() {
    this.powerT = 0;
  }

  setHat(id) {
    if (id === this.hatId) return;
    this.hatId = id;
    this.hatAnchor.clear();
    const h = id ? buildHat(id) : null;
    if (h) this.hatAnchor.add(h);
    this.hat = h;
  }

  // move: which of the Legend Master's 10 sword moves (0..9)
  startSwing(combo = false, move = 0) {
    this.swing = 1;
    this.swingDir = combo ? -1 : this.swingDir * -1;
    this.move = move;
  }

  startDodge() {
    this.dodge = 1;
  }

  // capture: point at the monster, then cheer when the orb arrives
  startCatch() {
    this.catchT = 0;
  }

  startCheer() {
    this.cheerT = 0;
  }

  // anim: ANIM code. speed: horizontal speed. carrying: bool.
  update(dt, anim, speed, carrying, t) {
    const legs = this.legs;
    const arms = this.arms;
    const st = this.style; // costume animation style (null: normal clothes)
    let legSwing = 0;
    if (anim === ANIM.walk || anim === ANIM.run) {
      this.walkPhase += dt * (anim === ANIM.run ? 13 : 10) * Math.min(1.3, 0.4 + speed / 18);
      legSwing = Math.sin(this.walkPhase) * (anim === ANIM.run ? 0.95 : 0.7);
    } else {
      this.walkPhase *= 0.9;
    }
    const swimming = anim === ANIM.swim;
    const air = anim === ANIM.air;
    legs[0].rotation.x = air ? -0.5 : swimming ? Math.sin(t * 8) * 0.4 : legSwing;
    legs[1].rotation.x = air ? 0.3 : swimming ? -Math.sin(t * 8) * 0.4 : -legSwing;
    legs[0].rotation.z = 0;
    legs[1].rotation.z = 0;
    // body bob
    this.body.position.y = anim === ANIM.walk || anim === ANIM.run ? Math.abs(Math.sin(this.walkPhase)) * 0.12 : Math.sin(t * 2) * 0.02;
    this.body.rotation.y = 0;
    this.body.position.z = 0;
    let flipX = 0; // a front flip in a sword move
    this.torso.rotation.x = swimming ? 0.9 : anim === ANIM.run ? 0.12 : 0;
    this.head.rotation.x = 0;
    this.head.rotation.y *= 0.9;
    // arms
    let leftX = -legSwing * 0.8;
    let rightX = legSwing * 0.6 - 0.5;
    let leftZ = 0.08;
    let rightZ = -0.08;
    if (swimming) {
      leftX = -2.4 + Math.sin(t * 8) * 0.8;
      rightX = -2.4 - Math.sin(t * 8) * 0.8;
    }
    if (air) {
      leftX = -2.6;
      leftZ = 0.4;
    }
    if (st === 'legend' && anim === ANIM.run && !carrying) {
      // the hero run: leaning in, arms swept back
      leftX = rightX = 1.0 + legSwing * 0.1;
      leftZ = 0.3;
      rightZ = -0.3;
      this.torso.rotation.x = 0.35;
    }
    if (carrying) {
      leftX = rightX = -2.9;
      leftZ = 0.25;
      rightZ = -0.25;
    }
    // costume idle stance (standing still)
    const still = anim === ANIM.idle && speed < 0.6 && !carrying;
    if (st && still) {
      this.idleT = (this.idleT || 0) + dt;
      const k = Math.min(1, this.idleT / 0.4);
      switch (st) {
        case 'spy': // arms folded, looking around
          leftX = -1.35 * k;
          leftZ = 0.08 + 0.7 * k;
          rightX = -0.5 - 0.65 * k;
          rightZ = -0.08 - 0.72 * k;
          this.head.rotation.y = Math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.55 * k;
          break;
        case 'ninja': // low stance, hands together
          this.body.position.y -= 0.32 * k;
          leftX = rightX = -1.45 * k;
          leftZ = 0.55 * k;
          rightZ = -0.55 * k;
          legs[0].rotation.z = -0.22 * k;
          legs[1].rotation.z = 0.22 * k;
          this.body.position.y += Math.sin(t * 3) * 0.04;
          break;
        case 'knight': // hand on the hip, sword ready
          leftX = 0.1;
          leftZ = -0.5 * k;
          rightX = -0.5 - 0.3 * k;
          this.torso.rotation.x = -0.06 * k + Math.sin(t * 1.5) * 0.02;
          break;
        case 'hero': // fists on the hips, chin up
          leftX = rightX = 0.2 * k;
          leftZ = -0.5 * k;
          rightZ = 0.5 * k;
          this.head.rotation.x = -0.15 * k;
          legs[0].rotation.z = -0.12 * k;
          legs[1].rotation.z = 0.12 * k;
          break;
        case 'guard': // at attention, sword ready
          leftX = 0.05;
          leftZ = 0.05;
          rightX = -0.55 * k;
          rightZ = -0.12;
          this.head.rotation.y = Math.sin(t * 0.6) * 0.35 * k;
          break;
        case 'legend': // floating, sword raised, the free hand glowing with power
          this.body.position.y += (0.35 + Math.sin(t * 2.2) * 0.15) * k;
          leftX = -0.35 * k;
          leftZ = 0.08 + 0.55 * k;
          rightX = -0.5 - 0.35 * k;
          rightZ = -0.08 + 0.55 * k;
          this.head.rotation.x = -0.12 * k;
          legs[0].rotation.x = 0.15 * k;
          legs[1].rotation.x = -0.25 * k;
          break;
        case 'bunny': // happy little hops
          this.body.position.y += Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 5)) * 0.35 * k;
          leftX = rightX = -0.6 * k + Math.sin(t * 10) * 0.15;
          leftZ = -0.35 * k;
          rightZ = 0.35 * k;
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
    } else this.idleT = 0;
    if (this.catchT !== undefined && this.catchT < 0.75) {
      this.catchT += dt;
      const k = Math.min(1, this.catchT / 0.15);
      rightX = -0.5 - k * 1.1;
      rightZ = -0.08;
      leftX = -0.3 * k;
    }
    if (this.cheerT !== undefined && this.cheerT < 0.9) {
      this.cheerT += dt;
      const w = Math.sin(this.cheerT * 22) * 0.2;
      leftX = -2.9 + w;
      rightX = -2.9 - w;
      leftZ = 0.45;
      rightZ = -0.45;
      this.body.position.y += Math.abs(Math.sin(this.cheerT * Math.PI * 2)) * 0.6;
    }
    if (this.swing > 0) {
      const p = 1 - this.swing; // 0 -> 1
      let dur = 0.34;
      if (st === 'legend') {
        const r = legendMove(this.move || 0, p);
        leftX = r.lx ?? leftX;
        leftZ = r.lz ?? leftZ;
        rightX = r.rx ?? rightX;
        rightZ = r.rz ?? rightZ;
        this.torso.rotation.y = r.ty || 0;
        this.torso.rotation.x = r.tx ?? this.torso.rotation.x;
        this.body.rotation.y = r.by || 0;
        this.body.position.y += r.y || 0;
        this.body.position.z = r.z || 0;
        flipX = r.flip || 0;
        dur = LEGEND_MOVE_DUR[this.move || 0];
      } else if (st === 'spy') {
        // a spinning slash with the sword arm stretched out
        const k = Math.min(1, p / 0.2);
        rightX = -0.3;
        rightZ = 0.2 + 1.3 * k;
        leftZ = -0.9 * k;
        this.body.rotation.y = this.swingDir * Math.max(0, (p - 0.15) / 0.85) * Math.PI * 2;
        dur = 0.36;
      } else if (st === 'knight') {
        // a heavy chop from above
        rightX = p < 0.35 ? -0.5 - (p / 0.35) * 2.6 : -3.1 + ((p - 0.35) / 0.65) * 3.3;
        leftX = rightX * 0.6;
        rightZ = -0.08;
        this.torso.rotation.x = p < 0.35 ? -0.12 : 0.28;
        dur = 0.42;
      } else if (st === 'hero') {
        // an uppercut
        rightX = p < 0.3 ? 0.4 * (p / 0.3) : 0.4 - ((p - 0.3) / 0.7) * 3.4;
        this.body.position.y += Math.sin(p * Math.PI) * 0.6;
      } else if (st === 'bunny') {
        // a twirl
        this.body.rotation.y = p * Math.PI * 2;
        leftZ = -1.1;
        rightZ = 1.1;
        rightX = -0.4;
      } else {
        const wind = p < 0.25 ? p / 0.25 : 1;
        const slash = p < 0.25 ? 0 : Math.min(1, (p - 0.25) / 0.35);
        rightX = -0.5 - wind * 2.2 + slash * 2.7;
        rightZ = -0.08 + this.swingDir * (wind * 0.6 - slash * 1.1);
        this.torso.rotation.y = this.swingDir * (wind * 0.35 - slash * 0.6);
        if (st === 'ninja') {
          this.torso.rotation.x = 0.35 * Math.sin(p * Math.PI);

    } else {
      this.torso.rotation.y *= 0.8;

    // Z: master power
    const powerDur = st === 'legend' ? 1.1 : 0.75;
    if (this.powerT !== undefined && this.powerT < powerDur) {
      this.powerT += dt;
      const p = Math.min(1, this.powerT / powerDur);
      if (st === 'legend') {
