        else if (res.message) app.ui.toast(res.message, 'warn');
      },
      release: (ownedId) => req('release', { ownedId, confirm: true }, 'Released back into the wild. Bye bye!').then(() => app.ui.close()),
      home: async () => {
        const res = await req('home');
        if (res.ok) app.steal = null;
      },
      lock: () => req('lock', {}, '🔒 Security lasers ON!'),
      useItem: (itemId) => app.useItem(itemId),
      equipCosmetic: (id) => req('equipCosmetic', { id }),
      buyCostume: (id) => req('buyCostume', { id }, () => {
        const c = COSTUME_BY_ID[id];
        if (c.choosePower) {
          // the Legend Master: choose its power right away
          setTimeout(() => this.ui.open('legend'), 300);
          return `${c.icon} You are now a ${c.name}! Choose your power!`;
        }
        return `${c.icon} You are now a ${c.name}! Press Z for ${c.power.name}.`;
      }),
      choosePower: (id) => req('choosePower', { power: id }, () => {
        const el = LEGEND_POWERS[id];
        setTimeout(() => this.ui.close(), 200);
        return `${el.icon} Your Legend Master now has the power of ${el.name}! Press Z for ${el.power}.`;
      }),
      equipCostume: (id) => req('equipCostume', { id }),
      buyPower: () => req('buyPower', {}, (r) => `💪 Power level ${r.level}! +${r.bonus} damage on every costume power.`),
      buyGuards: () => req('buyGuards', {}, (r) => `💂 Guards level ${r.level}: ${r.guards} guards${r.helis ? ` and ${r.helis} helicopter${r.helis > 1 ? 's' : ''}` : ''} protect your base!`),
      // admin ("daniel"): give a stolen monster back / ban a player. Online
      // accounts also get the ban or the return in the database (only the
      // admin's account may write those).
      adminReturn: async (pn, ownedId) => {
        const res = await req('adminReturn', { pn, ownedId }, (r) => (r.delivered ? '🛡 Returned to its owner.' : '🛡 Returned: the owner gets it the next time they play.'));
        if (res.ok && res.deliver?.account && app.accounts?.kind === 'online') {
          await app.accounts.deliverReturn(res.deliver.account, res.deliver.monster).catch((e) => app.ui.toast(`Could not send it to ${res.deliver.owner}: ${e.message}`, 'bad'));
        }
        app.ui.render();
        return res;
      },
      adminBan: async (pn, name) => {
        if (!confirm(`Ban ${name}? They are kicked and can't come back.`)) return null;
        const res = await req('adminBan', { pn }, `🛡 ${name} is banned.`);
        if (res.ok && res.ban?.account && app.accounts?.kind === 'online') {
          await app.accounts.ban(res.ban.account, res.ban.name).catch((e) => app.ui.toast(`The ban was not saved online: ${e.message}`, 'bad'));
        }
        app.ui.render();
        return res;
      },
      chat: (text) => app.net.request('chat', { text }).then((r) => { if (!r.ok && r.message) app.ui.toast(r.message, 'bad'); }),
      skipTutorial: () => req('tutorial', { skip: true }),
    };
  }

  useItem(itemId) {
    const item = ITEM_BY_ID[itemId];
    if (!this.profile.items[itemId]) {
      this.ui.toast(`You don't have a ${item.name}. Buy one at the Gadget Shop!`, 'warn');
      return;
    }
    let yaw = this.player.yaw;
    if (item.target === 'player') {
      // aim at the closest rival in front of the camera
      const fwd = this.cam.forward();
      const camYaw = Math.atan2(fwd.x, fwd.z);
      let best = null;
      let bd = item.range + 1;
      for (const p of this.players.values()) {
        const dx = p.pos.x - this.player.pos.x;
        const dz = p.pos.z - this.player.pos.z;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        let diff = Math.atan2(dx, dz) - camYaw;
        while (diff > Math.PI) diff -= Math.PI * 2;
        while (diff < -Math.PI) diff += Math.PI * 2;
        if (d < bd && Math.abs(diff) < 1.2) {
          bd = d;
          best = p;
        }
      }
      yaw = best ? Math.atan2(best.pos.x - this.player.pos.x, best.pos.z - this.player.pos.z) : camYaw;
      this.attackYaw = yaw;
      this.attackFaceUntil = performance.now() + 300;
      this.me.swing(false);
    }
    this.net.request('useItem', { itemId, yaw }).then((res) => {
      if (!res.ok) {
        if (res.message) this.ui.toast(res.message, 'warn');
        return;
      }
      if (res.miss) this.ui.toast('Missed! Get closer and face your target.', 'warn');
      else if (res.blocked) this.ui.toast('Blocked by a shield!', 'warn');
      else if (res.hit) this.ui.toast(`${item.icon} Hit!`, 'good');
    });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- movement rules (mirror the server)

  canEnter(x, z) {
    const id = regionIdAt(x, z);
    if (!id) return 'That is the edge of the world.';
    if (id !== this.region) {
      const reason = regionLockReason(REGION_BY_ID[id], this.progress(), this.activeRegions);
      if (reason) return reason;
    }
    const cur = this.player.pos;
    for (const b of this.world.bases) {
      if (b.index === this.myBase) continue;
      const st = this.baseStates[b.index];
      if (!st || !(st.lockedUntil > this.serverNow())) continue;
      if (isInsideBase(b, x, z) && !isInsideBase(b, cur.x, cur.z)) return 'Security lasers are on!';
    }
    if (this.puzzle && !(this.puzzle.openUntil > this.serverNow())) {
      const c = this.world.puzzle.center;
      const inside = (px, pz) => Math.abs(px - c.x) < 10.4 && Math.abs(pz - c.z) < 10.4;
      if (inside(x, z) && !inside(cur.x, cur.z)) return 'The vault door is sealed. Solve the plate puzzle!';
    }
    return true;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- attack & interact

  doAttack() {
    const sword = SWORD_BY_ID[this.profile.sword];
    const now = performance.now();
    if (now < this.nextSwingAt) return;
    if (this.myFx & (FX.frozen | FX.stunned | FX.dead | FX.slipping)) return;
    this.nextSwingAt = now + sword.cooldownMs;
    const fwd = this.cam.forward();
    const camYaw = Math.atan2(fwd.x, fwd.z);
    const pos = this.player.pos;
    let target = this.monsters.nearestTarget(pos, camYaw, sword.range + 3.5, 1.35) || this.monsters.nearestTarget(pos, this.player.yaw, sword.range + 1.5, Math.PI);
    let yaw;
    if (target) yaw = Math.atan2(target.pos.x - pos.x, target.pos.z - pos.z);
    else {
      const block = this.items.nearestBlock(pos, 5);
      yaw = block ? Math.atan2(block.data.x - pos.x, block.data.z - pos.z) : this.input.mouseLook ? camYaw : this.player.yaw;
    }
    this.attackYaw = yaw;
    this.attackFaceUntil = now + 350;
    this.player.yaw = yaw;
    this.comboCount = now - (this.lastSwing || 0) < CONFIG.combat.comboWindowMs ? (this.comboCount || 0) + 1 : 1;
    this.lastSwing = now;
    // the Legend Master's sword moves: 1, 2, 3 ... 10, then again
    this.moveIdx = ((this.moveIdx ?? -1) + 1) % LEGEND_MOVES;
    this.me.swing(this.comboCount % 3 === 0, this.moveIdx);
    if (this.me.h.element) {
      legendSwingFx(this.effects, this.me.h.element, this.moveIdx, this.player.pos, yaw, (k) => this.cam.addShake(k));
    }
    this.audio.play('swing');
    this.net.send('attack', { yaw });
  }

  // Z: the master power of your costume, aimed like a sword swing
  usePower() {
    const worn = COSTUME_BY_ID[this.profile.costumes.equipped];
    if (!worn) {
      this.ui.toast('🕶 Buy a costume at the Costume Shop in the plaza to get a master power (Z)!', 'warn');
      return;
    }
    if (worn.choosePower && !this.profile.costumes.power) {
      this.ui.open('legend');
      return;
    }
    const c = costumeWithPower(worn, this.profile.costumes.power);
    const now = performance.now();
    if (now < (this.powerLockUntil || 0)) return;
    this.powerLockUntil = now + 400;
    if (this.myFx & (FX.frozen | FX.stunned | FX.dead | FX.slipping)) return;
    const fwd = this.cam.forward();
    const camYaw = Math.atan2(fwd.x, fwd.z);
    const pos = this.player.pos;
    const reach = c.power.range || c.power.radius || 10;
    const target = this.monsters.nearestTarget(pos, camYaw, reach, 1.35) || this.monsters.nearestTarget(pos, this.player.yaw, reach, Math.PI);
    const yaw = target ? Math.atan2(target.pos.x - pos.x, target.pos.z - pos.z) : this.input.mouseLook ? camYaw : this.player.yaw;
    this.attackYaw = yaw;
    this.attackFaceUntil = now + 700;
    this.player.yaw = yaw;
    this.net.request('power', { yaw }).then((res) => {
      if (res.ok) this.powerReadyAt = performance.now() + (res.readyAt - this.serverNow());
      else if (res.message && res.error !== 'cant_act') this.ui.toast(res.message, res.error === 'cooldown' ? 'info' : 'warn');
    });
  }

  // the Z button shows the power's cooldown while you wear a costume
  updatePowerButton() {
    const btn = this.powerBtn || (this.powerBtn = $('power-btn'));
    const worn = COSTUME_BY_ID[this.profile.costumes.equipped];
    btn.hidden = !worn;
    if (!worn) return;
    const c = costumeWithPower(worn, this.profile.costumes.power);
    if (worn.choosePower && !this.profile.costumes.power) {
      setTextOnce(btn.querySelector('span'), ' Choose your power!');
      btn.classList.remove('locked');
      return;
    }
    const left = Math.ceil(((this.powerReadyAt || 0) - performance.now()) / 1000);
    setTextOnce(btn.querySelector('span'), left > 0 ? ` ${left}s` : ` ${c.power.name}`);
    btn.classList.toggle('locked', left > 0);
  }

  onPower(d) {
    const c = costumeWithPower(COSTUME_BY_ID[d.costume], d.element);
    const av = d.pn === this.pn ? this.me : this.players.get(d.pn);
    if (!c || !av) return;
    av.h.startPower();
    const pw = c.power;
    if (c.choosePower) {
      // Legend Master: charge up, then the power of its element
      const mine = d.pn === this.pn;
      const release = legendPowerFx(this.effects, d, c, mine);
      const near = Math.hypot(this.player.pos.x - d.x, this.player.pos.z - d.z) < 60;
      this.audio.play('crit');
      this.effects.later(release, () => {
        if (mine || near) this.cam.addShake(mine ? 1.4 : 0.7);
        this.audio.play('slam');
        if (d.element === 'lightning') this.audio.play('crit', { pitch: 0.6 });
      });
      if (mine) {
        const el = LEGEND_POWERS[d.element];
        this.ui.regionBanner(`${el?.icon || '👑'} ${pw.name.toUpperCase()}!`, `${fmt(powerDamage(c, this.profile.powerLevel))} damage`);
      }
      return;
    }
    const y = d.y;
    if (pw.shape === 'wave') this.effects.slashWave(d.x, y, d.z, d.yaw, pw.range, pw.arc, pw.color);
    else if (pw.shape === 'ring') {
      const cols = { flame_ninja: [0xff6a2a, 0xffd23a, 0xff3a1a], frost_knight: [0x9fe8ff, 0xffffff, 0x5ab8ff], bunny_hoodie: [0xff9fd8, 0xffffff, 0xffe27a] }[c.id] || [pw.color, 0xffffff];
      this.effects.ringBlast(d.x, y, d.z, pw.radius, cols);
      if (pw.heal) for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) this.effects.number('💖', new THREE.Vector3(d.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3, y + 4 + Math.random() * 2, d.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3), 'money');
    } else if (pw.shape === 'chain') {
      const pts = [{ x: d.x, y: y + 9, z: d.z }, ...d.targets.map((t) => ({ x: t.x, y: t.y + 1.5, z: t.z }))];
      this.effects.lightning(pts, pw.color);
    }
    if (d.pn === this.pn) {
      this.cam.addShake(0.9);
      this.ui.regionBanner(`${c.icon} ${pw.name.toUpperCase()}!`, `${powerDamage(c, this.profile.powerLevel)} damage`);
    }
    this.audio.play(pw.shape === 'chain' ? 'crit' : 'slam');
  }

  // costume arrival after a teleport (smoke for the spy, sparkles for others)
  costumeArrival(av, x, y, z) {
    const c = costumeWithPower(COSTUME_BY_ID[av.info.costume], av.info.costumePower);
    if (!c) return;
    av.h.startTeleport();
    const cols = c.id === 'black_spy' ? [0x14141c, 0x2c2c38, c.colors.glow] : [c.colors.glow, c.colors.jacket, 0xffffff];
    this.effects.burst(x, y + 1.5, z, 30, { color: cols, speed: 5, up: 0.6, life: 0.8, size: 0.35, grav: -1 });
  }

  // what pressing E (or R) would do right now
  findInteraction() {
    const pos = this.player.pos;
    const p = this.profile;
    // recruitable monster
    const offerId = this.ui.firstOfferId();
    if (offerId) {
      const m = this.monsters.get(offerId);
      if (m && m.state === MSTATE.defeated && m.pos.distanceTo(new THREE.Vector3(pos.x, m.pos.y, pos.z)) < CONFIG.recruitment.maxDistance) {
        const o = this.ui.offerEls.get(offerId).offer;
        return { kind: 'recruit', key: 'R', text: `Recruit ${m.species.name} for $${fmt(o.price)}`, id: offerId };
      }
    }
    const dropped = this.items.nearestDropped(pos, 4);
    if (dropped) {
      const mine = this.baseStates[this.myBase]?.monsters.some((m) => m.id === dropped.data.ownedId);
      return { kind: 'dropped', key: 'E', text: mine ? `Rescue your ${SPECIES_BY_ID[dropped.data.species].name}` : `Grab ${SPECIES_BY_ID[dropped.data.species].name}`, id: dropped.data.ownedId };
    }
    const block = this.items.nearestBlock(pos, CONFIG.lucky.claimRange - 0.5);
    if (block) return { kind: 'lucky', key: 'E', text: block.geode ? 'Crack open the Gem Geode!' : 'Open the Lucky Block!', id: block.data.id };
    // stealing from a rival base
    for (const b of this.world.bases) {
      if (b.index === this.myBase || !isInsideBase(b, pos.x, pos.z)) continue;
      const st = this.baseStates[b.index];
      if (!st) continue;
      if (st.lockedUntil > this.serverNow()) return null;
      const near = this.basesView.nearestPlaced(pos, CONFIG.stealing.maxDistance - 0.5, this.myBase);
      if (near && near.view.base.index === b.index) {
        if (this.myCarry >= 0) return { kind: 'info', key: '!', text: 'You are already carrying a monster — run to your base!' };
        return { kind: 'steal', key: 'E', text: `Hold to steal ${near.m.species.name}!`, id: near.id };
      }
    }
    for (const sh of this.world.shops) {
      if (Math.hypot(pos.x - sh.x, pos.z - sh.z) < 9) return { kind: 'shop', key: 'E', text: sh.name, panel: { swords: 'swords', items: 'items', costumes: 'costumes', power: 'power' }[sh.kind] || 'board' };
    }
    const g = this.world.gate;
    if (Math.hypot(pos.x - g.x, pos.z - g.z) < g.range) return { kind: 'shop', key: 'E', text: 'Island Gate: travel to the monster islands', panel: 'travel' };
    const myB = this.world.bases[this.myBase];
    if (myB && Math.hypot(pos.x - myB.terminal.x, pos.z - myB.terminal.z) < 3.5) return { kind: 'shop', key: 'E', text: 'Base upgrades', panel: 'base' };
    if (myB && isInsideBase(myB, pos.x, pos.z) && p.monsters.some((m) => m.slot === null)) {
      return { kind: 'info', key: 'C', text: 'Open your monsters to place them on pads' };
    }
    return null;
  }

  handleInteraction(dt) {
    const it = this.ui.isOpen() ? null : this.findInteraction();
    const now = performance.now();
    // stealing is a timed hold
    if (this.steal) {
      const s = this.steal;
      const held = this.input.down.has('interact');
      const still = it && it.kind === 'steal' && it.id === s.ownedId;
      if (!held || !still) {
        this.net.send('stealCancel', {});
        this.steal = null;
      } else {
        const k = Math.min(1, (now - s.start) / s.holdMs);
        this.ui.prompt('E', `Stealing… keep holding!`, k);
        if (k >= 1 && !s.confirming) {
          s.confirming = true;
          this.net.request('stealConfirm', { ownedId: s.ownedId }).then((res) => {
            this.steal = null;
            if (res.ok) {
              this.ui.toast('🐾 Got it! Run back to YOUR base before someone stops you!', 'good');
              this.audio.play('grab');
            } else if (res.message) this.ui.toast(res.message, 'bad');
          });
        }
        return;
      }
    }
    if (!it) {
      this.ui.hidePrompt();
    } else {
      this.ui.prompt(it.key, it.text);
    }
    const pressedE = this.input.consumePress('interact');
    const pressedR = this.input.consumePress('recruit');
    if (pressedR) {
      // R always means "recruit the monster on my newest card"
      const offerId = it?.kind === 'recruit' ? it.id : this.ui.firstOfferId();
      if (offerId) this.actions.recruit(offerId);
      else this.ui.toast('Defeat a wild monster first, then press R to pay its fee.', 'warn');
    }
    if (!it) return;
    if (it.kind === 'recruit') {
      if (pressedE) this.actions.recruit(it.id);
      return;
    }
    if (!pressedE) return;
    switch (it.kind) {
      case 'dropped':
        this.net.request('grabDropped', { ownedId: it.id }).then((r) => {
          if (!r.ok && r.message) this.ui.toast(r.message, 'warn');
          else if (r.ok && !r.rescued) this.audio.play('grab');
        });
        break;
      case 'lucky':
        this.net.request('claimLucky', { blockId: it.id }).then((r) => {
          if (!r.ok && r.message) this.ui.toast(r.message, 'warn');
        });
        break;
      case 'steal':
        this.net.request('stealBegin', { ownedId: it.id }).then((r) => {
          if (r.ok) {
            this.steal = { ownedId: it.id, start: performance.now(), holdMs: r.holdMs };
            this.audio.play('grab');
          } else if (r.message) this.ui.toast(r.message, 'bad');
        });
        break;
      case 'shop':
        this.ui.open(it.panel);
        break;
      case 'info':
        if (it.key === 'C') this.ui.open('collection');
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  }

  objective() {
    const p = this.profile;
    if (!p || p.tutorial.done) return null;
    const step = TUTORIAL[p.tutorial.step]?.key;
    const b = this.world.bases[this.myBase];
    if (step === 'explore') return { x: 70, z: -40 };
    if (step === 'defeat' || step === 'recruit') {
      let best = null;
      let bd = 200;
      for (const m of this.monsters.map.values()) {
        const d = Math.hypot(m.pos.x - this.player.pos.x, m.pos.z - this.player.pos.z);
        if (d < bd && m.state !== MSTATE.recover) {
          bd = d;
          best = m.pos;
        }
      }
      return best;
    }
    if (step === 'place') return b;
    if (step === 'collect') return b.collector;
    if (step === 'lock') return b.lockPad;
    if (step === 'sword') return this.world.shops.find((s) => s.kind === 'swords');
    return null;
  }

  drawFullMap(canvas) {
    const s = this.mapState();
    this.mapRenderer.drawFull(canvas, s);
  }

  mapState() {
    const now = performance.now();
    this.clues = this.clues.filter((c) => c.until > now);
    return {
      me: { x: this.player.pos.x, z: this.player.pos.z, yaw: this.player.yaw },
      camYaw: this.cam.yaw,
      bases: this.baseStates,
      myBase: this.myBase,
      lucky: [...this.items.blocks.values()].map((b) => b.data),
      monsters: [...this.monsters.map.values()].filter((m) => !m.gone).map((m) => ({ x: m.pos.x, z: m.pos.z, aggro: (m.flags & 32) !== 0, rare: RARITIES[m.species.rarity].order >= 2 })),
      players: [...this.players.values()].map((p) => ({ x: p.pos.x, z: p.pos.z, carrying: p.carryIdx >= 0 })),
      radar: this.radar.until > this.serverNow() ? this.radar.list : [],
      clues: this.clues,
      progress: this.progress(),
      active: this.activeRegions,
      minPop: this.worldState?.minPop,
      discoveredSpots: this.profile.discoveries.spots,
      objective: this.objective(),
      t: this.t,
    };
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- frame

  frame(nowMs) {
    requestAnimationFrame((t) => this.frame(t));
    const dt = Math.min(0.25, (nowMs - this.last) / 1000);
    this.last = nowMs;
    this.t += dt;
    if (!this.ready) return;
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const input = this.input;
    const serverNow = this.serverNow();
    const renderT = serverNow - (this.net.remote ? REMOTE_INTERP_DELAY : INTERP_DELAY);
    const panelOpen = this.ui.isOpen();

    // keys that open things
    if (input.consumePress('menu')) {
      if (panelOpen) this.ui.close();
      else this.ui.open('settings');
    }
    if (input.consumePress('debug')) this.showDebug = !this.showDebug;
    if (!input.typing) {
      if (input.consumePress('chat')) this.ui.openChat();
      if (input.consumePress('collection')) this.ui.toggle('collection');
      if (input.consumePress('map')) this.ui.toggle('map');
      if (input.consumePress('mouselook')) input.toggleMouseLook();
    }
    document.body.classList.toggle('mouselook', input.mouseLook);
    const active = !panelOpen && !input.typing;
    if (active) {
      if (input.consumePress('home')) this.actions.home();
      if (input.consumePress('lock')) this.actions.lock();
      if (input.consumePress('callAllies')) this.actions.callAllies();
      if (input.consumePress('power') && !(this.myFx & FX.dead)) this.usePower();
      ITEMS.forEach((it, i) => {
        if (input.consumePress(`item${i + 1}`)) this.useItem(it.id);
      });
    }

    // camera input
    const look = active ? input.consumeLook() : (input.consumeLook(), { x: 0, y: 0 });
    const zoom = active ? input.consumeZoom() : 0;

    // local movement
    const fx = this.myFx;
    const dead = (fx & FX.dead) !== 0;
    const p = this.profile;
    let speedMult = 1 + (p.perks?.speed || 0);
    if (fx & FX.slowed) speedMult *= 0.6;
    if (fx & FX.speed) speedMult *= ITEM_BY_ID.speed_boost.speedMultiplier;
    if (this.myCarry >= 0) speedMult *= CONFIG.player.carrySpeedFactor;
    const frozen = dead || (fx & (FX.frozen | FX.rooted)) !== 0;
    const move = active ? input.axis() : { x: 0, z: 0 };
    const fwd = this.cam.forward();
    const camYaw = Math.atan2(fwd.x, fwd.z);
    const faceYaw = performance.now() < this.attackFaceUntil ? this.attackYaw : input.mouseLook ? camYaw : null;
    const wasGrounded = this.player.grounded;
    const jump = active && input.down.has('jump');
    // physics in small sub-steps so slow devices still move correctly
    const moveOpts = {
      sprint: input.down.has('sprint'),
      jump,
      speedMult,
      frozen,
      slipping: (fx & FX.slipping) !== 0,
      canEnter: (x, z) => this.canEnter(x, z),
      resolveDynamic: (pos) => this.basesView.resolveGates(pos, this.myBase),
      faceYaw,
    };
    let blocked = null;
    const steps = Math.ceil(dt / 0.034);
    for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) blocked = this.player.update(dt / steps, move, fwd, moveOpts) || blocked;
    if (blocked) this.blockedToast(blocked);
    if (wasGrounded && !this.player.grounded && jump && this.player.vel.y > 5) this.audio.play('jump');
    if (active && input.consumePress('dodge') && !frozen) {
      this.net.request('dodge').then((r) => {
        if (r.ok) {
          this.player.startDodge();
          this.me.h.startDodge();
          this.audio.play('dodge');
        }
      });
    }
    if (active && (input.down.has('attack') || input.consumePress('attack')) && !dead) this.doAttack();
    if (active) this.handleInteraction(dt);
    else this.ui.hidePrompt();

    // region change
    const region = regionIdAt(this.player.pos.x, this.player.pos.z);
    if (region && region !== this.region) {
      this.region = region;
      const r = REGION_BY_ID[region];
      this.ui.regionBanner(r.name, r.blurb);
    }

    // send our position ~15 times a second
    const now = performance.now();
    if (now - this.lastMoveSent > 66) {
      this.lastMoveSent = now;
      const pp = this.player.pos;
      this.net.send('move', { x: Math.round(pp.x * 100) / 100, y: Math.round(pp.y * 100) / 100, z: Math.round(pp.z * 100) / 100, yaw: Math.round(this.player.yaw * 1000) / 1000, a: this.player.anim, tp: this.teleportSeq });
    }

    // views
    this.me.setLocal(this.player.pos, this.player.yaw, this.player.anim);
    const everyone = [this.me, ...this.players.values()];
    for (const pl of everyone) pl.update(dt, this.t, renderT, this.effects, everyone.filter((o) => o !== pl).map((o) => o.pos));
    const camPos = this.sceneView.camera.position;
    this.monsters.update(dt, renderT, this.t, camPos, this.player.pos);
    this.guardsView.update(dt, renderT, this.t, camPos);
    const near = [{ x: this.player.pos.x, y: this.player.pos.y, z: this.player.pos.z }, ...[...this.players.values()].map((pl) => pl.pos)];
    this.basesView.update(dt, this.t, near, camPos);
    this.items.update(dt, this.t);
    this.effects.update(dt, serverNow);
    this.capture.update(dt);
    this.worldView.update(dt, this.t, camPos);
    if (this.preview) this.preview.update(dt);

    // ← → turn the camera; walking forward slowly swings it behind you
    // (unless you turned it yourself in the last moment)
    if (active) {
      const turn = (input.down.has('camRight') ? 1 : 0) - (input.down.has('camLeft') ? 1 : 0);
      if (turn) {
        this.cam.yaw -= turn * 2.0 * dt;
        input.lastManualLook = performance.now();
      }
      if (!input.mouseLook && move.z > 0.2 && !dead && performance.now() - input.lastManualLook > 1500) {
        let d = this.player.yaw + Math.PI - this.cam.yaw;
        while (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
        while (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
        this.cam.yaw += d * Math.min(1, dt * 1.3);
      }
    }
    this.cam.update(dt, this.player.pos, look, zoom, this.indoorView());
    this.updateBaseMarker(panelOpen);
    const lucky = this.events?.some((e) => e.phase === 'active');
    // the Moon Sky Arena is always under the night sky
    this.sceneView.update(dt, this.t, this.region === 'moonsky' ? 0.82 : this.dayT(), this.player.pos, this.region, lucky);
    if (lucky && Math.random() < dt * 6) this.effects.confetti(this.player.pos.x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40, this.player.pos.y + 25, this.player.pos.z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40, 3);

    // HUD at ~10 Hz
    this.hudT = (this.hudT || 0) + dt;
    if (this.hudT > 0.1) {
      this.hudT = 0;
      const st = this.state();
      this.ui.updateHUD(st);
      this.ui.updateEvent(this.events, serverNow);
      this.worldView.updateBarriers(this.progress(), this.activeRegions);
      this.mapRenderer.drawMini($('minimap'), this.mapState());
      if (this.ui.panelName === 'map') this.drawFullMap($('map-canvas'));
      if (this.puzzle) this.worldView.setPuzzleState(this.puzzle, serverNow);
      this.updateMoonHud();
      setNightGlow(this.isNight() || this.region === 'moonsky');
      this.updatePowerButton();
      const open = this.puzzle && this.puzzle.openUntil > serverNow;
      for (const c of this.vaultColliders) c.enabled = !open;
      this.updateDebug(serverNow);
    }
    const t1 = performance.now();
    // skipRender: automated tests turn drawing off while bots walk long
    // routes on software-rendered browsers (game logic still runs)
    if (!this.skipRender) this.sceneView.render();
    const t2 = performance.now();
    this.jsMs = (this.jsMs || 0) * 0.95 + (t1 - t0) * 0.05;
    this.renderMs = (this.renderMs || 0) * 0.95 + (t2 - t1) * 0.05;
    this.frames = (this.frames || 0) + 1;
    input.endFrame();
  }

  // F3: performance and state overlay
  updateDebug(serverNow) {
    const el = $('debug');
    const now = performance.now();
    if (!this.fpsAt) this.fpsAt = now;
    if (now - this.fpsAt >= 1000) {
      this.fps = Math.round((this.frames * 1000) / (now - this.fpsAt));
      this.frames = 0;
      this.fpsAt = now;
    }
    this.stats = {
      fps: this.fps || 0,
      calls: this.sceneView.renderer.info.render.calls,
      triangles: this.sceneView.renderer.info.render.triangles,
      monsters: this.monsters.map.size,
      players: this.players.size + 1,
      particles: this.effects.mesh.count,
      rtt: Math.round(this.net.rtt),
      jsMs: Math.round(this.jsMs * 10) / 10,
      renderMs: Math.round(this.renderMs * 10) / 10,
    };
    el.hidden = !this.showDebug;
    if (!this.showDebug) return;
    const p = this.player.pos;
    el.textContent = `FPS ${this.stats.fps}  logic ${this.stats.jsMs} ms  render ${this.stats.renderMs} ms  draw calls ${this.stats.calls}  triangles ${this.stats.triangles.toLocaleString()}\n`
      + `monsters ${this.stats.monsters}  players ${this.stats.players}  particles ${this.stats.particles}  ping ${this.stats.rtt} ms\n`
      + `pos ${p.x.toFixed(1)} ${p.y.toFixed(1)} ${p.z.toFixed(1)}  region ${this.region}  day ${(this.dayT() * 24).toFixed(1)}h  quality ${this.settings.quality}`;
    void serverNow;
  }
}

window.addEventListener('error', (e) => console.error('client error', e.message));
const app = new App();
window.__app = app;

FILE: public/client/minimap.js

// Minimap (rotates with the camera) and the full world map panel.

import { REGIONS, REGION_BY_ID, RING, regionIdAt, regionCenter, regionLockReason } from '#shared/regions.js';
import { SPECIES_BY_ID, RARITIES } from '#shared/monsters.js';

const WORLD_EXTENT = RING.edge + 40;
const IMG = 640;

function hex(c) {
  return '#' + c.toString(16).padStart(6, '0');
}

export class MapRenderer {
  constructor(world) {
    this.world = world;
    this.image = this.renderTerrain(-WORLD_EXTENT, -WORLD_EXTENT, WORLD_EXTENT * 2, IMG);
    this.islands = REGIONS.filter((r) => r.shape.kind === 'island' && !r.arena).map((r) => {
      const m = r.shape.r + 30;
      return { region: r, x0: r.shape.cx - m, z0: r.shape.cz - m, size: m * 2, img: this.renderTerrain(r.shape.cx - m, r.shape.cz - m, m * 2, 220) };
    });
  }

  renderTerrain(x0, z0, size, px) {
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = c.height = px;
    const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
    const img = ctx.createImageData(px, px);
    const cache = {};
    for (const r of REGIONS) {
      const lo = r.colors.low;
      cache[r.id] = [(lo >> 16) & 255, (lo >> 8) & 255, lo & 255];
    }
    for (let j = 0; j < px; j++) {
      for (let i = 0; i < px; i++) {
        const x = x0 + ((i + 0.5) / px) * size;
        const z = z0 + ((j + 0.5) / px) * size;
        const h = this.world.groundHeight(x, z);
        const id = regionIdAt(x, z);
        let rgb;
        if (h < -0.3) {
          const d = Math.min(1, -h / 10);
          rgb = [60 - d * 30, 160 - d * 50, 230 - d * 40];
        } else if (id) {
          const base = cache[id];
          const shade = 0.82 + Math.min(0.3, h / 60);
          rgb = [base[0] * shade, base[1] * shade, base[2] * shade];
        } else rgb = [40, 90, 150];
        const k = (j * px + i) * 4;
        img.data[k] = rgb[0];
        img.data[k + 1] = rgb[1];
        img.data[k + 2] = rgb[2];
        img.data[k + 3] = 255;
      }
    }
    ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
    // roads and plaza
    const toPx = (v) => ((v - x0) / size) * px;
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(240, 220, 170, 0.8)';
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, (6 / size) * px);
    if (x0 < 0 && x0 + size > 0) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(toPx(-RING.edge), toPx(0));
      ctx.lineTo(toPx(RING.edge), toPx(0));
      ctx.moveTo(toPx(0), toPx(-RING.edge));
      ctx.lineTo(toPx(0), toPx(RING.edge));
      ctx.stroke();
      for (const r of [72, 128]) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(toPx(0), toPx(0), (r / size) * px, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e8e0cc';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(toPx(0), toPx(0), (38 / size) * px, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    return c;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ minimap

  drawMini(canvas, s) {
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const W = canvas.width;
    const R = W / 2;
    const range = 130;
    const scale = R / range;
    const me = s.me;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, W);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(R, R, R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.clip();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2a6aa8';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, W);
    ctx.translate(R, R);
    // rotate so the camera's forward is up
    ctx.rotate(s.camYaw);
    ctx.scale(scale, scale);
    ctx.translate(-me.x, -me.z);
    const unitsPerPx = (WORLD_EXTENT * 2) / IMG;
    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
    ctx.drawImage(this.image, -WORLD_EXTENT, -WORLD_EXTENT, IMG * unitsPerPx, IMG * unitsPerPx);
    for (const isl of this.islands) ctx.drawImage(isl.img, isl.x0, isl.z0, isl.size, isl.size);
    // locked regions are shaded
    this.shadeLocked(ctx, s);
    // bases
    for (const b of this.world.bases) {
      const st = s.bases[b.index];
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(b.x, b.z);
      ctx.rotate(Math.atan2(b.tu.z, b.tu.x));
      ctx.fillStyle = st ? hex(st.colorHex ?? 0x3a7ae0) : 'rgba(255,255,255,.35)';
      ctx.strokeStyle = b.index === s.myBase ? '#ffe14a' : '#241640';
      ctx.lineWidth = b.index === s.myBase ? 4 : 2;
      ctx.fillRect(-13, -13, 26, 26);
      ctx.strokeRect(-13, -13, 26, 26);
      ctx.restore();
    }
    // lucky blocks
    for (const b of s.lucky) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd93a';
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#5a3a00';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.fillRect(b.x - 4, b.z - 4, 8, 8);
      ctx.strokeRect(b.x - 4, b.z - 4, 8, 8);
    }
    // monsters
    for (const m of s.monsters) {
      ctx.fillStyle = m.aggro ? '#ff4a5e' : m.rare ? '#c46bff' : '#ffffff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(m.x, m.z, m.rare ? 3.2 : 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    // radar and clues
    for (const r of s.radar) {
      ctx.fillStyle = RARITIES[SPECIES_BY_ID[r.sp]?.rarity]?.color || '#c46bff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(r.x, r.z, 4.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    for (const c of s.clues) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#ff5aa5';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(c.x, c.z, 7 + Math.sin(s.t * 5) * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    // other players
    for (const p of s.players) {
      ctx.fillStyle = p.carrying ? '#ff4a5e' : '#3fa6ff';
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.z, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
    // me (always centered, pointing in my facing direction relative to the camera)
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(R, R);
    ctx.rotate(-(me.yaw - s.camYaw - Math.PI));
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe14a';
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#241640';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, -9);
    ctx.lineTo(6, 7);
    ctx.lineTo(0, 3);
    ctx.lineTo(-6, 7);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
    // objective arrow on the rim
    if (s.objective) {
      const dx = s.objective.x - me.x;
      const dz = s.objective.z - me.z;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
      const a = Math.atan2(dz, dx);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(R, R);
      ctx.rotate(s.camYaw);
      const r = Math.min(R - 10, d * scale);
      ctx.translate(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r);
      ctx.rotate(-s.camYaw);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5aa5';
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  shadeLocked(ctx, s) {
    for (const r of REGIONS) {
      const reason = regionLockReason(r, s.progress, s.active);
      if (!reason) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20, 10, 40, 0.5)';
      const sh = r.shape;
      ctx.beginPath();
      if (sh.kind === 'sector') {
        let a1 = sh.a1 < sh.a0 ? sh.a1 + 360 : sh.a1;
        ctx.arc(0, 0, sh.r2, (sh.a0 * Math.PI) / 180, (a1 * Math.PI) / 180);
        ctx.arc(0, 0, sh.r1, (a1 * Math.PI) / 180, (sh.a0 * Math.PI) / 180, true);
      } else if (sh.kind === 'ring') {
        ctx.arc(0, 0, sh.r2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.arc(0, 0, sh.r1, Math.PI * 2, 0, true);
      } else if (sh.kind === 'island') {
        ctx.arc(sh.cx, sh.cz, sh.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      }
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill('evenodd');
    }
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ full map

  drawFull(canvas, s) {
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const W = canvas.width;
    // canvas pixels per CSS pixel, so text keeps its size however big the map
    // is shown; the label size itself follows the map's on-screen size
    const cssW = canvas.clientWidth || W;
    const ui = W / cssW;
    const fontPx = Math.max(8.5, Math.min(12, cssW / 52));
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, W);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1e4a7a';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, W);
    ctx.save();
    // the continent in the middle, the islands as round insets around it
    // (in the direction where they really are)
    const k = (W * 0.66) / (WORLD_EXTENT * 2);
    ctx.translate(W / 2, W / 2);
    ctx.scale(k, k);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(0, 0, RING.edge + 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.clip();
    ctx.drawImage(this.image, -WORLD_EXTENT, -WORLD_EXTENT, WORLD_EXTENT * 2, WORLD_EXTENT * 2);
    this.shadeLocked(ctx, s);
    ctx.restore();
    const insets = this.islands.map((isl) => {
      const sh = isl.region.shape;
      const a = Math.atan2(sh.cz, sh.cx);
      const sz = W * 0.13;
      return { isl, sz, cx: W / 2 + Math.cos(a) * W * 0.42, cy: W / 2 + Math.sin(a) * W * 0.42 };
    });
    for (const n of insets) {
      const { isl, sz, cx, cy } = n;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, sz / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.clip();
      ctx.drawImage(isl.img, cx - sz / 2, cy - sz / 2, sz, sz);
      const reason = regionLockReason(isl.region, s.progress, s.active);
      if (reason) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,10,40,.6)';
        ctx.fillRect(cx - sz / 2, cy - sz / 2, sz, sz);
      }
      ctx.restore();
      ctx.lineWidth = 3 * ui;
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#241640';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, sz / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.font = `800 ${Math.round(fontPx * 0.95 * ui)}px "Trebuchet MS", system-ui`;
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      const name = isl.region.name.replace(/ (Island|Isle)$/, '');
      const lock = !reason ? '' : s.active.has(isl.region.id) ? `🔒 Lv ${isl.region.unlock?.level}` : `🔒 ${s.minPop?.[isl.region.id] ?? isl.region.minPopulation}+ players`;
      const lines = lock ? [name, lock] : [name];
      // labels under the island, except at the bottom edge of the map
      const above = cy > W * 0.75;
      lines.forEach((t, i) => {
        const y = above ? cy - sz / 2 - (6 + (lines.length - 1 - i) * 13) * ui : cy + sz / 2 + (12 + i * 13) * ui;
        const half = ctx.measureText(t).width / 2 + 4 * ui;
        const x = Math.min(W - half, Math.max(half, cx));
        ctx.lineWidth = 3 * ui;
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#241640';
        ctx.fillStyle = i === 0 ? '#fff' : '#ffb0c0';
        ctx.strokeText(t, x, y);
        ctx.fillText(t, x, y);
      });
    }
    // a world point on an island -> its inset on screen
    const onInset = (x, z) => {
      for (const n of insets) {
        const sh = n.isl.region.shape;
        const m = sh.r + 30;
        const dx = x - sh.cx;
        const dz = z - sh.cz;
        if (dx * dx + dz * dz < m * m) return { x: n.cx + (dx / m) * (n.sz / 2), y: n.cy + (dz / m) * (n.sz / 2) };
      }
      return null;
    };
    const dot = (x, z, r, fill, stroke) => {
      const p = onInset(x, z);
      if (!p && Math.max(Math.abs(x), Math.abs(z)) > WORLD_EXTENT) return;
      const sx = p ? p.x : W / 2 + x * k;
      const sy = p ? p.y : W / 2 + z * k;
      ctx.fillStyle = fill;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(sx, sy, r * ui, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      if (stroke) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = stroke;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2 * ui;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    };
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(W / 2, W / 2);
    ctx.scale(k, k);
    // bases
    for (const b of this.world.bases) {
      const st = s.bases[b.index];
      ctx.fillStyle = st ? hex(st.colorHex ?? 0x3a7ae0) : 'rgba(255,255,255,.3)';
      ctx.fillRect(b.x - 12, b.z - 12, 24, 24);
      if (b.index === s.myBase) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffe14a';
        ctx.lineWidth = 6;
        ctx.strokeRect(b.x - 14, b.z - 14, 28, 28);
      }
    }
    ctx.restore();
    // discovered spots, clues, players (on the continent or on an island inset)
    for (const sp of this.world.spots) {
      if (!s.discoveredSpots[sp.id] && sp.hidden) continue;
      dot(sp.x, sp.z, 3.2, s.discoveredSpots[sp.id] ? '#ffe14a' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.6)');
    }
    for (const c of s.clues) dot(c.x, c.z, 6, 'rgba(255,90,165,.35)', '#ff5aa5');
    for (const p of s.players) dot(p.x, p.z, 4, '#3fa6ff');
    dot(s.me.x, s.me.z, 5.5, '#ffe14a', '#241640');
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(W / 2, W / 2);
    ctx.scale(k, k);
    // labels (two lines: name + lock)
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    for (const r of REGIONS) {
      if (r.shape.kind === 'island') continue;
      let c = regionCenter(r);
      // (upper left: the island insets sit in the lower corners)
      if (r.shape.kind === 'ring') c = { x: Math.cos(2.36) * 535, z: Math.sin(2.36) * 535 };
      if (r.id === 'plains') c = { x: 0, z: -118 };
      // regions centred on the horizontal axis: stagger inner/outer labels
      if (r.shape.kind === 'sector' && Math.abs(c.z) < 60) c = { x: c.x, z: c.z + (r.shape.r1 === RING.hub ? 60 : -60) };
      const reason = regionLockReason(r, s.progress, s.active);
      const lines = [r.name];
      if (reason && r.id !== 'plains') lines.push(`🔒 Lv ${r.unlock.level}${r.unlock.swordTier ? ` · T${r.unlock.swordTier} sword` : ''}`);
      const fp = fontPx * 0.85;
      ctx.font = `800 ${Math.round((fp * ui) / k)}px "Trebuchet MS", system-ui`;
      ctx.lineWidth = (4 * ui) / k;
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#241640';
      lines.forEach((t, i) => {
        const y = c.z + (i - (lines.length - 1) / 2) * ((fp * 1.25 * ui) / k);
        ctx.fillStyle = i === 0 ? '#ffffff' : '#ffb0c0';
        ctx.strokeText(t, c.x, y);
        ctx.fillText(t, c.x, y);
      });
    }
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

export { REGION_BY_ID };

// Turns a species "model recipe" (shared/monsters.js) into a rigged 3D model.
//
// Everything is built from a small set of shared, cached geometries (spheres,
// rounded boxes, cones, lathes...) scaled into shape, with cached
// materials, so dozens of monsters stay cheap while still looking different.
// The returned rig exposes named pivots (head, eyes, mouth, ears, tail
// segments, legs, wings...) that client/animationSystem.js animates.
//
// Works without a DOM (except the 'cube' body checker texture), so tests can
// build every species in Node.

import * as THREE from 'three';
import { RoundedBoxGeometry } from 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js';
import { mergeGeometries } from 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js';
import { SPECIES_BY_ID } from '#shared/monsters.js';

const V = (x = 0, y = 0, z = 0) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z);

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ geometry cache

function lathe(taper, segments = 28, wobble = 0, n = 20) {
  const pts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
    const t = -1 + (2 * i) / n;
    const r = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - t * t)) * (1 - taper * t) * (1 + wobble * Math.sin(t * 9));
    pts.push(new THREE.Vector2(Math.max(0.0001, r), t));
  }
  return new THREE.LatheGeometry(pts, segments);
}

function dropGeo(n = 18, segments = 14) {
  // teardrop: round bottom, pointed top (flames, leaves, petals)
  const pts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
    const t = i / n; // 0 bottom -> 1 top
    const a = t * Math.PI;
    const r = Math.sin(a) * (1 - t * 0.85) * 0.95 + 0.0001;
    pts.push(new THREE.Vector2(r, -Math.cos(a) * 0.5 + t * 0.5));
  }
  return new THREE.LatheGeometry(pts, segments);
}

function ghostGeo(n = 12, segments = 28) {
  const pts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
    const a = (i / n) * (Math.PI / 2);
    pts.push(new THREE.Vector2(Math.sin(a), Math.cos(a)));
  }
  pts.push(new THREE.Vector2(1.0, -0.4));
  pts.push(new THREE.Vector2(0.94, -0.62));
  pts.push(new THREE.Vector2(0.0001, -0.62));
  return new THREE.LatheGeometry(pts.reverse(), segments);
}

function batWingShape() {
  const s = new THREE.Shape();
  s.moveTo(0, 0);
  s.lineTo(0.2, 0.55);
  s.lineTo(0.55, 0.8);
  s.lineTo(1.0, 0.75);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(0.85, 0.45, 0.95, 0.2);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(0.72, 0.28, 0.62, 0.05);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(0.45, 0.18, 0.32, -0.08);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(0.18, 0.05, 0, 0);
  return new THREE.ShapeGeometry(s, 6);
}

function starShape() {
  const s = new THREE.Shape();
  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    const r = i % 2 ? 0.45 : 1;
    const a = (i / 10) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.PI / 2;
    if (i === 0) s.moveTo(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r);
    else s.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r);
  }
  return new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(s, { depth: 0.3, bevelEnabled: false }).translate(0, 0, -0.15);
}

// Two resolutions of every primitive: 'hi' for close-ups and nearby
// monsters, 'lo' for the far-away copies (same shapes, far fewer triangles).
const GEO_SETS = {};
let G = null;

function makeGeoSet(lo) {
  if (lo) {
    return {
      sphere: new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 14, 10),
      sphereLo: new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 8, 6),
      hemi: new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 12, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2),
      cone: new THREE.ConeGeometry(1, 1, 8).translate(0, 0.5, 0),
      cone4: new THREE.ConeGeometry(1, 1, 4).rotateY(Math.PI / 4).translate(0, 0.5, 0),
      cone3: new THREE.ConeGeometry(1, 1, 3).translate(0, 0.5, 0),
      cyl: new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 8).translate(0, 0.5, 0),
      cylC: new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 8),
      rbox: new RoundedBoxGeometry(1, 1, 1, 1, 0.2),
      rboxSoft: new RoundedBoxGeometry(1, 1, 1, 2, 0.42),
      box: new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1),
      arc: new THREE.TorusGeometry(1, 0.2, 4, 10, Math.PI),
      torus: new THREE.TorusGeometry(1, 0.14, 4, 14),
      octa: new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(1, 0),
      ico: new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 0),
      egg: lathe(0.12, 12, 0, 9),
      pear: lathe(0.24, 12, 0, 9),
      ghost: ghostGeo(5, 12),
      drop: dropGeo(8, 7),
      wing: batWingShape(),
      star: starShape(),
      capsule: new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.5, 1, 3, 8),
      disc: new THREE.CircleGeometry(1, 12),
    };
  }
  return {
    sphere: new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 32, 24),
    sphereLo: new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 14, 10),
    hemi: new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 24, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2, 0, Math.PI / 2),
    cone: new THREE.ConeGeometry(1, 1, 16).translate(0, 0.5, 0),
    cone4: new THREE.ConeGeometry(1, 1, 4).rotateY(Math.PI / 4).translate(0, 0.5, 0),
    cone3: new THREE.ConeGeometry(1, 1, 3).translate(0, 0.5, 0),
    cyl: new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 16).translate(0, 0.5, 0),
    cylC: new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 16),
    rbox: new RoundedBoxGeometry(1, 1, 1, 4, 0.2),
    rboxSoft: new RoundedBoxGeometry(1, 1, 1, 5, 0.42),
    box: new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1),
    arc: new THREE.TorusGeometry(1, 0.2, 8, 24, Math.PI),
    torus: new THREE.TorusGeometry(1, 0.14, 8, 32),
    octa: new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(1, 0),
    ico: new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 1),
    egg: lathe(0.12),
    pear: lathe(0.24),
    ghost: ghostGeo(),
    drop: dropGeo(),
    wing: batWingShape(),
    star: starShape(),
    capsule: new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.5, 1, 6, 14),
    disc: new THREE.CircleGeometry(1, 24),
  };
}

function useGeoSet(name) {
  if (!GEO_SETS[name]) GEO_SETS[name] = makeGeoSet(name === 'lo');
  G = GEO_SETS[name];
  return G;
}

function geos() {
  return G || useGeoSet('hi');
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ materials

const matCache = new Map();
function mat(color, o = {}) {
  const key = `${color}|${o.emissive ?? ''}|${o.ei ?? ''}|${o.rough ?? ''}|${o.opacity ?? ''}|${o.side ?? ''}|${o.metal ?? ''}`;
  let m = matCache.get(key);
  if (!m) {
    m = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color,
      roughness: o.rough ?? 0.5,
      metalness: o.metal ?? 0,
      emissive: o.emissive ?? 0x000000,
      emissiveIntensity: o.ei ?? 1,
      transparent: (o.opacity ?? 1) < 1,
      opacity: o.opacity ?? 1,
      side: o.side ?? THREE.FrontSide,
      depthWrite: (o.opacity ?? 1) >= 0.6,
    });
    matCache.set(key, m);
  }
  return m;
}

export const FLASH_MAT = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, emissive: 0xff6a6a, emissiveIntensity: 1.2, roughness: 0.6 });
export const FROZEN_MAT = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xbff1ff, emissive: 0x4a9fd8, emissiveIntensity: 0.5, roughness: 0.2 });

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers

function mesh(geo, material, scale, pos, rot) {
  // small spheres don't need many polygons
  if (geo === G.sphere && scale) {
    const s = typeof scale === 'number' ? scale : Math.max(Math.abs(scale[0]), Math.abs(scale[1]), Math.abs(scale[2]));
    if (s < 0.3) geo = G.sphereLo;
  }
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, material);
  if (scale) {
    if (typeof scale === 'number') m.scale.setScalar(scale);
    else m.scale.set(scale[0], scale[1], scale[2]);
  }
  if (pos) m.position.set(pos[0], pos[1], pos[2]);
  if (rot) m.rotation.set(rot[0], rot[1], rot[2]);
  return m;
}

function pivot(parent, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.position.set(x, y, z);
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}

// Shapes with an analytic surface so face features sit exactly on them.
// p: superellipse exponent (2 = ellipsoid, 4 = rounded box), taper: egg/pear.
function shapeOf(kind, size, center) {
  const p = kind === 'roundbox' ? 4 : kind === 'cube' ? 8 : kind === 'gem' ? 1.15 : 2;
  const taper = kind === 'egg' ? 0.12 : kind === 'pear' ? 0.24 : 0;
  return { kind, p, taper, c: center.clone(), r: V(size[0] / 2, size[1] / 2, size[2] / 2) };
}

// Point on the front (+z) of a shape at normalized coordinates nx, ny in -1..1.
function surf(sh, nx, ny, inset = 0) {
  const { p } = sh;
  const ax = Math.min(0.999, Math.abs(nx));
  const ay = Math.min(0.999, Math.abs(ny));
  let rem;
  if (sh.kind === 'ghost' && ny < 0) rem = 1 - Math.pow(ax, 2);
  else rem = 1 - Math.pow(ax, p) - Math.pow(ay, p);
  const nz = rem > 0 ? Math.pow(rem, 1 / p) : 0;
  const k = 1 - sh.taper * ny;
  const pos = V(nx * sh.r.x * k, ny * sh.r.y, nz * sh.r.z * k).add(sh.c);
  const n = V(
    (Math.sign(nx) * Math.pow(ax, p - 1)) / sh.r.x,
    sh.kind === 'ghost' && ny < 0 ? 0 : (Math.sign(ny) * Math.pow(ay, p - 1)) / sh.r.y,
    Math.pow(Math.max(nz, 0.0001), p - 1) / sh.r.z,
  ).normalize();
  if (inset) pos.addScaledVector(n, -inset);
  return { pos, n };
}

// Point on top of a shape (for ears, horns, crests). nx, nz in -1..1.
function top(sh, nx, nz = 0) {
  const ax = Math.min(0.999, Math.abs(nx));
  const az = Math.min(0.999, Math.abs(nz));
  const rem = 1 - Math.pow(ax, sh.p) - Math.pow(az, sh.p);
  const ny = rem > 0 ? Math.pow(rem, 1 / sh.p) : 0;
  const k = 1 - sh.taper * ny;
  return V(nx * sh.r.x * k, ny * sh.r.y, nz * sh.r.z * k).add(sh.c);
}

function orient(obj, normal) {
  obj.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(V(0, 0, 1), normal);
}

function hex(v) {
  return typeof v === 'number' ? v : 0xff00ff;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ builder

// Every species is built once into an optimised template (static meshes
// merged per pivot and material); each monster is a cheap clone that shares
// geometry and materials with the template.
const TEMPLATES = new Map();
const SINGLE_KEYS = ['root', 'bodyPivot', 'body', 'head', 'mouth', 'mouthOpen', 'jaw', 'upperTeeth', 'crest', 'shell', 'spout', 'flames', 'halo', 'tailFlame', 'coin', 'snout', 'lantern', 'waveArm'];

// opts.lod: 'hi' (default) or 'lo' (low-poly copy for far-away monsters).
export function buildMonster(speciesId, opts = {}) {
  const lod = opts.lod === 'lo' ? 'lo' : 'hi';
  const key = `${speciesId}|${lod}`;
  let t = TEMPLATES.get(key);
  if (!t) {
    useGeoSet(lod);
    try {
      t = buildRawMonster(speciesId, opts);
    } finally {
      useGeoSet('hi');
    }
    optimizeTemplate(t, lod === 'lo');
    TEMPLATES.set(key, t);
  }
  const rig = cloneRig(t);
  rig.lod = lod;
  return rig;
}

function rigObjects(rig) {
  const list = [];
  for (const k of SINGLE_KEYS) if (rig[k]) list.push(rig[k]);
  for (const e of rig.eyes) list.push(e.group, e.inner);
  list.push(...rig.eyeX, ...rig.tail, ...rig.antennae);
  for (const x of [...rig.ears, ...rig.legs, ...rig.arms, ...rig.wings]) list.push(x.pivot);
  for (const x of rig.spin) list.push(x.obj);
  return list;
}

function flipWinding(g) {
  for (const name of Object.keys(g.attributes)) {
    const a = g.attributes[name];
    const n = a.itemSize;
    for (let i = 0; i < a.count; i += 3) {
      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        const t = a.array[(i + 1) * n + k];
        a.array[(i + 1) * n + k] = a.array[(i + 2) * n + k];
        a.array[(i + 2) * n + k] = t;
      }
    }
  }
}

function mergeMeshes(list) {
  const hasUv = list.every((m) => m.geometry.attributes.uv);
  const geos = list.map((m) => {
    m.updateMatrix();
    let g = m.geometry.index ? m.geometry.toNonIndexed() : m.geometry.clone();
    for (const k of Object.keys(g.attributes)) if (k !== 'position' && k !== 'normal' && !(k === 'uv' && hasUv)) g.deleteAttribute(k);
    g.applyMatrix4(m.matrix);
    if (m.matrix.determinant() < 0) flipWinding(g);
    return g;
  });
  const merged = mergeGeometries(geos, false);
  const out = new THREE.Mesh(merged, list[0].material);
  out.castShadow = list[0].castShadow;
  out.userData.detail = !!list[0].userData.detail;
  return out;
}

function optimizeTemplate(rig, dropDetail = false) {
  const keep = new Set(rigObjects(rig));
  // flag tiny parts as "detail" (hidden on far-away monsters, left out of
  // the low-poly copy)
  const tiny = [];
  rig.root.traverse((o) => {
    if (o.isMesh) {
      const sc = Math.max(Math.abs(o.scale.x), Math.abs(o.scale.y), Math.abs(o.scale.z));
      o.userData.detail = sc < 0.13 && !keep.has(o);
      if (o.userData.detail && !o.children.length) tiny.push(o);
    }
  });
  if (dropDetail) for (const o of tiny) o.parent.remove(o);
  const parents = [];
  rig.root.traverse((o) => parents.push(o));
  for (const parent of parents) {
    const groups = new Map();
    for (const c of parent.children) {
      if (!c.isMesh || keep.has(c) || c.children.length) continue;
      const key = `${c.material.uuid}|${c.userData.detail ? 1 : 0}`;
      if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, []);
      groups.get(key).push(c);
    }
    for (const list of groups.values()) {
      if (list.length < 2) continue;
      const merged = mergeMeshes(list);
      for (const m of list) parent.remove(m);
      parent.add(merged);
    }
  }
  let n = 0;
  rig.root.traverse((o) => { o.name = `n${n++}`; });
  rig.meshCount = 0;
  rig.root.traverse((o) => { if (o.isMesh) rig.meshCount++; });
}

function cloneRig(t) {
  const root = t.root.clone(true);
  const byName = new Map();
  root.traverse((o) => byName.set(o.name, o));
  const get = (o) => (o ? byName.get(o.name) : o);
  const rig = { ...t, root };
  for (const k of SINGLE_KEYS) rig[k] = get(t[k]);
  rig.eyes = t.eyes.map((e) => ({ ...e, group: get(e.group), inner: get(e.inner) }));
  rig.eyeX = t.eyeX.map(get);
  rig.tail = t.tail.map(get);
  rig.antennae = t.antennae.map(get);
  rig.ears = t.ears.map((e) => ({ ...e, pivot: get(e.pivot) }));
  rig.legs = t.legs.map((e) => ({ ...e, pivot: get(e.pivot) }));
  rig.arms = t.arms.map((e) => ({ ...e, pivot: get(e.pivot) }));
  rig.wings = t.wings.map((e) => ({ ...e, pivot: get(e.pivot) }));
  rig.spin = t.spin.map((e) => ({ ...e, obj: get(e.obj) }));
  rig.meshes = [];
  rig.detailMeshes = [];
  root.traverse((o) => {
    if (o.isMesh) {
      o.userData.baseMat = o.material;
      rig.meshes.push(o);
      if (o.userData.detail) rig.detailMeshes.push(o);
    }
  });
  rig.bbox = t.bbox.clone();
  rig.prepared = false;
  rig.animNodes = null;
  rig.decor = null;
  return rig;
}

// Hide tiny parts (eye sparkles, teeth, claws) on far-away monsters.
export function setRigDetail(rig, on) {
  if (rig.detailOn === on) return;
  rig.detailOn = on;
  for (const m of rig.detailMeshes) m.visible = on;
}

function buildRawMonster(speciesId, opts = {}) {
  const species = SPECIES_BY_ID[speciesId];
  if (!species) throw new Error(`unknown species ${speciesId}`);
  const recipe = species.model;
  const g = geos();
  const col = (k, fallback = 'body') => {
    if (typeof k === 'number') return k;
    return hex(recipe.colors[k] ?? recipe.colors[fallback]);
  };
  const M = (k, o) => mat(col(k), o);
  const rig = {
    species, speciesId,
    root: new THREE.Group(),
    eyes: [], eyeX: [], ears: [], tail: [], legs: [], arms: [], wings: [], antennae: [], spin: [], glow: [], fx: {},
    meshes: [],
  };
  const root = rig.root;
  const bodyPivot = pivot(root);
  rig.bodyPivot = bodyPivot;
  const parts = new Set();

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- body
  const B = recipe.body;
  const bodyGroup = pivot(bodyPivot, 0, B.y, B.z || 0);
  rig.body = bodyGroup;
  const bodyShape = shapeOf(B.shape, B.size, V(0, 0, 0));
  const bodyColor = B.color || 'body';
  const translucent = B.translucent ? { opacity: 0.88, rough: 0.3 } : {};
  const bodyMat = M(bodyColor, { rough: 0.48, ...translucent });
  const [bw, bh, bd] = B.size;
  switch (B.shape) {
    case 'roundbox':
      bodyGroup.add(mesh(B.round > 0.35 ? g.rboxSoft : g.rbox, bodyMat, [bw, bh, bd]));
      break;
    case 'egg':
      bodyGroup.add(mesh(g.egg, bodyMat, [bw / 2, bh / 2, bd / 2]));
      break;
    case 'pear':
      bodyGroup.add(mesh(g.pear, bodyMat, [bw / 2, bh / 2, bd / 2]));
      break;
    case 'bean': {
      const cap = mesh(g.capsule, bodyMat, [bw, bh, bd / 1.6], null, [Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]);
      bodyGroup.add(cap);
      bodyShape.p = 2;
      break;
    }
    case 'ghost': {
      bodyGroup.add(mesh(g.ghost, bodyMat, [bw / 2, bh / 2, bd / 2], [0, bh * 0.3, 0]));
      bodyShape.c.y = bh * 0.3;
      bodyShape.r.y = bh / 2;
      for (let k = 0; k < 7; k++) {
        const a = (k / 7) * Math.PI * 2;
        bodyGroup.add(mesh(g.sphereLo, bodyMat, [bw * 0.17, bh * 0.14, bw * 0.17], [Math.cos(a) * bw * 0.4, bh * 0.3 - bh * 0.32, Math.sin(a) * bd * 0.4]));
      }
      rig.fx.ghost = true;
      break;
    }
    case 'gem': {
      const gm = mesh(g.octa, M(bodyColor, { emissive: col('glow', 'body'), ei: 0.25, rough: 0.15 }), [bw / 2, bh / 2, bd / 2]);
      bodyGroup.add(gm);
      rig.spin.push({ obj: gm, axis: 'y', speed: 0.6 });
      break;
    }
    case 'cloud': {
      bodyGroup.add(mesh(g.sphere, bodyMat, [bw / 2, bh / 2, bd / 2]));
      const puffs = [[0.45, 0.25, 0.05, 0.42], [-0.45, 0.25, 0.05, 0.42], [0.25, 0.45, -0.2, 0.4], [-0.25, 0.48, -0.15, 0.38], [0.0, 0.1, -0.45, 0.45], [0.5, -0.1, -0.2, 0.36], [-0.5, -0.1, -0.2, 0.36]];
      for (const [x, y, z, r] of puffs) bodyGroup.add(mesh(g.sphereLo, bodyMat, [r * bw * 0.6, r * bh * 0.6, r * bd * 0.6], [x * bw * 0.5, y * bh * 0.5, z * bd * 0.5]));
      break;
    }
    case 'cube': {
      let m2 = bodyMat;
      if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
        const c = document.createElement('canvas');
        c.width = c.height = 64;
        const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
        for (let y = 0; y < 8; y++) for (let x = 0; x < 8; x++) {
          ctx.fillStyle = (x + y) % 2 ? '#ff3df2' : '#1a1a1a';
          ctx.fillRect(x * 8, y * 8, 8, 8);
        }
        const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
        tex.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
        tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
        m2 = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: tex, roughness: 0.4, emissive: 0x220022 });
      }
      bodyGroup.add(mesh(g.box, m2, [bw, bh, bd]));
      break;
    }
    case 'serpent': {
      // a chain of segments trailing behind the head, animated as a wave
      const segs = B.segments || 6;
      let parent = bodyGroup;
      const len = bd / segs;
      for (let i = 0; i < segs; i++) {
        const seg = pivot(parent, 0, 0, i === 0 ? 0.6 : -len);
        const s = 1 - i * 0.09;
        seg.add(mesh(g.sphere, bodyMat, [bw * 0.62 * s, bh * 0.62 * s, len * 0.75]));
        if (recipe.colors.belly) seg.add(mesh(g.sphereLo, M('belly'), [bw * 0.5 * s, bh * 0.4 * s, len * 0.6], [0, -bh * 0.18 * s, 0]));
        if (i % 2 === 0) {
          const fin = mesh(g.drop, M('accent2', { side: THREE.DoubleSide }), [0.05, 0.6 * s, 0.4 * s], [0, bh * 0.35 * s, 0], [-0.6, 0, 0]);
          seg.add(fin);
        }
        rig.tail.push(seg);
        parent = seg;
      }
      rig.serpent = true;
      break;
    }
    default:
      bodyGroup.add(mesh(g.sphere, bodyMat, [bw / 2, bh / 2, bd / 2]));
  }
  if (B.bicolor) {
    const under = mesh(g.sphere, M(B.bicolor), [bw * 0.49, bh * 0.4, bd * 0.48], [0, -bh * 0.13, 0]);
    bodyGroup.add(under);
  }
  if (B.stripes) {
    for (const k of [-0.42, 0.08]) {
      const rr = Math.sqrt(1 - k * k) * 1.01;
      const t = mesh(g.torus, M(B.stripes), [bw * 0.5 * rr, bd * 0.5 * rr, 0.75], [0, k * bh * 0.5, 0], [Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]);
      bodyGroup.add(t);
    }
  }
  parts.add(`body:${B.shape}`);

  // belly patch
  if (recipe.belly) {
    const b = recipe.belly;
    const p = surf(bodyShape, 0, (b.y - B.y) / (bh / 2), 0.02);
    const patch = mesh(g.sphere, M(b.color || 'belly', { rough: 0.55 }), [b.size[0] / 2, b.size[1] / 2, 0.16]);
    patch.position.copy(p.pos);
    orient(patch, p.n);
    bodyGroup.add(patch);
    if (b.stripes) {
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
        const sp = surf(bodyShape, 0, (b.y - B.y) / (bh / 2) + (k - 1) * 0.2, -0.01);
        const st = mesh(g.box, M('accent'), [b.size[0] * 0.7, 0.035, 0.05]);
        st.position.copy(sp.pos);
        orient(st, sp.n);
        bodyGroup.add(st);
      }
    }
    if (b.chevrons) {
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
        for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
          const sp = surf(bodyShape, s * 0.12, (b.y - B.y) / (bh / 2) - 0.1 + k * 0.18, -0.01);
          const ch = mesh(g.box, M('accent'), [0.18, 0.04, 0.05], null);
          ch.position.copy(sp.pos);
          orient(ch, sp.n);
          ch.rotateZ(s * 0.5);
          bodyGroup.add(ch);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- head
  let headShape;
  let head;
  if (recipe.head) {
    const H = recipe.head;
    head = pivot(bodyPivot, H.pos[0], H.pos[1], H.pos[2]);
    const hmat = M(H.color || 'body', { rough: 0.48, ...translucent });
    if (H.shape === 'roundbox') head.add(mesh(H.round > 0.35 ? g.rboxSoft : g.rbox, hmat, H.size));
    else head.add(mesh(g.sphere, hmat, [H.size[0] / 2, H.size[1] / 2, H.size[2] / 2]));
    headShape = shapeOf(H.shape === 'roundbox' ? 'roundbox' : 'ellipsoid', H.size, V(0, 0, 0));
    parts.add(`head:${H.shape}`);
  } else {
    head = bodyGroup;
    headShape = bodyShape;
  }
  rig.head = head;
  rig.headIsBody = !recipe.head;
  const faceHost = head;
  const hs = headShape;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- face
  const F = recipe.face || {};
  const ny = (y) => y / hs.r.y; // face offsets are in units from the head centre

  if (F.mask) {
    const mk = F.mask;
    const p = surf(hs, 0, ny(mk.low ? -0.2 : -0.05), 0.03);
    const m = mesh(g.sphere, M(mk.color, { rough: 0.55 }), [hs.r.x * mk.size[0] * 0.85, hs.r.y * mk.size[1] * 0.85, 0.09]);
    m.position.copy(p.pos);
    orient(m, p.n);
    faceHost.add(m);
    if (mk.heart) {
      for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
        const p2 = surf(hs, s * 0.2, ny(0.35), 0.03);
        const m2 = mesh(g.sphere, M(mk.color), [hs.r.x * 0.36, hs.r.y * 0.3, 0.09]);
        m2.position.copy(p2.pos);
        orient(m2, p2.n);
        faceHost.add(m2);
      }
    }
    parts.add('mask');
  }

  if (F.disc) {
    for (const s of [-1, 1]) {
      const p = surf(hs, (s * F.disc.gap) / hs.r.x, ny(F.disc.y), 0.02);
      const d = mesh(g.sphere, M(F.disc.color, { emissive: col(F.disc.color), ei: 0.35 }), [F.disc.size, F.disc.size, 0.12]);
      d.position.copy(p.pos);
      orient(d, p.n);
      faceHost.add(d);
    }
    parts.add('disc');
  }

  if (F.snout) {
    const sn = F.snout;
    const p = surf(hs, 0, ny(sn.y), sn.size[2] * 0.25);
    const s = mesh(g.sphere, M(sn.color || 'body', { rough: 0.5 }), [sn.size[0] / 2, sn.size[1] / 2, sn.size[2] / 2]);
    s.position.copy(p.pos);
    if (sn.long) s.position.z += sn.size[2] * 0.25;
    faceHost.add(s);
    const tipZ = s.position.z + sn.size[2] / 2;
    if (sn.nose) {
      const nose = mesh(g.sphere, mat(sn.nose, { rough: 0.25 }), sn.bigNose ? [0.17, 0.13, 0.12] : [0.09, 0.065, 0.06], [0, s.position.y + sn.size[1] * 0.18, tipZ - 0.03]);
      faceHost.add(nose);
    }
    if (sn.nostrils) {
      for (const k of [-1, 1]) faceHost.add(mesh(g.sphereLo, mat(0x2a1410), [0.04, 0.03, 0.03], [k * sn.size[0] * 0.18, s.position.y + sn.size[1] * 0.15, tipZ - 0.02]));
    }
    rig.snout = s;
    parts.add(sn.long ? 'snout:long' : 'snout');
  }

  // eyes
  if (F.eyes) {
    const E = F.eyes;
    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      const p = surf(hs, (side * E.gap) / hs.r.x, ny(E.y), F.mask || F.disc ? -0.05 : 0);
      const eye = new THREE.Group();
      eye.position.copy(p.pos);
      orient(eye, p.n);
      faceHost.add(eye);
      const s = E.size;
      const inner = new THREE.Group(); // blink scales this
      eye.add(inner);
      const dark = mat(E.style === 'glow' ? 0x000000 : 0x14121c, { rough: 0.08 });
      const shine = mat(0xffffff, { emissive: 0xffffff, ei: 0.6, rough: 0.1 });
      const iris = mat(E.color || 0x2a2040, { rough: 0.1 });
      switch (E.style) {
        case 'gloss-white':
        case 'fierce-white':
        case 'cat':
        case 'liner': {
          inner.add(mesh(g.sphere, mat(0xffffff, { rough: 0.2 }), [s * 1.05, s * 1.2, s * 0.45]));
          inner.add(mesh(g.sphere, iris, [s * 0.74, s * 0.9, s * 0.4], [0, -s * 0.06, s * 0.12]));
          if (E.style === 'cat') inner.add(mesh(g.sphere, dark, [s * 0.16, s * 0.72, s * 0.3], [0, -s * 0.06, s * 0.3]));
          else inner.add(mesh(g.sphere, dark, [s * 0.44, s * 0.55, s * 0.3], [0, -s * 0.08, s * 0.3]));
          inner.add(mesh(g.sphere, shine, s * 0.2, [-side * s * 0.22, s * 0.25, s * 0.42]));
          inner.add(mesh(g.sphere, shine, s * 0.09, [side * s * 0.25, -s * 0.3, s * 0.4]));
          if (E.style === 'liner') {
            const wing = mesh(g.box, mat(0x14121c), [s * 0.9, s * 0.12, s * 0.1], [side * s * 0.75, s * 0.55, s * 0.2], [0, 0, side * 0.45]);
            eye.add(wing);
          }
          break;
        }
        case 'glow':
          inner.add(mesh(g.sphere, mat(E.color || 0x7affd8, { emissive: E.color || 0x7affd8, ei: 1.6 }), [s * 0.8, s * 1.0, s * 0.35]));
          rig.glow.push(inner.children[0].material);
          break;
        case 'pixel':
          inner.add(mesh(g.box, mat(0x000000), [s * 1.2, s * 1.2, s * 0.3]));
          inner.add(mesh(g.box, mat(E.color || 0x3dfff2, { emissive: E.color || 0x3dfff2 }), [s * 0.4, s * 0.4, s * 0.32], [-s * 0.25, s * 0.25, 0.02]));
          break;
        case 'happy': {
          const a = mesh(g.arc, mat(0x14121c), [s * 0.7, s * 0.7, s * 0.7], [0, -s * 0.2, s * 0.05]);
          inner.add(a);
          break;
        }
        case 'stalk': {
          const stalk = mesh(g.cyl, M('body'), [s * 0.22, s * 2.6, s * 0.22], [0, -s * 2.4, -s * 0.6]);
          eye.add(stalk);
          inner.add(mesh(g.sphere, mat(0xffffff, { rough: 0.2 }), [s * 1.0, s * 1.0, s * 0.9]));
          inner.add(mesh(g.sphere, dark, [s * 0.6, s * 0.7, s * 0.5], [0, 0, s * 0.5]));
          inner.add(mesh(g.sphere, shine, s * 0.18, [-side * s * 0.15, s * 0.22, s * 0.85]));
          break;
        }
        default: {
          // 'gloss', 'lashes', 'sleepy', 'fierce', 'sparkle'
          inner.add(mesh(g.sphere, dark, [s, s * 1.18, s * 0.5]));
          if (E.color && E.style !== 'fierce') inner.add(mesh(g.sphere, iris, [s * 0.86, s * 1.0, s * 0.3], [0, -s * 0.2, s * 0.24]));
          inner.add(mesh(g.sphere, shine, s * 0.3, [-side * s * 0.3, s * 0.38, s * 0.38]));
          inner.add(mesh(g.sphere, shine, s * 0.13, [side * s * 0.32, -s * 0.38, s * 0.4]));
          if (E.style === 'sparkle') {
            const st = mesh(g.star, shine, s * 0.22, [side * s * 0.05, -s * 0.05, s * 0.5]);
            inner.add(st);
          }
          if (E.style === 'lashes') {
            for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
              const l = mesh(g.cone, mat(0x14121c), [s * 0.07, s * 0.35, s * 0.07], [side * s * (0.55 + k * 0.18), s * (0.85 - k * 0.2), 0], [0, 0, side * (-0.6 - k * 0.45)]);
              eye.add(l);
            }
          }
        }
      }
      if (E.style === 'fierce' || E.style === 'fierce-white') {
        const brow = mesh(g.box, M('dark', 'accent'), [s * 1.2, s * 0.22, s * 0.25], [side * s * 0.1, s * 1.15, s * 0.1], [0, 0, side * 0.42]);
        eye.add(brow);
      }
      if (E.style === 'sleepy') {
        const lid = mesh(g.hemi, M(F.lidColor || bodyColor), [s * 1.08, s * 1.2, s * 0.56], [0, 0, 0.0], [0.15, 0, 0]);
        eye.add(lid);
      }
      if (E.bumps) {
        const bump = mesh(g.sphere, M('body'), [s * 1.25, s * 1.25, s * 0.8], [0, -s * 0.15, -s * 0.35]);
        eye.add(bump);
      }
      if (E.patch) {
        const patch = mesh(g.sphere, M(E.patch), [s * 1.1, s * 1.5, s * 0.3], [side * s * 0.15, -s * 0.55, -s * 0.12]);
        eye.add(patch);
      }
      if (E.pop) inner.scale.z = 1.6;
      // defeated "x" eyes (hidden until needed)
      const x = new THREE.Group();
      x.visible = false;
      for (const r of [0.78, -0.78]) x.add(mesh(g.box, mat(0x14121c), [s * 1.4, s * 0.24, s * 0.2], [0, 0, s * 0.3], [0, 0, r]));
      eye.add(x);
      rig.eyes.push({ group: eye, inner, side, size: s });
      rig.eyeX.push(x);
    }
    if (F.brows) {
      for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
        const p = surf(hs, (side * F.eyes.gap * 0.9) / hs.r.x, ny(F.eyes.y + F.eyes.size * 1.5), -0.01);
        const b = mesh(g.sphere, M(F.brows.color), [F.eyes.size * 0.45, F.eyes.size * 0.25, 0.06]);
        b.position.copy(p.pos);
        orient(b, p.n);
        faceHost.add(b);
      }
    }
    parts.add(`eyes:${F.eyes.style}`);
  }

  // mouth
  if (F.mouth) {
    const Mo = F.mouth;
    const s = Mo.size;
    const mouth = new THREE.Group();
    const p = surf(hs, 0, ny(Mo.y), 0);
    mouth.position.copy(p.pos);
    orient(mouth, p.n);
    if (rig.snout && Mo.style !== 'chomp' && Mo.style !== 'croc') {
      // sit just under the snout
      mouth.position.z = Math.max(mouth.position.z, rig.snout.position.z + recipe.face.snout.size[2] * 0.35);
      mouth.position.y = Math.min(mouth.position.y, rig.snout.position.y - recipe.face.snout.size[1] * 0.25);
    }
    faceHost.add(mouth);
    const line = mat(0x2a1420, { rough: 0.4 });
    const inside = mat(col(Mo.color, 'mouth') === 0xff00ff ? 0x6e1a2e : col(Mo.color === undefined ? 'mouth' : Mo.color, 'dark'), { rough: 0.5 });
    const tooth = mat(col('tooth', 'belly') === 0xff00ff ? 0xffffff : recipe.colors.tooth ?? 0xffffff, Mo.glowTeeth ? { emissive: recipe.colors.tooth ?? 0xffffff, ei: 0.6 } : { rough: 0.3 });
    const open = new THREE.Group(); // shown when attacking
    open.visible = false;
    mouth.add(open);
    switch (Mo.style) {
      case 'chomp': {
        // the big toothy grin
        const cavity = mesh(g.sphere, mat(recipe.colors.mouth ?? 0x6e1a2e, { rough: 0.6 }), [s * 0.95, s * 0.52, s * 0.4], [0, 0, -s * 0.18]);
        mouth.add(cavity);
        const tongue = mesh(g.sphere, mat(0xff7a9a), [s * 0.45, s * 0.16, s * 0.3], [0, -s * 0.28, -s * 0.02]);
        mouth.add(tongue);
        const upper = new THREE.Group();
        const lower = new THREE.Group();
        mouth.add(upper, lower);
        const n = 7;
        for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
          const t = (k / (n - 1)) * 2 - 1;
          const x = t * s * 0.78;
          const yy = Math.sqrt(1 - t * t * 0.8) * s * 0.4;
          const tu = mesh(g.cone, tooth, [s * 0.1, s * 0.26, s * 0.1], [x, yy, s * 0.05], [Math.PI, 0, 0]);
          upper.add(tu);
          if (k > 0 && k < n - 1) {
            const tl = mesh(g.cone, tooth, [s * 0.09, s * 0.22, s * 0.09], [x * 0.9, -yy * 0.95, s * 0.05]);
            lower.add(tl);
          }
        }
        rig.jaw = lower;
        rig.upperTeeth = upper;
        parts.add('mouth:chomp');
        break;
      }
      case 'croc': {
        const sn = rig.snout;
        const smile = mesh(g.arc, line, [s * 0.75, s * 0.25, s * 0.4], [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, Math.PI]);
        mouth.add(smile);
        if (sn) {
          for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
            for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
              const t = mesh(g.cone, tooth, [0.05, 0.13, 0.05], [side * recipe.face.snout.size[0] * 0.42, sn.position.y - mouth.position.y - 0.12, -0.05 - k * 0.14], [Math.PI, 0, 0]);
              mouth.add(t);
            }
          }
        }
        open.add(mesh(g.sphere, inside, [s * 0.6, s * 0.3, s * 0.2], [0, -s * 0.2, 0]));
        parts.add('mouth:croc');
        break;
      }
      case 'beak': {
        const c = mat(col(Mo.color, 'accent'), { rough: 0.35 });
        const upperB = mesh(g.cone, c, [s * 0.55, s * 1.1, s * 0.45], [0, 0, 0], [Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]);
        mouth.add(upperB);
        const lowerB = mesh(g.cone, c, [s * 0.4, s * 0.7, s * 0.3], [0, -s * 0.22, -s * 0.05], [Math.PI / 2 + 0.25, 0, 0]);
        mouth.add(lowerB);
        rig.jaw = lowerB;
        parts.add('mouth:beak');
        break;
      }
      case 'o': {
        const c = Mo.color ? col(Mo.color) : 0x6e1a2e;
        mouth.add(mesh(g.sphere, mat(c, { rough: 0.4 }), [s * 0.8, s, s * 0.35]));
        parts.add('mouth:o');
        break;
      }
      case 'cat': {
        for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
          const a = mesh(g.arc, mat(col(Mo.color, 'dark') === 0xff00ff ? 0x2a1420 : col(Mo.color, 'dark')), [s * 0.5, s * 0.5, s * 0.5], [side * s * 0.48, 0, 0], [0, 0, Math.PI]);
          mouth.add(a);
        }
        open.add(mesh(g.sphere, mat(0x6e1a2e), [s * 0.6, s * 0.7, s * 0.3], [0, -s * 0.5, 0]));
        parts.add('mouth:cat');
        break;
      }
      case 'pixel': {
        const b = mat(0x000000);
        mouth.add(mesh(g.box, b, [s * 1.2, s * 0.22, s * 0.2], [0, -s * 0.15, 0]));
        mouth.add(mesh(g.box, b, [s * 0.22, s * 0.22, s * 0.2], [-s * 0.7, s * 0.05, 0]));
        mouth.add(mesh(g.box, b, [s * 0.22, s * 0.22, s * 0.2], [s * 0.7, s * 0.05, 0]));
        parts.add('mouth:pixel');
        break;
      }
      default: {
        // smile, grin, fangs, tongue
        const w = Mo.style === 'grin' ? 1.2 : 1;
        const smile = mesh(g.arc, line, [s * w, s * 0.8, s * 0.6], [0, s * 0.3, 0], [0, 0, Math.PI]);
        mouth.add(smile);
        if (Mo.style === 'grin' || Mo.style === 'tongue') {
          mouth.add(mesh(g.hemi, mat(0x6e1a2e), [s * w * 0.9, s * 0.7, s * 0.3], [0, s * 0.25, -s * 0.05], [Math.PI, 0, 0]));
          mouth.add(mesh(g.sphere, mat(0xff7a9a), [s * 0.5, s * 0.22, s * 0.3], [0, -s * 0.2, s * 0.05]));
        }
        if (Mo.style === 'tongue') mouth.add(mesh(g.capsule, mat(0xff7a9a), [s * 0.5, s * 0.5, s * 0.3], [s * 0.2, -s * 0.55, s * 0.15]));
        if (Mo.style === 'fangs') {
          for (const side of [-1, 1]) mouth.add(mesh(g.cone, tooth, [s * 0.16, s * 0.42, s * 0.14], [side * s * 0.55, s * 0.0, s * 0.05], [Math.PI, 0, 0]));
        }
        open.add(mesh(g.sphere, mat(0x6e1a2e), [s * 0.7, s * 0.6, s * 0.3], [0, -s * 0.1, 0]));
        parts.add(`mouth:${Mo.style}`);
      }
    }
    rig.mouth = mouth;
    rig.mouthOpen = open;
  }

  if (F.cheeks) {
    const C = F.cheeks;
    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      const p = surf(hs, (side * C.gap) / hs.r.x, ny(C.y), 0.01);
      const c = mesh(g.sphere, mat(col(C.color, 'cheek'), { opacity: 0.75, rough: 0.6 }), [C.size, C.size * 0.62, 0.05]);
      c.position.copy(p.pos);
      orient(c, p.n);
      faceHost.add(c);
    }
    parts.add('cheeks');
  }

  if (F.mark) {
    const mk = F.mark;
    const p = surf(hs, 0, ny(mk.y), -0.01);
    const grp = new THREE.Group();
    grp.position.copy(p.pos);
    orient(grp, p.n);
    faceHost.add(grp);
    const mm = mat(col(mk.color), mk.glow ? { emissive: col(mk.color), ei: 0.9 } : { rough: 0.4 });
    const s = mk.size;
    switch (mk.kind) {
      case 'bolt':
        grp.add(mesh(g.box, mm, [s * 0.35, s * 0.8, 0.06], [-s * 0.1, s * 0.25, 0], [0, 0, -0.5]));
        grp.add(mesh(g.box, mm, [s * 0.35, s * 0.8, 0.06], [s * 0.1, -s * 0.25, 0], [0, 0, -0.5]));
        grp.add(mesh(g.box, mm, [s * 0.5, s * 0.22, 0.06], [0, 0, 0]));
        break;
      case 'diamond':
      case 'gem':
        grp.add(mesh(g.octa, mk.kind === 'gem' ? mat(col(mk.color), { emissive: col(mk.color), ei: 0.5, rough: 0.1 }) : mm, [s * 0.6, s * 0.9, s * 0.3]));
        break;
      case 'star':
        grp.add(mesh(g.star, mm, s * 0.8));
        break;
      case 'crescent': {
        const c = mesh(g.arc, mm, [s, s, s * 0.6], [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0.6]);
        grp.add(c);
        break;
      }
      case 'rune':
        grp.add(mesh(g.torus, mm, [s, s, s]));
        grp.add(mesh(g.box, mm, [s * 0.15, s * 1.6, 0.05]));
        break;
      case 'dots':
        for (const side of [-1, 1]) grp.add(mesh(g.sphere, mm, [s, s * 0.7, 0.05], [side * s * 3.2, -s * 1.5, 0]));
        break;
      case 'clover':
        for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
          const a = (k / 3) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.PI / 2;
          grp.add(mesh(g.sphere, mm, [s * 0.5, s * 0.5, 0.05], [Math.cos(a) * s * 0.45, Math.sin(a) * s * 0.45, 0]));
        }
        break;
      case 'freckles':
        for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
          for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
            const fp = surf(hs, side * (0.42 + (k % 2) * 0.1), ny(mk.y) - 0.62 - k * 0.07, -0.005);
            const f = mesh(g.sphere, mm, [s, s, 0.03]);
            f.position.copy(fp.pos);
            orient(f, fp.n);
            faceHost.add(f);
          }
        }
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
    if (mk.glow) rig.glow.push(mm);
    parts.add(`mark:${mk.kind}`);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- ears
  if (recipe.ears) {
    const E = recipe.ears;
    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      const base = top(hs, side * E.gap * 0.95, 0);
      const pv = pivot(faceHost, base.x, base.y + (E.y || 0) - E.size[1] * 0.1, base.z);
      pv.rotation.z = -side * E.tilt;
      const emat = M(E.color || 'body', { rough: 0.5 });
      const inner = E.inner ? M(E.inner, { rough: 0.55 }) : null;
      const [w, h, d] = E.size;
      switch (E.style) {
        case 'bunny':
          pv.add(mesh(g.sphere, emat, [w / 2, h / 2, d], [0, h / 2, 0]));
          if (inner) pv.add(mesh(g.sphere, inner, [w * 0.3, h * 0.42, d * 0.6], [0, h / 2, d * 0.45]));
          pv.rotation.x = -0.12;
          break;
        case 'round':
          pv.add(mesh(g.sphere, emat, [w / 2, h / 2, d], [0, h * 0.35, 0]));
          if (inner) pv.add(mesh(g.sphere, inner, [w * 0.3, h * 0.3, d * 0.6], [0, h * 0.35, d * 0.45]));
          break;
        case 'floppy':
          pv.add(mesh(g.sphere, emat, [w / 2, h / 2, d], [side * w * 0.3, -h * 0.2, 0], [0, 0, side * 0.6]));
          break;
        case 'leaf':
        case 'petal':
          pv.add(mesh(g.drop, emat, [w, h, d], [0, 0, 0]));
          if (inner) pv.add(mesh(g.drop, inner, [w * 0.6, h * 0.75, d * 1.2], [0, h * 0.05, d * 0.2]));
          pv.add(mesh(g.box, M('accent2', 'dark'), [0.03, h * 0.7, d * 1.2], [0, h * 0.35, 0]));
          break;
        case 'fin':
          pv.add(mesh(g.drop, emat, [d * 0.6, h, w], [0, 0, -w * 0.2], [-0.5, 0, 0]));
          break;
        case 'tuft':
          for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) pv.add(mesh(g.cone, emat, [w * 0.25, h * (1 - k * 0.2), d], [(k - 1) * w * 0.22 * side, 0, 0], [0, 0, (k - 1) * 0.25]));
          break;
        default: {
          // pointy, fennec, lynx, bat
          const big = E.style === 'fennec' || E.style === 'bat';
          pv.add(mesh(g.cone4, emat, [w / 2, h, d], [0, 0, 0]));
          if (inner) pv.add(mesh(g.cone4, inner, [w * 0.32, h * 0.78, d * 0.5], [0, h * 0.05, d * 0.32]));
