// One shared off-screen renderer for every 2D monster preview: recruitment
// cards and the inspector turntable (live) and collection/codex icons
// (rendered once and cached as images). Avoids opening many WebGL contexts.

import * as THREE from 'three';
import { SPECIES_BY_ID } from '#shared/monsters.js';
import { buildMonster } from './monsterRenderer.js';
import { animateMonster } from './animationSystem.js';
import { buildSword, Humanoid, ANIM, setNightGlow } from './humanoid.js';

export class MonsterPreview {
  constructor() {
    this.renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: true, preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
    this.renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
    this.renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    this.scene = new THREE.Scene();
    this.scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0xb8a8e0, 1.6));
    const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 2.2);
    key.position.set(2, 4, 5);
    this.scene.add(key);
    this.camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(30, 1, 0.1, 100);
    this.views = new Set();
    this.icons = new Map();
    this.holder = new THREE.Group();
    this.scene.add(this.holder);
  }

  frameRig(rig, aspect) {
    const h = rig.height;
    const w = Math.max(rig.width, h * 0.8);
    this.camera.aspect = aspect;
    const dist = (Math.max(h, w / aspect) * 0.62) / Math.tan((this.camera.fov * Math.PI) / 360) + w * 0.6;
    this.camera.position.set(0, h * 0.62, dist);
    this.camera.lookAt(0, h * 0.46, 0);
    this.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  }

  // live preview drawn into a 2D canvas every frame until detached
  attach(canvas, speciesId, opts = {}) {
    const rig = buildMonster(speciesId);
    rig.root.scale.setScalar(1);
    const view = { canvas, rig, st: { pose: opts.pose || 'idle', poseT: 0 }, yaw: opts.yaw ?? 0.5, spin: opts.spin ?? 0.6, drag: 0, t: Math.random() * 10 };
    if (opts.draggable) {
      let last = null;
      canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
        last = e.clientX;
        canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
      });
      canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
        if (last === null) return;
        view.yaw += (e.clientX - last) * 0.012;
        last = e.clientX;
        view.drag = 2;
      });
      canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', () => { last = null; });
    }
    this.views.add(view);
    return view;
  }

  detach(view) {
    this.views.delete(view);
  }

  render(view, dt) {
    const c = view.canvas;
    if (!c.isConnected) {
      this.views.delete(view);
      return;
    }
    // hidden canvases (collapsed cards, closed tabs) are skipped
    const w = c.clientWidth;
    const h = c.clientHeight;
    if (w < 2 || h < 2) return;
    if (c.width !== w || c.height !== h) {
      c.width = w;
      c.height = h;
    }
    this.renderer.setSize(w, h, false);
    this.holder.clear();
    this.holder.add(view.rig.root);
    view.t += dt;
    if (view.drag > 0) view.drag -= dt;
    else view.yaw += dt * view.spin;
    view.rig.root.rotation.y = view.yaw;
    animateMonster(view.rig, view.st, dt, view.t);
    this.frameRig(view.rig, w / h);
    this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);
    const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    ctx.drawImage(this.renderer.domElement, 0, 0, w, h);
  }

  update(dt) {
    for (const v of this.views) this.render(v, dt);
  }

  // sword icon (cached data URL)
  swordIcon(id, size = 96) {
    const key = `sword|${id}|${size}`;
    if (this.icons.has(key)) return this.icons.get(key);
    const sword = buildSword(id);
    const g = new THREE.Group();
    g.add(sword);
    sword.position.y = -(sword.userData.length + 0.5) / 2;
    g.rotation.z = -Math.PI / 4;
    g.rotation.y = 0.5;
    this.renderer.setSize(size, size, false);
    this.holder.clear();
    this.holder.add(g);
    const L = sword.userData.length + 1;
    this.camera.aspect = 1;
    this.camera.position.set(0, 0, (L * 0.62) / Math.tan((this.camera.fov * Math.PI) / 360));
    this.camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);
    this.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);
    const url = this.renderer.domElement.toDataURL('image/png');
    this.icons.set(key, url);
    return url;
  }

  // a player in a costume (cached data URL); night: dark, with the glow on
  costumeIcon(id, size = 160, night = false, power = null) {
    const key = `costume|${id}|${size}|${night}|${power}`;
    if (this.icons.has(key)) return this.icons.get(key);
    const h = new Humanoid(0x3a7ae0);
    h.setCostume(id, power);
    h.setSword(null);
    setNightGlow(night);
    h.update(0.5, ANIM.idle, 0, false, 1.2);
    h.update(0.5, ANIM.idle, 0, false, 1.4);
    h.root.rotation.y = 0.35;
    this.renderer.setSize(size, size, false);
    this.holder.clear();
    this.holder.add(h.root);
    if (night) {
      this.scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0c0c24);
      this.renderer.toneMappingExposure = 0.35;
    }
    this.camera.aspect = 1;
    this.camera.position.set(0, 3.2, 13);
    this.camera.lookAt(0, 2.9, 0);
    this.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);
    this.scene.background = null;
    this.renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1;
    setNightGlow(false);
    const url = this.renderer.domElement.toDataURL('image/png');
    this.icons.set(key, url);
    return url;
  }

  // static icon (cached data URL)
  icon(speciesId, size = 128) {
    const key = `${speciesId}|${size}`;
    if (this.icons.has(key)) return this.icons.get(key);
    if (!SPECIES_BY_ID[speciesId]) return '';
    const rig = buildMonster(speciesId);
    rig.root.scale.setScalar(1);
    rig.root.rotation.y = 0.45;
    animateMonster(rig, { pose: 'idle', poseT: 0 }, 0, 1.3);
    this.renderer.setSize(size, size, false);
    this.holder.clear();
    this.holder.add(rig.root);
    this.frameRig(rig, 1);
    this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);
    const url = this.renderer.domElement.toDataURL('image/png');
    this.icons.set(key, url);
    return url;
  }
}

FILE: public/client/rooms.js

// Online rooms over Firebase Realtime Database (for the static web build,
// which has no game server).
//
// One player HOSTS: the real game server (server/game.js) already runs in
// their page (localNet.js). RoomHost relays it to the other players through
// Firebase. The others are GUESTS: RoomGuestNet has the same interface as
// Net (net.js), so the rest of the client does not know the difference.
// The host's game stays the only authority: guests only send "I moved / I
// swung / please recruit" messages, exactly like with the Node server.
//
// Everyone in a room is logged in to an online account (accounts.js); a
// guest's id is their account id (uid), which the database rules check, so
// the host knows who is who. The host reads each guest's name and saved
// progress from their account, and sends their progress back to them
// ('saveProfile') to save in their own account.
//
// Database layout, under sam/rooms/{CODE}:
//   host                {v, at, uid}    the host is online (removed when they leave)
//   guests/{uid}        {at}            a guest is online
//   up/{uid}/{push}     {j}             guest -> host messages (JSON text)
//   down/{uid}/{push}   {j}             host -> guest messages (JSON text)
// Messages travel as JSON text because the database drops nulls and empty
// arrays inside stored objects. Every message is deleted once it is read.

import { PROTOCOL_VERSION } from '#shared/config.js';
import { randomId } from '#shared/rng.js';
import { steadyInterval } from './steadyTimer.js';
import { firebase, firebaseConfig } from './fb.js';

export { firebaseConfig };

const ROOT = 'sam/rooms';
const DOWN_MS = 100; // host -> guest batches (10 a second)
const UP_MS = 60;   // guest -> host batches
const GUEST_SAVE_MS = 10000; // a guest's progress is sent to them to save at most this often
const MOVE_MS = 50; // the host applies each guest's latest position this often
const TRANSACTIONAL = new Set(['recruit', 'buySword', 'buyItem', 'buyUpgrade', 'buyDecor', 'buyCostume', 'buyPower', 'buyGuards']);
const CODE_CHARS = 'ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789'; // no I/L/O/0/1 mix-ups

export function makeRoomCode() {
  let s = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) s += CODE_CHARS[Math.floor(Math.random() * CODE_CHARS.length)];
  return s;
}

export function cleanRoomCode(text) {
  const c = String(text || '').toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, '');
  return c.length === 5 && [...c].every((ch) => CODE_CHARS.includes(ch)) ? c : null;
}

const parse = (v) => {
  try {
    return v && typeof v.j === 'string' ? JSON.parse(v.j) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
};

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ host

export class RoomHost {
  constructor(game, accounts) {
    this.game = game;
    this.accounts = accounts;
    this.guests = new Map();
    this.code = null;
  }

  get guestCount() {
    let n = 0;
    for (const g of this.guests.values()) if (g.joined) n++;
    return n;
  }

  async open() {
    const { fb, db, auth } = await firebase();
    this.fb = fb;
    this.db = db;
    this.uid = auth.currentUser?.uid;
    if (!this.uid) throw new Error('Log in to your account to open a room.');
    // pick a code nobody is using right now
    for (let tries = 0; tries < 6 && !this.code; tries++) {
      const code = makeRoomCode();
      const taken = await fb.get(fb.ref(db, `${ROOT}/${code}/host`));
      if (!taken.exists()) this.code = code;
    }
    if (!this.code) throw new Error('Could not find a free room code. Try again.');
    this.room = fb.ref(db, `${ROOT}/${this.code}`);
    // the whole room disappears when the host goes away
    await fb.onDisconnect(this.room).remove();
    await fb.set(fb.child(this.room, 'host'), { v: PROTOCOL_VERSION, at: fb.serverTimestamp(), uid: this.uid });
    const guestsRef = fb.child(this.room, 'guests');
    this.unsubs = [
      fb.onChildAdded(guestsRef, (snap) => this.addGuest(snap.key)),
      fb.onChildRemoved(guestsRef, (snap) => this.dropGuest(snap.key)),
    ];
    // (worker timers: they keep going when the host's tab is in the background)
    this.stopTimers = [
      steadyInterval(() => this.flush(), DOWN_MS),
      steadyInterval(() => {
        for (const g of this.guests.values()) this.applyMove(g);
      }, MOVE_MS),
    ];
    return this.code;
  }

  addGuest(gid) {
    if (this.guests.has(gid) || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{4,40}$/.test(gid)) return;
    const { fb } = this;
    const g = { gid, out: [], snap: null, move: null, joined: false };
    g.transport = {
      closed: false,
      send: (e, d) => this.queue(g, e, d),
      sendVolatile: (e, d) => this.queue(g, e, d),
      disconnect: (reason) => this.kick(g, reason),
    };
    g.unsub = fb.onChildAdded(fb.child(this.room, `up/${gid}`), (snap) => {
      const list = parse(snap.val());
      fb.remove(snap.ref);
      this.receive(g, list);
    });
    this.guests.set(gid, g);
  }

  dropGuest(gid) {
    const g = this.guests.get(gid);
    if (!g) return;
    this.sendSave(g);
    this.flushGuest(g);
    this.guests.delete(gid);
    g.transport.closed = true;
    if (g.unsub) g.unsub();
    if (g.joined) this.game.leave(gid);
    this.fb.remove(this.fb.child(this.room, `up/${gid}`));
    this.fb.remove(this.fb.child(this.room, `down/${gid}`));
  }

  // The reason is written on the guest's entry first, so they always learn
  // why (the messages channel is cleared when they are removed).
  kick(g, reason = 'You were removed from the room.') {
    this.flush();
    const me = this.fb.child(this.room, `guests/${g.gid}`);
    this.fb.update(me, { kick: String(reason).slice(0, 200) }).catch(() => {});
    setTimeout(() => this.fb.remove(me), 1500);
  }

  queue(g, event, data) {
    if (g.transport.closed) return;
    // only the newest snapshot matters; older ones are already out of date
    if (event === 'snap') g.snap = data;
    else g.out.push([event, data]);
  }

  async receive(g, list) {
    for (const m of list.slice(0, 80)) {
      if (!Array.isArray(m)) continue;
      const [kind, id, type, payload] = m;
      if (typeof type !== 'string') continue;
      if (kind === 'h') {
        const res = await this.joinGuest(g, payload);
        g.joined = !!(res && res.ok);
        if (g.joined) {
          const s = this.game.players.get(g.gid);
          if (s && s.offlineEarned) {
            this.game.toast(s, `Your monsters earned ${s.offlineEarned} Money while you were away! Collect it at your base.`, 'good');
            s.offlineEarned = 0;
          }
        }
        g.out.push(['__res', { id, res }]);
        continue;
      }
      if (!g.joined || !this.game.handlers[type]) {
        if (kind === 'r') g.out.push(['__res', { id, res: { ok: false, error: 'unknown' } }]);
        continue;
      }
      if (kind === 's' && type === 'move') {
        g.move = payload; // applied on the next move tick (see applyMove)
        continue;
      }
      // anything else acts from the guest's latest position
      this.applyMove(g);
      const res = this.game.handle(g.gid, type, payload);
      if (kind === 'r') g.out.push(['__res', { id, res: res || { ok: true } }]);
    }
    if (g.out.some((m) => m[0] === '__res')) this.flushGuest(g);
  }

  // The guest's name and progress come from their own account; banned
  // players can't come in.
  async joinGuest(g, payload) {
    let acct;
    try {
      acct = await this.accounts.readAccount(g.gid);
    } catch (e) {
      return { ok: false, error: 'account', message: `Could not read your account (${e.message}).` };
    }
    if (acct.banned) return { ok: false, error: 'banned', message: 'You are banned.' };
    if (!acct.name) return { ok: false, error: 'account', message: 'Log in to your account first.' };
    const ident = { account: g.gid, name: acct.name, profile: acct.profile, external: true };
    return this.game.join(g.gid, payload, g.transport, ident);
  }

  // A guest's progress goes back to them to save in their account.
  saveFor(profile) {
    const g = this.guests.get(profile.account);
    if (!g || !g.joined || g.transport.closed) return false;
    g.savePending = profile;
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - (g.lastSaveAt || 0) >= GUEST_SAVE_MS) this.sendSave(g);
    else if (!g.saveTimer) g.saveTimer = setTimeout(() => this.sendSave(g), GUEST_SAVE_MS - (now - (g.lastSaveAt || 0)));
    return true;
  }

  sendSave(g) {
    clearTimeout(g.saveTimer);
    g.saveTimer = null;
    if (!g.savePending || g.transport.closed) return;
    g.lastSaveAt = Date.now();
    g.out.push(['saveProfile', g.savePending]);
    g.savePending = null;
  }

  // Positions arrive in batches, sometimes several at once after a network
  // hiccup. The server checks speed against the time since the last move it
  // accepted, so it gets only the newest position, at most every MOVE_MS.
  applyMove(g) {
    if (!g.move || !g.joined) return;
    const m = g.move;
    g.move = null;
    this.game.handle(g.gid, 'move', m);
  }

  flushGuest(g) {
    const msgs = g.out;
    if (g.snap) msgs.push(['snap', g.snap]);
    g.out = [];
    g.snap = null;
    if (!msgs.length || g.transport.closed) return;
    this.fb.push(this.fb.child(this.room, `down/${g.gid}`), { j: JSON.stringify(msgs) });
  }

  flush() {
    for (const g of this.guests.values()) this.flushGuest(g);
  }

  close() {
    for (const stop of this.stopTimers || []) stop();
    for (const u of this.unsubs || []) u();
    if (this.room) this.fb.remove(this.room);
  }

  link() {
    const u = new URL(location.href);
    u.search = '';
    u.hash = '';
    u.searchParams.set('room', this.code);
    return u.toString();
  }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ guest

export class RoomGuestNet {
  constructor(code) {
    this.code = code;
    this.remote = true;
    this.socket = null;
    this.offset = 0;
    this.rtt = 250;
    this.handlers = new Map();
    this.connected = false;
    this.pending = new Map();
    this.seq = 0;
    this.out = [];
    this.move = null;
  }

  async connect() {
    const { fb, db, auth } = await firebase();
    this.fb = fb;
    this.db = db;
    this.uid = auth.currentUser?.uid || null;
    const room = fb.ref(db, `${ROOT}/${this.code}`);
    this.room = room;
    const host = await fb.get(fb.child(room, 'host'));
    if (!host.exists()) throw new Error(`Room ${this.code} was not found. Check the code, or ask your friend to open the room again.`);
    if (host.val().v !== PROTOCOL_VERSION) throw new Error('Your friend has a different version of the game. Both of you: refresh the page.');
    this.gid = this.uid;
    if (!this.gid) throw new Error('Log in to your account to join a room.');
    const me = fb.child(room, `guests/${this.gid}`);
    await fb.onDisconnect(me).remove();
    await fb.onDisconnect(fb.child(room, `up/${this.gid}`)).remove();
    await fb.onDisconnect(fb.child(room, `down/${this.gid}`)).remove();
    // listen before announcing ourselves, so nothing is missed
    this.bytesIn = 0;
    this.unsubDown = fb.onChildAdded(fb.child(room, `down/${this.gid}`), (snap) => {
      const v = snap.val();
      this.bytesIn += v && typeof v.j === 'string' ? v.j.length : 0;
      const list = parse(v);
      fb.remove(snap.ref);
      this.receive(list);
    });
    this.unsubHost = fb.onValue(fb.child(room, 'host'), (snap) => {
      if (!snap.exists() && this.connected) {
        this.connected = false;
        this.emitLocal('roomClosed');
      }
    });
    this.unsubMe = fb.onValue(me, (snap) => {
      const kick = snap.val()?.kick;
      if (kick && this.connected) {
        this.connected = false;
        this.emitLocal('kicked', { reason: kick });
        return;
      }
      // the host removed us (kicked, or the room is full and closed)
      if (!snap.exists() && this.connected && this.joinedOnce) {
        this.connected = false;
        this.emitLocal('roomClosed');
      }
    });
    await fb.set(me, { at: fb.serverTimestamp() });
    this.upTimer = setInterval(() => this.flush(), UP_MS);
    this.socket = { room: this.code };
    this.connected = true;
    this.emitLocal('connect');
  }

  on(event, fn) {
    if (!this.handlers.has(event)) this.handlers.set(event, []);
    this.handlers.get(event).push(fn);
  }

  emitLocal(event, data) {
    const list = this.handlers.get(event);
    if (list) for (const fn of list) {
      try {
        fn(data);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(`handler for ${event} failed`, e);
      }
    }
  }

  receive(list) {
    for (const m of list) {
      if (!Array.isArray(m)) continue;
      const [event, data] = m;
      if (event === '__res') {
        const done = this.pending.get(data?.id);
        if (done) {
          this.pending.delete(data.id);
          done(data.res);
        }
      } else {
        this.emitLocal(event, data);
      }
    }
  }

  call(kind, type, payload, timeout) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (!this.connected) return resolve({ ok: false, error: 'offline', message: 'Not connected.' });
      const id = ++this.seq;
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.pending.delete(id);
        resolve({ ok: false, error: 'timeout', message: "Your friend's game did not answer in time." });
      }, timeout);
      this.pending.set(id, (res) => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        resolve(res || { ok: true });
      });
      this.out.push([kind, id, type, payload]);
      this.flush();
    });
  }

  async hello(token, name, color, extra = {}) {
    const t0 = Date.now();
    const res = await this.call('h', 'hello', { protocol: PROTOCOL_VERSION, token, name, color, ...extra }, 20000);
    if (res && res.serverTime) {
      this.rtt = Date.now() - t0;
      this.offset = res.serverTime - (t0 + this.rtt / 2);
    }
    if (res && res.ok) this.joinedOnce = true;
    return res;
  }

  send(type, payload) {
    if (!this.connected) return;
    // positions are sent as the newest one per batch
    if (type === 'move') this.move = payload;
    else this.out.push(['s', 0, type, payload]);
  }

  request(type, payload = {}, timeout = 8000) {
    if (TRANSACTIONAL.has(type) && !payload.reqId) payload = { ...payload, reqId: randomId('r', 10) };
    return this.call('r', type, payload, timeout);
  }

  flush() {
    if (!this.connected) return;
    if (this.move) {
      this.out.push(['s', 0, 'move', this.move]);
      this.move = null;
    }
    if (!this.out.length) return;
    const j = JSON.stringify(this.out);
    this.out = [];
    this.fb.push(this.fb.child(this.room, `up/${this.gid}`), { j });
  }

  async syncClock() {
    const t0 = Date.now();
    const res = await this.request('ping', {}, 4000);
    if (res && res.t) {
      const rtt = Date.now() - t0;
      const off = res.t - (t0 + rtt / 2);
      this.rtt = this.rtt * 0.7 + rtt * 0.3;
      this.offset = this.offset * 0.8 + off * 0.2;
    }
  }

  serverNow() {
    return Date.now() + this.offset;
  }
}

// Renderer, scene, lights, sky and the day/night cycle.

import * as THREE from 'three';
import { REGION_BY_ID } from '#shared/regions.js';

const SKY_VERT = /* glsl */ `
varying vec3 vDir;
void main() {
  vDir = normalize(position);
  vec4 p = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
  // pinned to the far plane (a hair inside so it is never clipped)
  gl_Position = vec4(p.xy, p.w * 0.99999, p.w);
}`;

const SKY_FRAG = /* glsl */ `
uniform vec3 uTop;
uniform vec3 uHorizon;
uniform vec3 uBottom;
uniform vec3 uSunDir;
uniform vec3 uSunColor;
uniform float uStars;
uniform float uTime;
uniform float uRainbow;
varying vec3 vDir;
float hash(vec3 p) { return fract(sin(dot(p, vec3(12.9898, 78.233, 37.719))) * 43758.5453); }
void main() {
  vec3 d = normalize(vDir);
  float h = d.y;
  vec3 col = h > 0.0 ? mix(uHorizon, uTop, pow(h, 0.55)) : mix(uHorizon, uBottom, pow(-h, 0.4));
  float sd = max(dot(d, normalize(uSunDir)), 0.0);
  col += uSunColor * (pow(sd, 900.0) * 3.0 + pow(sd, 12.0) * 0.25);
  if (uStars > 0.0 && h > 0.0) {
    vec3 g = floor(d * 220.0);
    float s = hash(g);
    float tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * sin(uTime * 2.0 + s * 40.0);
    col += vec3(step(0.9965, s) * uStars * tw);
  }
  if (uRainbow > 0.0) {
    float a = atan(d.z, d.x);
    vec3 rb = 0.5 + 0.5 * cos(6.2831 * (a * 0.3 + uTime * 0.1 + vec3(0.0, 0.33, 0.67)));
    col = mix(col, col * 0.6 + rb * 0.6, uRainbow * smoothstep(-0.1, 0.5, h) * 0.55);
  }
  gl_FragColor = vec4(col, 1.0);
}`;

const C = (hex) => new THREE.Color(hex);
const CLOUD_SPAN = 360;

// Keyframes over the day (0 = sunrise). Colors for sky top/horizon and lights.
const DAY_KEYS = [
  { t: 0.0, top: C(0x6f8fd8), hor: C(0xffb98a), sun: C(0xffc79a), sunI: 1.2, hemi: 0.9, amb: C(0xc9b0ff) },
  { t: 0.08, top: C(0x3f9bff), hor: C(0xbfe6ff), sun: C(0xfff4e0), sunI: 2.6, hemi: 1.25, amb: C(0xffffff) },
  { t: 0.55, top: C(0x3f9bff), hor: C(0xc9ecff), sun: C(0xfff4e0), sunI: 2.6, hemi: 1.25, amb: C(0xffffff) },
  { t: 0.64, top: C(0x5a6fc8), hor: C(0xff9a6a), sun: C(0xffa070), sunI: 1.4, hemi: 0.9, amb: C(0xffc0a0) },
  { t: 0.7, top: C(0x1a2050), hor: C(0x3a3a7a), sun: C(0x8090ff), sunI: 0.6, hemi: 0.75, amb: C(0x9aa0ff) },
  { t: 0.95, top: C(0x101838), hor: C(0x2a3060), sun: C(0x8090ff), sunI: 0.55, hemi: 0.7, amb: C(0x9aa0ff) },
  { t: 1.0, top: C(0x6f8fd8), hor: C(0xffb98a), sun: C(0xffc79a), sunI: 1.2, hemi: 0.9, amb: C(0xc9b0ff) },
];

export const QUALITY = {
  // monsterDist: wild monsters farther away than this are not drawn (with 50
  // on every island there can be dozens in view)
  low: { pixelRatio: 1, shadows: false, shadowSize: 0, viewDist: 230, antialias: false, monsterDist: 80 },
  medium: { pixelRatio: 1.25, shadows: true, shadowSize: 1024, viewDist: 300, antialias: true, monsterDist: 110 },
  high: { pixelRatio: 2, shadows: true, shadowSize: 2048, viewDist: 380, antialias: true, monsterDist: 150 },
};

export class SceneView {
  constructor(canvas, quality = 'high') {
    this.quality = QUALITY[quality] ? quality : 'high';
    const q = QUALITY[this.quality];
    this.renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: q.antialias, powerPreference: 'high-performance' });
    this.renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, q.pixelRatio));
    this.renderer.shadowMap.enabled = q.shadows;
    this.renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFShadowMap;
    this.renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    this.renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.05;

    this.scene = new THREE.Scene();
    // nothing is visible through the fog beyond viewDist, so the far plane
    // sits just past it and the frustum culls everything further away
    this.camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, 1, 0.3, q.viewDist + 80);
    this.scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xbfe6ff, 120, q.viewDist);

    this.hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xdff3ff, 0x7a9a5a, 1.2);
    this.scene.add(this.hemi);
    this.sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff4e0, 2.6);
    this.sun.castShadow = q.shadows;
    if (q.shadows) {
      this.sun.shadow.mapSize.set(q.shadowSize, q.shadowSize);
      const sc = this.sun.shadow.camera;
      sc.left = -75; sc.right = 75; sc.top = 75; sc.bottom = -75; sc.near = 1; sc.far = 400;
      this.sun.shadow.bias = -0.0006;
      this.sun.shadow.normalBias = 0.6;
    }
    this.scene.add(this.sun);
    this.scene.add(this.sun.target);

    this.skyUniforms = {
      uTop: { value: new THREE.Color(0x3f9bff) },
      uHorizon: { value: new THREE.Color(0xc9ecff) },
      uBottom: { value: new THREE.Color(0x9bc4e8) },
      uSunDir: { value: new THREE.Vector3(0.3, 0.8, 0.2) },
      uSunColor: { value: new THREE.Color(0xfff4e0) },
      uStars: { value: 0 },
      uTime: { value: 0 },
      uRainbow: { value: 0 },
    };
    const sky = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.SphereGeometry(1500, 32, 16),
      new THREE.ShaderMaterial({ uniforms: this.skyUniforms, vertexShader: SKY_VERT, fragmentShader: SKY_FRAG, side: THREE.BackSide, depthWrite: false, fog: false }),
    );
    sky.frustumCulled = false;
    sky.renderOrder = -10;
    this.sky = sky;
    this.scene.add(sky);

    this.clouds = this.makeClouds();
    this.scene.add(this.clouds);

    this.fogColor = new THREE.Color(0xbfe6ff);
    this.targetFog = { color: new THREE.Color(0xbfe6ff), near: 120, far: q.viewDist };
    this.luckyMix = 0;
    this.nightness = 0;
    this.resize();
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => this.resize());
  }

  // One instanced draw for every cloud puff. Clouds drift and wrap around
  // the player so the sky is never empty and never beyond the far plane.
  makeClouds() {
    const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.92, fog: false });
    let seed = 7;
    const rnd = () => ((seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647) / 2147483647);
    this.cloudList = [];
    let puffs = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
      const n = 3 + Math.floor(rnd() * 4);
      const parts = [];
      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        parts.push({
          sx: 18 + rnd() * 26, sy: 6 + rnd() * 6, sz: 14 + rnd() * 18,
          x: (k - n / 2) * 14 + rnd() * 8, y: rnd() * 4, z: rnd() * 10 - 5,
        });
      }
      puffs += n;
      this.cloudList.push({ x: (rnd() - 0.5) * CLOUD_SPAN, y: 115 + rnd() * 40, z: (rnd() - 0.5) * CLOUD_SPAN, speed: 1 + rnd() * 2, parts });
    }
    const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 1), mat, puffs);
    mesh.frustumCulled = false;
    return mesh;
  }

  updateClouds(dt, focus) {
    const m4 = new THREE.Matrix4();
    const q = new THREE.Quaternion();
    const v = new THREE.Vector3();
    const sc = new THREE.Vector3();
    const half = CLOUD_SPAN / 2;
    let i = 0;
    for (const c of this.cloudList) {
      c.x += c.speed * dt;
      // wrap around the player
      if (focus) {
        while (c.x - focus.x > half) c.x -= CLOUD_SPAN;
        while (c.x - focus.x < -half) c.x += CLOUD_SPAN;
        while (c.z - focus.z > half) c.z -= CLOUD_SPAN;
        while (c.z - focus.z < -half) c.z += CLOUD_SPAN;
      }
      for (const p of c.parts) {
        v.set(c.x + p.x, c.y + p.y, c.z + p.z);
        sc.set(p.sx, p.sy, p.sz);
        this.clouds.setMatrixAt(i++, m4.compose(v, q, sc));
      }
    }
    this.clouds.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
  }

  // Applies a quality preset live (antialiasing needs a reload).
  setQuality(name) {
    if (!QUALITY[name] || name === this.quality) return;
    this.quality = name;
    const q = QUALITY[name];
    this.renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, q.pixelRatio));
    this.camera.far = q.viewDist + 80;
    this.targetFog.far = Math.min(this.targetFog.far, q.viewDist);
    if (q.shadows !== this.renderer.shadowMap.enabled || (q.shadows && this.sun.shadow.mapSize.x !== q.shadowSize)) {
      this.renderer.shadowMap.enabled = q.shadows;
      this.sun.castShadow = q.shadows;
      if (q.shadows) {
        this.sun.shadow.mapSize.set(q.shadowSize, q.shadowSize);
        const sc = this.sun.shadow.camera;
        sc.left = -75; sc.right = 75; sc.top = 75; sc.bottom = -75; sc.near = 1; sc.far = 400;
        this.sun.shadow.bias = -0.0006;
        this.sun.shadow.normalBias = 0.6;
      }
      if (this.sun.shadow.map) {
        this.sun.shadow.map.dispose();
        this.sun.shadow.map = null;
      }
      this.scene.traverse((o) => {
        if (!o.material) return;
        for (const m of Array.isArray(o.material) ? o.material : [o.material]) m.needsUpdate = true;
      });
    }
    this.resize();
  }

  resize() {
    const w = window.innerWidth;
    const h = window.innerHeight;
    this.renderer.setSize(w, h, false);
    this.camera.aspect = w / h;
    this.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  }

  // dayT: 0..1 (0 = sunrise). regionId tints the fog. lucky: LUCKY LUCKY active.
  update(dt, time, dayT, focus, regionId, lucky) {
    let a = DAY_KEYS[0];
    let b = DAY_KEYS[1];
    for (let i = 0; i < DAY_KEYS.length - 1; i++) {
      if (dayT >= DAY_KEYS[i].t && dayT <= DAY_KEYS[i + 1].t) {
        a = DAY_KEYS[i];
        b = DAY_KEYS[i + 1];
        break;
      }
    }
    const k = (dayT - a.t) / Math.max(1e-6, b.t - a.t);
    const top = a.top.clone().lerp(b.top, k);
    const hor = a.hor.clone().lerp(b.hor, k);
    const sunCol = a.sun.clone().lerp(b.sun, k);
    const sunI = a.sunI + (b.sunI - a.sunI) * k;
    const hemiI = a.hemi + (b.hemi - a.hemi) * k;
    this.nightness = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (0.95 - sunI) / 0.4));

    this.luckyMix += ((lucky ? 1 : 0) - this.luckyMix) * Math.min(1, dt * 1.5);
    if (this.luckyMix > 0.01) {
      top.lerp(C(0xffb03a), this.luckyMix * 0.5);
      hor.lerp(C(0xfff0a0), this.luckyMix * 0.6);
    }
    this.skyUniforms.uTop.value.copy(top);
    this.skyUniforms.uHorizon.value.copy(hor);
    this.skyUniforms.uBottom.value.copy(hor).multiplyScalar(0.8);
    this.skyUniforms.uStars.value = this.nightness;
    this.skyUniforms.uTime.value = time;
    this.skyUniforms.uRainbow.value = this.luckyMix;

    // the sun travels across the sky; at night the "sun" light is the moon
    const ang = dayT * Math.PI * 2;
    const sunDir = new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(ang) * 0.8, Math.max(0.15, Math.sin(ang) * 0.9 + 0.1), 0.35).normalize();
    const lightDir = this.nightness > 0.5 ? new THREE.Vector3(-0.4, 0.8, 0.3).normalize() : sunDir;
    this.skyUniforms.uSunDir.value.copy(sunDir);
    this.skyUniforms.uSunColor.value.copy(sunCol).multiplyScalar(1 - this.nightness * 0.8);

    this.sun.color.copy(sunCol);
    this.sun.intensity = sunI;
    this.hemi.intensity = hemiI;
    this.hemi.color.copy(a.amb.clone().lerp(b.amb, k));
    if (focus) {
      this.sun.position.set(focus.x + lightDir.x * 150, focus.y + lightDir.y * 150, focus.z + lightDir.z * 150);
      this.sun.target.position.set(focus.x, focus.y, focus.z);
      this.sky.position.copy(this.camera.position);
    }

    // fog follows the region you are in, darker at night
    const region = regionId ? REGION_BY_ID[regionId] : null;
    const q = QUALITY[this.quality];
    if (region) {
      this.targetFog.color.setHex(region.fog.color);
      this.targetFog.near = region.fog.near;
      this.targetFog.far = Math.min(q.viewDist, region.fog.far + 40);
    }
    const nightFog = this.targetFog.color.clone().lerp(C(0x1a2040), this.nightness * 0.75);
    if (this.luckyMix > 0.01) nightFog.lerp(C(0xffe9a0), this.luckyMix * 0.4);
    this.scene.fog.color.lerp(nightFog, Math.min(1, dt * 1.5));
    this.scene.fog.near += (this.targetFog.near - this.scene.fog.near) * Math.min(1, dt);
    this.scene.fog.far += (this.targetFog.far - this.scene.fog.far) * Math.min(1, dt);
    this.renderer.setClearColor(this.scene.fog.color);

    this.updateClouds(dt, focus);
  }

  render() {
    this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);
  }
}

FILE: public/client/steadyTimer.js

// setInterval that keeps its pace when the tab is in the background.
// Browsers slow timers in hidden tabs down to once a second (or less), which
// would freeze the game for everyone in a room this browser hosts; timers in
// a worker are not slowed down like that. Falls back to setInterval.
export function steadyInterval(fn, ms) {
  try {
    const src = `const t = setInterval(() => postMessage(0), ${Number(ms)}); onmessage = () => { clearInterval(t); close(); };`;
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([src], { type: 'text/javascript' }));
    const worker = new Worker(url);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    worker.onmessage = () => fn();
    return () => worker.postMessage('stop');
  } catch {
    const id = setInterval(fn, ms);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }
}
