    { geo: merge([g(ICO, 0, 6.8, 0, 3.2, 2.6, 3.2), g(ICO, 1.6, 8.0, 0.6, 1.8, 1.6, 1.8)]), mat: lambert(0xffd24a, { flat: true, emissive: 0x3a2800 }), tint: [0xffd24a, 0xffe27a, 0xffb83a] },
  ];
  P.blossom_tree = [
    { geo: merge([g(CYL6, 0, 2.4, 0, 0.8, 4.8, 0.8, 0, 0, 0.08)]), mat: flat(0x7a4a3a) },
    { geo: merge([g(ICO, 0.3, 6.2, 0, 3, 2.4, 3), g(ICO, 1.8, 7.0, 0.5, 1.7, 1.5, 1.7), g(ICO, -1.4, 6.6, -0.6, 1.6, 1.4, 1.6)]), mat: flat(0xff9fd0), tint: [0xff9fd0, 0xffb8e0, 0xff86c0, 0xffffff] },
  ];
  P.star_crystal = [{ geo: merge([g(OCTA, 0, 1.8, 0, 1, 1.8, 1), g(OCTA, 0, 1.8, 0, 1.6, 0.35, 0.35), g(OCTA, 0, 1.8, 0, 0.35, 0.35, 1.6)]), mat: lambert(0xfff27a, { flat: true, emissive: 0x6a5a10 }), tint: [0xfff27a, 0xffffff, 0x9fd8ff] }];
  propPartsCache = P;
  return P;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ barrier shader

const BARRIER_MAT = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  transparent: true,
  depthWrite: false,
  side: THREE.DoubleSide,
  uniforms: { uTime: { value: 0 }, uColor: { value: new THREE.Color(0xff5a7a) } },
  vertexShader: `varying vec2 vUv; varying vec3 vPos; void main(){ vUv = uv; vPos = position; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
  fragmentShader: `uniform float uTime; uniform vec3 uColor; varying vec2 vUv; varying vec3 vPos;
    void main(){
      float stripe = step(0.5, fract((vPos.x + vPos.z) * 0.12 + vPos.y * 0.25 - uTime * 0.6));
      float fade = (1.0 - vUv.y) * 0.85 + 0.1;
      float edge = smoothstep(0.0, 0.08, vUv.y) ;
      gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(uColor, vec3(1.0), stripe * 0.35), (0.22 + stripe * 0.18) * fade * edge);
    }`,
});

// ------------------------------------------------------------------

export class WorldRenderer {
  constructor(scene, world) {
    this.scene = scene;
    this.world = world;
    this.root = new THREE.Group();
    scene.add(this.root);
    this.terrainChunks = [];
    this.animated = [];
    this.barriers = {};
    this.portalMeshes = {};
    this.time = 0;
  }

  build(onProgress = () => {}) {
    this.buildTerrain();
    onProgress(0.4);
    this.buildWater();
    this.buildProps();
    onProgress(0.7);
    this.buildStructures();
    this.buildPlaza();
    this.buildPortals();
    this.buildBarriers();
    this.buildSpots();
    this.buildMoon();
    onProgress(1);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- terrain

  buildTerrain() {
    const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ vertexColors: true, flatShading: true });
    for (const patch of this.world.patches) {
      const n = patch.n;
      const chunks = Math.ceil((n - 1) / CHUNK_CELLS);
      for (let cj = 0; cj < chunks; cj++) {
        for (let ci = 0; ci < chunks; ci++) {
          const i0 = ci * CHUNK_CELLS;
          const j0 = cj * CHUNK_CELLS;
          const i1 = Math.min(n - 1, i0 + CHUNK_CELLS);
          const j1 = Math.min(n - 1, j0 + CHUNK_CELLS);
          const mesh = this.buildChunk(patch, i0, j0, i1, j1, mat);
          if (mesh) {
            this.root.add(mesh);
            this.terrainChunks.push(mesh);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  buildChunk(patch, i0, j0, i1, j1, mat) {
    const w = i1 - i0 + 1;
    const h = j1 - j0 + 1;
    const H = (i, j) => patch.h[Math.min(patch.n - 1, Math.max(0, j)) * patch.n + Math.min(patch.n - 1, Math.max(0, i))];
    // skip chunks that are entirely deep sea floor (beyond the world)
    let maxH = -Infinity;
    for (let j = j0; j <= j1; j++) for (let i = i0; i <= i1; i++) maxH = Math.max(maxH, H(i, j));
    if (maxH < -12) return null;
    const pos = new Float32Array(w * h * 3);
    const col = new Float32Array(w * h * 3);
    const c = [0, 0, 0];
    let k = 0;
    for (let j = j0; j <= j1; j++) {
      for (let i = i0; i <= i1; i++) {
        const x = patch.x0 + i * CELL;
        const z = patch.z0 + j * CELL;
        const y = H(i, j);
        const slope = Math.max(Math.abs(H(i + 1, j) - H(i - 1, j)), Math.abs(H(i, j + 1) - H(i, j - 1))) / (2 * CELL) * 2;
        terrainColor(this.world, x, z, y, slope, c);
        pos[k * 3] = x;
        pos[k * 3 + 1] = y;
        pos[k * 3 + 2] = z;
        col[k * 3] = c[0];
        col[k * 3 + 1] = c[1];
        col[k * 3 + 2] = c[2];
        k++;
      }
    }
    const idx = [];
    for (let j = 0; j < h - 1; j++) {
      for (let i = 0; i < w - 1; i++) {
        const a = j * w + i;
        const b = a + 1;
        const d = a + w;
        const e = d + 1;
        idx.push(a, e, b, a, d, e);
      }
    }
    const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
    geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(col, 3));
    geo.setIndex(idx);
    geo.computeVertexNormals();
    geo.computeBoundingSphere();
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
    mesh.receiveShadow = true;
    return mesh;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- water & lava

  buildWater() {
    const water = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(4200, 2400, 1, 1),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x2ea6ee, transparent: true, opacity: 0.78, roughness: 0.18, metalness: 0.05 }),
    );
    water.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    water.position.y = WATER_Y;
    water.receiveShadow = true;
    water.renderOrder = 1;
    this.root.add(water);
    this.water = water;

    const lavaMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xff5a10, emissive: 0xff4a00, emissiveIntensity: 1.4, roughness: 0.6 });
    this.lavaMat = lavaMat;
    for (const p of this.world.lavaPools) {
      const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(p.r + 1.5, 28), lavaMat);
      m.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
      m.position.set(p.x, p.y, p.z);
      this.root.add(m);
      const light = new THREE.PointLight(0xff6a1f, 40, 40, 1.6);
      light.position.set(p.x, p.y + 4, p.z);
      this.root.add(light);
    }
    const lake = this.world.spots.find((s) => s.id === 'frost_lake');
    if (lake) {
      const ice = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(lake.r, 40), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xcdeeff, roughness: 0.08, metalness: 0.1, transparent: true, opacity: 0.85 }));
      ice.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
      ice.position.set(lake.x, lake.y + 0.06, lake.z);
      ice.receiveShadow = true;
      this.root.add(ice);
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- props

  // Props are instanced per type within square cells, so whole cells are
  // frustum-culled and small decorations are dropped beyond DETAIL_DIST.
  buildProps() {
    const parts = propParts();
    const byCellType = new Map();
    for (const p of this.world.props) {
      const key = `${Math.floor(p.x / PROP_CELL)},${Math.floor(p.z / PROP_CELL)}|${p.type}`;
      if (!byCellType.has(key)) byCellType.set(key, []);
      byCellType.get(key).push(p);
    }
    const m4 = new THREE.Matrix4();
    const q = new THREE.Quaternion();
    const up = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
    const color = new THREE.Color();
    this.propMeshes = [];
    for (const [key, list] of byCellType) {
      const type = key.split('|')[1];
      const defs = parts[type];
      if (!defs) continue;
      for (const part of defs) {
        const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(part.geo, part.mat, list.length);
        list.forEach((p, i) => {
          q.setFromAxisAngle(up, p.rot);
          const squash = type === 'rock' || type === 'desert_rock' ? 0.75 + ((Math.floor(p.x * 7 + p.z * 13) & 1023) % 10) / 20 : 1;
          m4.compose(new THREE.Vector3(p.x, p.y - 0.15, p.z), q, new THREE.Vector3(p.s, p.s * squash, p.s));
          mesh.setMatrixAt(i, m4);
          if (part.tint) {
            color.setHex(part.tint[Math.abs(Math.floor(p.x * 3 + p.z * 5)) % part.tint.length]);
            mesh.setColorAt(i, color);
          }
        });
        mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
        if (mesh.instanceColor) mesh.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true;
        mesh.computeBoundingSphere();
        const big = PROP_TYPES[type].r > 0.9;
        mesh.castShadow = big;
        mesh.receiveShadow = true;
        this.root.add(mesh);
        this.propMeshes.push({ mesh, sphere: mesh.boundingSphere, detail: DETAIL_PROPS.has(type) });
      }
    }
  }

  cullProps(camPos) {
    for (const p of this.propMeshes) {
      if (!p.detail) continue;
      p.mesh.visible = p.sphere.center.distanceTo(camPos) - p.sphere.radius < DETAIL_DIST;
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- structures

  buildStructures() {
    const groups = new Map();
    const door = [];
    for (const b of this.world.boxes) {
      if (b.invisible) continue; // collision-only (e.g. the glass in base windows)
      const geo = g(BOX, b.x, b.y, b.z, b.hw * 2, b.hh * 2, b.hd * 2, 0, -b.rot, 0);
      if (b.door) {
        door.push(geo);
        continue;
      }
      // one mesh per material per base, so whole towers can be culled
      const key = `${b.mat}|${b.base ?? ''}`;
      if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, []);
      groups.get(key).push(geo);
    }
    for (const [key, list] of groups) {
      const name = key.split('|')[0];
      const def = STRUCT_MATS[name] || { color: 0xcccccc };
      const geo = merge(list);
      let material;
      if (def.studs) {
        boxUV(geo, 1.25);
        material = studMaterial(def.color);
      } else {
        material = lambert(def.color, { flat: true, emissive: def.emissive });
      }
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, material);
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      this.root.add(mesh);
    }
    if (door.length) {
      this.vaultDoor = new THREE.Mesh(merge(door), lambert(STRUCT_MATS.vault_door.color, { flat: true, emissive: STRUCT_MATS.vault_door.emissive }));
      this.vaultDoor.castShadow = true;
      this.root.add(this.vaultDoor);
    }
  }

  setVaultOpen(open) {
    if (this.vaultDoor) this.vaultDoor.visible = !open;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- plaza

  buildPlaza() {
    const y = PLAZA.y;
    const stone = lambert(0xd8d2c4, { flat: true });
    const basin = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(5.2, 5.6, 1.2, 20), stone);
    basin.position.set(0, y + 0.6, 0);
    basin.castShadow = basin.receiveShadow = true;
    const water = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(4.6, 4.6, 0.2, 20), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x5ac8ff, roughness: 0.1, transparent: true, opacity: 0.85 }));
    water.position.set(0, y + 1.1, 0);
    const column = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.7, 1, 4, 10), stone);
    column.position.set(0, y + 2.6, 0);
    const top = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(1.3, 16, 12), lambert(0xffd23a, { emissive: 0x3a2a00 }));
    top.position.set(0, y + 5.2, 0);
    this.fountainTop = top;
    this.root.add(basin, water, column, top);
    this.animated.push((t) => {
      top.position.y = y + 5.2 + Math.sin(t * 1.5) * 0.25;
      top.rotation.y = t * 0.6;
    });
    const title = makeLabel('STEAL A MONSTER', { font: '900 64px "Trebuchet MS", system-ui, sans-serif', color: '#ffe14a', strokeColor: '#5a2a8a', strokeWidth: 12, scale: 0.05 });
    title.position.set(0, y + 9, 0);
    this.root.add(title);

    for (const shop of this.world.shops) {
      const sign = {
        swords: ['⚔ SWORD SHOP', '#d8384a'], items: ['🥊 GADGET SHOP', '#3a7ae0'], board: ['🍀 LUCKY BOARD', '#e0a020'],
        costumes: ['🕶 COSTUME SHOP', '#26262e'], power: ['💪 UPGRADE YOUR POWER', '#8a4ad8'],
      }[shop.kind];
      const label = makeLabel(sign[0], { color: '#ffffff', bg: sign[1], border: shop.kind === 'costumes' ? '#5ff3ff' : '#ffffff', scale: 0.035 });
      const back = { x: shop.x - Math.cos(shop.facing * DEG) * 3, z: shop.z - Math.sin(shop.facing * DEG) * 3 };
      label.position.set(back.x, y + 9.4, back.z);
      this.root.add(label);
    }
    // benches & lamps around the plaza
    const wood = lambert(0xa0703a, { flat: true });
    const metal = lambert(0x3a3a4a, { flat: true });
    const glow = lambert(0xfff2c0, { emissive: 0xffe08a });
    for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
      const a = (k / 8) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.PI / 8;
      const lx = Math.cos(a) * (PLAZA.r - 3);
      const lz = Math.sin(a) * (PLAZA.r - 3);
      const pole = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.15, 0.2, 5, 6), metal);
      pole.position.set(lx, y + 2.5, lz);
      const lamp = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.55, 10, 8), glow);
      lamp.position.set(lx, y + 5.2, lz);
      this.root.add(pole, lamp);
      if (k % 2 === 0) {
        const bench = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(3, 0.3, 1), wood);
        const ba = a + 0.25;
        bench.position.set(Math.cos(ba) * (PLAZA.r - 4), y + 0.8, Math.sin(ba) * (PLAZA.r - 4));
        bench.rotation.y = -ba + Math.PI / 2;
        bench.castShadow = true;
        this.root.add(bench);
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- portals

  buildPortals() {
    const stone = lambert(0x9a8fb8, { flat: true });
    const gold = lambert(0xffc94a, { flat: true });
    for (const p of [...this.world.portals, { ...this.world.gate, gate: true }]) {
      const grp = new THREE.Group();
      const yaw = Math.atan2(p.x, p.z);
      grp.position.set(p.x, p.y, p.z);
      grp.rotation.y = yaw;
      if (p.gate) {
        // the Island Gate: a bigger golden arch with a rainbow swirl
        grp.scale.setScalar(1.25);
        for (let k = 0; k < 7; k++) {
          const gem = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.45, 0), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: [0xff6b9d, 0xffb84a, 0xfff06a, 0x6be08a, 0x5ab8ff, 0x9a7bff, 0xff7ae0][k], emissive: [0xff6b9d, 0xffb84a, 0xfff06a, 0x6be08a, 0x5ab8ff, 0x9a7bff, 0xff7ae0][k], emissiveIntensity: 0.6 }));
          gem.position.set(-3 + k, 9.3, 0.9);
          grp.add(gem);
        }
      }
      for (const sgn of [-1, 1]) {
        const pillar = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.4, 8, 1.4), p.gate ? gold : stone);
        pillar.position.set(3.4 * sgn, 4, 0);
        pillar.castShadow = true;
        grp.add(pillar);
      }
      const lintel = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(8.4, 1.2, 1.6), p.gate ? gold : stone);
      lintel.position.set(0, 8.4, 0);
      grp.add(lintel);
      const region = REGION_BY_ID[p.region || 'plains'];
      const color = new THREE.Color(p.gate ? 0xff9fd8 : region.id === 'plains' ? 0x7af0ff : region.colors.accent);
      const swirl = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.PlaneGeometry(5.6, 7.4),
        new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
          transparent: true,
          side: THREE.DoubleSide,
          depthWrite: false,
          uniforms: { uTime: { value: 0 }, uColor: { value: color }, uOn: { value: 1 } },
          vertexShader: 'varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }',
          fragmentShader: `uniform float uTime; uniform vec3 uColor; uniform float uOn; varying vec2 vUv;
            void main(){ vec2 c = vUv - 0.5; float r = length(c * vec2(1.0, 0.75)); float a = atan(c.y, c.x);
              float s = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(a * 4.0 + r * 18.0 - uTime * 4.0);
              vec3 col = mix(uColor, vec3(1.0), s * 0.5);
              float alpha = smoothstep(0.5, 0.35, r) * (0.55 + 0.35 * s);
              col = mix(vec3(0.35), col, uOn); alpha *= mix(0.35, 1.0, uOn);
              gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha); }`,
        }),
      );
      swirl.position.set(0, 4, 0);
      grp.add(swirl);
      const label = makeLabel(p.gate ? '🌴 Island Gate' : p.region === 'plains' ? '🏠 Plaza' : `✨ ${p.name}`, { scale: 0.028, color: p.gate ? '#fff3a8' : '#ffffff' });
      label.position.set(0, 10.4, 0);
      grp.add(label);
      this.root.add(grp);
      if (!p.gate) this.portalMeshes[p.id] = { group: grp, swirl, label, portal: p };
      this.animated.push((t) => { swirl.material.uniforms.uTime.value = t; });
    }
  }

  setPortalStates(activeRegions, minPop) {
    for (const { swirl, portal, label } of Object.values(this.portalMeshes)) {
      const on = portal.region === 'plains' || activeRegions.has(portal.region);
      swirl.material.uniforms.uOn.value = on ? 1 : 0;
      if (!on && !label.userData.closed) {
        label.userData.closed = true;
        const need = minPop?.[portal.region] ?? REGION_BY_ID[portal.region].minPopulation;
        const nl = makeLabel(`🔒 ${portal.name}\nopens at ${need}+ players`, { scale: 0.024, color: '#ffd0d0' });
        nl.position.copy(label.position);
        label.parent.add(nl);
        label.visible = false;
        label.userData.closedLabel = nl;
      } else if (on && label.userData.closed) {
        label.userData.closed = false;
        label.visible = true;
        label.userData.closedLabel?.removeFromParent();
      }
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- region barriers & signs

  buildBarriers() {
    const pts = (r, a0, a1) => {
      if (a1 < a0) a1 += 360;
      const out = [];
      const n = Math.max(8, Math.round(((a1 - a0) * DEG * r) / 4));
      for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        const a = (a0 + ((a1 - a0) * i) / n) * DEG;
        out.push([Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r]);
      }
      return out;
    };
    const radial = (a, r1, r2) => {
      const out = [];
      const n = Math.round((r2 - r1) / 4);
      for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        const r = r1 + ((r2 - r1) * i) / n;
        out.push([Math.cos(a * DEG) * r, Math.sin(a * DEG) * r]);
      }
      return out;
    };
    for (const region of REGIONS) {
      const s = region.shape;
      let paths = [];
      if (s.kind === 'sector') paths = [pts(s.r1, s.a0, s.a1), pts(s.r2 - 0.5, s.a0, s.a1), radial(s.a0, s.r1, s.r2), radial(s.a1, s.r1, s.r2)];
      else if (s.kind === 'ring') paths = [pts(s.r1, 0, 360)];
      if (!paths.length) continue;
      const geos = paths.map((p) => this.curtain(p, 9));
      const mat = BARRIER_MAT.clone();
      mat.uniforms.uColor.value = new THREE.Color(0xff5a7a);
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(merge2(geos), mat);
      mesh.visible = false;
      mesh.renderOrder = 3;
      this.root.add(mesh);
      this.animated.push((t) => { mat.uniforms.uTime.value = t; });
      // signs where the roads cross into the region
      const signs = new THREE.Group();
      const roadAngles = s.kind === 'ring' ? [0, 90, 180, 270] : [((s.a0 + (s.a1 < s.a0 ? s.a1 + 360 : s.a1)) / 2) % 360];
      for (const a of roadAngles) {
        const r = (s.kind === 'ring' ? s.r1 : s.r1) - 3;
        const x = Math.cos(a * DEG) * r + Math.cos((a + 90) * DEG) * 6;
        const z = Math.sin(a * DEG) * r + Math.sin((a + 90) * DEG) * 6;
        const yy = Math.max(this.world.groundHeight(x, z), WATER_Y);
        const post = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.4, 5, 0.4), lambert(0x8a5a32, { flat: true }));
        post.position.set(x, yy + 2.5, z);
        signs.add(post);
        const lbl = makeLabel(`${region.name}\nLevel ${region.unlock.level || 1}+${region.unlock.swordTier ? ` · Tier ${region.unlock.swordTier} sword` : ''}`, {
          bg: '#2a2340', border: region.colors ? '#' + region.colors.accent.toString(16).padStart(6, '0') : '#ffffff', scale: 0.022, colors: ['#ffffff', '#ffe27a'], fog: true,
        });
        lbl.position.set(x, yy + 6, z);
        signs.add(lbl);
      }
      this.root.add(signs);
      this.barriers[region.id] = mesh;
    }
  }

  curtain(points, height) {
    const pos = [];
    const uv = [];
    const idx = [];
    points.forEach(([x, z], i) => {
      const y0 = Math.max(this.world.groundHeight(x, z), WATER_Y) - 1;
      pos.push(x, y0, z, x, y0 + height, z);
      uv.push(i / points.length, 0, i / points.length, 1);
      if (i > 0) {
        const a = (i - 1) * 2;
        idx.push(a, a + 2, a + 1, a + 1, a + 2, a + 3);
      }
    });
    const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
    geo.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv, 2));
    geo.setIndex(idx);
    return geo;
  }

  updateBarriers(progress, active) {
    for (const [id, mesh] of Object.entries(this.barriers)) {
      mesh.visible = !!regionLockReason(REGION_BY_ID[id], progress, active);
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- spots

  buildSpots() {
    // ruins puzzle plates and the carved hint
    const plateMat = lambert(0x8a8270, { flat: true });
    this.plates = {};
    for (const p of this.world.puzzle.plates) {
      const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(this.world.puzzle.plateRadius, this.world.puzzle.plateRadius + 0.3, 0.4, 16), plateMat.clone());
      m.position.set(p.x, p.y + 0.2, p.z);
      m.receiveShadow = true;
      this.root.add(m);
      const icon = { Sun: '☀', Moon: '☾', Star: '★' }[p.symbol];
      const lbl = makeLabel(icon, { font: '900 90px system-ui', scale: 0.03, color: '#ffe9a0' });
      lbl.position.set(p.x, p.y + 2.2, p.z);
      this.root.add(lbl);
      this.plates[p.id] = m;
    }
    const c = this.world.puzzle.center;
    const hint = makeLabel('☾ → ★ → ☀', { font: '900 70px system-ui', scale: 0.04, color: '#7affd8', bg: 'rgba(30,40,40,0.75)' });
    hint.position.set(c.x + 13, this.world.groundHeight(c.x, c.z) + 11.5, c.z);
    this.root.add(hint);
  }

  setPuzzleState(state, serverNow) {
    const open = state.openUntil > serverNow;
    const lit = new Set(state.progress || []);
    for (const [id, m] of Object.entries(this.plates)) {
      const on = open || lit.has(Number(id));
      m.material.emissive.setHex(on ? 0x2affc0 : 0x000000);
    }
    this.setVaultOpen(open);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the moon secret

  buildMoon() {
    const moon = this.world.moon;
    // the five small moon buttons on Cute Monster Island
    const tex = moonButtonTexture();
    const rimMat = lambert(0xf3ead2, { flat: true });
    this.moonButtons = moon.buttons.map((b) => {
      const grp = new THREE.Group();
      grp.position.set(b.x, b.y, b.z);
      const rim = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1.2, 1.35, 0.32, 20), rimMat);
      rim.position.y = 0.12;
      rim.receiveShadow = true;
      const face = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ map: tex, color: 0xfff3c4, emissive: 0x000000 });
      const top = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.98, 0.98, 0.14, 24), [rimMat, face, rimMat]);
      top.position.y = 0.32;
      top.rotation.y = b.id;
      grp.add(rim, top);
      this.root.add(grp);
      return { grp, face, top, found: false, pop: 0 };
    });

    // the secret portal (appears when all five are lit)
    const p = moon.portal;
    const portal = new THREE.Group();
    portal.position.set(p.x, p.y, p.z);
    const ring = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(3.4, 0.38, 10, 40), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xfff3c4, emissive: 0x6a7aff }));
    ring.position.y = 4.2;
    const swirl = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(3.1, 40), swirlMaterial(0x8fb8ff));
    swirl.position.y = 4.2;
    const crescent = makeLabel('☾', { font: '900 120px system-ui', scale: 0.03, color: '#fff3a8' });
    crescent.position.y = 9;
    const lbl = makeLabel('🌙 Moon Portal', { scale: 0.026, color: '#cfe0ff' });
    lbl.position.y = 10.6;
    const pad = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(3.6, 4, 0.4, 28), lambert(0xd8d2ff, { flat: true, emissive: 0x2a2a6a }));
    pad.position.y = 0.2;
    portal.add(pad, ring, swirl, crescent, lbl);
    portal.visible = false;
    this.root.add(portal);
    this.moonPortal = { group: portal, swirl, appear: 0 };
    this.animated.push((t) => {
      swirl.material.uniforms.uTime.value = t;
      ring.rotation.y = swirl.rotation.y = Math.sin(t * 0.4) * 0.6;
    });

    // the Moon Sky Arena: a giant moon, stars, clouds below and round signs
    const arena = new THREE.Group();
    const bigMoon = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(46, 32, 20), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xfff6d0, fog: false }));
    bigMoon.position.set(ARENA.cx - 90, 150, ARENA.cz - 230);
    const glow = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(58, 24, 16), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xbfc8ff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.18, fog: false, depthWrite: false }));
    glow.position.copy(bigMoon.position);
    const starPos = [];
    let seed = 7;
    const rnd = () => ((seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647) / 2147483647);
    for (let i = 0; i < 700; i++) {
      const a = rnd() * Math.PI * 2;
      const e = rnd() * 1.2 - 0.1;
      const r = 240 + rnd() * 60;
      starPos.push(ARENA.cx + Math.cos(a) * Math.cos(e) * r, 20 + Math.sin(e) * r, ARENA.cz + Math.sin(a) * Math.cos(e) * r);
    }
    const starGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    starGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(starPos, 3));
    const stars = new THREE.Points(starGeo, new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, size: 2.2, fog: false, sizeAttenuation: true }));
    const clouds = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CircleGeometry(170, 48), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x1c1846, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9, fog: false }));
    clouds.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    clouds.position.set(ARENA.cx, -13, ARENA.cz);
    arena.add(bigMoon, glow, stars, clouds);
    for (let k = 0; k < 18; k++) {
      const puff = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(10 + rnd() * 10, 10, 8), lambert(0x5a4aa8, { flat: true, emissive: 0x1a1450 }));
      const a = rnd() * Math.PI * 2;
      const r = 40 + rnd() * 110;
      puff.scale.y = 0.3;
      puff.position.set(ARENA.cx + Math.cos(a) * r, -9 + rnd() * 3, ARENA.cz + Math.sin(a) * r);
      arena.add(puff);
    }
    const s0 = moon.start;
    const startLbl = makeLabel('🌙 Moon Sky Arena\nJump across the stones!', { scale: 0.02, color: '#ffffff', bg: 'rgba(40,30,90,0.8)' });
    startLbl.position.set(s0.x, s0.y + 9, s0.z + 4);
    arena.add(startLbl);
    moon.platforms.forEach((pl, k) => {
      const r = RARITIES[moon.rounds[k]];
      const l = makeLabel(`Round ${k + 1}\n${r.name}`, { scale: 0.032, colors: ['#ffffff', r.color], bg: 'rgba(30,24,70,0.82)', border: r.color });
      l.position.set(pl.x, pl.top + 8, pl.z);
      arena.add(l);
    });
    this.root.add(arena);
    this.moonArena = arena;
  }

  // found: ids of the buttons this player has lit; portal shows at 5/5
  setMoonState(state, burst) {
    if (!this.moonButtons || !state) return;
    const found = new Set(state.found);
    for (let i = 0; i < this.moonButtons.length; i++) {
      const b = this.moonButtons[i];
      const on = found.has(i);
      if (on && !b.found && burst) b.pop = 1;
      b.found = on;
      b.face.color.setHex(on ? 0x8fc4ff : 0xfff3c4);
      b.face.emissive.setHex(on ? 0x2a6cff : 0x000000);
    }
    const open = found.size >= this.moonButtons.length;
    const g = this.moonPortal.group;
    if (open && !g.visible) {
      g.visible = true;
      this.moonPortal.appear = burst ? 0.01 : 1;
    } else if (!open) g.visible = false;
  }

  updateMoon(dt, camPos) {
    if (!this.moonButtons) return;
    for (const b of this.moonButtons) {
      if (b.pop > 0) {
        b.pop = Math.max(0, b.pop - dt * 1.6);
        b.top.position.y = 0.32 + Math.sin(b.pop * Math.PI) * 0.6;
      }
    }
    const mp = this.moonPortal;
    if (mp.group.visible && mp.appear < 1) {
      mp.appear = Math.min(1, mp.appear + dt * 0.8);
      const k = mp.appear;
      mp.group.scale.setScalar(k < 0.7 ? (k / 0.7) * 1.15 : 1.15 - ((k - 0.7) / 0.3) * 0.15);
    }
    if (camPos) this.moonArena.visible = Math.hypot(camPos.x - ARENA.cx, camPos.z - ARENA.cz) < 520;
  }

  update(dt, t, camPos) {
    this.time = t;
    this.updateMoon(dt, camPos);
    if (camPos && this.propMeshes) this.cullProps(camPos);
    for (const fn of this.animated) fn(t);
    if (this.lavaMat) this.lavaMat.emissiveIntensity = 1.2 + Math.sin(t * 2) * 0.3;
  }
}

// Studded toy-brick texture (grey, tinted by the material colour).
let studTex = null;
const studMats = new Map();
function studMaterial(color) {
  if (!studTex) {
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = c.height = 64;
    const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
    ctx.fillStyle = '#d4d4d4';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#b8b8b8'; // seams between bricks
    ctx.fillRect(0, 62, 64, 2);
    ctx.fillRect(62, 0, 2, 64);
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(28, 28, 2, 32, 32, 17);
    g.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff');
    g.addColorStop(0.7, '#e2e2e2');
    g.addColorStop(1, '#9a9a9a');
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(32, 32, 16, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    studTex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
    studTex.wrapS = studTex.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
    studTex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    studTex.anisotropy = 4;
  }
  if (!studMats.has(color)) studMats.set(color, new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color, map: studTex }));
  return studMats.get(color);
}

// Box-projected UVs from world positions, so the stud pattern has the same
// size on every wall, floor and step however the boxes are scaled.
function boxUV(geo, size) {
  const pos = geo.attributes.position;
  const nor = geo.attributes.normal;
  const uv = new Float32Array(pos.count * 2);
  for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
    const ax = Math.abs(nor.getX(i));
    const ay = Math.abs(nor.getY(i));
    const az = Math.abs(nor.getZ(i));
    let a;
    let b;
    if (ay >= ax && ay >= az) {
      a = pos.getX(i);
      b = pos.getZ(i);
    } else if (ax >= az) {
      a = pos.getZ(i);
      b = pos.getY(i);
    } else {
      a = pos.getX(i);
      b = pos.getY(i);
    }
    uv[i * 2] = a / size;
    uv[i * 2 + 1] = b / size;
  }
  geo.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.BufferAttribute(uv, 2));
}

// A small round button face with a crescent moon on it.
let moonTex = null;
function moonButtonTexture() {
  if (moonTex) return moonTex;
  const c = document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = c.height = 128;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e8e2ff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(64, 64, 60, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd84a';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(64, 64, 38, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e8e2ff'; // bite out of the full moon -> a crescent
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(80, 52, 32, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe98a';
  for (const [x, y, r] of [[92, 88, 5], [100, 66, 3], [38, 30, 3]]) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  moonTex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  moonTex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  return moonTex;
}

function swirlMaterial(hex) {
  return new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    transparent: true,
    side: THREE.DoubleSide,
    depthWrite: false,
    uniforms: { uTime: { value: 0 }, uColor: { value: new THREE.Color(hex) } },
    vertexShader: 'varying vec2 vUv; void main(){ vUv = uv; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }',
    fragmentShader: `uniform float uTime; uniform vec3 uColor; varying vec2 vUv;
      void main(){ vec2 c = vUv - 0.5; float r = length(c); float a = atan(c.y, c.x);
        float s = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(a * 5.0 + r * 22.0 - uTime * 5.0);
        vec3 col = mix(uColor, vec3(1.0, 0.97, 0.8), s * 0.55);
        float alpha = smoothstep(0.5, 0.3, r) * (0.6 + 0.35 * s);
        gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha); }`,
  });
}

function regionOf(p) {
  return regionIdAt(p.x, p.z);
}

function merge2(geos) {
  return mergeGeometries(geos, false);
}

export { RING };

/* STEAL A MONSTER — chunky, bright, readable UI */
:root {
  --ink: #241640;
  --ink-2: #3b2a63;
  --paper: #fff8ec;
  --purple: #6b3fd8;
  --pink: #ff5aa5;
  --yellow: #ffd93a;
  --green: #5fd35a;
  --red: #ff4a5e;
  --blue: #3fa6ff;
  --panel: #fffaf2;
  --shadow: 0 5px 0 rgba(36, 22, 64, 0.35);
  --font: "Trebuchet MS", "Arial Rounded MT Bold", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  color-scheme: light;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: #8fd0ff; font-family: var(--font); color: var(--ink); -webkit-user-select: none; user-select: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
canvas#game { position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; outline: none; touch-action: none; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
button { font-family: var(--font); }
.muted { color: #6a5a8a; }
.small { font-size: 13px; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- buttons */
.btn { font: 800 16px var(--font); color: var(--ink); background: var(--yellow); border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 14px; padding: 9px 18px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: var(--shadow); transition: transform .08s, filter .1s; }
.btn:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.btn:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(36,22,64,.35); }
.btn:disabled { filter: grayscale(.8) brightness(.95); cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }
.btn.go { background: var(--green); color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.25); }
.btn.pink { background: var(--pink); color: #fff; }
.btn.blue { background: var(--blue); color: #fff; }
.btn.red { background: var(--red); color: #fff; }
.btn.ghost { background: #fff; }
.btn.big { font-size: 26px; padding: 12px 34px; border-radius: 18px; }
.btn.icon { padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 18px; }
.btn.sm { font-size: 13px; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(36,22,64,.35); }
.linkish { background: none; border: 0; color: var(--purple); font: 700 15px var(--font); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline; }
kbd { display: inline-block; min-width: 22px; padding: 1px 6px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-bottom-width: 4px; border-radius: 7px; background: #fff; font: 800 13px var(--font); text-align: center; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- title */
.screen { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: grid; z-index: 30; padding: 16px; overflow-y: auto; }
.screen > .title-card { margin: auto; } /* centered, but scrolls instead of clipping on short screens */
.title-bg { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, #ffe9a8 0%, #ff9fd2 35%, #8a6bff 75%, #4a2fa8 100%); }
.title-bg::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.35) 2px, transparent 2.5px); background-size: 34px 34px; animation: drift 12s linear infinite; }
@keyframes drift { to { background-position: 34px 68px; } }
.title-card { position: relative; background: var(--panel); border: 4px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 26px; padding: 26px 30px; width: min(440px, 100%); text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 10px 0 rgba(36,22,64,.4); }
.title-card.small { width: min(380px, 100%); }
#loading .title-card, #disconnected .title-card { z-index: 1; }
#loading { background: rgba(36, 22, 64, .55); }
#disconnected { background: rgba(36, 22, 64, .7); }
.logo { margin: 0 0 4px; font: 900 46px/1 var(--font); letter-spacing: 1px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 2px 12px; }
.logo span { color: var(--yellow); -webkit-text-stroke: 3px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke fill; text-shadow: 0 5px 0 var(--ink); transform: rotate(-3deg); display: inline-block; }
.logo span:nth-child(3) { color: var(--green); transform: rotate(2deg); }
.logo .a { color: var(--pink); font-size: 34px; transform: rotate(8deg) translateY(4px); }
.tagline { margin: 6px 0 18px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-2); }
.field { display: block; text-align: left; font-weight: 800; margin: 12px 0; }
.field input { display: block; width: 100%; margin-top: 6px; font: 700 18px var(--font); padding: 10px 12px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); }
.swatches { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px; margin-top: 6px; }
.swatches button { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 10px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); cursor: pointer; }
.swatches button.on { outline: 4px solid var(--purple); outline-offset: 1px; }
#play-btn { margin-top: 10px; width: 100%; }
.title-links { display: flex; gap: 18px; justify-content: center; margin-top: 10px; }
.title-links a { color: var(--purple); font-weight: 700; }
.bar { height: 18px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; overflow: hidden; margin: 12px 0; }
.bar > div { height: 100%; width: 0; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--green), var(--yellow)); transition: width .2s; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- HUD */
#hud { position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 10; }
#hud button, #hud input, #hud form, #offers *, #quest button { pointer-events: auto; }
#profile-card { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 12px; width: 236px; background: rgba(255, 250, 242, .94); border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 18px; padding: 10px 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
.pc-row { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; }
.badge { width: 42px; height: 42px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--purple); color: #fff; font: 900 20px var(--font); border: 3px solid var(--ink); flex: none; }
.pc-name-wrap { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
#pc-name { font: 900 17px var(--font); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.xp { height: 9px; border-radius: 6px; background: #e8dcff; border: 2px solid var(--ink); overflow: hidden; margin-top: 3px; }
#xp-fill { height: 100%; width: 0; background: var(--purple); transition: width .3s; }
.hp { position: relative; height: 22px; border-radius: 10px; background: #ffd4d8; border: 3px solid var(--ink); overflow: hidden; margin: 8px 0 6px; }
#hp-fill { height: 100%; width: 100%; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #7ef06a, #3fb83a); transition: width .15s; }
#hp-fill.low { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff8a8a, #e83a4a); }
#hp-text { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; font: 900 13px var(--font); color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 0 3px #000, 0 1px 0 #000; }
.money { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 900 26px var(--font); color: #2a8a2a; -webkit-text-stroke: 1px #fff; }
.money.bump { animation: bump .35s; }
@keyframes bump { 40% { transform: scale(1.15); } }
.coin { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--yellow); border: 3px solid #b8860b; color: #8a5a00; font-size: 16px; -webkit-text-stroke: 0; }
.pc-stats { font: 700 13px var(--font); color: var(--ink-2); }
.gems { margin-left: auto; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; font: 900 16px var(--font); color: #b03ad8; -webkit-text-stroke: 0; background: #f6e6ff; border: 2px solid #c88af0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 1px 7px; }
.gem-price { color: #b03ad8; font-weight: 900; }
.floor-title { margin: 12px 0 6px; font: 900 15px var(--font); color: var(--ink); }
.floor-title small { font: 700 12px var(--font); color: var(--ink-2); margin-left: 6px; }
.decor-spots { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr)); gap: 6px 10px; margin: 6px 0 12px; }
.decor-spot { display: flex; flex-direction: column; font: 800 12px var(--font); color: var(--ink-2); }
.decor-spot select { font: 700 14px var(--font); padding: 5px 6px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); }
.decor-spot select:disabled { opacity: .6; }

#topright { position: absolute; right: 12px; top: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 6px; }
#minimap { width: 180px; height: 180px; border-radius: 50%; border: 4px solid var(--ink); background: #2a6a3a; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
#region-label { font: 900 14px var(--font); background: var(--ink); color: #fff; padding: 3px 12px; border-radius: 10px; max-width: 220px; text-align: center; }
#side-buttons { display: flex; gap: 5px; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-end; max-width: 240px; }
#side-buttons button { pointer-events: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.1; padding: 4px 6px; min-width: 46px; background: #fff; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(36,22,64,.35); cursor: pointer; }
#side-buttons button span { font: 800 10px var(--font); }
#side-buttons button:active { transform: translateY(2px); }

#event-banner { position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); padding: 8px 22px; border-radius: 18px; border: 4px solid var(--ink); font: 900 22px var(--font); color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.35); background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff5aa5, #ffd93a, #5fd35a, #3fa6ff, #b48cff, #ff5aa5); background-size: 300% 100%; animation: rainbow 3s linear infinite; box-shadow: var(--shadow); white-space: nowrap; }
#event-banner.soon { background: var(--ink); animation: none; }
@keyframes rainbow { to { background-position: 300% 0; } }
#region-banner { position: absolute; top: 18%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); text-align: center; animation: fadeInOut 3.6s forwards; }
#region-banner b { display: block; font: 900 40px var(--font); color: #fff; -webkit-text-stroke: 2px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke fill; text-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--ink); }
#region-banner i { font: 700 16px var(--font); color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px #000; font-style: normal; }
@keyframes fadeInOut { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(-50%, 10px); } 12%, 75% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, 0); } 100% { opacity: 0; } }
#theft-alert { position: absolute; top: 74px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: var(--red); color: #fff; border: 4px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 20px; font: 900 20px var(--font); animation: pulse .6s infinite alternate; box-shadow: var(--shadow); text-align: center; }
@keyframes pulse { to { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1.05); } }
#announce { position: absolute; top: 130px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; align-items: center; width: min(560px, 90vw); }
#announce div { background: rgba(36,22,64,.82); color: #fff; padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 12px; font: 800 15px var(--font); text-align: center; animation: fadeInOut 5s forwards; }
#announce div.rare { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #c46bff, #ffb12a); }
#announce div.theft { background: #d8384a; }
#announce div.lucky { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff5aa5, #ffb12a); }
#toasts { position: absolute; bottom: 92px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); display: flex; flex-direction: column-reverse; gap: 6px; align-items: center; width: min(520px, 92vw); }
.toast { background: #fff; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 14px; padding: 7px 16px; font: 800 15px var(--font); box-shadow: var(--shadow); animation: toast 3.6s forwards; text-align: center; }
.toast.good { background: #e3ffd8; }
.toast.bad { background: #ffe0e3; }
.toast.warn { background: #fff3c2; }
@keyframes toast { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px) scale(.95); } 8%, 82% { opacity: 1; transform: none; } 100% { opacity: 0; } }

#quest { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 210px; width: 236px; background: rgba(255,250,242,.94); border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); font: 700 14px var(--font); }
#quest h3 { margin: 0 0 4px; font: 900 15px var(--font); color: var(--purple); }
#quest .steps { display: flex; gap: 3px; margin-top: 6px; }
#quest .steps i { flex: 1; height: 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: #e8dcff; }
#quest .steps i.done { background: var(--green); }
#quest button { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 11px; }
#status-fx { position: absolute; left: 12px; bottom: 120px; display: flex; gap: 6px; }
#status-fx span { background: #fff; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 12px; padding: 3px 8px; font: 800 13px var(--font); }
#prompt { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 56%; transform: translateX(-50%); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: rgba(255,250,242,.95); border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 16px; padding: 8px 14px; font: 800 17px var(--font); box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
#prompt .key { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 9px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-bottom-width: 5px; background: var(--yellow); font: 900 16px var(--font); }
#prompt .ring { width: 70px; height: 10px; border-radius: 6px; background: #e8dcff; overflow: hidden; display: none; }
#prompt.holding .ring { display: block; }
#prompt-progress { height: 100%; width: 0; background: var(--red); }
#debug { position: absolute; left: 260px; top: 12px; margin: 0; padding: 6px 10px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.6); color: #9fff9f; font: 12px ui-monospace, monospace; border-radius: 8px; white-space: pre; }
#base-marker { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; pointer-events: none; font: 900 14px var(--font); color: #fff; background: rgba(36,22,64,.78); border: 2px solid #3fbf5a; border-radius: 12px; padding: 3px 9px; white-space: nowrap; will-change: transform; }
#base-marker .bm-arrow { display: inline-block; color: #7ef06a; font-size: 15px; }
#base-marker .bm-arrow[hidden] { display: none; }
#goal-marker { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; pointer-events: none; font: 900 15px var(--font); color: #fff; background: rgba(44,36,110,.85); border: 2px solid #8fb8ff; border-radius: 12px; padding: 3px 10px; white-space: nowrap; will-change: transform; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(143,184,255,.7); }
#goal-marker .bm-arrow { display: inline-block; color: #bfe0ff; font-size: 17px; }
#goal-marker .bm-arrow[hidden] { display: none; }
.row-item.costume .costume-pics { display: flex; gap: 4px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.costume-pic { width: 84px; height: 84px; border-radius: 12px; background: #e8e2ff; border: 2px solid var(--ink); }
.costume-pic.night { background: #0c0c24; }
.btn.gold { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffe27a, #f3a934); color: var(--ink); }
.btn-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; align-items: stretch; flex-shrink: 0; }
.legend-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.legend-card { border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 14px; padding: 8px; text-align: center; background: #fffaf0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; align-items: center; }
.legend-card img { width: 120px; height: 120px; border-radius: 12px; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--glow) 0%, #1a1240 75%); }
.legend-card.on { box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--glow), 0 0 18px var(--glow); }
.legend-card h4 { margin: 2px 0 0; }
.legend-card .sub { font-size: 12px; }
.power-bar { display: flex; gap: 4px; margin: 8px 0; }
.power-bar i { flex: 1; height: 14px; border-radius: 6px; background: #e8dcff; border: 2px solid var(--ink); }
.power-bar i.on { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #8a4ad8, #5ff3ff); }
.power-list { flex-wrap: wrap; }
.account-box { margin-bottom: 6px; }
.account-in { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; background: #efe6ff; border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 800 15px var(--font); }
.acct-tabs { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.acct-tabs button { flex: 1; font: 800 14px var(--font); padding: 6px; border-radius: 10px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); background: #fff; cursor: pointer; }
.acct-tabs button.on { background: var(--yellow); }
#account-btn { width: 100%; margin-top: 4px; }
#noacct-btn { display: block; margin: 6px auto 0; }
#progress-choice .btn { display: block; width: 100%; margin-top: 10px; }
#pc-cancel { display: block; margin: 10px auto 0; }
.admin-row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 10px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 8px; background: #fff; }
.admin-row .who { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; font: 800 15px var(--font); }
.admin-row .stolen { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; background: #ffeef0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 6px 8px; font: 700 13px var(--font); }
#moon-hud { margin-top: 4px; background: rgba(36,28,90,.85); color: #fff; border: 2px solid #8fb8ff; border-radius: 10px; padding: 3px 8px; font: 800 12px var(--font); text-align: center; pointer-events: none; }
#crosshair { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin: -4px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ink); opacity: .7; display: none; }
.mouselook #crosshair { display: block; }

#bottom-bar { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 12px; transform: translateX(-50%); display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 12px; }
#quick { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.quick-btn { pointer-events: auto; font: 800 14px var(--font); background: #fff; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 12px; padding: 5px 10px; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(36,22,64,.35); cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; min-width: 98px; text-align: left; }
.quick-btn b { display: inline-block; background: var(--ink); color: #fff; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 5px; margin-right: 3px; }
.quick-btn.locked { background: #ffe0e3; }
.quick-btn.on { background: #d8ffd0; }
#hotbar { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
.slot { pointer-events: auto; position: relative; width: 58px; height: 58px; border-radius: 14px; background: rgba(255,250,242,.94); border: 3px solid var(--ink); display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 26px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(36,22,64,.35); overflow: hidden; }
.slot.empty { opacity: .45; }
.slot .n { position: absolute; left: 4px; top: 1px; font: 900 11px var(--font); color: var(--ink-2); }
.slot .c { position: absolute; right: 4px; bottom: 1px; font: 900 13px var(--font); color: var(--ink); }
.slot .cd { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: rgba(36,22,64,.55); }
.slot.sword { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff3c2, #ffe08a); width: 64px; }

#offers { position: absolute; right: 12px; top: 300px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; width: 290px; max-height: calc(100vh - 312px); overflow-y: auto; }
.offer { background: var(--panel); border: 4px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 20px; padding: 10px 12px 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); animation: slideIn .3s; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
@keyframes slideIn { from { transform: translateX(40px); opacity: 0; } }
.offer h3 { margin: 0; font: 900 20px var(--font); }
.offer .rar { font: 900 12px var(--font); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; }
.offer canvas { width: 100%; height: 130px; display: block; border-radius: 14px; background: radial-gradient(circle, #fff 0%, #e8dcff 100%); margin: 6px 0; }
.offer .stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 2px 10px; font: 700 13px var(--font); }
.offer .perk { font: 700 13px var(--font); color: var(--purple); margin: 4px 0; }
.offer .price { font: 900 18px var(--font); margin: 6px 0; }
.offer .row { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.offer .row .btn { flex: 1; padding: 8px 6px; }
.offer .timer { position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; height: 5px; background: var(--pink); }
.offer .note { font: 700 12px var(--font); color: #c0303a; }
.offer .req { font: 800 12px var(--font); color: var(--purple); background: #f1e9ff; border-radius: 8px; padding: 3px 7px; margin: 2px 0 4px; }
.offer.mini .req { display: none; }
.offer.mini { padding: 6px 10px 9px; border-radius: 14px; border-width: 3px; animation: none; }
.offer.mini canvas, .offer.mini .stats, .offer.mini .perk, .offer.mini .rar { display: none; }
.offer.mini h3 { font-size: 15px; }
.offer.mini .price { margin: 2px 0 4px; font-size: 14px; }
.offer.mini .note { font-size: 11px; }
.offer.mini .row .btn { padding: 4px 6px; font-size: 13px; }

#chat { position: absolute; left: 12px; bottom: 90px; width: min(380px, 60vw); }
#chat-log { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; font: 700 14px var(--font); color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px #000, 0 0 2px #000; max-height: 160px; overflow: hidden; }
#chat-log div { animation: fadeChat 12s forwards; }
#chat.open #chat-log div { animation: none; opacity: 1; }
@keyframes fadeChat { 85% { opacity: 1; } 100% { opacity: 0; } }
#chat-input { width: 100%; font: 700 15px var(--font); padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 10px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); margin-top: 4px; }
#dead { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; background: rgba(120, 20, 40, .35); }

/* damage numbers & world labels */
.dmg { position: fixed; pointer-events: none; font: 900 22px var(--font); color: #fff; -webkit-text-stroke: 2px var(--ink); paint-order: stroke fill; z-index: 11; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); animation: dmg 0.9s forwards; white-space: nowrap; }
.dmg.crit { color: var(--yellow); font-size: 30px; }
.dmg.player { color: #ff6a7a; }
.screen-flash { position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 9; opacity: 0; mix-blend-mode: screen; }
.dmg.heal { color: #7ef06a; }
.dmg.money { color: #7ef06a; font-size: 20px; }
.dmg.dodge { color: #8fd8ff; font-size: 18px; }
@keyframes dmg { 0% { opacity: 0; margin-top: 0; } 10% { opacity: 1; } 100% { opacity: 0; margin-top: -60px; } }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- panels */
#panel-wrap { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 20; display: grid; place-items: center; background: rgba(36,22,64,.45); padding: 12px; }
#panel { width: min(860px, 100%); max-height: min(88vh, 760px); display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--panel); border: 4px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 24px; box-shadow: 0 10px 0 rgba(36,22,64,.4); overflow: hidden; }
.panel-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 12px 16px; background: var(--purple); color: #fff; border-bottom: 4px solid var(--ink); }
.panel-head h2 { margin: 0; font: 900 24px var(--font); text-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.3); }
#panel-body { padding: 14px 16px 18px; overflow: auto; -webkit-user-select: text; user-select: text; }
.tabs { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.tabs button { font: 800 14px var(--font); border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 12px; padding: 6px 12px; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; }
.tabs button.on { background: var(--yellow); }
.tabs button small { font-weight: 700; opacity: .7; }
.island-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 30px; }
.grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.card { position: relative; background: #fff; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(36,22,64,.3); transition: transform .08s; }
.card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
.card .icon { height: 74px; border-radius: 12px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 38px; margin-bottom: 6px; overflow: hidden; }
.card .icon img { width: 74px; height: 74px; object-fit: contain; }
.card h4 { margin: 0; font: 900 16px var(--font); }
.card .sub { font: 700 12px var(--font); color: #6a5a8a; }
.card .tag { position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 6px; font: 900 10px var(--font); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--ink); color: #fff; }
.card.locked { opacity: .6; }
.card.unknown .icon img { filter: brightness(0) opacity(.6); }
.row-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #fff; border: 3px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 12px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.row-item .icon { width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 12px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 30px; flex: none; }
.row-item .info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.row-item h4 { margin: 0; font: 900 17px var(--font); }
.row-item p { margin: 2px 0 0; font: 600 13px var(--font); color: #5a4a7a; }
.row-item .meta { font: 800 13px var(--font); }
.row-item.owned { background: #e9ffe3; }
.row-item.equipped { outline: 4px solid var(--green); }
.stats-row { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; font: 800 13px var(--font); margin-top: 3px; }
.stats-row span { background: #f1e9ff; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 8px; }
.inspect { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(220px, 1fr) 1fr; gap: 14px; }
.inspect canvas { width: 100%; height: 300px; border-radius: 18px; border: 3px solid var(--ink); background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, #fff, #d8c8ff); touch-action: none; }
.inspect .desc { font: 600 14px var(--font); color: var(--ink-2); }
.inspect .acts { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 10px; }
.kv { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 3px 12px; font: 700 14px var(--font); margin: 8px 0; }
.kv b { color: #6a5a8a; font-weight: 700; }
#map-canvas { width: min(100%, 720px, calc(min(88vh, 760px) - 150px)); aspect-ratio: 1; display: block; margin: 0 auto; border-radius: 20px; border: 4px solid var(--ink); background: #1e3a5a; }
.settings-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 12px 16px; align-items: center; font-weight: 800; }
.settings-grid select, .settings-grid input[type=range] { font: 700 15px var(--font); width: 100%; }
.help-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font: 700 14px var(--font); }
.help-table td { padding: 5px 6px; border-bottom: 2px dashed #e0d4f5; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- touch */
#touch-ui { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
#touch-ui > * { pointer-events: auto; }
.tc-look { position: absolute; right: 0; top: 0; width: 60%; height: 100%; }
.tc-stick-zone { position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 40%; height: 60%; }
.tc-stick { position: absolute; left: 40px; bottom: 50px; top: auto; width: 120px; height: 120px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,.25); border: 3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7); }
.tc-stick.on { bottom: auto; }
.tc-knob { position: absolute; left: 35px; top: 35px; width: 50px; height: 50px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,.85); border: 3px solid var(--ink); }
.tc-buttons { position: absolute; right: 18px; bottom: 96px; width: 190px; height: 190px; pointer-events: none; }
.tc-btn { pointer-events: auto; position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; border: 4px solid var(--ink); background: rgba(255,250,242,.9); font: 900 22px var(--font); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 rgba(36,22,64,.35); }
.tc-btn.down { transform: translateY(3px); background: var(--yellow); }
.tc-attack { right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 92px; height: 92px; font-size: 38px; background: rgba(255,90,120,.9); }
.tc-jump { right: 100px; bottom: 0; width: 64px; height: 64px; }
.tc-dodge { right: 0; bottom: 100px; width: 64px; height: 64px; }
.tc-interact { right: 92px; bottom: 82px; width: 60px; height: 60px; background: rgba(255,217,58,.95); }
.tc-power { right: 4px; bottom: 176px; width: 56px; height: 56px; background: rgba(28,28,40,.92); border-color: #5ff3ff; }

FILE: scripts/build-firebase.mjs

// Bundles the parts of the Firebase JS SDK the game uses (app, Realtime
// Database for rooms and accounts, Authentication for log-in) into one ES module, public/vendor/firebase.js, so the
// game does not depend on a CDN. Re-run after updating the firebase package:
//   node scripts/build-firebase.mjs
import { build } from 'esbuild';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const entry = `
export { initializeApp } from 'firebase/app';
export {
  getDatabase, connectDatabaseEmulator, ref, child, set, update, push, remove, get,
  onChildAdded, onChildRemoved, onValue, onDisconnect, serverTimestamp,
} from 'firebase/database';
export {
  initializeAuth, indexedDBLocalPersistence, browserLocalPersistence, connectAuthEmulator,
  createUserWithEmailAndPassword, signInWithEmailAndPassword, signOut, onAuthStateChanged,
} from 'firebase/auth';
`;
await build({
  stdin: { contents: entry, resolveDir: root, loader: 'js' },
  bundle: true,
  format: 'esm',
  minify: true,
  target: 'es2020',
  platform: 'browser',
  legalComments: 'eof',
  outfile: path.join(root, 'public/vendor/firebase.js'),
});
const version = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'node_modules/firebase/package.json'), 'utf8')).version;
const out = path.join(root, 'public/vendor/firebase.js');
fs.writeFileSync(out, `/* Firebase JS SDK ${version} (app + database + auth), bundled by scripts/build-firebase.mjs. Apache-2.0 */\n` + fs.readFileSync(out, 'utf8'));
console.log(`public/vendor/firebase.js: Firebase ${version}, ${(fs.statSync(out).size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB`);

FILE: scripts/build-handoff-html.mjs

// Builds ONE html file with everything another AI needs to continue the
// game: AI-HANDOFF.md and the other docs first, then every source file as
// plain text (no zip needed). Open it in a browser to read it, or upload it
// to an AI chat. The web build also publishes it as source.html.
//   node scripts/build-handoff-html.mjs [out=steal-a-monster-for-ai.html]
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const out = path.resolve(root, process.argv[2] || 'steal-a-monster-for-ai.html');

// the files in git (or, without git, everything under the folder)
function listFiles() {
  try {
    return execFileSync('git', ['ls-files'], { cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8' }).split('\n').filter(Boolean);
  } catch {
    const all = [];
    const walk = (dir) => {
      for (const f of fs.readdirSync(path.join(root, dir))) {
        const p = dir ? `${dir}/${f}` : f;
        if (['node_modules', 'dist-web', 'data', 'test-results', '.git'].includes(f)) continue;
        if (fs.statSync(path.join(root, p)).isDirectory()) walk(p);
        else all.push(p);
      }
    };
    walk('');
    return all;
  }
}

const TEXT = /\.(js|mjs|json|md|html|css|yml|yaml|txt)$|(^|\/)\.gitignore$/;
const SKIP = [/^public\/vendor\//, /package-lock\.json$/, /^docs\/screenshots\//, /^steal-a-monster-for-ai\.html$/];
const FIRST = ['AI-HANDOFF.md', 'AGENTS.md', 'README.md', 'TESTING.md', 'PANDUAN-FIREBASE.md', 'package.json', 'firebase-database.rules.json', 'firebase.json'];
const files = listFiles().filter((f) => TEXT.test(f) && !SKIP.some((r) => r.test(f)) && f !== 'CLAUDE.md');
files.sort((a, b) => {
  const ia = FIRST.indexOf(a);
  const ib = FIRST.indexOf(b);
  if (ia !== -1 || ib !== -1) return (ia === -1 ? 99 : ia) - (ib === -1 ? 99 : ib);
  return a.localeCompare(b);
});
// the workflow that publishes the website lives outside this folder
const workflow = path.join(root, '..', '.github', 'workflows', 'steal-a-monster-pages.yml');
const extra = fs.existsSync(workflow) ? [['../.github/workflows/steal-a-monster-pages.yml', fs.readFileSync(workflow, 'utf8')]] : [];

const esc = (s) => s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
const anchor = (f) => `f-${f.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]+/g, '-')}`;
let commit = 'unknown';
try {
  commit = execFileSync('git', ['log', '-1', '--format=%h %cs %s'], { cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();
} catch { /* not a git checkout */ }

const entries = [...files.map((f) => [f, fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, f), 'utf8')]), ...extra];
const totalLines = entries.reduce((n, [, t]) => n + t.split('\n').length, 0);
const toc = entries.map(([f, t]) => `<li><a href="#${anchor(f)}">${esc(f)}</a> <small>${t.split('\n').length} lines</small></li>`).join('\n');
const body = entries.map(([f, t]) => `<section id="${anchor(f)}">
<h2>FILE: ${esc(f)}</h2>
<pre><code>${esc(t)}</code></pre>
</section>`).join('\n');

const html = `<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Steal a Monster source</title>
<style>
  :root { --bg: #fbfaf7; --fg: #1d1b26; --muted: #6b6878; --line: #e3dfd6; --code: #f2efe8; --accent: #7a3fd8; }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root { --bg: #16151c; --fg: #ecebf2; --muted: #a09db0; --line: #2e2c38; --code: #1f1d27; --accent: #b48cff; } }
  body { margin: 0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg); font: 15px/1.55 system-ui, sans-serif; }
  main { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px 16px 80px; }
  h1 { margin: 0 0 4px; } h2 { font-size: 16px; margin: 32px 0 8px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 2px solid var(--line); color: var(--accent); }
  #dl { font: 700 18px system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 12px 22px; border-radius: 12px; border: 0; background: var(--accent); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; }
  .note { background: var(--code); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 16px; margin: 16px 0; }
  pre { background: var(--code); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px; overflow-x: auto; font: 12.5px/1.45 ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; white-space: pre; }
  a { color: var(--accent); } small { color: var(--muted); }
  ol { columns: 2; column-gap: 32px; font-size: 13px; } @media (max-width: 700px) { ol { columns: 1; } }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main>
<h1>STEAL A MONSTER — full source for AI</h1>
<p><button id="dl" type="button">⬇ Download this file</button> <small>(simpan sebagai <b>steal-a-monster-for-ai.html</b>, lalu upload ke AI lain)</small></p>
<p><small>Version: ${esc(commit)} · ${entries.length} files · ${totalLines.toLocaleString('en-US')} lines</small></p>
<div class="note">
<p><b>To the AI reading this:</b> this one file contains the whole game: <code>AI-HANDOFF.md</code> (read it first: what the game is, how it is built and tested, the rules for changing it, the Firebase setup and the current state), the other docs, and every source file of the <code>steal-a-monster/</code> folder as plain text, each under a heading <code>FILE: path</code>. When you change the game, give back complete files with their paths, and update <code>AI-HANDOFF.md</code> (Current state + Change log). Not included: the bundled Firebase SDK (<code>public/vendor/firebase.js</code>, rebuilt with <code>node scripts/build-firebase.mjs</code>), <code>package-lock.json</code> and screenshots.</p>
<p><b>Untuk pemilik game:</b> upload file ini ke AI lain, lalu tulis permintaanmu. Bilang: <i>"Baca AI-HANDOFF.md di dalam file ini dulu. Setelah selesai, berikan file lengkap yang diubah beserta path-nya, dan perbarui AI-HANDOFF.md."</i> Versi terbaru file ini selalu ada di https://kenshirodaniel8-bit.github.io/minecraft-realistis/source.html (tekan tombol <b>⬇ Download this file</b> di atas), atau di layar awal game: <b>⬇ Download game for AI</b>.</p>
</div>
<h2>Files</h2>
<ol>
${toc}
</ol>
${body}
</main>
<script>
// saves this very page as a file (works on phones too)
document.getElementById('dl').onclick = async () => {
  const name = 'steal-a-monster-for-ai.html';
  let url;
  try {
    const blob = new Blob(['<!doctype html>' + document.documentElement.outerHTML], { type: 'text/html' });
    url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  } catch {
    url = location.href;
  }
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = name;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
};
</script>
</body>
</html>
`;
fs.writeFileSync(out, html);
console.log(`handoff html: ${entries.length} files, ${totalLines} lines, ${(html.length / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB -> ${path.relative(process.cwd(), out)}`);

FILE: scripts/build-web.mjs

// Builds the single-player web version: a folder of static files that runs
// the whole game (including the game server logic) in the browser. Host it
// anywhere that serves static files, e.g. GitHub Pages.
//   node scripts/build-web.mjs [outDir=dist-web]
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const out = path.resolve(root, process.argv[2] || 'dist-web');
fs.rmSync(out, { recursive: true, force: true });
fs.mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });

const copy = (from, to) => {
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.join(out, to)), { recursive: true });
  fs.copyFileSync(path.join(root, from), path.join(out, to));
};
const copyDir = (from, to, filter = () => true) => {
  for (const f of fs.readdirSync(path.join(root, from))) {
    const p = path.join(from, f);
    if (fs.statSync(path.join(root, p)).isDirectory()) copyDir(p, path.join(to, f), filter);
    else if (filter(f)) copy(p, path.join(to, f));
  }
};

// client, shared code and the game server logic (no Node networking/storage)
copyDir('public/client', 'client');
copyDir('shared', 'shared');
copy('public/style.css', 'style.css');
// online rooms: the Firebase config and the bundled Firebase SDK
copy('public/firebase-config.js', 'firebase-config.js');
copyDir('public/vendor', 'vendor');
for (const f of ['game.js', 'validate.js', 'rateLimit.js']) copy(`server/${f}`, `server/${f}`);
copyDir('server/services', 'server/services');
// three.js and the two addons the game uses
const three = 'node_modules/three';
copy(`${three}/build/three.module.js`, 'lib/three/three.module.js');
copy(`${three}/build/three.core.js`, 'lib/three/three.core.js');
copy(`${three}/examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js`, 'lib/three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js');
copy(`${three}/examples/jsm/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js`, 'lib/three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js');
copy(`${three}/LICENSE`, 'lib/three/LICENSE');

// pages: relative import map (works in any sub-folder) + single-player flag
const importMap = JSON.stringify({
  imports: {
    three: './lib/three/three.module.js',
    'three/addons/': './lib/three/addons/',
    '#shared/': './shared/',
    '#server/': './server/',
  },
}, null, 2);
for (const page of ['index.html', 'gallery.html']) {
  let html = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'public', page), 'utf8');
  html = html.replace(/<script type="importmap">[\s\S]*?<\/script>/, `<script type="importmap">\n${importMap}\n</script>`);
  if (page === 'index.html') html = html.replace('<script type="module"', '<script>window.SAM_SOLO = true;</script>\n  <script type="module"');
  // a download link for the one-file source (for other AIs), web build only
  if (page === 'index.html') html = html.replace('<button id="controls-btn"', '<a href="source.html" download="steal-a-monster-for-ai.html">⬇ Download game for AI</a>\n        <button id="controls-btn"');
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, page), html);
}
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, '.nojekyll'), '');

// sanity checks: no absolute imports left that a static host can't serve
const bad = [];
const walk = (dir) => {
  for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir)) {
    const p = path.join(dir, f);
    if (fs.statSync(p).isDirectory()) walk(p);
    else if (p.endsWith('.js') && !p.includes(`${path.sep}lib${path.sep}`) && !p.includes(`${path.sep}vendor${path.sep}`)) {
      const src = fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8');
      for (const m of src.matchAll(/^import [^;]*? from '([^']+)'/gm)) {
        const spec = m[1];
        if (spec.startsWith('node:') || (!spec.startsWith('.') && !spec.startsWith('#') && !spec.startsWith('three'))) bad.push(`${path.relative(out, p)}: ${spec}`);
      }
    }
  }
};
walk(out);
if (bad.length) {
  console.error('Imports a static site cannot load:\n  ' + bad.join('\n  '));
  process.exit(1);
}
// the whole source in one html page for other AIs (source.html)
execFileSync(process.execPath, [path.join(root, 'scripts', 'build-handoff-html.mjs'), path.join(out, 'source.html')], { stdio: 'ignore' });

let files = 0;
let bytes = 0;
const count = (dir) => {
  for (const f of fs.readdirSync(dir)) {
    const p = path.join(dir, f);
    if (fs.statSync(p).isDirectory()) count(p);
    else {
      files++;
      bytes += fs.statSync(p).size;
    }
  }
};
count(out);
console.log(`web build: ${files} files, ${(bytes / 1048576).toFixed(1)} MB -> ${path.relative(root, out) || out}`);

FILE: scripts/e2e-smoke.mjs

// End-to-end browser test: two real browser players on one server.
//
//   npm run test:e2e                 (needs Playwright + a Chromium build)
//   E2E_SHOTS=./shots npm run test:e2e   save screenshots
//
// It starts its own server (temporary data dir, dev commands on), then:
//   Alice: joins with 1,000 Money, defeats a monster, pays to recruit it,
//          presses H and sees it placed on a pad in her base.
//   Bob:   joins, walks into Alice's unlocked base, holds E to steal the
//          monster and carries it to his own base -> ownership moves.
// Every step is checked against the client state and the server state.

import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { createGameServer } from '../server/network.js';

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');

function loadPlaywright() {
  const tries = [root, '/opt/node22/lib/node_modules/', process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_PATH].filter(Boolean);
  for (const t of tries) {
    try {
      return createRequire(path.join(t, 'x.js'))('playwright');
    } catch { /* try next */ }
  }
  console.error('Playwright is not installed. Run: npm i -D playwright && npx playwright install chromium');
  process.exit(2);
}

const { chromium } = loadPlaywright();
const shots = process.env.E2E_SHOTS || null;
if (shots) fs.mkdirSync(shots, { recursive: true });
const dataDir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'sam-e2e-'));
let failures = 0;
const check = (cond, msg) => {
  console.log(`${cond ? '  ✔' : '  ✘'} ${msg}`);
  if (!cond) failures++;
};

const srv = await createGameServer({ port: 0, host: '127.0.0.1', dataDir, devCommands: true, quiet: true });
for (const e of Object.values(srv.game.events.events)) e.nextAt = Infinity;
const url = `http://127.0.0.1:${srv.port}/`;
const browser = await chromium.launch({ args: ['--use-gl=angle', '--use-angle=swiftshader', '--enable-unsafe-swiftshader', '--ignore-gpu-blocklist'] });

async function player(name, color) {
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 640, height: 400 } });
  await ctx.addInitScript(([n, c]) => localStorage.setItem('sam_settings', JSON.stringify({ quality: 'low', name: n, color: c, volume: 0 })), [name, color]);
  const page = await ctx.newPage();
  page.errors = [];
  page.on('pageerror', (e) => page.errors.push(e.message));
  page.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error') page.errors.push(m.text()); });

  await page.waitForFunction(() => window.__app && window.__app.ready, null, { timeout: 90000, polling: 500 });
  return page;
}

// walk around the inner ring (between the plaza and the bases) to an angle
async function ringWalk(page, fromAngle, toAngle, r = 72) {
  let d = toAngle - fromAngle;
  while (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
  while (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
  const n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.abs(d) / 0.3));
  for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
    const a = fromAngle + (d * i) / n;
    await walkTo(page, Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r, 3, 45000);
  }
}

const shot = async (page, name) => {

// walk with the real controls (camera + forward key) inside the page
// (drawing is paused while walking: software rendering runs at ~1 fps, which

const walkTo = (page, x, z, near = 2, maxMs = 60000) => page.evaluate(([x, z, near, maxMs]) => new Promise((resolve) => {
  const a = window.__app;
  const t0 = performance.now();

      a.input.down.delete('sprint');

      clearInterval(iv);
      resolve(d);
      return;

    a.cam.yaw = Math.atan2(-dx, -dz);
    a.input.setVirtual('forward', true);
    a.input.down.add('sprint');
  }, 40);
}), [x, z, near, maxMs]);

// fight a monster with left-click swings until the server says it is defeated
const fight = (page, id, maxMs = 90000) => page.evaluate(([id, maxMs]) => new Promise((resolve) => {
  const a = window.__app;

      a.input.setVirtual('attack', false);
      a.input.setVirtual('forward', false);
      a.skipRender = false;
      clearInterval(iv);
      resolve(m ? m.state : -1);
      return;
    }
    const dx = m.pos.x - a.player.pos.x;
    const dz = m.pos.z - a.player.pos.z;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    a.cam.yaw = Math.atan2(-dx, -dz);
    a.input.setVirtual('forward', d > 3);
    a.input.setVirtual('attack', d < 5);
  }, 40);
}), [id, maxMs]);
