// Server load test: N simulated players (real Socket.IO clients) walk out of
// their bases, wander the plains and swing swords, while the server's tick
// time, event-loop lag and per-client bandwidth are measured.
//   node scripts/load-test.mjs [players=12] [seconds=60]
import fs from 'node:fs';
import os from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { monitorEventLoopDelay } from 'node:perf_hooks';
import { io as ioClient } from 'socket.io-client';
import { createGameServer } from '../server/network.js';
import { PROTOCOL_VERSION, CONFIG } from '../shared/config.js';
import { buildWorld } from '../shared/world.js';

const N = Math.max(1, Math.min(CONFIG.maxPlayers, Number(process.argv[2]) || 12));
const SECONDS = Math.max(5, Number(process.argv[3]) || 60);
const world = buildWorld();
const dataDir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'sam-load-'));
const srv = await createGameServer({ port: 0, host: '127.0.0.1', dataDir, quiet: true });
const game = srv.game;

// time every server tick
const ticks = [];
const tick = game.tick.bind(game);
game.tick = (dt) => {
  const t0 = performance.now();
  tick(dt);
  ticks.push(performance.now() - t0);
};
const lag = monitorEventLoopDelay({ resolution: 10 });
lag.enable();

function connect() {
  const s = ioClient(`http://127.0.0.1:${srv.port}`, { transports: ['websocket'], forceNew: true, reconnection: false });
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    s.on('connect', () => resolve(s));
    s.on('connect_error', reject);
  });
}

const bots = [];
const reasons = {};
for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
  const s = await connect();
  const w = await s.timeout(5000).emitWithAck('hello', { protocol: PROTOCOL_VERSION, token: `load-test-token-${i}-xxxxxxxx`, name: `Bot${i + 1}` });
  if (!w.ok) throw new Error(`join failed: ${w.error}`);
  const base = world.bases[w.baseIndex];
  // out through the tower door, then round the tower through the gap between
  // two bases (towers are solid: walking through one is refused)
  const gap = base.angle + (i % 2 ? 1 : -1) * (Math.PI / 12);
  const route = [base.spawn, base.outside, { x: Math.cos(gap) * 76, z: Math.sin(gap) * 76 }, { x: Math.cos(gap) * 128, z: Math.sin(gap) * 128 }];
  const bot = { s, pos: { ...w.pos }, tp: w.teleportSeq, yaw: 0, base, bytes: 0, corrections: 0, route, leg: 0 };
  s.onAny((e, d) => { bot.bytes += e.length + JSON.stringify(d ?? null).length; });
  s.on('teleport', (d) => {
    bot.pos = { x: d.x, y: d.y, z: d.z };
    bot.tp = d.seq;
    bot.corrections++;
    reasons[d.reason] = (reasons[d.reason] || 0) + 1;
  });
  bots.push(bot);
}
console.log(`${N} players joined; running ${SECONDS}s`);

// after leaving the base, wander between random points on the plains ring
// behind the towers (close enough together that no straight line between
// two of them cuts through a tower)
function nextTarget(bot) {
  const a = bot.base.angle + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.6;
  const r = 120 + Math.random() * 25;
  return { x: Math.cos(a) * r, z: Math.sin(a) * r };
}

const speed = CONFIG.player.walkSpeed * 0.85;
const stepMs = 66;
const bytesAtStart = new Map();
const started = Date.now();
await new Promise((resolve) => {
  const iv = setInterval(() => {
    for (const bot of bots) {
      const target = bot.route[bot.leg] || (bot.route[bot.leg] = nextTarget(bot));
      const dx = target.x - bot.pos.x;
      const dz = target.z - bot.pos.z;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
      if (d < 1.5) bot.leg++;
      const step = Math.min(d, (speed * stepMs) / 1000);
      if (d > 0.01) {
        bot.pos.x += (dx / d) * step;
        bot.pos.z += (dz / d) * step;
        bot.yaw = Math.atan2(dx, dz);
      }
      // slide around trees and walls like the real client does; if stuck on
      // something, pick another place to go
      const bx = bot.pos.x;
      const bz = bot.pos.z;
      world.colliders.resolve(bot.pos, CONFIG.player.radius, CONFIG.player.height);
      if (Math.hypot(bot.pos.x - bx, bot.pos.z - bz) > step * 0.8 && bot.leg >= bot.route.length - 1) bot.route[bot.leg] = nextTarget(bot);
      bot.pos.y = world.surfaceHeight(bot.pos.x, bot.pos.z, bot.pos.y);
      bot.s.emit('move', { x: bot.pos.x, y: bot.pos.y, z: bot.pos.z, yaw: bot.yaw, a: 1, tp: bot.tp });
      if (Math.random() < 0.08) bot.s.emit('attack', { yaw: bot.yaw });
    }
    if (Date.now() - started > 5000 && !bytesAtStart.size) for (const b of bots) bytesAtStart.set(b, b.bytes);
    if (Date.now() - started > SECONDS * 1000) {
      clearInterval(iv);
      resolve();
    }
  }, stepMs);
});

const sorted = [...ticks].sort((a, b) => a - b);
const pct = (p) => sorted[Math.min(sorted.length - 1, Math.floor(sorted.length * p))];
const measured = SECONDS - 5;
const kbps = bots.map((b) => (b.bytes - (bytesAtStart.get(b) || 0)) / 1024 / measured);
const result = {
  players: N,
  seconds: SECONDS,
  monsters: game.monsters.list.size,
  ticks: ticks.length,
  tickMs: { avg: +(ticks.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / ticks.length).toFixed(2), p50: +pct(0.5).toFixed(2), p95: +pct(0.95).toFixed(2), p99: +pct(0.99).toFixed(2), max: +sorted[sorted.length - 1].toFixed(2) },
  budgetMs: 1000 / CONFIG.tickRate,
  eventLoopLagMs: { p50: +(lag.percentile(50) / 1e6).toFixed(1), p99: +(lag.percentile(99) / 1e6).toFixed(1) },
  downKBps: { avg: +(kbps.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / kbps.length).toFixed(1), max: +Math.max(...kbps).toFixed(1) },
  corrections: bots.reduce((a, b) => a + b.corrections, 0),
  correctionReasons: reasons,
  rssMB: Math.round(process.memoryUsage().rss / 1048576),
};
console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
for (const b of bots) b.s.disconnect();
await srv.close();
fs.rmSync(dataDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
const ok = result.tickMs.p95 < result.budgetMs;
console.log(ok ? `\nLOAD OK: p95 tick ${result.tickMs.p95} ms of a ${result.budgetMs} ms budget` : '\nLOAD WARNING: ticks exceed the budget');
process.exit(ok ? 0 : 1);

FILE: scripts/population-bench.mjs

// Worst case for the wild monster population: 12 players, each on a different
// island/region, so every one of those regions fills up to its 50 monsters.
// Runs the real Game in-process with a simulated clock and times every tick
// (AI, combat, snapshots for every player).
//   node scripts/population-bench.mjs [seconds=60]
import { Game } from '../server/game.js';
import { MemoryStore } from '../server/storage.js';
import { CONFIG, PROTOCOL_VERSION } from '../shared/config.js';
import { REGIONS, regionCenter } from '../shared/regions.js';

const SECONDS = Math.max(10, Number(process.argv[2]) || 60);
const clock = { t: 1_700_000_000_000 };
const game = new Game({ store: new MemoryStore(), now: () => clock.t, expansionThresholds: [0, 0], log: () => {} });
await game.init();

// one player per region (the plaza hub has the bases, so it counts as one)
const regions = REGIONS.slice(0, CONFIG.maxPlayers);
const players = [];
for (let i = 0; i < regions.length; i++) {
  const bytes = { n: 0 };
  const transport = {
    closed: false,
    send: (e, d) => { bytes.n += e.length + JSON.stringify(d ?? null).length; },
    sendVolatile: (e, d) => { bytes.n += e.length + JSON.stringify(d ?? null).length; },
    disconnect() {},
  };
  const res = await game.join(`bench${i}`, { protocol: PROTOCOL_VERSION, token: `population-bench-token-${i}-xx`, name: `Bench${i + 1}` }, transport);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(res.error);
  const s = game.players.get(`bench${i}`);
  s.profile.level = 30;
  const c = regionCenter(regions[i]);
  // the plains centre is the plaza (a safe zone): stand out in the meadow
  const home = regions[i].id === 'plains' ? { x: 60, z: -40 } : c;
  players.push({ s, home, bytes, region: regions[i].id });
}

const step = 1000 / CONFIG.tickRate;
const ticks = [];
let bytesAtWarm = null;
const total = SECONDS * CONFIG.tickRate;
for (let k = 0; k < total; k++) {
  clock.t += step;
  // walk slowly in a circle around the region centre, never knocked out
  for (const [i, p] of players.entries()) {
    const a = (k / total) * Math.PI * 2 + i;
    p.s.pos.x = p.home.x + Math.cos(a) * 20;
    p.s.pos.z = p.home.z + Math.sin(a) * 20;
    p.s.hp = p.s.maxHp;
  }
  const t0 = performance.now();
  game.tick(step);
  ticks.push(performance.now() - t0);
  if (k === 20 * CONFIG.tickRate) bytesAtWarm = players.map((p) => p.bytes.n);
}

const warm = ticks.slice(20 * CONFIG.tickRate); // after the islands filled up
const sorted = [...warm].sort((a, b) => a - b);
const pct = (q) => sorted[Math.min(sorted.length - 1, Math.floor(sorted.length * q))];
const perRegion = {};
for (const m of game.monsters.list.values()) perRegion[m.region] = (perRegion[m.region] || 0) + 1;
const measured = SECONDS - 20;
const kbps = players.map((p, i) => (p.bytes.n - bytesAtWarm[i]) / 1024 / measured);
console.log(JSON.stringify({
  players: players.length,
  simulatedSeconds: SECONDS,
  monsters: game.monsters.list.size,
  monstersPerRegion: perRegion,
  tickMs: {
    avg: +(warm.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / warm.length).toFixed(2),
    p50: +pct(0.5).toFixed(2),
    p95: +pct(0.95).toFixed(2),
    p99: +pct(0.99).toFixed(2),
    max: +sorted[sorted.length - 1].toFixed(2),
  },
  budgetMs: step,
  downKBpsPerPlayer: { avg: +(kbps.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / kbps.length).toFixed(1), max: +Math.max(...kbps).toFixed(1) },
}, null, 2));

// End-to-end test of accounts and online rooms (Firebase Authentication +
// Realtime Database) with the web build: the admin account "daniel" hosts a
// room, a second browser creates an account and joins it with the room link
// and plays through the host's game.
//
// Needs the Firebase emulators (Auth + Realtime Database) with this repo's
// rules, for example with firebase-tools:
//   firebase.json: {"database":{"rules":"firebase-database.rules.json"},
//                   "emulators":{"auth":{"port":9099},"database":{"port":9000}}}
//   npx firebase-tools emulators:start --only auth,database --project demo-sam
//   node scripts/build-web.mjs && node scripts/room-e2e.mjs [db=127.0.0.1:9000] [auth=127.0.0.1:9099]
//
// It checks: creating accounts and logging in, the room code and link, the
// guest joining with its own base and 1,000 Money, both players seeing each
// other, the guest walking with the real controls without being corrected by
// the host's server, fighting, paying to recruit, H home placing the monster
// on a pad, the guest's progress being saved in THEIR account and coming
// along to their own game ("continue" on the start-over question), the admin
// panel (who stole what), giving a stolen monster back, banning (kicked, can't
// come back), and the guest being told when the host leaves.

import http from 'node:http';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const emulator = process.argv[2] || '127.0.0.1:9000';
const authEmulator = process.argv[3] || '127.0.0.1:9099';
const dist = path.join(root, 'dist-web');
if (!fs.existsSync(path.join(dist, 'index.html'))) {
  console.error('Build the web version first: node scripts/build-web.mjs');
  process.exit(2);
}
function loadPlaywright() {
  for (const t of [root, '/opt/node22/lib/node_modules/', process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_PATH].filter(Boolean)) {
    try {
      return createRequire(path.join(t, 'x.js'))('playwright');
    } catch { /* try next */ }
  }
  console.error('Playwright is not installed.');
  process.exit(2);
}
const { chromium } = loadPlaywright();

// a static file server under a sub-folder, like GitHub Pages
const PREFIX = '/minecraft-realistis/';
const types = { '.html': 'text/html', '.js': 'text/javascript', '.css': 'text/css' };
const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  const u = decodeURIComponent(new URL(req.url, 'http://x').pathname);
  let p = u.startsWith(PREFIX) ? path.join(dist, u.slice(PREFIX.length)) : '';
  if (u.endsWith('/')) p = path.join(p, 'index.html');
  if (!p || !p.startsWith(dist) || !fs.existsSync(p) || fs.statSync(p).isDirectory()) {
    res.writeHead(404);
    return res.end('not found');
  }
  res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': types[path.extname(p)] || 'application/octet-stream' });
  fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res);
});
await new Promise((r) => server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', r));
const base = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.address().port}${PREFIX}`;

let failures = 0;
const check = (cond, msg) => {
  console.log(`${cond ? '  ✔' : '  ✘'} ${msg}`);
  if (!cond) failures++;
};

const browser = await chromium.launch({ args: ['--use-gl=angle', '--use-angle=swiftshader', '--enable-unsafe-swiftshader', '--ignore-gpu-blocklist'] });
const fbConfig = {
  apiKey: 'demo-key', authDomain: 'demo-sam.firebaseapp.com', projectId: 'demo-sam',
  databaseURL: `http://${emulator}?ns=demo-sam-default-rtdb`, emulator, authEmulator,
};
async function page(name, color) {
  const ctx = await browser.newContext({ viewport: { width: 640, height: 400 } });
  await ctx.addInitScript(([n, c, fb]) => {
    localStorage.setItem('sam_settings', JSON.stringify({ quality: 'low', name: n, color: c, volume: 0 }));
    localStorage.setItem('sam_firebase', JSON.stringify(fb));
  }, [name, color, fbConfig]);
  const p = await ctx.newPage();
  p.on('dialog', (d) => d.accept()); // "Ban …?" / "Really start over?"
  p.ctx = ctx;
  p.errors = [];
  p.on('pageerror', (e) => p.errors.push(e.message));
  p.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error') p.errors.push(m.text()); });
  p.on('response', (r) => { if (r.status() >= 400) p.errors.push(`HTTP ${r.status()} ${r.url().slice(0, 120)}`); });
  return p;
}
const ready = async (p) => {
  try {
    await p.waitForFunction(() => window.__app && window.__app.ready, null, { timeout: 120000, polling: 500 });
  } catch (e) {
    const status = await p.evaluate(() => [document.getElementById('title-status')?.textContent, document.getElementById('loading-text')?.textContent, !document.getElementById('progress-choice').hidden]).catch(() => null);
    console.log('  (not in the game:', JSON.stringify(status), 'errors:', (p.errors || []).slice(0, 5).join(' | '), ')');
    throw e;
  }
};

// create the account (or log in if it exists from an earlier run)
async function account(p, name, password) {
  await p.waitForFunction(() => window.__app?.accounts && document.getElementById('account-note').textContent !== 'Connecting to accounts…', null, { timeout: 60000, polling: 300 });
  if (await p.isVisible('#account-in')) return 'already';
  for (const tab of ['#tab-register', '#tab-login']) {
    await p.click(tab);
    await p.fill('#name-input', name);
    await p.fill('#password-input', password);
    await p.click('#account-btn');
    await p.waitForFunction(() => !document.getElementById('account-in').hidden || /⚠/.test(document.getElementById('account-note').textContent), null, { timeout: 30000, polling: 300 });
    if (await p.isVisible('#account-in')) {
      p.errors.length = 0; // (a failed first try, e.g. "taken" on a second run, logs an HTTP 400)
      return tab === '#tab-register' ? 'created' : 'logged in';
    }
  }
  throw new Error(`could not log in as ${name}: ${await p.textContent('#account-note')}`);
}
// the "start over or continue?" question
async function continueProgress(p) {
  const shown = await p.waitForSelector('#progress-choice:not([hidden])', { timeout: 20000 }).then(() => true, () => false);
  if (shown) await p.click('#pc-continue');
  return shown;
}
const guestName = `Guesty${Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4)}`;

// walk with the real controls (camera + forward key) inside the page
const walkTo = (p, x, z, near = 2, maxMs = 60000) => p.evaluate(([x, z, near, maxMs]) => new Promise((resolve) => {
  const a = window.__app;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  a.skipRender = true;
  const iv = setInterval(() => {
    const dx = x - a.player.pos.x;
    const dz = z - a.player.pos.z;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    if (d < near || performance.now() - t0 > maxMs) {
      a.input.setVirtual('forward', false);
      a.skipRender = false;
      clearInterval(iv);
      resolve(d);
      return;
    }
    a.cam.yaw = Math.atan2(-dx, -dz);
    a.input.setVirtual('forward', true);
  }, 40);
}), [x, z, near, maxMs]);

const fight = (p, id, maxMs = 90000) => p.evaluate(([id, maxMs]) => new Promise((resolve) => {
  const a = window.__app;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  a.skipRender = true;
  const iv = setInterval(() => {
    const m = a.monsters.get(id);
    if (!m || m.gone || m.state === 7 || performance.now() - t0 > maxMs) {
      a.input.setVirtual('attack', false);
      a.input.setVirtual('forward', false);
      a.skipRender = false;
      clearInterval(iv);
      resolve(m ? m.state : -1);
      return;
    }
    const dx = m.pos.x - a.player.pos.x;
    const dz = m.pos.z - a.player.pos.z;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    a.cam.yaw = Math.atan2(-dx, -dz);
    a.input.setVirtual('forward', d > 3);
    a.input.setVirtual('attack', d < 5);
  }, 40);
}), [id, maxMs]);

  const panel = await host.textContent('#panel-body');

  await host.screenshot({ path: path.join(root, 'test-results', 'admin-panel.png') }).catch(() => {});
  await host.click('[data-act="adminReturn"]');
  await host.waitForFunction(() => !document.querySelector('[data-act="adminReturn"]'), null, { timeout: 20000, polling: 300 }).catch(() => {});
  const gone = await host.evaluate(() => {
    const g = window.__app.net.game;
    const s = [...g.players.values()].find((x) => x.profile.name.startsWith('Guesty'));
    return !s.profile.monsters.some((m) => m.id === 'mstolen0001');
  });
  check(gone, 'the stolen monster was taken from the thief');
  const ret = await host.evaluate(async () => {
    const a = window.__app.accounts;
    const snap = await a.fb.get(a.ref('sam/returns/victimuid000000000000000000')).catch((e) => ({ err: e.message }));
    return snap.err ? `read denied (as it should be: only the owner reads)` : 'readable?';
  });
  check(/denied/.test(ret), `it waits in the owner's returns (${ret})`);
  await host.click(`[data-act="adminBan"][data-name="${guestName}"]`);
  await g2.waitForFunction(() => !document.getElementById('disconnected').hidden, null, { timeout: 30000, polling: 500 }).catch(() => {});
  const kicked = await g2.evaluate(() => document.getElementById('disc-text').textContent);
  check(/banned/i.test(kicked), `the thief is kicked (${kicked.trim()})`);
  const banned = await g2.evaluate(() => window.__app.accounts.isBanned());
  check(banned === true, 'the ban is saved online');
  const g3 = await guestCtx.newPage();
  g3.on('dialog', (d) => d.accept());
  await g3.goto(`${base}?room=${room.code}`);
  await g3.waitForSelector('#account-in:not([hidden])', { timeout: 60000 });
  await g3.click('#join-btn');
  await g3.waitForFunction(() => /banned/i.test(document.getElementById('title-status').textContent), null, { timeout: 30000, polling: 500 }).catch(() => {});
  check(/banned/i.test(await g3.textContent('#title-status')), `a banned player can't come back (${(await g3.textContent('#title-status')).trim()})`);
  check(g2.errors.length === 0 && solo.errors.length === 0, `guest pages: no browser errors ${[...g2.errors, ...solo.errors].slice(0, 3).join(' | ')}`);

  console.log('The host closes the game');
  await host.ctx.close();
  check(host.errors.length === 0, `host: no browser errors ${host.errors.slice(0, 3).join(' | ')}`);
  check(guest.errors.length === 0, `guest: no browser errors ${guest.errors.slice(0, 3).join(' | ')}`);
} catch (e) {
  console.error(e);
  failures++;
} finally {
  await browser.close();
  server.close();
}
console.log(failures ? `\nROOM E2E FAILED (${failures})` : '\nROOM E2E PASSED');
process.exit(failures ? 1 : 0);

// Checks firebase-database.rules.json against the local Firebase emulators
// (Auth on 127.0.0.1:9099, Realtime Database on 127.0.0.1:9000, started with
// the rules file; see scripts/room-e2e.mjs): accounts can only be written by
// their owner and only under their own name, only the admins (daniel, nadine, prabu, shallom) can ban
// or send returns, banned players can't join or open rooms, nobody can join
// or talk as someone else, and only the host can close a room.
//   node scripts/rules-check.mjs
import { initializeApp } from 'firebase/app';
import { getDatabase, connectDatabaseEmulator, ref, set, get, update, remove, push } from 'firebase/database';
import { getAuth, connectAuthEmulator, createUserWithEmailAndPassword, signInWithEmailAndPassword } from 'firebase/auth';
const cfg = { apiKey: 'fake-key', authDomain: 'demo-sam.firebaseapp.com', projectId: 'demo-sam', databaseURL: 'http://127.0.0.1:9000?ns=demo-sam-default-rtdb' };
let n = 0;
async function user(email, password = 'secret123') {
  const app = initializeApp(cfg, `u${n++}`);
  const auth = getAuth(app);
  connectAuthEmulator(auth, 'http://127.0.0.1:9099', { disableWarnings: true });
  const db = getDatabase(app);
  connectDatabaseEmulator(db, '127.0.0.1', 9000);
  const cred = await createUserWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, password).catch(() => signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, password));
  return { uid: cred.user.uid, db, r: (p) => ref(db, p) };
}
const results = [];
async function expect(label, ok, fn) {
  let res;
  try { await fn(); res = true; } catch (e) { res = false; }
  results.push(`${res === ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}  ${label} (${res ? 'allowed' : 'denied'})`);
}

const bob = await user(`bob${stamp}@players.steal-a-monster.game`);

await expect('eve cannot write bob\'s account', false, () => update(eve.r(`sam/accounts/${bob.uid}`), { profile: '{"money":9999}' }));

// Node 20 (which has no glob support in --test) as well as newer versions.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const dir = path.join(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..', 'tests');
const files = fs.readdirSync(dir).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.test.js')).sort().map((f) => path.join(dir, f));
const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--test', ...process.argv.slice(2), ...files], { stdio: 'inherit' });
process.exit(r.status ?? 1);

FILE: server.js

// STEAL A MONSTER — server entry point.
//
//   npm start                        -> http://localhost:3000
//   PORT=8080 npm start              -> another port
//   DATA_DIR=/var/lib/sam npm start  -> where player saves go (default ./data)
//   DEV_COMMANDS=1 npm start         -> enable /lucky, /money, /level, /night chat commands
//   EXPANSION_THRESHOLDS=2,4         -> players needed to open Bloomveil / Starfall Isle

import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { createGameServer } from './server/network.js';

const root = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const env = process.env;

const thresholds = env.EXPANSION_THRESHOLDS ? env.EXPANSION_THRESHOLDS.split(',').map((v) => Number(v.trim())) : undefined;

const srv = await createGameServer({
  port: Number(env.PORT) || 3000,
  host: env.HOST || '0.0.0.0',
  dataDir: env.DATA_DIR || path.join(root, 'data'),
  devCommands: env.DEV_COMMANDS === '1',
  dev: env.NODE_ENV !== 'production',
  expansionThresholds: thresholds,
  env,
});

let closing = false;
async function shutdown(signal) {
  if (closing) return;
  closing = true;
  console.log(`\n${signal}: saving all players...`);
  try {
    await srv.close();
    console.log('Saved. Bye!');
    process.exit(0);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Error while shutting down', e);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}
process.on('SIGINT', () => shutdown('SIGINT'));
process.on('SIGTERM', () => shutdown('SIGTERM'));

// Accounts for the Node server (npm start): a name and a password.
//
// Names are unique (shared/names.js nameKey). Passwords are stored as scrypt
// hashes. After a log-in the browser gets a "remember" key so it can log in
// again by itself; only a hash of it is stored. The first account made on a
// device takes over that device's progress (its old player token).
//
// The browser build (GitHub Pages) uses Firebase accounts instead
// (public/client/accounts.js); both end up in Game.join as a checked identity.

import crypto from 'node:crypto';
import { cleanName, nameKey, PASSWORD_MIN } from '#shared/names.js';
import { profileIdFromToken } from './services/playerData.js';
import { fail } from './validate.js';

const sha = (s) => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(String(s)).digest('hex');
const hashPassword = (password, salt) => crypto.scryptSync(String(password), salt, 32).toString('hex');

export class AccountRegistry {
  constructor(store, log = () => {}) {
    this.store = store;
    this.log = log;
    this.accounts = {}; // name key -> { name, pid, salt, hash, remember: [], createdAt }
  }

  async load() {
    this.accounts = (this.store.loadAccounts ? await this.store.loadAccounts() : null) || {};
  }

  async save() {
    if (this.store.saveAccounts) await this.store.saveAccounts(this.accounts);
  }

  taken(name) {
    return !!this.accounts[nameKey(name)];
  }

  // a = { name, password, create } or { name, remember }
  async verify(a, token) {
    const name = cleanName(a.name);
    if (!name) return fail('bad_name', 'A name needs 2–16 letters, numbers or spaces.');
    const key = nameKey(name);
    let rec = this.accounts[key];
    if (a.create === true) {
      if (rec) return fail('name_taken', `The name "${rec.name}" is already taken. Choose another one.`);
      if (typeof a.password !== 'string' || a.password.length < PASSWORD_MIN || a.password.length > 64) {
        return fail('bad_password', `Use a password of at least ${PASSWORD_MIN} characters.`);
      }
      // the progress on this device moves into the new account (once)
      let pid = profileIdFromToken(token);
      if (!pid || Object.values(this.accounts).some((r) => r.pid === pid)) pid = 'p_' + crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
      const salt = crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
      rec = { name, pid, salt, hash: hashPassword(a.password, salt), remember: [], createdAt: Date.now() };
      this.accounts[key] = rec;
      this.log(`account created: ${name}`);
    } else {
      if (!rec) return fail('no_account', `There is no account called "${name}". Check the spelling, or create one.`);
      let ok = false;
      if (typeof a.remember === 'string' && a.remember.length >= 16) {
        ok = rec.remember.includes(sha(a.remember));
      } else if (typeof a.password === 'string' && a.password.length <= 64) {
        const h = Buffer.from(hashPassword(a.password, rec.salt), 'hex');
        ok = crypto.timingSafeEqual(h, Buffer.from(rec.hash, 'hex'));
      }
      if (!ok) return fail('bad_login', a.remember ? 'Please log in again.' : 'Wrong password.');
    }
    const remember = crypto.randomBytes(24).toString('base64url');
    rec.remember = [...rec.remember, sha(remember)].slice(-5);
    await this.save();
    return { ok: true, ident: { account: `n:${key}`, pid: rec.pid, name: rec.name, remember } };
  }
}

// The authoritative game simulation. Transport-agnostic: server/network.js
// connects it to Socket.IO, and tests drive it directly.

import { CONFIG, PROTOCOL_VERSION } from '#shared/config.js';
import { buildWorld, isInsideBase, WATER_Y } from '#shared/world.js';
import { REGION_BY_ID, regionIdAt, regionLockReason } from '#shared/regions.js';
import { SWORD_BY_ID, SWORD_INDEX } from '#shared/weapons.js';
import { SPECIES_INDEX } from '#shared/monsters.js';
import { COSMETIC_INDEX } from '#shared/lucky.js';
import { isObj, finite, int, sanitizeName, sanitizeText, color as isColor, fail } from './validate.js';
import { nameKey, isAdminName } from '#shared/names.js';
import { RateLimiter } from './rateLimit.js';
import {
  profileIdFromToken, accountProfileId, newProfile, migrateProfile, sanitizeProfile, computePerks, playerMaxHp,
  OwnershipLedger, xpProgress, levelForXp,
} from './services/playerData.js';
import { Economy } from './services/economy.js';
import { Combat } from './services/combat.js';
import { MonsterManager } from './services/monsterAI.js';
import { Recruitment } from './services/recruitment.js';
import { BaseManager } from './services/bases.js';
import { Security } from './services/security.js';
import { Stealing } from './services/stealing.js';
import { ItemSystem } from './services/items.js';
import { LuckyBlocks } from './services/luckyBlocks.js';
import { EventManager } from './services/events.js';
import { WorldExpansion } from './services/worldExpansion.js';
import { Puzzles } from './services/puzzles.js';
import { MoonSecret } from './services/moonSecret.js';
import { Companions } from './services/companions.js';
import { CostumeShop } from './services/costumes.js';
import { Admin } from './services/admin.js';
import { GuardSystem } from './services/guards.js';

export { fail };

export const EFFECT = {
  frozen: 1, rooted: 2, slowed: 4, shield: 8, speed: 16, dodge: 32, protected: 64, burning: 128,
  stunned: 256, slipping: 512, radar: 1024, dead: 2048, thief: 4096,
};

class Session {
  constructor(sid, pn, profile, transport, now) {
    this.sid = sid;
    this.pn = pn;                    // small public player number used in snapshots
    this.id = profile.id;
    this.profile = profile;
    this.name = profile.name;
    this.transport = transport;
    this.joinedAt = now;
    this.pos = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
    this.yaw = 0;
    this.anim = 0;
    this.lastMoveAt = now;
    this.teleportSeq = 0;
    this.hp = 100;
    this.maxHp = 100;
    this.dead = false;
    this.respawnAt = 0;
    this.protectUntil = now + CONFIG.player.spawnProtectionMs;
    this.lastDamagedAt = 0;
    this.dodgeUntil = 0;
    this.dodgeReadyAt = 0;
    this.lastAttackAt = 0;
    this.combo = { count: 0, at: 0 };
    this.baseIndex = -1;
    this.carrying = null;
    this.stealPending = null;
    this.fx = { frozenUntil: 0, rootedUntil: 0, slowUntil: 0, slowFactor: 1, shieldUntil: 0, speedUntil: 0, speedMult: 1, slipUntil: 0, radarUntil: 0, burnUntil: 0, burnDps: 0, stunUntil: 0 };
    this.itemReadyAt = {};
    this.homeReadyAt = 0;
    this.knockbackUntil = 0;
    this.region = 'plains';
    this.spotsInside = new Set();
    this.inBases = new Set();
    this.recent = new Map();         // request id -> result (idempotency)
    this.profileDirty = true;
    this.saveDirty = false;
    this.violations = 0;
    this.perks = null;
    this.income = 0;
    this.lastLava = 0;
    this.lastCollectAt = 0;
  }

  remember(reqId, result) {
    if (typeof reqId !== 'string') return result;
    this.recent.set(reqId, result);
    if (this.recent.size > 64) this.recent.delete(this.recent.keys().next().value);
    return result;
  }

  recall(reqId) {
    return typeof reqId === 'string' ? this.recent.get(reqId) : undefined;
  }
}

export class Game {
  constructor(opts = {}) {
    this.store = opts.store;
    this.now = opts.now || (() => Date.now());
    this.rng = opts.rng || Math.random;
    this.log = opts.log || ((...a) => console.log('[game]', ...a));
    this.devCommands = !!opts.devCommands;
    this.world = buildWorld();
    this.players = new Map();            // sid -> Session
    this.byProfile = new Map();          // profile id -> Session
    this.profileCache = new Map();       // profile id -> profile (online + recently offline)
    this.joining = new Map();            // profile id -> Promise
    this.pnFree = [];
    this.pnNext = 1;
    this.ledger = new OwnershipLedger(this.store, this.log);
    this.tickCount = 0;
    this.time = 0;
    this.dayEpoch = this.now();
    this.lastSaveAt = this.now();
    this.saveFailures = 0;
    this.saving = new Map(); // profile id -> the save of it still running

    this.economy = new Economy(this);
    this.combat = new Combat(this);
    this.monsters = new MonsterManager(this);
    this.recruitment = new Recruitment(this);
    this.bases = new BaseManager(this);
    this.security = new Security(this);
    this.stealing = new Stealing(this);
    this.items = new ItemSystem(this);
    this.lucky = new LuckyBlocks(this);
    this.events = new EventManager(this);
    this.expansion = new WorldExpansion(this, opts.expansionThresholds);
    this.puzzles = new Puzzles(this);
    this.moonSecret = new MoonSecret(this);
    this.companions = new Companions(this);
    this.costumes = new CostumeShop(this);
    this.admin = new Admin(this);
    this.guards = new GuardSystem(this);
    this.accounts = opts.accounts || null;     // server/accounts.js (Node server only)
    this.accountSaver = opts.accountSaver || null; // saves online accounts (browser rooms)
    this.bans = new Map();                     // profile id -> ban
    this.pendingReturns = new Map();           // monster id -> admin return waiting for its owner

    this.handlers = {
      move: (s, p) => this.handleMove(s, p),
      attack: (s, p) => this.combat.handleAttack(s, p),
      dodge: (s, p) => this.combat.handleDodge(s, p),
      recruit: (s, p) => this.recruitment.handleRecruit(s, p),
      decline: (s, p) => this.recruitment.handleDecline(s, p),
      place: (s, p) => this.bases.handlePlace(s, p),
      unplace: (s, p) => this.bases.handleUnplace(s, p),
      follow: (s, p) => this.bases.handleFollow(s, p),
      callAllies: (s) => this.companions.handleCall(s),
      buyCostume: (s, p) => this.costumes.handleBuy(s, p),
      equipCostume: (s, p) => this.costumes.handleEquip(s, p),
      buyPower: (s, p) => this.costumes.handleBuyPower(s, p),
      power: (s, p) => this.costumes.handlePower(s, p),
      choosePower: (s, p) => this.costumes.handleChoosePower(s, p),
      buyGuards: (s, p) => this.bases.handleBuyGuards(s, p),
      adminPlayers: (s) => this.admin.handlePlayers(s),
      adminReturn: (s, p) => this.admin.handleReturn(s, p),
      adminBan: (s, p) => this.admin.handleBan(s, p),
      release: (s, p) => this.bases.handleRelease(s, p),
      collect: (s) => this.bases.handleCollect(s),
      buyDecor: (s, p) => this.bases.handleBuyDecor(s, p),
      placeDecor: (s, p) => this.bases.handlePlaceDecor(s, p),
      buySword: (s, p) => this.economy.handleBuySword(s, p),
      equipSword: (s, p) => this.economy.handleEquipSword(s, p),
      buyItem: (s, p) => this.economy.handleBuyItem(s, p),
      buyUpgrade: (s, p) => this.economy.handleBuyUpgrade(s, p),
      travel: (s, p) => this.economy.handleTravel(s, p),
      useItem: (s, p) => this.items.handleUse(s, p),
      lock: (s) => this.security.handleLock(s),
      home: (s) => this.bases.handleHome(s),
      stealBegin: (s, p) => this.stealing.handleBegin(s, p),
      stealConfirm: (s, p) => this.stealing.handleConfirm(s, p),
      stealCancel: (s) => this.stealing.handleCancel(s),
      grabDropped: (s, p) => this.stealing.handleGrabDropped(s, p),
      claimLucky: (s, p) => this.lucky.handleClaim(s, p),
      chat: (s, p) => this.handleChat(s, p),
      equipCosmetic: (s, p) => this.handleEquipCosmetic(s, p),
      setColor: (s, p) => this.handleSetColor(s, p),
      tutorial: (s, p) => this.handleTutorial(s, p),
      ping: () => ({ ok: true, t: this.now() }),
    };
  }

  async init() {
    await this.ledger.load();
    if (this.store.loadBans) {
      for (const b of Object.values((await this.store.loadBans()) || {})) if (b && b.id) this.bans.set(b.id, b);
    }
    if (this.accounts) await this.accounts.load();
    this.events.init();
    this.expansion.update(true);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- sessions

  // trusted: an identity the caller has already checked (an online
  // account signed in with Firebase, see client/rooms.js and localNet.js):
  //   { account, name, profile (saved progress or null), external: true }
  // Without it, hello.account logs in to an account of this server
  // (server/accounts.js), or hello.token alone plays without an account.
  async join(sid, hello, transport, trusted = null) {
    if (!isObj(hello)) return fail('bad_hello', 'Invalid hello');
    if (hello.protocol !== PROTOCOL_VERSION) return fail('protocol', 'The game was updated. Please refresh the page.');
    if (this.players.has(sid)) return fail('already_joined');
    let ident = trusted;
    if (!ident && isObj(hello.account)) {
      if (!this.accounts) return fail('no_accounts', 'This server has no accounts.');
      const r = await this.accounts.verify(hello.account, hello.token);
      if (!r.ok) return r;
      ident = r.ident;
    }
    const pid = ident ? ident.pid || accountProfileId(ident.account) : profileIdFromToken(hello.token);
    if (!pid) return fail('bad_token', 'Invalid player token');
    const name = ident ? ident.name : sanitizeName(hello.name) || 'Player';
    // names are unique: account names belong to their account
    if (!ident && this.accounts?.taken(name)) return fail('name_taken', `"${name}" is the name of an account. Log in, or choose another name.`);
    if (this.isBanned(pid)) return fail('banned', 'You are banned from this server.');
    if (this.joining.has(pid)) {
      try { await this.joining.get(pid); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    }
    const existing = this.byProfile.get(pid);
    if (existing) this.kick(existing, 'You joined from another window.');
    if (this.players.size >= CONFIG.maxPlayers) return fail('full', 'The server is full (12 players). Try again soon.');

    let loaded;
    const p = this.loadOrCreate(pid, name, ident, hello.fresh === true);
    this.joining.set(pid, p);
    try {
      loaded = await p;
    } catch (e) {
      this.log('profile load failed', pid, e.message);
      return fail('load_failed', 'Your saved progress could not be loaded, so you were not logged in (nothing was overwritten). Please try again later.');
    } finally {
      this.joining.delete(pid);
    }
    if (transport.closed) return fail('gone');
    if (this.players.size >= CONFIG.maxPlayers) return fail('full', 'The server is full.');
    for (const o of this.players.values()) {
      if (o.id !== pid && nameKey(o.profile.name) === nameKey(name)) {
        return fail('name_taken', `Someone here is already called "${o.profile.name}". Choose another name.`);
      }
    }
    const { profile, isNew } = loaded;
    if (!isNew && name && name !== profile.name) profile.name = name;
    if (ident) profile.account = ident.account;
    this.applyPendingReturns(profile);
    if (isColor(hello.color)) profile.color = hello.color;

    const baseIndex = this.bases.assign(pid);
    if (baseIndex < 0) return fail('full', 'No free base plot.');
    const pn = this.pnFree.length ? this.pnFree.pop() : this.pnNext++;
    const now = this.now();
    const s = new Session(sid, pn, profile, transport, now);
    s.account = ident ? ident.account : null;
    s.admin = !!ident && isAdminName(ident.name); // daniel, nadine, prabu or shallom
    s.baseIndex = baseIndex;
    this.players.set(sid, s);
    this.byProfile.set(pid, s);
    this.profileCache.set(pid, profile);
    this.refreshPerks(s);
    s.hp = s.maxHp;
    const base = this.world.bases[baseIndex];
    s.pos = { x: base.spawn.x, y: base.y, z: base.spawn.z };
    s.yaw = base.yaw;
    s.inBases.add(baseIndex);
    // passive income earned while offline (reduced rate, capped)
    if (!isNew) this.bases.applyOfflineIncome(s, now);
    profile.lastSeen = now;
    this.markSave(s);

    const welcome = {
      ok: true,
      pn,
      isNew,
      serverTime: now,
      dayEpoch: this.dayEpoch,
      dayLength: CONFIG.dayLengthMs,
      profile: this.clientProfile(s),
      admin: s.admin,
      remember: ident?.remember || null,
      pos: { ...s.pos, yaw: s.yaw },
      teleportSeq: s.teleportSeq,
      baseIndex,
      players: [...this.players.values()].map((o) => this.playerInfo(o)),
      bases: this.bases.allStates(),
      world: this.expansion.state(),
      event: this.events.state(),
      lucky: this.lucky.list(),
      puzzle: this.puzzles.state(),
      moon: this.moonSecret.state(s),
      dropped: this.stealing.droppedList(),
      traps: this.items.groundList(),
    };
    this.broadcast('playerJoined', this.playerInfo(s), s);
    this.bases.broadcastBase(baseIndex);
    this.expansion.update();
    this.log(`${profile.name} joined (${isNew ? 'new profile' : 'returning'}) -> base ${baseIndex + 1}, ${this.players.size} online`);
    return welcome;
  }

  async loadOrCreate(pid, name, ident = null, fresh = false) {
    const now = this.now();
    // starting over: a brand-new profile (the old monsters are let go)
    if (fresh) {
      this.profileCache.delete(pid);
      this.ledger.removeOwner(pid);
      const profile = newProfile(pid, name, now);
      if (ident) profile.account = ident.account;
      this.profileCache.set(pid, profile);
      if (!ident?.external) await this.store.saveProfile(pid, profile);
      return { profile, isNew: true };
    }
    const cached = this.profileCache.get(pid);
    if (cached) return { profile: cached, isNew: false };
    // an online account brings its own saved progress (from any room)
    if (ident?.external) {
      const profile = ident.profile ? sanitizeProfile(migrateProfile(ident.profile), pid, now) : newProfile(pid, name, now);
      profile.account = ident.account;
      this.ledger.adopt(profile);
      this.profileCache.set(pid, profile);
      return { profile, isNew: !ident.profile };
    }
    const raw = await this.store.loadProfile(pid);
    if (raw === null) {
      const profile = newProfile(pid, name, this.now());
      this.profileCache.set(pid, profile);
      await this.store.saveProfile(pid, profile);
      return { profile, isNew: true };
    }
    const profile = sanitizeProfile(migrateProfile(raw), pid, this.now());
    const fixes = this.ledger.reconcile(profile);
    if (fixes.length) {
      this.log(`ownership reconciled for ${pid}:`, fixes.join(', '));
      await this.ledger.save();
    }
    this.profileCache.set(pid, profile);
    return { profile, isNew: false };
  }

  leave(sid) {
    const s = this.players.get(sid);
    if (!s) return;
    this.stealing.onLeave(s);
    this.recruitment.onLeave(s);
    this.items.onLeave(s);
    this.moonSecret.onLeave(s);
    this.companions.onLeave(s);
    this.players.delete(sid);
    if (this.byProfile.get(s.id) === s) this.byProfile.delete(s.id);
    this.bases.release(s.baseIndex);
    this.pnFree.push(s.pn);
    s.profile.lastSeen = this.now();
    const profile = s.profile;
    this.saveProfile(profile).finally(() => {
      if (!this.byProfile.has(profile.id)) this.profileCache.delete(profile.id);
    });
    this.broadcast('playerLeft', { pn: s.pn });
    this.bases.broadcastBase(s.baseIndex);
    this.expansion.update();
    this.log(`${s.name} left, ${this.players.size} online`);
  }

  kick(s, reason) {
    try { this.send(s, 'kicked', { reason }); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    this.leave(s.sid);
    try { s.transport.disconnect?.(reason); } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- messages

  handle(sid, type, payload) {
    const s = this.players.get(sid);
    if (!s) return fail('not_joined');
    const h = this.handlers[type];
    if (!h) return fail('unknown');
    if (!s.rate) s.rate = new RateLimiter(CONFIG.rateLimits, this.now);
    if (!s.rate.allow(type)) return fail('rate_limited', 'Slow down!');
    try {
      return h(s, payload) || { ok: true };
    } catch (e) {
      this.log('handler error', type, e.stack || e);
      return fail('error', 'Something went wrong');
    }
  }

  send(s, event, data) {
    s.transport.send(event, data);
  }

  sendVolatile(s, event, data) {
    (s.transport.sendVolatile || s.transport.send)(event, data);
  }

  broadcast(event, data, except) {
    for (const s of this.players.values()) if (s !== except) s.transport.send(event, data);
  }

  broadcastNear(x, z, radius, event, data, except) {
    const r2 = radius * radius;
    for (const s of this.players.values()) {
      if (s === except) continue;
      const dx = s.pos.x - x;
      const dz = s.pos.z - z;
      if (dx * dx + dz * dz <= r2) s.transport.send(event, data);
    }
  }

  toast(s, text, kind = 'info') {
    this.send(s, 'toast', { text, kind });
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- movement

  maxSpeed(s) {
    let v = CONFIG.player.sprintSpeed * (1 + (s.perks?.speed || 0));
    const t = this.now();
    if (s.fx.speedUntil > t) v *= s.fx.speedMult;
    return v;
  }

  handleMove(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || !finite(p.x) || !finite(p.y) || !finite(p.z) || !finite(p.yaw, -100, 100)) return fail('bad_move');
    if (p.tp !== s.teleportSeq) return { ok: true, stale: true }; // sent before our last teleport
    const now = this.now();
    if (s.dead) return { ok: true, dead: true };
    s.yaw = p.yaw;
    s.anim = int(p.a, 0, 31) ? p.a : 0;
    const frozen = s.fx.frozenUntil > now || s.fx.rootedUntil > now;
    const dt = Math.min(CONFIG.movement.maxUpdateGapMs, now - s.lastMoveAt) / 1000;
    const dx = p.x - s.pos.x;
    const dz = p.z - s.pos.z;
    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
    let allowed = this.maxSpeed(s) * CONFIG.movement.speedTolerance * dt + CONFIG.movement.slackUnits;
    if (s.knockbackUntil > now) allowed += 30;
    if (s.dodgeUntil + 400 > now) allowed += CONFIG.player.dodgeDistance;
    if (frozen) allowed = 0.6;
    if (dist > allowed) return this.correct(s, 'speed');

    const nx = p.x;
    const nz = p.z;
    // regions: locked or closed areas can't be entered
    const regionId = regionIdAt(nx, nz);
    const region = regionId ? REGION_BY_ID[regionId] : null;
    if (!region) return this.correct(s, 'edge');
    if (regionId !== s.region) {
      const reason = regionLockReason(region, this.playerProgress(s), this.expansion.active);
      if (reason) return this.correct(s, 'locked', reason);
    }
    // base lasers: rivals can't walk into a locked base
    for (const b of this.world.bases) {
      const inside = isInsideBase(b, nx, nz);
      if (inside && !s.inBases.has(b.index)) {
        if (!this.security.mayEnter(s, b.index)) return this.correct(s, 'lasers', 'Security lasers are on!');
      }
    }
    if (!this.puzzles.mayMove(s, nx, nz)) return this.correct(s, 'sealed', 'The vault door is sealed.');
    // walls: the client stays out of them on its own, so a move through one
    // (for example into a base tower anywhere but its door) is refused
    if (this.world.colliders.segmentBlocked(s.pos.x, s.pos.z, nx, nz, 0.3, p.y + 0.6, p.y + CONFIG.player.height - 0.6)) {
      return this.correct(s, 'wall');
    }

    // ground, or the base floor / stair tread under the player
    const ground = this.world.surfaceHeight(nx, nz, p.y);
    let y = p.y;
    if (y < ground - 3 && y < WATER_Y - 3) y = Math.max(ground, WATER_Y - 2);
    if (y < ground - 3) y = ground;
    if (y > Math.max(ground, WATER_Y) + CONFIG.movement.maxHeightAboveGround) return this.correct(s, 'fly');

    s.pos.x = nx;
    s.pos.y = y;
    s.pos.z = nz;
    s.lastMoveAt = now;
    this.afterMove(s, regionId);
    return null; // no ack needed
  }

  correct(s, why, message) {
    s.violations++;
    s.teleportSeq++;
    this.send(s, 'teleport', { x: s.pos.x, y: s.pos.y, z: s.pos.z, seq: s.teleportSeq, reason: why, message });
    return { ok: false, error: why, message };
  }

  teleport(s, x, y, z, reason, yaw) {
    // others nearby see you vanish here and appear there
    const from = { x: s.pos.x, z: s.pos.z };
    const r1 = (v) => Math.round(v * 10) / 10;
    const ev = { pn: s.pn, x: r1(x), y: r1(y), z: r1(z), fx: r1(from.x), fz: r1(from.z) };
    this.broadcastNear(from.x, from.z, 120, 'ptp', ev, s);
    if ((x - from.x) ** 2 + (z - from.z) ** 2 > 240 * 240) this.broadcastNear(x, z, 120, 'ptp', ev, s);
    s.teleportSeq++;
    s.pos = { x, y, z };
    s.lastMoveAt = this.now();
    if (yaw !== undefined) s.yaw = yaw;
    this.send(s, 'teleport', { x, y, z, yaw, seq: s.teleportSeq, reason });
    this.afterMove(s, regionIdAt(x, z));
  }

  afterMove(s, regionId) {
    if (regionId && regionId !== s.region) {
      s.region = regionId;
      if (!s.profile.regionsVisited.includes(regionId)) {
        s.profile.regionsVisited.push(regionId);
        this.markProfile(s);
        this.send(s, 'discovery', { kind: 'region', id: regionId, name: REGION_BY_ID[regionId].name });
      }
    }
    // spots (landmarks and hidden places)
    for (const spot of this.world.spots) {
      const dx = s.pos.x - spot.x;
      const dz = s.pos.z - spot.z;
      const inside = dx * dx + dz * dz < (spot.r + 4) * (spot.r + 4);
      if (inside && !s.profile.discoveries.spots[spot.id]) {
        s.profile.discoveries.spots[spot.id] = this.now();
        this.economy.credit(s, spot.reward, 'discovery');
        this.send(s, 'discovery', { kind: 'spot', id: spot.id, name: spot.name, reward: spot.reward, hidden: !!spot.hidden });
        this.markProfile(s);
      }
    }
    // bases: entering/leaving
    for (const b of this.world.bases) {
      const inside = isInsideBase(b, s.pos.x, s.pos.z);
      if (inside && !s.inBases.has(b.index)) {
        s.inBases.add(b.index);
        if (b.index === s.baseIndex) this.bases.onEnterOwnBase(s);
      } else if (!inside && s.inBases.has(b.index)) {
        s.inBases.delete(b.index);
      }
    }
    if (s.carrying && s.inBases.has(s.baseIndex)) this.stealing.completeTheft(s);
    this.bases.checkPads(s);
    this.puzzles.checkPlates(s);
    this.moonSecret.afterMove(s);
    this.items.checkGround(s);
    this.economy.checkPortals(s);
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- admin

  isBanned(pid) {
    return this.bans.has(pid);
  }

  addBan(ban) {
    this.bans.set(ban.id, ban);
    if (this.store.saveBans) {
      this.store.saveBans(Object.fromEntries(this.bans)).catch((e) => this.log('ban save failed', e.message));
    }
  }

  // An admin return for an owner who is not in the server right now. A
  // profile saved by this server gets it at once; an online account gets
  // it through the admin's browser (sam/returns, see client/accounts.js).
  async deliverLater(d) {
    if (!d.profileId) return;
    const cached = this.profileCache.get(d.profileId);
    if (cached?.account && this.accountSaver) return;
    this.pendingReturns.set(d.monster.id, d);
    try {
      let profile = cached;
      if (!profile) {
        const raw = await this.store.loadProfile(d.profileId);
        if (!raw) return;
        profile = sanitizeProfile(migrateProfile(raw), d.profileId, this.now());
      }
      if (this.byProfile.has(d.profileId)) return; // they came back meanwhile (applied at join)
      if (this.applyPendingReturns(profile)) await this.saveProfile(profile);
    } catch (e) {
      this.log('return delivery failed', e.message);
    }
  }

  applyPendingReturns(profile) {
    let n = 0;
    for (const [mid, d] of [...this.pendingReturns]) {
      if (d.profileId !== profile.id) continue;
      this.pendingReturns.delete(mid);
      if (profile.monsters.some((m) => m.id === mid)) continue;
      profile.monsters.push({ ...d.monster, slot: null, following: false });
      this.ledger.set(mid, profile.id, d.monster.species, d.monster.level);
      n++;
    }
    return n;
  }

  playerProgress(s) {
    const sw = SWORD_BY_ID[s.profile.sword];
    return { level: s.profile.level, swordTier: Math.max(...s.profile.swords.map((id) => SWORD_BY_ID[id]?.tier || 1), sw?.tier || 1) };
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- profiles

  refreshPerks(s) {
    const { perks, income } = computePerks(s.profile);
    s.perks = perks;
    s.income = income;
    const oldMax = s.maxHp;
    s.maxHp = playerMaxHp(s.profile, perks);
    if (s.maxHp !== oldMax && oldMax > 0) s.hp = Math.min(s.maxHp, Math.round(s.hp * (s.maxHp / oldMax)));
  }

  addXp(s, amount) {
    const p = s.profile;
    const gain = Math.round(amount * (1 + (s.perks?.xp || 0)));
    p.xp += gain;
    const newLevel = levelForXp(p.xp);
    if (newLevel > p.level) {
      p.level = newLevel;
      this.refreshPerks(s);
      s.hp = s.maxHp;
      this.send(s, 'levelUp', { level: newLevel });
      this.broadcast('playerInfo', this.playerInfo(s));
    }
    this.markProfile(s);
    return gain;
  }

  markProfile(s) {
    s.profileDirty = true;
    s.saveDirty = true;
  }

  markSave(s) {
    s.saveDirty = true;
  }

  // Saves of one profile run one after another (they write the same file and
  // its backup), and flushSaves()/shutdown() can wait for every save that is
  // still running, including the one started when a player leaves.
  saveProfile(profile) {
    const prev = this.saving.get(profile.id) || Promise.resolve();
    const job = prev.then(() => this.writeProfile(profile));
    this.saving.set(profile.id, job);
    job.finally(() => {
      if (this.saving.get(profile.id) === job) this.saving.delete(profile.id);
    });
    return job;
  }

  async writeProfile(profile) {
    try {
      // online accounts are saved to the account (by its owner's browser)
      if (profile.account && this.accountSaver) await this.accountSaver(profile);
      else await this.store.saveProfile(profile.id, profile);
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      this.saveFailures++;
      this.log('SAVE FAILED for', profile.id, e.message);
      const s = this.byProfile.get(profile.id);
      if (s) s.saveDirty = true; // retry on the next save cycle
      return false;
    }
  }

  // Immediately persist (used after money/ownership transactions).
  async saveNow(...sessionsOrProfiles) {
    const jobs = [];
    if (this.ledger.dirty) jobs.push(this.ledger.save().catch((e) => this.log('LEDGER SAVE FAILED', e.message)));
    for (const x of sessionsOrProfiles) {
      if (!x) continue;
      const profile = x.profile || x;
      const s = this.byProfile.get(profile.id);
      if (s) s.saveDirty = false;
      jobs.push(this.saveProfile(profile));
    }
    return Promise.all(jobs);
  }

  clientProfile(s) {
    const p = s.profile;
    const prog = xpProgress(p.xp);
    return {
      name: p.name,
      color: p.color,
      money: Math.floor(p.money),
      gems: p.gems,
      decor: p.decor,
      xp: p.xp,
      level: p.level,
      xpInto: prog.into,
      xpNeed: prog.need,
      sword: p.sword,
      swords: p.swords,
      items: p.items,
      monsters: p.monsters,
      base: p.base,
      storedIncome: Math.floor(p.storedIncome),
      income: s.income,
      perks: s.perks,
      maxHp: s.maxHp,
      discoveries: p.discoveries,
      regionsVisited: p.regionsVisited,
      tutorial: p.tutorial,
      moon: p.moon,
      costumes: p.costumes,
      powerLevel: p.powerLevel,
      powerReadyAt: s.powerReadyAt || 0,
      cosmetics: p.cosmetics,
      coupons: p.coupons,
      stats: p.stats,
      homeReadyAt: s.homeReadyAt,
      itemReadyAt: s.itemReadyAt,
    };
  }

  playerInfo(s) {
    return {
      pn: s.pn,
      name: s.profile.name,
      color: s.profile.color,
      level: s.profile.level,
      baseIndex: s.baseIndex,
      cosmetic: s.profile.cosmetics.equipped,
      costume: s.profile.costumes.equipped,
      costumePower: s.profile.costumes.power || null,
      sword: s.profile.sword,
      admin: !!s.admin,
    };
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- misc handlers

  handleChat(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p)) return fail('bad');
    const text = sanitizeText(p.text, 160);
    if (!text) return fail('empty');
    if (text.startsWith('/')) return this.devCommand(s, text);
    this.broadcast('chat', { pn: s.pn, name: s.profile.name, text });
    return { ok: true };
  }

  devCommand(s, text) {
    const [cmd, ...args] = text.slice(1).split(/\s+/);
    if (cmd === 'help') {
      this.toast(s, this.devCommands ? 'Dev commands: /lucky, /money N, /level N, /night, /day, /spawn species, /tp X Z' : 'No commands on this server.');
      return { ok: true };
    }
    if (!this.devCommands) return fail('no_commands', 'Commands are disabled on this server.');
    if (cmd === 'lucky') this.events.trigger('luckyLucky');
    else if (cmd === 'money') this.economy.credit(s, Math.min(1e7, Math.max(0, Number(args[0]) || 0)), 'dev');
    else if (cmd === 'level') {
      const target = Math.max(1, Math.min(CONFIG.progression.maxLevel, Number(args[0]) | 0));
      while (s.profile.level < target) this.addXp(s, 1e5);
    } else if (cmd === 'night') this.dayEpoch = this.now() - CONFIG.dayLengthMs * 0.75;
    else if (cmd === 'day') this.dayEpoch = this.now() - CONFIG.dayLengthMs * 0.2;
    else if (cmd === 'spawn') this.monsters.devSpawn(s, args[0]);
    else if (cmd === 'tp') {
      const x = Number(args[0]);
      const z = Number(args[1]);
      if (!Number.isFinite(x) || !Number.isFinite(z) || Math.abs(x) > 1200 || Math.abs(z) > 1200) return fail('bad');
      this.teleport(s, x, this.world.groundHeight(x, z), z, 'dev');
    } else return fail('unknown_command');
    if (cmd === 'night' || cmd === 'day') this.broadcast('time', { dayEpoch: this.dayEpoch });
    this.markProfile(s);
    return { ok: true };
  }

  handleEquipCosmetic(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p)) return fail('bad');
    const id = p.id === null ? null : p.id;
    if (id !== null && !s.profile.cosmetics.owned.includes(id)) return fail('not_owned');
    s.profile.cosmetics.equipped = id;
    this.markProfile(s);
    this.broadcast('playerInfo', this.playerInfo(s));
    return { ok: true };
  }

  handleSetColor(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || !isColor(p.color)) return fail('bad');
    s.profile.color = p.color;
    this.markProfile(s);
    this.broadcast('playerInfo', this.playerInfo(s));
    this.bases.broadcastBase(s.baseIndex);
    return { ok: true };
  }

  handleTutorial(s, p) {
    if (isObj(p) && p.skip) {
      s.profile.tutorial.done = true;
      this.markProfile(s);
    }
    return { ok: true };
  }

  // Called by services when the player did something the tutorial teaches.
  tutorialEvent(s, what) {
    const t = s.profile.tutorial;
    if (t.done) return;
    const steps = ['explore', 'defeat', 'recruit', 'place', 'collect', 'lock', 'sword'];
    const want = steps[t.step];
    if (what === want) {
      t.step++;
      if (t.step >= steps.length) {
        t.done = true;
        this.economy.credit(s, 300, 'tutorial');
        this.toast(s, 'Tutorial complete! +300 Money. Go explore and collect them all!', 'good');
      }
      this.markProfile(s);
    }
  }

  isNight() {
    const t = (((this.now() - this.dayEpoch) % CONFIG.dayLengthMs) + CONFIG.dayLengthMs) % CONFIG.dayLengthMs / CONFIG.dayLengthMs;
    return t >= 0.68 && t < 0.97;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- loop

  tick(dtMs = 1000 / CONFIG.tickRate) {
    const now = this.now();
    this.tickCount++;
    this.time += dtMs;
    const dt = dtMs / 1000;
    this.monsters.tick(dt, now);
    this.companions.tick(dt, now);
    this.guards.tick(dt, now);
    this.combat.tick(dt, now);
    this.items.tick(dt, now);
    this.stealing.tick(dt, now);
    this.bases.tick(dt, now);
    this.security.tick(dt, now);
    this.recruitment.tick(dt, now);
    this.lucky.tick(dt, now);
    this.events.tick(dt, now);
    this.expansion.tick(dt, now);
    this.puzzles.tick(dt, now);
    this.moonSecret.tick(dt, now);
    for (const s of this.players.values()) {
      if (s.profile.tutorial.step === 0 && !s.inBases.has(s.baseIndex) && Math.hypot(s.pos.x, s.pos.z) > 45) {
        this.tutorialEvent(s, 'explore');
      }
    }
    const every = Math.max(1, Math.round(CONFIG.tickRate / CONFIG.snapshotRate));
    if (this.tickCount % every === 0) this.sendSnapshots(now);
    for (const s of this.players.values()) {
      if (s.profileDirty) {
        s.profileDirty = false;
        this.send(s, 'profile', this.clientProfile(s));
      }
    }
    if (now - this.lastSaveAt > 5000) {
      this.lastSaveAt = now;
      this.flushSaves();
    }
  }

  flushSaves() {
    const jobs = [];
    if (this.ledger.dirty) jobs.push(this.ledger.save().catch((e) => this.log('LEDGER SAVE FAILED', e.message)));
    for (const s of this.players.values()) {
      if (s.saveDirty) {
        s.saveDirty = false;
        s.profile.lastSeen = this.now();
        jobs.push(this.saveProfile(s.profile));
      }
    }
    // and the saves still running (e.g. of players who just left)
    jobs.push(...this.saving.values());
    return Promise.all(jobs);
  }

  async shutdown() {
    for (const s of [...this.players.values()]) {
      this.stealing.onLeave(s);
      s.profile.lastSeen = this.now();
    }
    const jobs = [...this.players.values()].map((s) => this.saveProfile(s.profile));
    jobs.push(this.ledger.save().catch(() => {}));
    jobs.push(...this.saving.values());
    await Promise.all(jobs);
  }

  effectBits(s, now) {
    let b = 0;
    const f = s.fx;
    if (f.frozenUntil > now) b |= EFFECT.frozen;
    if (f.rootedUntil > now) b |= EFFECT.rooted;
    if (f.slowUntil > now) b |= EFFECT.slowed;
    if (f.shieldUntil > now) b |= EFFECT.shield;
    if (f.speedUntil > now) b |= EFFECT.speed;
    if (s.dodgeUntil > now) b |= EFFECT.dodge;
    if (s.protectUntil > now) b |= EFFECT.protected;
    if (f.burnUntil > now) b |= EFFECT.burning;
    if (f.stunUntil > now) b |= EFFECT.stunned;
    if (f.slipUntil > now) b |= EFFECT.slipping;
    if (f.radarUntil > now) b |= EFFECT.radar;
    if (s.dead) b |= EFFECT.dead;
    if ((s.thiefUntil || 0) > now) b |= EFFECT.thief; // guards are after them
    return b;
  }

  sendSnapshots(now) {
    const r = (v) => Math.round(v * 100) / 100;
    const players = [];
    for (const s of this.players.values()) {
      players.push([
        s.pn, r(s.pos.x), r(s.pos.y), r(s.pos.z), r(s.yaw), s.anim,
        Math.round((100 * s.hp) / s.maxHp),
        SWORD_INDEX[s.profile.sword] ?? 0,
        s.carrying ? SPECIES_INDEX[s.carrying.species] : -1,
        this.effectBits(s, now),
        -1, // (was: the one follower; companions now come with the monsters)
        s.profile.level,
        s.profile.cosmetics.equipped ? COSMETIC_INDEX[s.profile.cosmetics.equipped] : -1,
        s.stealPending ? 1 : 0,
      ]);
    }
    for (const s of this.players.values()) {
      const m = this.companions.snapshotFor(s, this.monsters.snapshotFor(s), CONFIG.interestRadius);
      this.sendVolatile(s, 'snap', { t: now, p: players, m, g: this.guards.snapshotFor(s) });
    }
  }
}

// HTTP (Express) + real-time networking (Socket.IO) around the Game.

import http from 'node:http';
import path from 'node:path';
import os from 'node:os';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import express from 'express';
import { Server as IOServer } from 'socket.io';
import { CONFIG, applyEnvOverrides } from '#shared/config.js';
import { Game } from './game.js';
import { JsonFileStore, MemoryStore } from './storage.js';
import { AccountRegistry } from './accounts.js';

const ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');

export function lanAddresses() {
  const out = [];
  for (const list of Object.values(os.networkInterfaces())) {
    for (const a of list || []) if (a.family === 'IPv4' && !a.internal) out.push(a.address);
  }
  return out;
}

export async function createGameServer(opts = {}) {
  applyEnvOverrides(opts.env || {});
  const log = opts.quiet ? () => {} : (...a) => console.log(...a);
  const store = opts.store || (opts.dataDir ? new JsonFileStore(opts.dataDir) : new MemoryStore());
  const game = new Game({
    store,
    now: opts.now,
    rng: opts.rng,
    log: opts.quiet ? () => {} : (...a) => console.log('[game]', ...a),
    devCommands: !!opts.devCommands,
    expansionThresholds: opts.expansionThresholds,
    accounts: new AccountRegistry(store, log),
  });
  await game.init();

  const app = express();
  app.disable('x-powered-by');
  app.use((req, res, next) => {
    res.setHeader('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');
    next();
  });
  app.get('/health', (req, res) => {
    res.json({ ok: true, players: game.players.size, monsters: game.monsters.list.size, world: game.expansion.state(), saveFailures: game.saveFailures });
  });
  const staticOpts = { index: 'index.html', dotfiles: 'deny', fallthrough: true, maxAge: opts.dev ? 0 : '1h' };
  app.use('/shared', express.static(path.join(ROOT, 'shared'), staticOpts));
  app.use('/lib/three/build', express.static(path.join(ROOT, 'node_modules', 'three', 'build'), staticOpts));
  app.use('/lib/three/addons', express.static(path.join(ROOT, 'node_modules', 'three', 'examples', 'jsm'), staticOpts));
  app.use('/', express.static(path.join(ROOT, 'public'), staticOpts));
  app.use((req, res) => res.status(404).type('text/plain').send('Not found'));

  const httpServer = http.createServer(app);
  const io = new IOServer(httpServer, {
    maxHttpBufferSize: 32 * 1024,
    pingInterval: 10000,
    pingTimeout: 8000,
    serveClient: true,
    cors: opts.cors ? { origin: opts.cors } : undefined,
  });

  io.on('connection', (socket) => {
    let joined = false;
    const transport = {
      closed: false,
      send: (event, data) => socket.emit(event, data),
      sendVolatile: (event, data) => socket.volatile.emit(event, data),
      disconnect: () => socket.disconnect(true),
    };
    const helloTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (!joined) socket.disconnect(true);
    }, 15000);

    socket.once('hello', async (payload, ack) => {
      const res = await game.join(socket.id, payload, transport);
      if (typeof ack === 'function') ack(res);
      if (res.ok) {
        joined = true;
        clearTimeout(helloTimer);
        const s = game.players.get(socket.id);
        if (s && s.offlineEarned) {
          game.toast(s, `Your monsters earned ${s.offlineEarned} Money while you were away! Collect it at your base.`, 'good');
          s.offlineEarned = 0;
        }
      } else {
        setTimeout(() => socket.disconnect(true), 200);
      }
    });

    // client -> server messages: exactly the ones the game has handlers for
    // (anything else is ignored)
    for (const type of Object.keys(game.handlers)) {
      socket.on(type, (payload, ack) => {
        if (!joined) return;
        const res = game.handle(socket.id, type, payload);
        if (typeof ack === 'function') ack(res || { ok: true });
      });
    }

    socket.on('disconnect', () => {
      transport.closed = true;
      clearTimeout(helloTimer);
      if (joined) game.leave(socket.id);
    });
  });

  let timer = null;
  if (opts.autoTick !== false) {
    const step = 1000 / CONFIG.tickRate;
    let last = Date.now();
    timer = setInterval(() => {
      const t = Date.now();
      const dt = Math.min(200, t - last);
      last = t;
      try {
        game.tick(dt);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('[game] tick error', e);
      }
    }, step);
  }

  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    httpServer.once('error', reject);
    httpServer.listen(opts.port ?? 3000, opts.host ?? '0.0.0.0', resolve);
  });
  const port = httpServer.address().port;
  log(`STEAL A MONSTER server running on http://localhost:${port}`);
  for (const a of lanAddresses()) log(`  same Wi-Fi: http://${a}:${port}`);

  return {
    app,
    io,
    game,
    httpServer,
    port,
    async close() {
      if (timer) clearInterval(timer);
      io.close();
      await game.shutdown();
      await new Promise((r) => httpServer.close(() => r()));
    },
  };
}

// Token-bucket rate limiter per player and message type.

export class RateLimiter {
  constructor(limits, now) {
    this.limits = limits;
    this.now = now;
    this.buckets = new Map();
    this.dropped = 0;
  }

  allow(type) {
    const rate = this.limits[type] ?? this.limits.default;
    const burst = rate * 2;
    const t = this.now();
    let b = this.buckets.get(type);
    if (!b) {
      b = { tokens: burst, at: t };
      this.buckets.set(type, b);
    }
    b.tokens = Math.min(burst, b.tokens + ((t - b.at) / 1000) * rate);
    b.at = t;
    if (b.tokens < 1) {
      this.dropped++;
      return false;
    }
    b.tokens -= 1;
    return true;
  }
}

FILE: server/services/admin.js

// The admins: the accounts named "daniel", "nadine", "prabu" and "shallom"
// (shared/names.js) run every server.
// In any server he joins he gets the "Player" button: everyone in the server,
// the monsters they stole and from whom, and two actions:
//   return - the stolen monster goes back to its owner (now if they are in
//            this server, otherwise the next time they play)
//   ban    - the thief is kicked and can't come back
// Only a session the server knows is the admin may use these (s.admin is set
// in Game.join from a checked identity, never from what the client says).

import { SPECIES_BY_ID } from '#shared/monsters.js';
import { isObj, int, fail } from '../validate.js';

export class Admin {
  constructor(game) {
    this.game = game;
  }

  handlePlayers(s) {
    if (!s.admin) return fail('not_admin', 'Only the admin can see this.');
    const players = [...this.game.players.values()].map((o) => ({
      pn: o.pn,
      name: o.profile.name,
      level: o.profile.level,
      monsters: o.profile.monsters.length,
      admin: !!o.admin,
      you: o === s,
      stolen: o.profile.monsters.filter((m) => m.origin === 'stolen').map((m) => ({
        ownedId: m.id, species: m.species, level: m.level, from: m.stolenFrom || '?', at: m.obtainedAt,
      })),
    }));
    return { ok: true, players };
  }

  handleReturn(s, p) {
    if (!s.admin) return fail('not_admin', 'Only the admin can do this.');
    if (!isObj(p) || !int(p.pn, 0, 1e6) || typeof p.ownedId !== 'string') return fail('bad');
    const game = this.game;
    const thief = [...game.players.values()].find((o) => o.pn === p.pn);
    if (!thief) return fail('gone', 'That player left.');
    const m = thief.profile.monsters.find((x) => x.id === p.ownedId && x.origin === 'stolen');
    if (!m) return fail('gone', 'That monster is not there any more.');
    if (game.stealing.isAway(m.id)) return fail('busy', 'Someone is stealing it right now. Try again in a moment.');
    // take it from the thief
    thief.profile.monsters = thief.profile.monsters.filter((x) => x !== m);
    const back = {
      id: m.id, species: m.species, level: m.level, obtainedAt: game.now(), origin: 'returned', slot: null, following: false,
    };
    const name = SPECIES_BY_ID[m.species]?.name || 'monster';
    const owner = [...game.players.values()].find((o) => (m.stolenFromId && o.id === m.stolenFromId) || (m.stolenFromAccount && o.account === m.stolenFromAccount));
    let deliver = null;
    if (owner) {
      back.slot = game.bases.freeSlots(owner.profile)[0] ?? null;
      owner.profile.monsters.push(back);
      game.ledger.set(back.id, owner.id, back.species, back.level);
      game.toast(owner, `🛡 The admin returned your stolen ${name}!`, 'good');
      game.refreshPerks(owner);
      game.markProfile(owner);
      game.bases.broadcastBase(owner.baseIndex);
    } else {
      // the owner is not here: it waits for them
      game.ledger.remove(back.id);
      deliver = { account: m.stolenFromAccount || null, profileId: m.stolenFromId || null, owner: m.stolenFrom || '?', monster: back };
      game.deliverLater(deliver);
    }
    game.toast(thief, `🛡 The admin gave the stolen ${name} back to ${m.stolenFrom || 'its owner'}.`, 'warn');
    game.refreshPerks(thief);
    game.markProfile(thief);
    game.bases.broadcastBase(thief.baseIndex);
    game.saveNow(thief, owner);
    game.log(`admin ${s.profile.name} returned ${m.id} from ${thief.profile.name} to ${m.stolenFrom}`);
    return { ok: true, delivered: !!owner, deliver };
  }

  handleBan(s, p) {
    if (!s.admin) return fail('not_admin', 'Only the admin can do this.');
    if (!isObj(p) || !int(p.pn, 0, 1e6)) return fail('bad');
    const game = this.game;
    const target = [...game.players.values()].find((o) => o.pn === p.pn);
    if (!target) return fail('gone', 'That player left.');
    if (target === s || target.admin) return fail('no', 'You cannot ban an admin.');
    const ban = { id: target.id, account: target.account, name: target.profile.name, by: s.profile.name, at: game.now() };
    game.addBan(ban);
    game.broadcast('announce', { text: `🛡 ${target.profile.name} was banned by the admin.`, kind: 'theft' });
    game.kick(target, 'You were banned by the admin.');
    game.log(`admin ${s.profile.name} banned ${ban.name}`);
    return { ok: true, ban: { account: ban.account, name: ban.name } };
  }
}

FILE: server/services/bases.js

// Player bases: plot assignment, monster placement, passive income,
// collecting Money, milestones and the H-key "return to base" teleport.

import { CONFIG } from '#shared/config.js';
import { SPECIES_BY_ID, incomePerSecond } from '#shared/monsters.js';
import { isInsideBase } from '#shared/world.js';
import { isObj, id as isId, int, fail } from '../validate.js';
import { DECOR_BY_ID, DECOR_SPOTS, DECOR_MAX_OWNED, placedCounts } from '#shared/decor.js';
import { MAX_COMPANIONS } from './companions.js';
import { GUARDS, guardLevel } from '#shared/guards.js';

// Collection milestones (different species owned at once).
export const MILESTONES = [
  { id: 'species_3', count: 3, reward: 300, title: 'Monster Friend' },
  { id: 'species_6', count: 6, reward: 1000, title: 'Collector', decor: 'trophy_bronze' },
  { id: 'species_10', count: 10, reward: 4000, gems: 3, title: 'Monster Expert', decor: 'trophy_silver' },
  { id: 'species_20', count: 20, reward: 20000, gems: 10, title: 'Monster Master', decor: 'trophy_gold' },
  { id: 'species_30', count: 30, reward: 80000, gems: 25, title: 'Living Legend' },
];

export class BaseManager {
  constructor(game) {
    this.game = game;
    this.owners = new Array(12).fill(null);   // profile id per plot
    this.lastIncomeAt = game.now();
    this.lastStoredBroadcast = 0;
  }

  assign(pid) {
    const existing = this.owners.indexOf(pid);
    if (existing >= 0) return existing;
    const free = this.owners.indexOf(null);
    if (free < 0 || free >= CONFIG.maxPlayers) return -1;
    this.owners[free] = pid;
    this.game.security.resetBase(free);
    return free;
  }

  release(index) {
    if (index < 0) return;
    this.owners[index] = null;
    this.game.security.resetBase(index);
  }

  ownerSession(index) {
    const pid = this.owners[index];
    return pid ? this.game.byProfile.get(pid) : null;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------- base state

  state(index) {
    const s = this.ownerSession(index);
    if (!s) return { index, empty: true };
    const p = s.profile;
    const stealing = this.game.stealing;
    return {
      index,
      pn: s.pn,
      name: p.name,
      color: p.color,
      level: p.level,
      slots: p.base.slots,
      laserLevel: p.base.laserLevel,
      guardLevel: p.base.guardLevel || 0,
      decor: p.base.decor,
      lockedUntil: this.game.security.lockedUntil[index],
      relockAt: this.game.security.relockAt[index],
      stored: Math.floor(p.storedIncome),
      income: s.income,
      monsters: p.monsters
        .filter((m) => m.slot !== null)
        .map((m) => ({ id: m.id, species: m.species, level: m.level, slot: m.slot, away: stealing.isAway(m.id), income: incomePerSecond(SPECIES_BY_ID[m.species], m.level) })),
    };
  }

  allStates() {
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < this.owners.length; i++) if (this.owners[i]) out.push(this.state(i));
    return out;
  }

  broadcastBase(index) {
    if (index < 0) return;
    this.game.broadcast('base', this.state(index));
  }

  isAtOwnBase(s, margin = 1) {
    const b = this.game.world.bases[s.baseIndex];
    return b && isInsideBase(b, s.pos.x, s.pos.z, margin);
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------- placement

  findOwned(s, ownedId) {
    return isId(ownedId) ? s.profile.monsters.find((m) => m.id === ownedId) : null;
  }

  handlePlace(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || !int(p.slot, 0, CONFIG.bases.maxSlots - 1)) return fail('bad');
    const m = this.findOwned(s, p.ownedId);
    if (!m) return fail('not_owned');
    if (this.game.stealing.isAway(m.id)) return fail('busy', 'That monster is being stolen!');
    if (p.slot >= s.profile.base.slots) return fail('locked_slot', 'Upgrade your base to unlock that pad.');
    if (!this.isAtOwnBase(s, 6)) return fail('not_at_base', 'Go back to your base to place monsters (press H).');
    const other = s.profile.monsters.find((o) => o.slot === p.slot && o !== m);
    if (other) {
      if (this.game.stealing.isAway(other.id)) return fail('busy');
      other.slot = m.slot; // swap (may become unplaced)
    }
    m.slot = p.slot;
    m.following = false;
    m.team = false;
    this.afterPlacementChange(s);
    this.game.tutorialEvent(s, 'place');
    return { ok: true };
  }

  handleUnplace(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p)) return fail('bad');
    const m = this.findOwned(s, p.ownedId);
    if (!m) return fail('not_owned');
    if (this.game.stealing.isAway(m.id)) return fail('busy');
    if (m.slot === null) return { ok: true };
    if (!this.isAtOwnBase(s, 6)) return fail('not_at_base', 'You can only pick up monsters at your base.');
    m.slot = null;
    this.afterPlacementChange(s);
    return { ok: true };
  }

  handleFollow(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p)) return fail('bad');
    const m = this.findOwned(s, p.ownedId);
    if (!m) return fail('not_owned');
    if (this.game.stealing.isAway(m.id)) return fail('busy');
    const want = p.follow !== false;
    if (want && !m.following) {
      const n = s.profile.monsters.filter((o) => o.following && o.slot === null).length;
      if (n >= MAX_COMPANIONS) return fail('too_many', `You can bring up to ${MAX_COMPANIONS} monsters. Send one home first.`);
    }
    if (want && m.slot !== null) {
      if (!this.isAtOwnBase(s, 6)) return fail('not_at_base', 'Pick it up at your base first.');
      m.slot = null;
    }
    m.following = want;
    // chosen for your team: it stays with you even when you go home
    // (a freshly recruited follower moves into the base instead)
    m.team = want;
    this.afterPlacementChange(s);
    return { ok: true };
  }

  handleRelease(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || p.confirm !== true) return fail('bad');
    const m = this.findOwned(s, p.ownedId);
    if (!m) return fail('not_owned');
    if (this.game.stealing.isAway(m.id)) return fail('busy');
    s.profile.monsters = s.profile.monsters.filter((o) => o !== m);
    this.game.ledger.remove(m.id);
    this.afterPlacementChange(s);
    this.game.saveNow(s);
    return { ok: true };
  }

  // Guards: 420,000,000 for the first two, then upgrades up to level 10.
  handleBuyGuards(s, p) {
    const cached = isObj(p) ? s.recall(p.reqId) : undefined;
    if (cached) return cached;
    if (!this.isAtOwnBase(s, 8)) return fail('not_at_base', 'Buy guards at your own base.');
    const level = s.profile.base.guardLevel || 0;
    if (level >= GUARDS.maxLevel) return fail('max', 'Your guards are already at the top level (10)!');
    const price = level === 0 ? GUARDS.buyPrice : GUARDS.upgradePrice(level);
    if (!this.game.economy.debit(s, price, `guards:${level + 1}`)) return fail('money', `You need ${price.toLocaleString('en-US')} Money.`);
    s.profile.base.guardLevel = level + 1;
    this.game.markProfile(s);
    this.game.saveNow(s);
    this.broadcastBase(s.baseIndex);
    const L = guardLevel(level + 1);
    const res = { ok: true, level: level + 1, guards: L.guards, helis: L.helis, money: s.profile.money };
    return isObj(p) ? s.remember(p.reqId, res) : res;
  }

  afterPlacementChange(s) {
    this.game.refreshPerks(s);
    this.game.markProfile(s);
    this.broadcastBase(s.baseIndex);
  }

  freeSlots(profile) {
    const used = new Set(profile.monsters.filter((m) => m.slot !== null).map((m) => m.slot));
    const out = [];
