    for (let i = 0; i < profile.base.slots; i++) if (!used.has(i)) out.push(i);
    return out;
  }

  // Monsters that came home with you hop onto free pads automatically.
  autoPlace(s) {
    const free = this.freeSlots(s.profile);
    const placed = [];
    for (const m of s.profile.monsters) {
      if (m.slot !== null || !free.length || this.game.stealing.isAway(m.id) || (m.following && m.team)) continue;
      m.slot = free.shift();
      m.following = false;
      m.team = false;
      placed.push(m);
    }
    if (placed.length) {
      this.afterPlacementChange(s);
      this.game.tutorialEvent(s, 'place');
      const names = placed.map((m) => SPECIES_BY_ID[m.species].name).join(', ');
      this.game.toast(s, `${names} moved into your base!`, 'good');
    }
    return placed;
  }

  onEnterOwnBase(s) {
    this.autoPlace(s);
  }

  checkMilestones(s) {
    const n = Object.keys(s.profile.discoveries.species).length;
    const owned = new Set(s.profile.monsters.map((m) => m.species)).size;
    for (const ms of MILESTONES) {
      if (s.profile.milestones[ms.id] || Math.max(owned, 0) < ms.count) continue;
      s.profile.milestones[ms.id] = this.game.now();
      this.game.economy.credit(s, ms.reward, 'milestone');
      if (ms.gems) this.game.economy.creditGems(s, ms.gems, 'milestone');
      if (ms.decor) s.profile.decor.owned[ms.decor] = Math.min(DECOR_MAX_OWNED, (s.profile.decor.owned[ms.decor] || 0) + 1);
      this.game.send(s, 'milestone', { title: ms.title, count: ms.count, reward: ms.reward, gems: ms.gems || 0, decor: ms.decor || null });
    }
    return n;
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------- decorations

  // Buying happens at your own base (the upgrade terminal's catalog).
  handleBuyDecor(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || !isId(p.decorId)) return fail('bad');
    const cached = s.recall(p.reqId);
    if (cached) return cached;
    const d = DECOR_BY_ID[p.decorId];
    if (!d) return fail('unknown_decor');
    if (d.milestone) return fail('not_for_sale', 'Trophies are earned with collection milestones.');
    if (!this.isAtOwnBase(s, 1)) return fail('not_at_base', 'Buy decorations at your base. Press H to go home.');
    const owned = s.profile.decor.owned;
    if ((owned[d.id] || 0) >= DECOR_MAX_OWNED) return fail('full', `You can own at most ${DECOR_MAX_OWNED}.`);
    if (!this.game.economy.pay(s, d.price, d.gems, `decor:${d.id}`)) return this.game.economy.shortfall(s, d.price, d.gems);
    owned[d.id] = (owned[d.id] || 0) + 1;
    // put it on the first free spot right away
    const spot = s.profile.base.decor.indexOf(null);
    if (spot >= 0) s.profile.base.decor[spot] = d.id;
    this.game.saveNow(s);
    this.broadcastBase(s.baseIndex);
    return s.remember(p.reqId, { ok: true, decor: d.id, spot, money: s.profile.money, gems: s.profile.gems });
  }

  // Put an owned decoration on a spot (or clear the spot with decorId null).
  handlePlaceDecor(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || !int(p.spot, 0, DECOR_SPOTS - 1)) return fail('bad');
    if (p.decorId !== null && !isId(p.decorId)) return fail('bad');
    if (!this.isAtOwnBase(s, 1)) return fail('not_at_base', 'Decorate at your base. Press H to go home.');
    const placed = s.profile.base.decor;
    if (p.decorId !== null) {
      const d = DECOR_BY_ID[p.decorId];
      if (!d) return fail('unknown_decor');
      const owned = s.profile.decor.owned[d.id] || 0;
      if (!owned) return fail('not_owned', `You don't own a ${d.name} yet.`);
      if (placed[p.spot] === d.id) return { ok: true };
      // every copy is already out: move one from another spot
      if ((placedCounts(placed)[d.id] || 0) >= owned) placed[placed.findIndex((id, i) => id === d.id && i !== p.spot)] = null;
    }
    placed[p.spot] = p.decorId;
    this.game.markProfile(s);
    this.broadcastBase(s.baseIndex);
    return { ok: true };
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------- income

  incomeCap(s) {
    return Math.max(100, s.income * CONFIG.bases.incomeAccumulateCap);
  }

  applyOfflineIncome(s, now) {
    const p = s.profile;
    const ms = Math.min(Math.max(0, now - p.lastSeen), CONFIG.bases.offlineIncomeMaxHours * 3600e3);
    const earned = Math.floor((s.income * ms) / 1000 * CONFIG.bases.offlineIncomeRate);
    if (earned > 0) {
      p.storedIncome = Math.min(this.incomeCap(s), p.storedIncome + earned);
      s.offlineEarned = earned;
    }
  }

  handleCollect(s) {
    if (!this.isAtOwnBase(s, 1)) return fail('not_at_base', 'Collect at your base.');
    return this.collect(s);
  }

  collect(s) {
    const p = s.profile;
    const amount = Math.floor(p.storedIncome);
    if (amount <= 0) return { ok: true, amount: 0 };
    p.storedIncome -= amount;
    this.game.economy.credit(s, amount, 'income');
    this.game.send(s, 'collected', { amount });
    this.game.tutorialEvent(s, 'collect');
    this.broadcastBase(s.baseIndex);
    return { ok: true, amount };
  }

  // Stepping on your own pads (collector, lock button).
  checkPads(s) {
    if (s.dead || s.baseIndex < 0 || !s.inBases.has(s.baseIndex)) return;
    const b = this.game.world.bases[s.baseIndex];
    const now = this.game.now();
    const near = (p, r) => (s.pos.x - p.x) ** 2 + (s.pos.z - p.z) ** 2 < r * r;
    if (near(b.collector, 2.8) && now - s.lastCollectAt > 800) {
      s.lastCollectAt = now;
      this.collect(s);
    }
    if (near(b.lockPad, 2.2) && !this.game.security.isLocked(s.baseIndex) && now >= (s.lockPadReadyAt || 0)) {
      s.lockPadReadyAt = now + 1500;
      this.game.security.lock(s);
    }
  }

  tick(dt, now) {
    if (now - this.lastIncomeAt >= 1000) {
      const secs = Math.min(5, (now - this.lastIncomeAt) / 1000);
      this.lastIncomeAt = now;
      for (const s of this.game.players.values()) {
        if (s.income <= 0) continue;
        const p = s.profile;
        p.storedIncome = Math.min(this.incomeCap(s), p.storedIncome + s.income * secs);
        s.saveDirty = true;
      }
    }
    if (now - this.lastStoredBroadcast >= 2000) {
      this.lastStoredBroadcast = now;
      const list = [];
      for (const s of this.game.players.values()) list.push([s.baseIndex, Math.floor(s.profile.storedIncome)]);
      if (list.length) this.game.broadcast('baseStored', list);
    }
  }

  // ----------------------------------------------------------- H key

  handleHome(s) {
    const game = this.game;
    const now = game.now();
    const cfg = CONFIG.homeTeleport;
    if (s.dead) return fail('dead');
    if (s.fx.frozenUntil > now || s.fx.rootedUntil > now) return fail('stuck', 'You are stuck!');
    if (now < s.homeReadyAt) return fail('cooldown', `Home teleport ready in ${Math.ceil((s.homeReadyAt - now) / 1000)}s`);
    if (s.carrying && !cfg.allowWhileCarrying) return fail('carrying', 'You cannot teleport while carrying a stolen monster — run!');
    if (cfg.allowInCombatMs > 0 && now - s.lastDamagedAt < cfg.allowInCombatMs) return fail('combat', 'You cannot teleport during a fight.');
    const b = game.world.bases[s.baseIndex];
    if (!b) return fail('no_base');
    game.stealing.cancelPending(s);
    s.homeReadyAt = now + cfg.cooldownMs;
    game.teleport(s, b.spawn.x, b.y, b.spawn.z, 'home', b.yaw);
    game.markProfile(s);
    return { ok: true, readyAt: s.homeReadyAt };
  }
}

FILE: server/services/combat.js

// Sword combat (player -> monster) and damage to players (monster -> player).
//
// Clients only say "I swung my sword facing this way". The server decides
// which monsters are in reach (using the server's own positions), applies
// cooldowns, rolls damage and crits, and owns all health values.

import { CONFIG } from '#shared/config.js';
import { SWORD_BY_ID } from '#shared/weapons.js';
import { LEGEND_MOVES } from '#shared/costumes.js';
import { isObj, finite, fail } from '../validate.js';

const DEG = Math.PI / 180;

export class Combat {
  constructor(game) {
    this.game = game;
  }

  canAct(s, now) {
    return !s.dead && s.fx.frozenUntil <= now && s.fx.stunUntil <= now && s.fx.slipUntil <= now;
  }

  handleAttack(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || !finite(p.yaw, -100, 100)) return fail('bad');
    const game = this.game;
    const now = game.now();
    if (!this.canAct(s, now)) return fail('cant_act');
    const sword = SWORD_BY_ID[s.profile.sword];
    // small tolerance for network jitter, never more than ~15% faster
    if (now - s.lastAttackAt < sword.cooldownMs * 0.85) return fail('cooldown');
    s.lastAttackAt = now;
    if (now - s.combo.at < CONFIG.combat.comboWindowMs) s.combo.count++;
    else s.combo.count = 1;
    s.combo.at = now;
    const comboHit = s.combo.count % 3 === 0;
    s.yaw = p.yaw;
    // the Legend Master goes through 10 different sword moves, then again
    s.moveIdx = ((s.moveIdx ?? -1) + 1) % LEGEND_MOVES;
    game.broadcastNear(s.pos.x, s.pos.z, 120, 'swing', { pn: s.pn, combo: comboHit, move: s.moveIdx }, s);

    const reach = sword.range + CONFIG.player.radius + CONFIG.combat.rangeTolerance;
    const targets = game.monsters.findInArc(s.pos, p.yaw, reach, sword.arc + 20, sword.maxTargets, s);
    const hits = [];
    for (const m of targets) hits.push(this.hitMonster(s, m, sword, comboHit, 1, now));
    const sp = sword.special;
    if (sp && sp.kind === 'chain' && targets.length) {
      const extra = game.monsters.nearestTo(targets[0], sp.range, new Set(targets), s);
      if (extra) hits.push(this.hitMonster(s, extra, sword, false, sp.share, now, true));
    }
    // Galaxy Sword: every third hit sets off a star nova around the target
    let nova = null;
    if (sp && sp.kind === 'nova' && comboHit && targets.length) {
      const c = targets[0];
      nova = { x: Math.round(c.x * 10) / 10, z: Math.round(c.z * 10) / 10, r: sp.radius };
      const done = new Set(targets);
      for (let i = 0; i < sp.maxTargets; i++) {
        const m = game.monsters.nearestTo(c, sp.radius, done, s);
        if (!m) break;
        done.add(m);
        const h = this.hitMonster(s, m, sword, false, sp.share, now, true);
        h.fx = 'nova';
        hits.push(h);
      }
    }
    // base guards of other players are hit like monsters
    for (const t of game.guards.findInArc(s, p.yaw, reach, sword.arc + 20, Math.max(0, sword.maxTargets - targets.length))) {
      const c = CONFIG.combat;
      let dmg = sword.damage * (1 + (s.perks?.damage || 0)) * (1 - c.damageVariance + game.rng() * c.damageVariance * 2);
      const crit = game.rng() < c.critChance + (sword.special?.kind === 'crit' ? sword.special.chance : 0);
      if (crit) dmg *= c.critMultiplier;
      if (comboHit) dmg *= 1 + c.comboBonus;
      hits.push(game.guards.hit(s, t, Math.max(1, Math.round(dmg)), crit));
    }
    if (hits.length) game.broadcastNear(s.pos.x, s.pos.z, 140, 'hits', { pn: s.pn, hits, nova });
    // swinging at a lucky block opens it too
    if (!hits.length) game.lucky.trySwing(s, p.yaw);
    return { ok: true, hits: hits.length, move: s.moveIdx };
  }

  hitMonster(s, m, sword, comboHit, mult, now, chained = false) {
    const c = CONFIG.combat;
    const sp = sword.special || {};
    let dmg = sword.damage * mult * (1 + (s.perks?.damage || 0));
    dmg *= 1 - c.damageVariance + this.game.rng() * c.damageVariance * 2;
    let critChance = c.critChance + (sp.kind === 'crit' ? sp.chance : 0) + (sp.kind === 'celestial' ? sp.crit : 0);
    const crit = this.game.rng() < critChance;
    if (crit) dmg *= c.critMultiplier;
    if (comboHit) dmg *= 1 + c.comboBonus;
    // the special effect of this hit (shown by the client)
    let fx = null;
    if (sp.kind === 'jackpot' && !chained && this.game.rng() < sp.chance) {
      dmg *= sp.mult;
      fx = 'jackpot';
    }
    let rainbow = -1;
    if (sp.kind === 'rainbow' && !chained) {
      rainbow = s.rainbowStep = ((s.rainbowStep || 0) + 1) % 3;
      if (rainbow === 2) dmg *= 1 + sp.bonus;
      fx = ['rainbow_fire', 'rainbow_ice', 'rainbow_star'][rainbow];
    }
    dmg *= 100 / (100 + m.def * 3);
    dmg = Math.max(1, Math.round(dmg));
    const monsters = this.game.monsters;
    if (sp.kind === 'burn') m.burn = { dps: sword.damage * sp.dps, until: now + sp.durationMs, by: s, acc: 0 };
    if (rainbow === 0) m.burn = { dps: sword.damage * sp.burnDps, until: now + sp.burnMs, by: s, acc: 0 };
    if (sp.kind === 'slow' || rainbow === 1) {
      m.slowUntil = Math.max(m.slowUntil, now + (sp.durationMs || sp.slowMs));
      if (!fx) fx = 'slow';
    }
    if (sp.kind === 'freeze' && !m.species.ai.boss && this.game.rng() < sp.chance) {
      m.stunnedUntil = Math.max(m.stunnedUntil, now + sp.durationMs);
      fx = 'freeze';
    }
    if (sp.kind === 'cleave') monsters.knockback(m, s.pos, sp.knockback);
    if (comboHit && !m.species.ai.boss) m.stunnedUntil = Math.max(m.stunnedUntil, now + 450);
    this.game.companions.noteThreat(s, m.id); // your companions join in
    if (sp.kind === 'lifesteal') this.heal(s, dmg * sp.share);
    if (sp.kind === 'celestial') this.heal(s, dmg * sp.heal);
    monsters.damage(m, dmg, s, { crit });
    return { id: m.id, dmg, crit, combo: comboHit, chain: chained, fx, hp: Math.round((100 * m.hp) / m.maxHp) };
  }

  heal(s, amount) {
    if (s.dead) return;
    s.hp = Math.min(s.maxHp, s.hp + amount);
  }

  handleDodge(s) {
    const now = this.game.now();
    if (!this.canAct(s, now) || s.fx.rootedUntil > now) return fail('cant_act');
    if (now < s.dodgeReadyAt) return fail('cooldown');
    s.dodgeUntil = now + CONFIG.player.dodgeMs;
    s.dodgeReadyAt = now + CONFIG.player.dodgeCooldownMs;
    this.game.broadcastNear(s.pos.x, s.pos.z, 120, 'dodge', { pn: s.pn }, s);
    return { ok: true, until: s.dodgeUntil };
  }

  // Damage a player. opts: { from (monster id), kb: {x, z, up}, effect, power }
  damagePlayer(s, raw, opts = {}) {
    const game = this.game;
    const now = game.now();
    if (s.dead) return { blocked: 'dead' };
    // attacked (even if it misses): your companions go for it
    if (typeof opts.from === 'number') game.companions.noteThreat(s, opts.from);
    if (s.protectUntil > now) return { blocked: 'protected' };
    if (s.dodgeUntil > now) {
      game.send(s, 'dodged', { from: opts.from });
      return { blocked: 'dodge' };
    }
    const dmg = Math.max(1, Math.round(raw));
    s.hp -= dmg;
    s.lastDamagedAt = now;
    const fx = s.fx;
    switch (opts.effect) {
      case 'burn': fx.burnUntil = now + 3000; fx.burnDps = Math.max(fx.burnDps, raw * 0.15); break;
      case 'slow': fx.slowUntil = now + 2500; fx.slowFactor = 0.6; break;
      case 'freeze': fx.frozenUntil = Math.max(fx.frozenUntil, now + 900); break;
      case 'stun': fx.stunUntil = Math.max(fx.stunUntil, now + 800); break;
      default: break;
    }
    if (opts.kb) {
      s.knockbackUntil = now + CONFIG.movement.knockbackAllowanceMs;
      game.send(s, 'knock', { x: opts.kb.x, z: opts.kb.z, up: opts.kb.up || 4 });
    }
    game.send(s, 'hurt', { dmg, hp: Math.max(0, Math.round(s.hp)), maxHp: s.maxHp, from: opts.from, effect: opts.effect || null });
    if (s.hp <= 0) this.killPlayer(s, opts);
    return { dmg };
  }

  killPlayer(s, opts = {}) {
    const game = this.game;
    const now = game.now();
    s.hp = 0;
    s.dead = true;
    s.respawnAt = now + CONFIG.player.respawnMs;
    s.profile.stats.deaths++;
    s.fx.burnUntil = 0;
    game.stealing.interrupt(s, 'defeated');
    game.stealing.cancelPending(s);
    game.markProfile(s);
    game.broadcast('playerDown', { pn: s.pn, by: opts.from ?? null, respawnAt: s.respawnAt });
  }

  respawn(s) {
    const game = this.game;
    const now = game.now();
    const base = game.world.bases[s.baseIndex];
    s.dead = false;
    s.hp = s.maxHp;
    s.protectUntil = now + CONFIG.player.spawnProtectionMs;
    s.fx.frozenUntil = s.fx.rootedUntil = s.fx.slowUntil = s.fx.stunUntil = s.fx.slipUntil = s.fx.burnUntil = 0;
    game.teleport(s, base.spawn.x, base.y, base.spawn.z, 'respawn', base.yaw);
    game.broadcast('playerUp', { pn: s.pn });
  }

  tick(dt, now) {
    const P = CONFIG.player;
    for (const s of this.game.players.values()) {
      if (s.dead) {
        if (now >= s.respawnAt) this.respawn(s);
        continue;
      }
      // burning
      if (s.fx.burnUntil > now) {
        s.burnAcc = (s.burnAcc || 0) + s.fx.burnDps * dt;
        if (s.burnAcc >= 3) {
          const d = Math.floor(s.burnAcc);
          s.burnAcc -= d;
          this.damagePlayer(s, d, { effect: null });
        }
      }
      // lava pools
      if (this.game.world.isLava(s.pos.x, s.pos.z, s.pos.y)) {
        s.lavaAcc = (s.lavaAcc || 0) + P.lavaDps * dt;
        if (s.lavaAcc >= 5) {
          const d = Math.floor(s.lavaAcc);
          s.lavaAcc -= d;
          this.damagePlayer(s, d, { effect: 'burn', kb: { x: 0, z: 0, up: 9 } });
        }
      }
      if (s.dead) continue;
      // natural regeneration out of combat
      if (now - s.lastDamagedAt > P.regenDelayMs && s.hp < s.maxHp) {
        s.hp = Math.min(s.maxHp, s.hp + s.maxHp * P.regenPerSecond * (1 + (s.perks?.regen || 0)) * dt);
      }
    }
  }
}

export function angleDiff(a, b) {
  let d = (a - b) % (Math.PI * 2);
  if (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2;
  if (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2;
  return Math.abs(d);
}

export { DEG };

FILE: server/services/companions.js

// Companions: up to five of your monsters walk with you (owned monsters with
// following = true and no base pad). The server moves them, so everybody
// sees the same thing and their hits are real:
//   - they keep a little formation behind you,
//   - when a wild monster hits you, or you hit one, or one is about to
//     attack you, they run over and attack it with you,
//   - one that ends up more than "9 feet" (7.5 m) away while not fighting
//     pops back to your side (X calls all of them at once),
//   - they cannot be hurt and never fight other players.
// They are sent in the monster snapshot with the ALLY flag and their
// owner's player number, so the client draws them with the monster renderer.

import { SPECIES_BY_ID, SPECIES_INDEX, monsterStats } from '#shared/monsters.js';
import { WATER_Y } from '#shared/world.js';
import { fail } from '../validate.js';
import { MS } from './monsterAI.js';

export const MAX_COMPANIONS = 5;
export const ALLY_FLAG = 256;
export const COMPANION = {
  teleportDist: 7.5,   // ~9 feet: farther than this (not fighting) -> back to your side
  fightLeash: 24,      // while fighting they may chase this far from you
  threatMs: 8000,      // how long a monster that hit you (or you hit) stays a target
  callCooldownMs: 1000,
};
const ID_BASE = 1_000_000_000;
const SLOTS = [[0, 3.2], [-0.75, 3.8], [0.75, 3.8], [-1.35, 4.9], [1.35, 4.9]];
const FLYERS = new Set(['fly', 'flutter', 'serpent', 'float']);

export class Companions {
  constructor(game) {
    this.game = game;
    this.nextId = 1;
    this.think = 0;
  }

  followers(s) {
    return s.profile.monsters.filter((m) => m.following && m.slot === null).slice(0, MAX_COMPANIONS);
  }

  // Keeps s.allies in step with the monsters the player brings along.
  sync(s) {
    const want = this.followers(s);
    if (!s.allies) s.allies = new Map();
    const keep = new Set(want.map((m) => m.id));
    for (const [oid, a] of s.allies) {
      if (!keep.has(oid) || this.game.stealing.isAway(oid)) {
        s.allies.delete(oid);
        this.game.broadcastNear(a.x, a.z, 160, 'mGone', { id: a.id, reason: 'home' });
      }
    }
    want.forEach((m, i) => {
      if (this.game.stealing.isAway(m.id)) return;
      let a = s.allies.get(m.id);
      if (!a || a.level !== m.level) {
        if (a) this.game.broadcastNear(a.x, a.z, 160, 'mGone', { id: a.id, reason: 'home' });
        a = this.create(s, m, i);
        s.allies.set(m.id, a);
      }
      a.slotIndex = i;
    });
  }

  create(s, owned, i) {
    const sp = SPECIES_BY_ID[owned.species];
    const st = monsterStats(sp, owned.level);
    const slot = this.slotPos(s, i);
    const a = {
      id: ID_BASE + this.nextId++,
      ownedId: owned.id,
      sp,
      idx: SPECIES_INDEX[sp.id],
      level: owned.level,
      atk: st.atk,
      // they are drawn a little smaller than the wild giants (see client)
      radius: 0.75 * Math.min(sp.size, 1.6),
      fly: FLYERS.has(sp.ai.move),
      x: slot.x,
      z: slot.z,
      y: s.pos.y,
      yaw: s.yaw,
      state: MS.idle,
      target: null,
      attack: null,
      readyAt: 0,
      farSince: 0,
      slotIndex: i,
    };
    a.y = this.heightAt(s, a, a.x, a.z);
    return a;
  }

  slotPos(s, i) {
    const [da, d] = SLOTS[i % SLOTS.length];
    const ang = s.yaw + Math.PI + da;
    return { x: s.pos.x + Math.sin(ang) * d, z: s.pos.z + Math.cos(ang) * d };
  }

  heightAt(s, a, x, z) {
    const world = this.game.world;
    let g = world.surfaceHeight(x, z, s.pos.y + 1);
    // over a gap (floating platforms, a tower floor's edge) they keep to your height
    if (g < s.pos.y - 3.5) g = s.pos.y;
    if (!a.fly) g = Math.max(g, WATER_Y - 0.5);
    return a.fly ? Math.max(g, WATER_Y) + 1.4 : g;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ threats

  // A wild monster hit the player, or the player hit it.
  noteThreat(s, monsterId) {
    if (!s.threats) s.threats = new Map();
    s.threats.set(monsterId, this.game.now());
  }

  threatsOf(s, now) {
    const out = [];
    const monsters = this.game.monsters;
    if (s.threats) {
      for (const [id, at] of s.threats) {
        const m = monsters.get(id);
        if (!m || now - at > COMPANION.threatMs || !monsters.isAlive(m)) {
          s.threats.delete(id);
          continue;
        }
        out.push(m);
      }
    }
    // and monsters going for you right now
    for (const m of monsters.list.values()) {
      if (m.target !== s.pn || !monsters.isAlive(m) || out.includes(m)) continue;
      if ((m.x - s.pos.x) ** 2 + (m.z - s.pos.z) ** 2 < 16 * 16) out.push(m);
    }
    return out.filter((m) => monsters.canHit(s, m) && (m.x - s.pos.x) ** 2 + (m.z - s.pos.z) ** 2 < COMPANION.fightLeash ** 2);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ handlers

  handleCall(s) {
    const now = this.game.now();
    this.sync(s);
    if (!s.allies.size) return fail('none', 'No monsters are following you. Open one in your collection and press "Bring along".');
    if (now < (s.callReadyAt || 0)) return fail('cooldown');
    s.callReadyAt = now + COMPANION.callCooldownMs;
    let n = 0;
    for (const a of s.allies.values()) {
      a.target = null;
      a.attack = null;
      this.poof(s, a);
      n++;
    }
    return { ok: true, count: n };
  }

  poof(s, a) {
    const p = this.slotPos(s, a.slotIndex);
    a.x = p.x;
    a.z = p.z;
    a.y = this.heightAt(s, a, a.x, a.z);
    a.yaw = s.yaw;
    a.farSince = 0;
    a.state = MS.idle;
    this.game.broadcastNear(a.x, a.z, 160, 'allyPoof', { id: a.id, x: Math.round(a.x * 10) / 10, y: Math.round(a.y * 10) / 10, z: Math.round(a.z * 10) / 10 });
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ simulation

  tick(dt, now) {
    this.think = (this.think + 1) % 4;
    for (const s of this.game.players.values()) {
      if (this.think === 0 || !s.allies) this.sync(s);
      if (!s.allies.size) continue;
      const threats = this.think === 0 || !s.threatCache ? (s.threatCache = this.threatsOf(s, now)) : s.threatCache;
      for (const a of s.allies.values()) this.update(s, a, threats, dt, now);
    }
  }

  update(s, a, threats, dt, now) {
    const monsters = this.game.monsters;
    // owner knocked out or gone far away (home, a portal...): straight back
    const dOwner = Math.hypot(a.x - s.pos.x, a.z - s.pos.z);
    if (s.dead) {
      a.target = null;
      a.attack = null;
      a.state = MS.idle;
      return;
    }
    if (dOwner > 60 || Math.abs(a.y - s.pos.y) > 12) {
      a.target = null;
      a.attack = null;
      this.poof(s, a);
      return;
    }
    // an attack in progress
    if (a.attack) {
      const m = a.target;
      if (a.attack.phase === 'windup' && now >= a.attack.hitAt) {
        if (m && monsters.isAlive(m)) this.strike(s, a, m);
        a.attack.phase = 'strike';
        a.state = MS.strike;
      }
      if (now >= a.attack.endAt) {
        a.attack = null;
        a.state = MS.chase;
      }
      return;
    }
    // pick or keep a target
    if (a.target && (!monsters.isAlive(a.target) || !monsters.list.has(a.target.id) || !threats.includes(a.target))) a.target = null;
    if (!a.target && threats.length) {
      let best = null;
      let bd = Infinity;
      for (const m of threats) {
        const d = (m.x - a.x) ** 2 + (m.z - a.z) ** 2;
        if (d < bd) {
          bd = d;
          best = m;
        }
      }
      a.target = best;
    }
    if (a.target) {
      const m = a.target;
      if (dOwner > COMPANION.fightLeash) {
        a.target = null;
        this.poof(s, a);
        return;
      }
      const dx = m.x - a.x;
      const dz = m.z - a.z;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
      const reach = m.radius + a.radius + 1.4;
      a.yaw = Math.atan2(dx, dz);
      if (d > reach) {
        this.moveToward(s, a, m.x - (dx / d) * (reach - 0.6), m.z - (dz / d) * (reach - 0.6), 22, dt);
        a.state = MS.chase;
      } else if (now >= a.readyAt) {
        this.startAttack(s, a, m, now);
      } else a.state = MS.idle;
      a.farSince = 0;
      return;
    }
    // follow in formation
    const slot = this.slotPos(s, a.slotIndex);
    const ds = Math.hypot(slot.x - a.x, slot.z - a.z);
    if (ds > 0.5) {
      this.moveToward(s, a, slot.x, slot.z, Math.min(30, 4 + ds * 4), dt);
      a.state = ds > 3 ? MS.chase : MS.wander;
    } else {
      a.state = MS.idle;
      let dy = s.yaw - a.yaw;
      while (dy > Math.PI) dy -= Math.PI * 2;
      while (dy < -Math.PI) dy += Math.PI * 2;
      a.yaw += dy * Math.min(1, dt * 3);
    }
    // too far from you ("9 feet") for a moment: pop back
    if (Math.hypot(a.x - s.pos.x, a.z - s.pos.z) > COMPANION.teleportDist) {
      if (!a.farSince) a.farSince = now;
      else if (now - a.farSince > 450) this.poof(s, a);
    } else a.farSince = 0;
  }

  moveToward(s, a, tx, tz, speed, dt) {
    const dx = tx - a.x;
    const dz = tz - a.z;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    if (d < 1e-3) return;
    const step = Math.min(d, speed * dt);
    a.x += (dx / d) * step;
    a.z += (dz / d) * step;
    a.yaw = Math.atan2(dx, dz);
    a.y = this.heightAt(s, a, a.x, a.z);
  }

  startAttack(s, a, m, now) {
    const i = Math.max(0, a.sp.attacks.findIndex((x) => x.kind === 'melee' || x.kind === 'slam'));
    const atk = a.sp.attacks[i];
    const kind = atk.kind === 'slam' || atk.kind === 'breath' ? atk.kind : 'melee';
    const windupMs = 320;
    a.attack = { phase: 'windup', i, hitAt: now + windupMs, endAt: now + windupMs + 380 };
    a.readyAt = now + 1300 + Math.floor(this.game.rng() * 300);
    a.state = MS.windup;
    this.game.broadcastNear(a.x, a.z, 140, 'mAttack', { id: a.id, i, kind, windupMs, tx: Math.round(m.x * 10) / 10, tz: Math.round(m.z * 10) / 10, ally: true });
  }

  strike(s, a, m) {
    const game = this.game;
    const atk = a.sp.attacks[a.attack.i];
    let dmg = a.atk * 1.5 * Math.min(1.6, atk.power || 1) * (0.9 + game.rng() * 0.2);
    dmg *= 100 / (100 + m.def * 3);
    dmg = Math.max(1, Math.round(dmg));
    game.broadcastNear(a.x, a.z, 140, 'mStrike', { id: a.id, i: a.attack.i, ally: true });
    game.monsters.damage(m, dmg, s, { ally: true });
    game.broadcastNear(m.x, m.z, 140, 'hits', { pn: s.pn, ally: a.id, hits: [{ id: m.id, dmg, hp: Math.round((100 * m.hp) / m.maxHp), ally: true }] });
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ snapshots

  snapshotFor(viewer, out, radius) {
    const r1 = (v) => Math.round(v * 10) / 10;
    for (const s of this.game.players.values()) {
      if (!s.allies || s.dead) continue;
      for (const a of s.allies.values()) {
        if ((a.x - viewer.pos.x) ** 2 + (a.z - viewer.pos.z) ** 2 > radius * radius) continue;
        out.push([a.id, a.idx, r1(a.x), r1(a.y), r1(a.z), Math.round(a.yaw * 100) / 100, a.state, 100, a.level, ALLY_FLAG, 0, s.pn]);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  onLeave(s) {
    if (!s.allies) return;
    for (const a of s.allies.values()) this.game.broadcastNear(a.x, a.z, 160, 'mGone', { id: a.id, reason: 'home' });
    s.allies.clear();
  }
}

FILE: server/services/costumes.js

// Costumes and their master powers (shared/costumes.js).
//
//   buyCostume  - at the Costume Shop; the Black Spy also gives the Spy Sword
//   equipCostume - put one on (or take it off with id null)
//   buyPower    - at the "Upgrade your power" shop: +130 power per level
//   power (Z)   - the worn costume's master power, with a cooldown. It hits
//                 monsters only, for exactly its damage (583 for the Black
//                 Spy, plus 130 per upgrade level).

import { COSTUME_BY_ID, POWER_UPGRADE, LEGEND_POWERS, powerDamage, costumeWithPower } from '#shared/costumes.js';
import { SWORD_BY_ID } from '#shared/weapons.js';
import { isObj, id as isId, finite, fail } from '../validate.js';

export class CostumeShop {
  constructor(game) {
    this.game = game;
  }

  handleBuy(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || !isId(p.id)) return fail('bad');
    const cached = s.recall(p.reqId);
    if (cached) return cached;
    const c = COSTUME_BY_ID[p.id];
    if (!c) return fail('unknown');
    const prof = s.profile;
    if (prof.costumes.owned.includes(c.id)) return s.remember(p.reqId, fail('owned', 'You already own this costume.'));
    const eco = this.game.economy;
    if (!eco.nearShop(s, 'costumes')) return fail('not_at_shop', 'Visit the Costume Shop in the plaza.');
    if (!eco.debit(s, c.price, `costume:${c.id}`)) return fail('money', `You need ${c.price.toLocaleString('en-US')} Money.`);
    prof.costumes.owned.push(c.id);
    prof.costumes.equipped = c.id;
    if (c.sword && SWORD_BY_ID[c.sword] && !prof.swords.includes(c.sword)) {
      prof.swords.push(c.sword);
      prof.sword = c.sword;
    }
    this.game.markProfile(s);
    this.game.saveNow(s);
    this.game.broadcast('playerInfo', this.game.playerInfo(s));
    this.game.broadcast('announce', { text: `${prof.name} is now a ${c.name}! ${c.icon}`, kind: 'rare' });
    return s.remember(p.reqId, { ok: true, costume: c.id, sword: c.sword || null, money: prof.money });
  }

  // Legend Master: choose (or change) its power.
  handleChoosePower(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || typeof p.power !== 'string' || !LEGEND_POWERS[p.power]) return fail('bad', 'Unknown power.');
    if (!s.profile.costumes.owned.includes('legend_master')) return fail('not_owned', 'Buy the Legend Master first.');
    s.profile.costumes.power = p.power;
    this.game.markProfile(s);
    this.game.broadcast('playerInfo', this.game.playerInfo(s));
    return { ok: true, power: p.power };
  }

  handleEquip(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p)) return fail('bad');
    const id = p.id === null ? null : p.id;
    if (id !== null && !s.profile.costumes.owned.includes(id)) return fail('not_owned');
    s.profile.costumes.equipped = id;
    this.game.markProfile(s);
    this.game.broadcast('playerInfo', this.game.playerInfo(s));
    return { ok: true };
  }

  handleBuyPower(s, p) {
    const cached = isObj(p) ? s.recall(p.reqId) : undefined;
    if (cached) return cached;
    const prof = s.profile;
    const level = prof.powerLevel;
    if (level >= POWER_UPGRADE.maxLevel) return fail('max', 'Your power is already at the maximum level!');
    const eco = this.game.economy;
    if (!eco.nearShop(s, 'power')) return fail('not_at_shop', 'Visit the "Upgrade your power" shop in the plaza.');
    const price = POWER_UPGRADE.price(level);
    if (!eco.debit(s, price, `power:${level + 1}`)) return fail('money', `You need ${price.toLocaleString('en-US')} Money.`);
    prof.powerLevel = level + 1;
    this.game.markProfile(s);
    this.game.saveNow(s);
    const res = { ok: true, level: prof.powerLevel, bonus: prof.powerLevel * POWER_UPGRADE.bonus, money: prof.money };
    return isObj(p) ? s.remember(p.reqId, res) : res;
  }

  // Z: the master power of the costume you wear.
  handlePower(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || !finite(p.yaw, -100, 100)) return fail('bad');
    const game = this.game;
    const now = game.now();
    const worn = COSTUME_BY_ID[s.profile.costumes.equipped];
    if (!worn) return fail('no_costume', 'Put on a costume from the Costume Shop to use a master power (Z).');
    if (worn.choosePower && !s.profile.costumes.power) return fail('no_power', 'Choose the power of your Legend Master first (Costume Shop).');
    const c = costumeWithPower(worn, s.profile.costumes.power);
    if (!game.combat.canAct(s, now)) return fail('cant_act');
    if (now < (s.powerReadyAt || 0)) return fail('cooldown', `${c.power.name} is ready in ${Math.ceil((s.powerReadyAt - now) / 1000)}s`);
    const pw = c.power;
    s.powerReadyAt = now + pw.cooldownMs;
    s.yaw = p.yaw;
    const dmg = powerDamage(c, s.profile.powerLevel);
    const monsters = game.monsters;
    let targets = [];
    if (pw.shape === 'wave') {
      targets = monsters.findInArc(s.pos, p.yaw, pw.range, pw.arc, pw.maxTargets, s);
    } else if (pw.shape === 'ring') {
      targets = monsters.findInArc(s.pos, p.yaw, pw.radius, 360, pw.maxTargets, s);
    } else if (pw.shape === 'chain') {
      // the first bolt goes to the closest monster in front of you (or around)
      let first = monsters.findInArc(s.pos, p.yaw, pw.range, 160, 1, s)[0] || monsters.findInArc(s.pos, p.yaw, pw.range * 0.6, 360, 1, s)[0];
      if (first) {
        targets.push(first);
        const done = new Set(targets);
        while (targets.length < pw.maxTargets) {
          const m = monsters.nearestTo(targets[targets.length - 1], pw.range * 0.6, done, s);
          if (!m) break;
          done.add(m);
          targets.push(m);
        }
      }
    }
    const hits = [];
    for (const m of targets) {
      // exact damage: no defence and no randomness
      if (pw.burn) m.burn = { dps: dmg * 0.08, until: now + 4000, by: s, acc: 0 };
      if (pw.freezeMs && !m.species.ai.boss) m.stunnedUntil = Math.max(m.stunnedUntil, now + pw.freezeMs);
      game.companions.noteThreat(s, m.id);
      monsters.damage(m, dmg, s, { power: true });
      hits.push({ id: m.id, dmg, crit: true, fx: 'power', hp: Math.round((100 * m.hp) / m.maxHp) });
    }
    // base guards in reach are hit too (a thief's best friend)
    const reach = pw.range || pw.radius || 10;
    for (const t of game.guards.findInArc(s, p.yaw, reach, pw.shape === 'wave' ? pw.arc : 360, pw.maxTargets || 6)) {
      hits.push(game.guards.hit(s, t, dmg, true));
    }
    if (pw.heal) game.combat.heal(s, s.maxHp * pw.heal);
    const r1 = (v) => Math.round(v * 10) / 10;
    game.broadcastNear(s.pos.x, s.pos.z, 140, 'power', {
      pn: s.pn, costume: c.id, element: c.element || null, x: r1(s.pos.x), y: r1(s.pos.y), z: r1(s.pos.z), yaw: Math.round(p.yaw * 100) / 100,
      targets: targets.map((m) => ({ id: m.id, x: r1(m.x), y: r1(m.y), z: r1(m.z) })),
    });
    if (hits.length) game.broadcastNear(s.pos.x, s.pos.z, 140, 'hits', { pn: s.pn, hits, power: true });
    // a swing at nothing still opens a Lucky Block in front of you
    if (!hits.length && pw.shape === 'wave') game.lucky.trySwing(s, p.yaw);
    return { ok: true, hits: hits.length, dmg, readyAt: s.powerReadyAt };
  }
}

FILE: server/services/economy.js

// Money, shops and upgrades. Every purchase is validated here on the server:
// the price comes from the shared tables (never from the client), the player
// must be at the right shop, own enough money and meet unlock requirements,
// and repeated requests with the same request id are answered from cache.

import { CONFIG } from '#shared/config.js';
import { SWORD_BY_ID, swordLockReason } from '#shared/weapons.js';
import { ITEM_BY_ID } from '#shared/items.js';
import { isObj, id as isId, int, fail } from '../validate.js';
import { isInsideBase } from '#shared/world.js';
import { regionLockReason, REGION_BY_ID } from '#shared/regions.js';

export class Economy {
  constructor(game) {
    this.game = game;
    this.ledgerLog = []; // recent money movements, for debugging
  }

  credit(s, amount, reason) {
    const n = Math.floor(amount);
    if (!(n > 0)) return 0;
    const p = s.profile;
    const before = p.money;
    p.money = Math.min(CONFIG.economy.maxMoney, p.money + n);
    this.record(s, p.money - before, reason);
    this.game.markProfile(s);
    return p.money - before;
  }

  debit(s, amount, reason) {
    const n = Math.ceil(amount);
    if (!(n >= 0) || s.profile.money < n) return false;
    s.profile.money -= n;
    this.record(s, -n, reason);
    this.game.markProfile(s);
    return true;
  }

  // Monster Gems (the rare upgrade material). Same rules as Money: only the
  // server adds or removes them, never below zero.
  creditGems(s, amount, reason) {
    const n = Math.floor(amount);
    if (!(n > 0)) return 0;
    const p = s.profile;
    const before = p.gems;
    p.gems = Math.min(CONFIG.gems.max, p.gems + n);
    this.ledgerLog.push({ t: this.game.now(), who: s.id, gems: p.gems - before, reason });
    this.game.markProfile(s);
    return p.gems - before;
  }

  // Takes Money and Gems together, or neither.
  pay(s, money, gems, reason) {
    const m = Math.ceil(money || 0);
    const g = Math.ceil(gems || 0);
    if (!(m >= 0) || !(g >= 0) || s.profile.money < m || s.profile.gems < g) return false;
    if (!this.debit(s, m, reason)) return false;
    if (g) {
      s.profile.gems -= g;
      this.ledgerLog.push({ t: this.game.now(), who: s.id, gems: -g, reason });
    }
    return true;
  }

  // "Not enough Money" / "Not enough Gems" for a failed pay()
  shortfall(s, money, gems) {
    if (s.profile.money < (money || 0)) return fail('money', 'Not enough Money.');
    return fail('gems', `You need ${gems} 💎 Monster Gems (you have ${s.profile.gems}).`);
  }

  record(s, delta, reason) {
    this.ledgerLog.push({ t: this.game.now(), who: s.id, delta, reason, balance: s.profile.money });
    if (this.ledgerLog.length > 500) this.ledgerLog.splice(0, 100);
  }

  nearShop(s, kind) {
    if (!CONFIG.economy.requireShopProximity) return true;
    const r = CONFIG.economy.shopRange;
    return this.game.world.shops.some((sh) => sh.kind === kind && (s.pos.x - sh.x) ** 2 + (s.pos.z - sh.z) ** 2 <= r * r);
  }

  atOwnBase(s) {
    const b = this.game.world.bases[s.baseIndex];
    return b && isInsideBase(b, s.pos.x, s.pos.z, 1);
  }

  handleBuySword(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || !isId(p.swordId)) return fail('bad');
    const cached = s.recall(p.reqId);
    if (cached) return cached;
    const sword = SWORD_BY_ID[p.swordId];
    if (!sword) return fail('unknown_sword');
    if (s.profile.swords.includes(sword.id)) return s.remember(p.reqId, fail('owned', 'You already own this sword.'));
    if (sword.costume) return fail('costume', `The ${sword.name} comes with a costume from the Costume Shop.`);
    if (!this.nearShop(s, 'swords')) return fail('not_at_shop', 'Visit the Sword Shop in the plaza.');
    const lock = swordLockReason(sword, s.profile);
    if (lock) return fail('locked', lock);
    if (!this.pay(s, sword.price, sword.gems, `sword:${sword.id}`)) return this.shortfall(s, sword.price, sword.gems);
    s.profile.swords.push(sword.id);
    s.profile.sword = sword.id;
    this.game.saveNow(s);
    this.game.broadcast('playerInfo', this.game.playerInfo(s));
    this.game.tutorialEvent(s, 'sword');
    return s.remember(p.reqId, { ok: true, sword: sword.id, money: s.profile.money });
  }

  handleEquipSword(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || !isId(p.swordId)) return fail('bad');
    if (!s.profile.swords.includes(p.swordId)) return fail('not_owned');
    s.profile.sword = p.swordId;
    this.game.markProfile(s);
    this.game.broadcast('playerInfo', this.game.playerInfo(s));
    return { ok: true };
  }

  handleBuyItem(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || !isId(p.itemId)) return fail('bad');
    const qty = p.qty === undefined ? 1 : p.qty;
    if (!int(qty, 1, 10)) return fail('bad_qty');
    const cached = s.recall(p.reqId);
    if (cached) return cached;
    const item = ITEM_BY_ID[p.itemId];
    if (!item) return fail('unknown_item');
    if (!this.nearShop(s, 'items')) return fail('not_at_shop', 'Visit the Gadget Shop in the plaza.');
    const have = s.profile.items[item.id] || 0;
    if (have + qty > item.maxStack) return fail('full', item.kind === 'tool' ? 'You already own this gadget.' : `You can carry at most ${item.maxStack}.`);
    if (!this.debit(s, item.price * qty, `item:${item.id}x${qty}`)) return fail('money', 'Not enough Money.');
    s.profile.items[item.id] = have + qty;
    this.game.saveNow(s);
    return s.remember(p.reqId, { ok: true, item: item.id, count: s.profile.items[item.id] });
  }

  upgradeOffer(s, kind) {
    const p = s.profile;
    if (kind === 'slots') {
      const next = CONFIG.bases.slotUpgrades.find((u) => u.slots > p.base.slots);
      return next ? { price: next.price, gems: next.gems || 0, level: next.level, to: next.slots } : null;
    }
    if (kind === 'laser') {
      const lvl = p.base.laserLevel;
      if (lvl >= CONFIG.security.laserUpgradePrices.length) return null;
      return { price: CONFIG.security.laserUpgradePrices[lvl], gems: CONFIG.security.laserUpgradeGems[lvl] || 0, level: 1, to: lvl + 1 };
    }
    return null;
  }

  handleBuyUpgrade(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || (p.kind !== 'slots' && p.kind !== 'laser')) return fail('bad');
    const cached = s.recall(p.reqId);
    if (cached) return cached;
    if (!this.atOwnBase(s)) return fail('not_at_base', 'Upgrade at your base terminal.');
    const offer = this.upgradeOffer(s, p.kind);
    if (!offer) return fail('maxed', 'Already fully upgraded.');
    if (s.profile.level < offer.level) return fail('locked', `Requires Level ${offer.level}`);
    if (!this.pay(s, offer.price, offer.gems, `upgrade:${p.kind}`)) return this.shortfall(s, offer.price, offer.gems);
    if (p.kind === 'slots') s.profile.base.slots = offer.to;
    else s.profile.base.laserLevel = offer.to;
    this.game.saveNow(s);
    this.game.bases.broadcastBase(s.baseIndex);
    return s.remember(p.reqId, { ok: true, kind: p.kind, to: offer.to });
  }

  // The Island Gate in the plaza: travel to any island the player may enter.
  handleTravel(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || typeof p.region !== 'string') return fail('bad');
    const game = this.game;
    const gate = game.world.gate;
    if ((s.pos.x - gate.x) ** 2 + (s.pos.z - gate.z) ** 2 > (gate.range + 2) ** 2) return fail('too_far', 'Walk up to the Island Gate in the plaza.');
    if (s.carrying) return fail('carrying', 'The gate refuses monster thieves!');
    const region = REGION_BY_ID[p.region];
    if (!region || region.shape.kind !== 'island' || region.arena) return fail('bad_region', 'Unknown island.');
    const reason = regionLockReason(region, game.playerProgress(s), game.expansion.active);
    if (reason) return fail('locked', reason);
    const dest = game.world.islandArrival[region.id] || game.world.portals.find((pt) => pt.region === region.id)?.to;
    if (!dest) return fail('bad_region');
    s.portalReadyAt = game.now() + 2500;
    game.teleport(s, dest.x, dest.y, dest.z, 'portal');
    return { ok: true, region: region.id };
  }

  // Portals in the plaza lead to the expansion islands (server-chosen
  // destinations only).
  checkPortals(s) {
    const now = this.game.now();
    if (s.portalReadyAt && s.portalReadyAt > now) return;
    for (const portal of this.game.world.portals) {
      const dx = s.pos.x - portal.x;
      const dz = s.pos.z - portal.z;
      if (dx * dx + dz * dz > 3.2 * 3.2) continue;
      s.portalReadyAt = now + 2500;
      if (s.carrying) {
        this.game.toast(s, 'Portals refuse monster thieves!', 'bad');
        return;
      }
      const region = REGION_BY_ID[portal.region];
      const reason = regionLockReason(region, this.game.playerProgress(s), this.game.expansion.active);
      if (reason) {
        this.game.toast(s, reason, 'bad');
        return;
      }
      this.game.teleport(s, portal.to.x, portal.to.y, portal.to.z, 'portal');
      return;
    }
  }
}

FILE: server/services/events.js

// Global timed events. Each event definition has hooks; the manager runs a
// simple lifecycle for every event: idle -> announce -> active -> idle, and
// synchronises the state to every player (with server timestamps, so every
// client shows the same countdown).

import { CONFIG } from '#shared/config.js';
import { SPECIES_BY_ID } from '#shared/monsters.js';

const EVENT_DEFS = {
  luckyLucky: {
    name: 'LUCKY LUCKY',
    cfg: () => CONFIG.events.luckyLucky,
    onStart(game) {
      const n = game.lucky.spawnEventBlocks(CONFIG.events.luckyLucky.blocks);
      game.broadcast('announce', { text: `LUCKY LUCKY! ${n} Lucky Blocks appeared and Luckitty is roaming!`, kind: 'lucky' });
    },
    onEnd(game) {
      game.lucky.clearEventBlocks();
    },
    // event monsters spawn near players while it runs
    spawnTick(game, now, st) {
      if (now < (st.nextSpawnAt || 0)) return;
      st.nextSpawnAt = now + 8000;
      const live = [...game.monsters.list.values()].filter((m) => m.event === 'luckyLucky').length;
      const want = Math.min(6, Math.max(2, game.players.size));
      if (live >= want) return;
      const players = [...game.players.values()].filter((s) => !s.dead);
      if (!players.length) return;
      const s = players[Math.floor(game.rng() * players.length)];
      if (!game.expansion.active.has(s.region)) return;
      const sp = SPECIES_BY_ID.luckitty;
      const pt = game.monsters.findSpawnPoint(sp, s.region, s.pos, 30, 90);
      if (!pt) return;
      game.monsters.spawn(sp, Math.max(1, game.monsters.pickLevel({ levels: [s.profile.level, s.profile.level + 2] })), pt.x, pt.z, { region: s.region, event: 'luckyLucky' });
    },
  },
};

export class EventManager {
  constructor(game) {
    this.game = game;
    this.events = {};
  }

  init() {
    const now = this.game.now();
    for (const [id, def] of Object.entries(EVENT_DEFS)) {
      this.events[id] = { id, name: def.name, phase: 'idle', nextAt: now + def.cfg().firstDelayMs, startsAt: 0, endsAt: 0 };
    }
  }

  state() {
    return Object.values(this.events).map((e) => ({ id: e.id, name: e.name, phase: e.phase, startsAt: e.startsAt, endsAt: e.endsAt, nextAt: e.nextAt }));
  }

  isActive(id) {
    return this.events[id]?.phase === 'active';
  }

  rareMultiplier() {
    return this.isActive('luckyLucky') ? CONFIG.events.luckyLucky.rareSpawnMultiplier : 1;
  }

  // Starts an event now (dev command / tests).
  trigger(id) {
    const e = this.events[id];
    if (!e || e.phase !== 'idle') return false;
    e.nextAt = this.game.now();
    this.tick(0, this.game.now());
    return true;
  }

  broadcastState() {
    this.game.broadcast('event', this.state());
  }

  tick(dt, now) {
    for (const e of Object.values(this.events)) {
      const def = EVENT_DEFS[e.id];
      const cfg = def.cfg();
      if (e.phase === 'idle' && now >= e.nextAt) {
        if (this.game.players.size === 0) {
          e.nextAt = now + 30000; // nobody to enjoy it, try again later
          continue;
        }
        e.phase = 'announce';
        e.startsAt = now + cfg.announceMs;
        e.endsAt = e.startsAt + cfg.durationMs;
        this.broadcastState();
      } else if (e.phase === 'announce' && now >= e.startsAt) {
        e.phase = 'active';
        def.onStart(this.game, e);
        this.broadcastState();
      } else if (e.phase === 'active' && now >= e.endsAt) {
        e.phase = 'idle';
        e.nextAt = now + cfg.intervalMs;
        def.onEnd(this.game, e);
        this.broadcastState();
        this.game.broadcast('announce', { text: `${e.name} is over! Next one in ${Math.round(cfg.intervalMs / 60000)} minutes.`, kind: 'info' });
      }
    }
  }

  spawnTick(now) {
    for (const e of Object.values(this.events)) {
      if (e.phase === 'active' && EVENT_DEFS[e.id].spawnTick) EVENT_DEFS[e.id].spawnTick(this.game, now, e);
    }
  }
}

FILE: server/services/guards.js

// Base guards (shared/guards.js): bought and upgraded in the Base panel.
//
// Each guard has a post (the door, or a spot on one of the tower's floors).
// A guard goes for "intruders": other players who are inside the base, who
// are carrying one of the owner's monsters away, or who hit a guard. Guards
// stay on their own floor (the door guards may step out in front of the
// door), hit with their swords, and can be knocked out; they get up again
// after GUARDS.respawnMs. From level 7 helicopters circle the tower and shoot
// intruders from the air while at least one guard is still standing.
//
// The owner is told when a thief comes in ("guardAlert" intruder) and when
// the thief has beaten every guard ("defeated"); the thief gets a red
// "THIEF" tag (EFFECT.thief) for everyone to see.

import { CONFIG } from '#shared/config.js';
import { GUARDS, GUARD_POSTS, guardLevel } from '#shared/guards.js';
import { baseLocal } from '#shared/world.js';
import { angleDiff } from './combat.js';

export const GS = { idle: 0, walk: 1, chase: 2, windup: 3, strike: 4, down: 7, fly: 8 };
const ID_BASE = 2_000_000_000;
const REACH = 2.8;
const WINDUP_MS = 380;
const STRIKE_MS = 320;
const ATTACK_EVERY_MS = 1150;
const INSIDE = 11.2;        // |u|, |v| inside the walls
const DOOR_V = 13.5;        // just outside the door
const OUTSIDE_V = 26;       // door guards don't go farther out than this
const OUTSIDE_U = 14;

export class GuardSystem {
  constructor(game) {
    this.game = game;
    this.world = game.world;
    this.squads = new Map(); // base index -> squad
    this.nextId = 1;
    this.lastSync = 0;
  }

  ownerOf(index) {
    for (const s of this.game.players.values()) if (s.baseIndex === index) return s;
    return null;
  }

  floorY(base, floor) {
    return base.y + floor * CONFIG.bases.floorHeight;
  }

  // Squads follow their owner's guard level (and disappear with them).
  sync() {
    for (const base of this.world.bases) {
      const owner = this.ownerOf(base.index);
      const level = owner ? owner.profile.base.guardLevel || 0 : 0;
      let squad = this.squads.get(base.index);
      if (!level) {
        if (squad) this.drop(squad);
        continue;
      }
      if (squad && squad.level === level && squad.owner === owner) continue;
      if (squad) this.drop(squad);
      squad = this.makeSquad(base, owner, level);
      this.squads.set(base.index, squad);
    }
  }

  makeSquad(base, owner, level) {
    const L = guardLevel(level);
    const guards = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < L.guards; i++) {
      const [u, v, floor] = GUARD_POSTS[i];
      const p = base.toWorld(u, v);
      const post = { x: p.x, z: p.z, y: this.floorY(base, floor), floor, outside: v > base.half };
      guards.push({
        id: ID_BASE + this.nextId++, kind: 0, i, post, x: post.x, y: post.y, z: post.z, yaw: base.yaw,
        hp: L.hp, maxHp: L.hp, state: GS.idle, target: null, attack: null, readyAt: 0, downUntil: 0,
      });
    }
    const helis = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < L.helis; i++) {
      helis.push({ id: ID_BASE + this.nextId++, kind: 1, i, angle: (i / Math.max(1, L.helis)) * Math.PI * 2, x: base.x, y: base.y + 52, z: base.z, yaw: 0, state: GS.fly, readyAt: 0 });
    }
    return { base, owner, level, L, guards, helis, hitBy: new Map(), alerted: new Map(), allDown: false };
  }

  drop(squad) {
    this.squads.delete(squad.base.index);
    for (const g of [...squad.guards, ...squad.helis]) {
      this.game.broadcastNear(g.x, g.z, CONFIG.interestRadius + 20, 'gGone', { id: g.id });
    }
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ who is a thief

  intruders(squad, now) {
    const { base, owner } = squad;
    const out = [];
    for (const p of this.game.players.values()) {
      if (p === owner || p.dead) continue;
      const inside = p.inBases.has(base.index);
      const carrying = p.carrying && p.carrying.victimId === owner.id && Math.hypot(p.pos.x - base.x, p.pos.z - base.z) < 70;
      const hostile = (squad.hitBy.get(p.pn) || 0) > now - 15000 && Math.hypot(p.pos.x - base.x, p.pos.z - base.z) < 60;
      if (inside || carrying || hostile) out.push(p);
    }
    return out;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ simulation

  tick(dt, now) {
    if (now - this.lastSync > 1000) {
      this.lastSync = now;
      this.sync();
    }
    for (const squad of this.squads.values()) {
      const ints = this.intruders(squad, now);
      for (const p of ints) {
        p.thiefUntil = now + 3000;
        const last = squad.alerted.get(p.pn) || 0;
        if (now - last > 30000) {
          this.game.send(squad.owner, 'guardAlert', { stage: 'intruder', thief: p.profile.name });
          this.game.send(p, 'guardAlert', { stage: 'spotted', owner: squad.owner.profile.name });
        }
        squad.alerted.set(p.pn, now);
      }
      for (const g of squad.guards) this.updateGuard(squad, g, ints, dt, now);
      for (const h of squad.helis) this.updateHeli(squad, h, ints, dt, now);
      // every guard knocked out: the thief beat the security
      const standing = squad.guards.some((g) => g.state !== GS.down);
      if (!standing && !squad.allDown) {
        squad.allDown = true;
        const thief = ints[0] || [...this.game.players.values()].find((p) => p.pn === squad.lastHitter);
        const who = thief ? thief.profile.name : 'A thief';
        this.game.send(squad.owner, 'guardAlert', { stage: 'defeated', thief: who });
        for (const p of ints) this.game.send(p, 'guardAlert', { stage: 'beaten', owner: squad.owner.profile.name });
        this.game.broadcastNear(squad.base.x, squad.base.z, 160, 'announce', { text: `💥 ${who} defeated ${squad.owner.profile.name}'s guards!`, kind: 'theft' });
      } else if (standing) squad.allDown = false;
    }
  }

  // The zone a point is in: 'in' (inside the walls), 'out' (in front of the
  // door) or null (anywhere else, where guards don't go).
  zone(base, x, z) {
    const { u, v } = baseLocal(base, x, z);
    if (Math.abs(u) <= INSIDE && Math.abs(v) <= INSIDE) return 'in';
    if (Math.abs(u) <= OUTSIDE_U && v >= base.half && v <= OUTSIDE_V) return 'out';
    if (Math.abs(u) <= 2.6 && v > INSIDE && v < base.half + 0.5) return 'door';
    return null;
  }

  updateGuard(squad, g, ints, dt, now) {
    const base = squad.base;
    if (g.state === GS.down) {
      if (now >= g.downUntil) {
        g.hp = g.maxHp;
        g.state = GS.idle;
        g.x = g.post.x;
        g.z = g.post.z;
        g.y = g.post.y;
        this.game.broadcastNear(g.x, g.z, 140, 'gUp', { id: g.id });
      }
      return;
    }
    // an attack in progress
    if (g.attack) {
      const t = this.game.players.get(g.attack.sid);
      if (g.state === GS.windup && now >= g.attack.hitAt) {
        g.state = GS.strike;
        if (t && !t.dead && Math.hypot(t.pos.x - g.x, t.pos.z - g.z) < REACH + 1.4 && Math.abs(t.pos.y - g.y) < 3) {
          const dx = t.pos.x - g.x;
          const dz = t.pos.z - g.z;
          const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
          this.game.combat.damagePlayer(t, squad.L.damage * (0.9 + this.game.rng() * 0.2), { from: 'guard', kb: { x: (dx / d) * 6, z: (dz / d) * 6, up: 3 } });
        }
        this.game.broadcastNear(g.x, g.z, 140, 'gStrike', { id: g.id });
      }
      if (now >= g.attack.endAt) {
        g.attack = null;
        g.state = GS.chase;
      }
      return;
    }
    // pick the nearest intruder on this guard's floor that it may reach
    let target = null;
    let best = Infinity;
    for (const p of ints) {
      if (Math.abs(p.pos.y - g.post.y) > 3) continue;
      const z = this.zone(base, p.pos.x, p.pos.z);
      if (!z || (g.post.floor > 0 && z !== 'in')) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot(p.pos.x - g.x, p.pos.z - g.z);
      if (d < best && d < 40) {
        best = d;
        target = p;
      }
    }
    if (target) {
      const d = best;
      g.yaw = Math.atan2(target.pos.x - g.x, target.pos.z - g.z);
      if (d > REACH) {
        this.walkToward(squad, g, target.pos.x, target.pos.z, squad.L.speed, dt);
        g.state = GS.chase;
      } else if (now >= g.readyAt) {
        g.attack = { sid: target.sid, hitAt: now + WINDUP_MS, endAt: now + WINDUP_MS + STRIKE_MS };
        g.readyAt = now + ATTACK_EVERY_MS;
        g.state = GS.windup;
        this.game.broadcastNear(g.x, g.z, 140, 'gAttack', { id: g.id, windupMs: WINDUP_MS });
      } else g.state = GS.idle;
      return;
    }
    // back to the post
    const dp = Math.hypot(g.post.x - g.x, g.post.z - g.z);
    if (dp > 0.4) {
      this.walkToward(squad, g, g.post.x, g.post.z, squad.L.speed * 0.6, dt);
      g.state = GS.walk;
    } else {
      g.state = GS.idle;
      g.yaw = base.yaw;
    }
  }

  // Straight to the target, through the door when going in or out.
  walkToward(squad, g, tx, tz, speed, dt) {
    const base = squad.base;
    const from = this.zone(base, g.x, g.z);
    const to = this.zone(base, tx, tz);
    let wx = tx;
    let wz = tz;
    if (from && to && from !== to && to !== 'door') {
      // through the doorway: line up with the door first, then straight through
      const { u, v } = baseLocal(base, g.x, g.z);
      const p = Math.abs(u) > 1.2
        ? base.toWorld(0, from === 'in' ? INSIDE - 0.5 : from === 'out' ? base.half + 1.5 : v)
        : base.toWorld(0, to === 'in' ? INSIDE - 1.5 : base.half + 2.5);
      wx = p.x;
      wz = p.z;
    }
    const dx = wx - g.x;
    const dz = wz - g.z;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    if (d < 1e-3) return;
    const step = Math.min(d, speed * dt);
    const nx = g.x + (dx / d) * step;
    const nz = g.z + (dz / d) * step;
    const z = this.zone(base, nx, nz);
    if (!z || (g.post.floor > 0 && z !== 'in')) return; // never off its floor or away from the base
    g.x = nx;
    g.z = nz;
    g.yaw = Math.atan2(dx, dz);
    g.y = this.world.surfaceHeight(nx, nz, g.post.y + 0.5);
  }

  updateHeli(squad, h, ints, dt, now) {
    const base = squad.base;
    const L = squad.L;
    const active = !squad.allDown;
    // circle the tower (higher up and away while the guards are down)
    h.angle += dt * 0.35;
    const r = active ? 24 : 40;
    const tx = base.x + Math.cos(h.angle) * r;
    const tz = base.z + Math.sin(h.angle) * r;
    const ty = base.y + (active ? 46 : 62) + Math.sin(now / 900 + h.i) * 1.2;
    h.x += (tx - h.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 2);
    h.z += (tz - h.z) * Math.min(1, dt * 2);
    h.y += (ty - h.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 1.5);
    h.yaw = h.angle + Math.PI / 2;
    if (!active || now < h.readyAt) return;
    let target = null;
    let best = GUARDS.helicopterRange;
    for (const p of ints) {
      const d = Math.hypot(p.pos.x - base.x, p.pos.z - base.z);
      if (d < best) {
        best = d;
        target = p;
      }
    }
    if (!target) return;
    h.readyAt = now + 1700 + Math.floor(this.game.rng() * 400);
    h.yaw = Math.atan2(target.pos.x - h.x, target.pos.z - h.z);
    // the gunner rarely misses a thief standing still
    const hit = this.game.rng() < 0.8;
    if (hit) this.game.combat.damagePlayer(target, L.damage * 0.7, { from: 'heli' });
    const r1 = (v) => Math.round(v * 10) / 10;
    this.game.broadcastNear(h.x, h.z, 180, 'gShot', { id: h.id, x: r1(h.x), y: r1(h.y), z: r1(h.z), tx: r1(target.pos.x), ty: r1(target.pos.y + 2.5), tz: r1(target.pos.z), hit });
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ players hit guards

  // Guards in front of a player (never their own).
  findInArc(s, yaw, reach, arcDeg, max) {
    const half = (arcDeg / 2) * (Math.PI / 180);
    const out = [];
    for (const squad of this.squads.values()) {
      if (squad.owner === s) continue;
      for (const g of squad.guards) {
        if (g.state === GS.down || Math.abs(g.y - s.pos.y) > 4) continue;
        const dx = g.x - s.pos.x;
        const dz = g.z - s.pos.z;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
        if (d - 0.9 > reach) continue;
        if (d > 1.5 && angleDiff(Math.atan2(dx, dz), yaw) > half) continue;
        out.push({ g, squad, d });
      }
    }
    out.sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d);
    return out.slice(0, max);
  }

  // Damage a guard; returns the hit for the 'hits' message.
  hit(s, { g, squad }, dmg, crit = false) {
    const now = this.game.now();
    squad.hitBy.set(s.pn, now);
    squad.lastHitter = s.pn;
    g.hp -= dmg;
    if (g.hp <= 0) {
      g.hp = 0;
      g.state = GS.down;
      g.attack = null;
      g.downUntil = now + GUARDS.respawnMs;
      this.game.broadcastNear(g.x, g.z, 140, 'gDown', { id: g.id });
    }
    return { id: g.id, dmg: Math.round(dmg), crit, guard: true, hp: Math.round((100 * g.hp) / g.maxHp) };
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ snapshots

  snapshotFor(viewer) {
    const out = [];
    const R = CONFIG.interestRadius + 40;
    const r1 = (v) => Math.round(v * 10) / 10;
    for (const squad of this.squads.values()) {
      if (Math.hypot(squad.base.x - viewer.pos.x, squad.base.z - viewer.pos.z) > R) continue;
      for (const g of [...squad.guards, ...squad.helis]) {
        out.push([g.id, squad.base.index, g.kind, r1(g.x), r1(g.y), r1(g.z), Math.round(g.yaw * 100) / 100, g.state, g.kind ? 100 : Math.round((100 * g.hp) / g.maxHp), squad.level]);
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  squadOf(index) {
    return this.squads.get(index) || null;
  }
}

FILE: server/services/items.js

// Action items (gadgets) for player-vs-player play. The client only says
// "use item X facing this way"; the server checks ownership, cooldown, range
// and picks the target itself.

import { CONFIG } from '#shared/config.js';
import { ITEM_BY_ID } from '#shared/items.js';
import { isObj, id as isId, finite, fail } from '../validate.js';
import { angleDiff } from './combat.js';

export class ItemSystem {
  constructor(game) {
    this.game = game;
    this.ground = new Map(); // id -> trap/gel
    this.nextGround = 1;
  }

  handleUse(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || !isId(p.itemId) || !finite(p.yaw, -100, 100)) return fail('bad');
    const game = this.game;
    const now = game.now();
    const item = ITEM_BY_ID[p.itemId];
    if (!item) return fail('unknown_item');
    const have = s.profile.items[item.id] || 0;
    if (have <= 0) return fail('none', `You don't have a ${item.name}.`);
    if (s.dead) return fail('dead');
    if (s.fx.frozenUntil > now || s.fx.stunUntil > now) return fail('stuck', 'You are stuck!');
    if (now < (s.itemReadyAt[item.id] || 0)) return fail('cooldown', `${item.name} is recharging.`);
    let result;
    if (item.target === 'player') result = this.usePlayerTarget(s, item, p.yaw, now);
    else if (item.target === 'ground') result = this.placeGround(s, item, now);
    else result = this.useSelf(s, item, now);
    if (!result.ok) return result;
    s.itemReadyAt[item.id] = now + item.cooldownMs;
    if (item.kind === 'consumable') {
      s.profile.items[item.id] = have - 1;
      if (s.profile.items[item.id] <= 0) delete s.profile.items[item.id];
    }
    game.markProfile(s);
    game.broadcastNear(s.pos.x, s.pos.z, 120, 'itemUsed', { pn: s.pn, item: item.id, target: result.target ?? null, yaw: p.yaw });
    return result;
  }

  // nearest valid rival inside the item's cone
  findTarget(s, item, yaw) {
    const now = this.game.now();
    let best = null;
    let bd = Infinity;
    for (const o of this.game.players.values()) {
      if (o === s || o.dead) continue;
      const dx = o.pos.x - s.pos.x;
      const dz = o.pos.z - s.pos.z;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
      if (d > item.range + CONFIG.combat.rangeTolerance || Math.abs(o.pos.y - s.pos.y) > 6) continue;
      if (d > 1.5 && angleDiff(Math.atan2(dx, dz), yaw) > ((item.arc / 2) * Math.PI) / 180) continue;
      if (o.protectUntil > now) continue;
      if (d < bd) {
        bd = d;
        best = o;
      }
    }
    return best;
  }

  usePlayerTarget(s, item, yaw, now) {
    const game = this.game;
    const t = this.findTarget(s, item, yaw);
    if (!t) return { ok: true, miss: true };
    if (t.fx.shieldUntil > now) {
      game.send(t, 'blocked', { by: s.pn, item: item.id });
      return { ok: true, blocked: true, target: t.pn };
    }
    switch (item.id) {
      case 'knockback': {
        const dx = t.pos.x - s.pos.x;
        const dz = t.pos.z - s.pos.z;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
        t.knockbackUntil = now + CONFIG.movement.knockbackAllowanceMs;
        game.send(t, 'knock', { x: (dx / d) * item.knockback, z: (dz / d) * item.knockback, up: item.lift, by: s.pn });
        break;
      }
      case 'freeze':
        t.fx.frozenUntil = Math.max(t.fx.frozenUntil, now + item.freezeMs);
        game.send(t, 'status', { kind: 'frozen', until: t.fx.frozenUntil, by: s.pn });
        break;
      case 'capture_net':
        t.fx.rootedUntil = Math.max(t.fx.rootedUntil, now + item.rootMs);
        game.send(t, 'status', { kind: 'netted', until: t.fx.rootedUntil, by: s.pn });
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
    game.stealing.cancelPending(t);
    if (item.interrupts) game.stealing.interrupt(t, 'hit');
    return { ok: true, hit: true, target: t.pn };
  }

  placeGround(s, item, now) {
    const game = this.game;
    const mine = [...this.ground.values()].filter((g) => g.owner === s.id && g.item === item.id);
    if (mine.length >= item.maxActive) this.removeGround(mine[0]);
    const g = {
      id: this.nextGround++, item: item.id, owner: s.id, ownerPn: s.pn,
      x: s.pos.x, y: game.world.surfaceHeight(s.pos.x, s.pos.z, s.pos.y), z: s.pos.z,
      until: now + item.durationMs, r: item.triggerRadius, hitAt: new Map(),
    };
    this.ground.set(g.id, g);
    game.broadcast('ground', this.groundInfo(g));
    return { ok: true, placed: g.id };
  }

  groundInfo(g) {
    return { id: g.id, item: g.item, x: g.x, y: g.y, z: g.z, r: g.r, until: g.until, owner: g.ownerPn };
  }

  groundList() {
    return [...this.ground.values()].map((g) => this.groundInfo(g));
  }

  removeGround(g) {
    if (this.ground.delete(g.id)) this.game.broadcast('groundGone', { id: g.id });
  }

  useSelf(s, item, now) {
    const game = this.game;
    switch (item.id) {
      case 'shield':
        s.fx.shieldUntil = now + item.durationMs;
        break;
      case 'speed_boost':
        s.fx.speedUntil = now + item.durationMs;
        s.fx.speedMult = item.speedMultiplier;
        break;
      case 'detector':
        s.fx.radarUntil = now + item.durationMs;
        s.radarNextAt = 0;
        break;
      default:
        return fail('bad');
    }
    game.send(s, 'status', { kind: item.id, until: now + item.durationMs });
    return { ok: true };
  }

  // Ground gadgets trigger when a rival walks into them.
  checkGround(s) {
    if (s.dead || !this.ground.size) return;
    const game = this.game;
    const now = game.now();
    for (const g of this.ground.values()) {
      if (g.owner === s.id) continue;
      if ((s.pos.x - g.x) ** 2 + (s.pos.z - g.z) ** 2 > g.r * g.r) continue;
      if ((g.hitAt.get(s.id) || 0) > now) continue;
      const item = ITEM_BY_ID[g.item];
      if (s.fx.shieldUntil > now || s.protectUntil > now) {
        g.hitAt.set(s.id, now + 2000);
        continue;
      }
      if (g.item === 'sticky_trap') {
        s.fx.rootedUntil = Math.max(s.fx.rootedUntil, now + item.rootMs);
        game.send(s, 'status', { kind: 'trapped', until: s.fx.rootedUntil });
        game.stealing.interrupt(s, 'trap');
        game.stealing.cancelPending(s);
        this.removeGround(g);
        return;
      }
      if (g.item === 'slippery_gel') {
        g.hitAt.set(s.id, now + 3000);
        s.fx.slipUntil = Math.max(s.fx.slipUntil, now + item.slipMs);
        const a = game.rng() * Math.PI * 2;
        s.knockbackUntil = now + CONFIG.movement.knockbackAllowanceMs;
        game.send(s, 'knock', { x: Math.cos(a) * 8, z: Math.sin(a) * 8, up: 3, slip: true });
        game.send(s, 'status', { kind: 'slipping', until: s.fx.slipUntil });
        game.stealing.interrupt(s, 'slip');
        game.stealing.cancelPending(s);
      }
    }
  }

  onLeave(s) {
    for (const g of [...this.ground.values()]) if (g.owner === s.id) this.removeGround(g);
  }

  tick(dt, now) {
    for (const g of [...this.ground.values()]) if (now > g.until) this.removeGround(g);
    // ground gadgets also catch players standing still
    if (this.ground.size) for (const s of this.game.players.values()) this.checkGround(s);
    for (const s of this.game.players.values()) {
      if (s.fx.radarUntil > now && now >= (s.radarNextAt || 0)) {
        s.radarNextAt = now + 2000;
        const radius = 180 * (1 + (s.perks?.detect || 0));
        this.game.send(s, 'radar', { list: this.game.monsters.radarFor(s, radius), until: s.fx.radarUntil });
      }
    }
  }
}

FILE: server/services/luckyBlocks.js

// Lucky Blocks. A few always sit around every active region; the LUCKY LUCKY
// event scatters many more. Opening one is a single server-side claim: the
// block is removed before the reward is rolled, so repeated requests can never
// pay out twice.

import { CONFIG } from '#shared/config.js';
import { LUCKY_KINDS, rollLucky, COSMETICS } from '#shared/lucky.js';
import { ITEM_BY_ID } from '#shared/items.js';
import { SWORDS, swordLockReason } from '#shared/weapons.js';
import { REGION_BY_ID } from '#shared/regions.js';
import { SPECIES_BY_ID } from '#shared/monsters.js';
import { isObj, int, fail } from '../validate.js';
import { angleDiff } from './combat.js';

export class LuckyBlocks {
  constructor(game) {
    this.game = game;
    this.blocks = new Map();
    this.nextId = 1;
    this.ambientNext = {};
    this.geodeNext = {};
    this.lastCheck = 0;
  }

  info(b) {
    return { id: b.id, kind: b.kind, x: b.x, y: b.y, z: b.z, event: b.event };
  }

  list() {
    return [...this.blocks.values()].map((b) => this.info(b));
  }

  occupied(x, z) {
    for (const b of this.blocks.values()) if ((b.x - x) ** 2 + (b.z - z) ** 2 < 25) return true;
    return false;
  }

  spawnAt(regionId, kind, event) {
    const spots = this.game.world.luckySpots[regionId] || [];
    const free = spots.filter((p) => !this.occupied(p.x, p.z));
    if (!free.length) return null;
    const p = free[Math.floor(this.game.rng() * free.length)];
    const b = { id: this.nextId++, kind, x: p.x, y: p.y, z: p.z, region: regionId, event: !!event, claimedBy: null };
    this.blocks.set(b.id, b);
    this.game.broadcast('luckySpawn', this.info(b));
    return b;
  }

  remove(b) {
    if (this.blocks.delete(b.id)) this.game.broadcast('luckyGone', { id: b.id });
  }

  tick(dt, now) {
    if (now - this.lastCheck < 2000) return;
    this.lastCheck = now;
    const active = this.game.expansion.active;
    const counts = {};
    const geodes = {};
    for (const b of [...this.blocks.values()]) {
      if (!active.has(b.region)) {
        this.remove(b);
        continue;
      }
      if (b.kind === 'geode') geodes[b.region] = (geodes[b.region] || 0) + 1;
      else if (!b.event) counts[b.region] = (counts[b.region] || 0) + 1;
    }
    for (const regionId of active) {
      if ((counts[regionId] || 0) >= CONFIG.lucky.ambientPerRegion) continue;
      if (now < (this.ambientNext[regionId] || 0)) continue;
      this.ambientNext[regionId] = now + 5000;
      this.spawnAt(regionId, this.game.rng() < 0.15 ? 'super' : 'lucky', false);
    }
    // gem geodes in the gem-rich regions
    for (const regionId of CONFIG.gems.geodeRegions) {
      if (!active.has(regionId) || (geodes[regionId] || 0) >= CONFIG.gems.geodesPerRegion) continue;
      if (now < (this.geodeNext[regionId] || 0)) continue;
      this.geodeNext[regionId] = now + 5000;
      this.spawnAt(regionId, 'geode', false);
    }
  }

  // LUCKY LUCKY: scatter event blocks near where players are.
  spawnEventBlocks(n) {
    const game = this.game;
    const regions = new Map();
    for (const [id, near] of game.monsters.nearbyRegions()) {
      if (!game.expansion.active.has(id)) continue;
      const need = REGION_BY_ID[id].unlock.level || 0;
      if (near.some((s) => s.profile.level >= need)) regions.set(id, near.length);
    }
    if (!regions.size) regions.set('plains', 1);
    const ids = [...regions.keys()];
    let made = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < n * 3 && made < n; i++) {
      const id = ids[i % ids.length];
      const roll = game.rng();
      const kind = roll < 0.12 ? 'mythic' : roll < 0.42 ? 'super' : 'lucky';
      if (this.spawnAt(id, kind, true)) made++;
    }
    return made;
  }

  clearEventBlocks() {
    for (const b of [...this.blocks.values()]) if (b.event) this.remove(b);
  }

  handleClaim(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || !int(p.blockId, 1, 1e12)) return fail('bad');
    const b = this.blocks.get(p.blockId);
    if (!b) return fail('gone', 'Someone already opened that one!');
    return this.claim(s, b);
  }

  // swinging the sword at a block opens it too
  trySwing(s, yaw) {
    for (const b of this.blocks.values()) {
      const dx = b.x - s.pos.x;
      const dz = b.z - s.pos.z;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
      if (d > 4.5) continue;
      if (d > 1.5 && angleDiff(Math.atan2(dx, dz), yaw) > 1.1) continue;
      return this.claim(s, b);
    }
    return null;
  }

  claim(s, b) {
    const game = this.game;
    if (s.dead) return fail('dead');
    if (b.claimedBy) return fail('gone');
    if (Math.hypot(s.pos.x - b.x, s.pos.z - b.z) > CONFIG.lucky.claimRange || Math.abs(s.pos.y - b.y) > 6) return fail('too_far', 'Get closer to the Lucky Block.');
    b.claimedBy = s.id;
    this.blocks.delete(b.id); // gone before any reward is decided
    if (b.kind === 'geode') this.geodeNext[b.region] = game.now() + CONFIG.gems.geodeRespawnMs;
    else if (!b.event) this.ambientNext[b.region] = game.now() + CONFIG.lucky.ambientRespawnMs;
    const reward = b.kind === 'geode' ? this.giveGeode(s) : this.giveReward(s, b);
    if (b.kind !== 'geode') s.profile.stats.luckyOpened++;
    game.markProfile(s);
    game.saveNow(s);
    game.broadcast('luckyOpened', { id: b.id, pn: s.pn, kind: b.kind, reward: { kind: reward.kind, label: reward.label } });
    return { ok: true, reward };
  }

  giveGeode(s) {
    const [lo, hi] = CONFIG.gems.geodeReward;
    const n = this.game.economy.creditGems(s, lo + Math.floor(this.game.rng() * (hi - lo + 1)), 'geode');
    return { kind: 'gems', amount: n, label: `+${n} 💎 Monster Gems` };
  }

  giveReward(s, b) {
    const game = this.game;
    const kindDef = LUCKY_KINDS[b.kind];
    const kindLuck = b.kind === 'mythic' ? 1.2 : b.kind === 'super' ? 0.5 : 0;
    const luck = (s.perks?.luck || 0) + kindLuck + (b.event ? 0.3 : 0);
    const entry = rollLucky(game.rng, luck);
    const region = REGION_BY_ID[b.region];
    const lvl = region ? region.levels[0] : 1;
    const rnd = (a, z) => Math.round(a + game.rng() * (z - a));
    const money = (amount, label) => {
      const n = game.economy.credit(s, amount, 'lucky');
      return { kind: 'money', amount: n, label: label || `+${n} Money` };
    };
    switch (entry.kind) {
      case 'money': {
        const n = rnd(entry.min, entry.max) * kindDef.moneyMult * (1 + lvl * 0.35) * (game.events.isActive('luckyLucky') ? 2 : 1);
        return money(Math.round(n), entry.big ? `JACKPOT! +${Math.round(n)} Money` : null);
      }
      case 'xp': {
        const n = Math.round(rnd(entry.min, entry.max) * (1 + lvl * 0.25) * (b.kind === 'lucky' ? 1 : 2));
        const got = game.addXp(s, n);
        return { kind: 'xp', amount: got, label: `+${got} XP` };
      }
      case 'item': {
        const id = entry.pool[Math.floor(game.rng() * entry.pool.length)];
        const def = ITEM_BY_ID[id];
        const qty = rnd(entry.qty[0], entry.qty[1]);
        const have = s.profile.items[id] || 0;
        const add = Math.min(qty, def.maxStack - have);
        if (add <= 0) return money(def.price * qty, `+${def.price * qty} Money (bag full of ${def.name})`);
        s.profile.items[id] = have + add;
        return { kind: 'item', item: id, qty: add, label: `${def.icon} ${def.name} x${add}` };
      }
      case 'tool': {
        const id = entry.pool[Math.floor(game.rng() * entry.pool.length)];
        const def = ITEM_BY_ID[id];
        if (s.profile.items[id]) return money(Math.round(def.price * 0.6), `+${Math.round(def.price * 0.6)} Money (you already own a ${def.name})`);
        s.profile.items[id] = 1;
        return { kind: 'item', item: id, qty: 1, label: `${def.icon} New gadget: ${def.name}!` };
      }
      case 'discount': {
        s.profile.coupons.recruitDiscount = Math.max(s.profile.coupons.recruitDiscount, entry.value);
        return { kind: 'discount', value: entry.value, label: `Coupon: -${Math.round(entry.value * 100)}% on your next recruit!` };
      }
      case 'clue': {
        const m = game.monsters.spawnSpecial(s, 'clue');
        if (!m) return money(300 * kindDef.moneyMult);
        game.send(s, 'clue', { id: m.id, species: m.sp, x: Math.round(m.x), z: Math.round(m.z) });
        return { kind: 'clue', species: m.sp, label: `Clue: a ${SPECIES_BY_ID[m.sp].name} was spotted nearby! (see map)` };
      }
      case 'encounter': {
        const m = game.monsters.spawnSpecial(s, 'encounter');
        if (!m) return money(300 * kindDef.moneyMult);
        game.send(s, 'clue', { id: m.id, species: m.sp, x: Math.round(m.x), z: Math.round(m.z), encounter: true });
        return { kind: 'encounter', species: m.sp, label: `A wild ${SPECIES_BY_ID[m.sp].name} burst out! Defeat it to recruit it.` };
      }
      case 'cosmetic': {
        const left = COSMETICS.filter((c) => !s.profile.cosmetics.owned.includes(c.id));
        if (!left.length) return money(800 * kindDef.moneyMult);
        const c = left[Math.floor(game.rng() * left.length)];
        s.profile.cosmetics.owned.push(c.id);
        if (!s.profile.cosmetics.equipped) {
          s.profile.cosmetics.equipped = c.id;
          game.broadcast('playerInfo', game.playerInfo(s));
        }
        return { kind: 'cosmetic', id: c.id, label: `New hat: ${c.name}!` };
      }
      case 'sword': {
        const best = Math.max(...s.profile.swords.map((id) => SWORDS.find((w) => w.id === id)?.tier || 1));
        const next = SWORDS.find((w) => w.tier === best + 1 && !w.costume && !swordLockReason(w, s.profile));
        if (!next) return money(1500 * kindDef.moneyMult);
        s.profile.swords.push(next.id);
        s.profile.sword = next.id;
        game.broadcast('playerInfo', game.playerInfo(s));
        return { kind: 'sword', id: next.id, label: `NEW SWORD: ${next.name}!` };
      }
      case 'gems': {
        const mult = b.kind === 'mythic' ? 3 : b.kind === 'super' ? 2 : 1;
        const n = game.economy.creditGems(s, rnd(entry.min, entry.max) * mult, 'lucky');
        return { kind: 'gems', amount: n, label: `+${n} 💎 Monster Gems` };
      }
      default:
        return money(100);
    }
  }
}

FILE: server/services/monsterAI.js

// Wild monsters: spawning, AI, attacks and projectiles.
//
// One central manager updates every monster (no per-monster timers). Monsters
// only exist in regions near players; regions nobody is near go dormant and
// their monsters are cleaned up. Each species' temperament decides how it
// reacts to players:
//   aggressive  - chases any player it notices
//   territorial - attacks players who come close to its home
//   neutral     - ignores players until it is hit
//   shy         - runs away; fights back only after being hit
// Movement styles (hop, fly, swim...) are visual on the client; on the server
// they decide hover height and whether water is allowed.

import { CONFIG } from '#shared/config.js';
import { SPECIES, SPECIES_BY_ID, SPECIES_INDEX, RARITIES, monsterStats } from '#shared/monsters.js';
