import { REGIONS, REGION_BY_ID, regionIdAt } from '#shared/regions.js';
import { randomGroundPoint, isInsideBase, PLAZA, WATER_Y, SPOT_BY_ID } from '#shared/world.js';
import { angleDiff } from './combat.js';

export const MS = {
  idle: 0, wander: 1, chase: 2, windup: 3, strike: 4, flee: 5, stunned: 6, defeated: 7, sleep: 8, recover: 9, return: 10, quirk: 11,
};

const FLYERS = new Set(['fly', 'flutter', 'serpent']);

function rand(rng, a, b) {
  return a + rng() * (b - a);
}

export class MonsterManager {
  constructor(game) {
    this.game = game;
    this.world = game.world;
    this.list = new Map();
    this.nextId = 1;
    this.projectiles = new Map();
    this.nextProj = 1;
    this.spotNext = {};       // species id -> next time a spot spawn may roll
    this.spotLive = {};       // species id -> monster id
    this.regionSpawnAt = {};
    this.lastSpawnCheck = 0;
    this.thinkFlip = 0;
    this.tables = {};
    for (const r of REGIONS) {
      this.tables[r.id] = SPECIES.filter((sp) => sp.spawn.weight > 0 && sp.spawn.regions.includes(r.id) && !sp.spawn.event);
    }
    this.spotSpecies = SPECIES.filter((sp) => sp.spawn.spot);
  }

  get rng() {
    return this.game.rng;
  }

  // Every open region can hold its 50 (plus a little room for hidden-spot and
  // event monsters), so opening an expansion island raises the capacity.
  cap() {
    const c = CONFIG.monsters;
    return Math.min(c.hardCap, c.perRegion * this.game.expansion.active.size + 20);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ spawning

  spawn(species, level, x, z, opts = {}) {
    const now = this.game.now();
    const st = monsterStats(species, level);
    const regionId = opts.region || regionIdAt(x, z);
    const m = {
      id: this.nextId++,
      species,
      sp: species.id,
      idx: SPECIES_INDEX[species.id],
      level,
      maxHp: st.maxHp,
      hp: st.maxHp,
      atk: st.atk,
      def: st.def,
      speed: st.speed,
      radius: 0.75 * species.size,
      height: 2.2 * species.size,
      fly: FLYERS.has(species.ai.move),
      swims: !!species.ai.swims || species.ai.move === 'swim',
      hover: species.ai.hover || 0,
      x, z, y: 0,
      yaw: this.rng() * Math.PI * 2,
      home: { x, z },
      region: regionId,
      territory: species.ai.territory,
      state: MS.idle,
      stateUntil: now + rand(this.rng, 500, 3000),
      target: null,
      moveTarget: null,
      moveSpeed: 0,
      attack: null,
      cooldowns: species.attacks.map(() => now + rand(this.rng, 300, 1200)),
      damageBy: new Map(),
      spawnedAt: now,
      lastNearAt: now,
      spot: opts.spot || null,
      event: opts.event || null,
      clueFor: opts.clueFor || null,
      // Moon Sky Arena: a round's monster fights only the player who called
      // it and stays on its floating platform
      challengeFor: opts.challengeFor || null,
      plat: opts.plat || null,
      stunnedUntil: 0,
      burn: null,
      slowUntil: 0,
      provokedUntil: 0,
      kb: null,
      dash: null,
      eligible: null,
    };
    m.y = this.groundY(m, x, z);
    this.list.set(m.id, m);
    if (opts.spot) this.spotLive[species.id] = m.id;
    return m;
  }

  groundY(m, x, z) {
    if (m.plat) return m.plat.top + (m.hover || 0);
    const g = this.world.groundHeight(x, z);
    if (m.fly) return Math.max(g, WATER_Y) + m.hover;
    if (m.swims && g < WATER_Y - 0.6) return WATER_Y - 0.5 + (m.hover || 0);
    return g + (m.hover || 0);
  }

  pickLevel(region) {
    const [a, b] = region.levels;
    const t = this.rng();
    return Math.round(a + (b - a) * t * t); // lower levels are more common
  }

  pickSpecies(regionId) {
    const night = this.game.isNight();
    const rareMult = this.game.events.rareMultiplier();
    const table = this.tables[regionId].filter((sp) => {
      const t = sp.spawn.time;
      return !t || t === 'any' || (t === 'night' ? night : !night);
    });
    let total = 0;
    const w = table.map((sp) => {
      const v = sp.spawn.weight * (RARITIES[sp.rarity].order >= 1 ? rareMult : 1);
      total += v;
      return v;
    });
    let r = this.rng() * total;
    for (let i = 0; i < table.length; i++) {
      r -= w[i];
      if (r <= 0) return table[i];
    }
    return table[0] || null;
  }

  // Regions with a player inside them.
  occupiedRegions() {
    const out = new Set();
    for (const s of this.game.players.values()) {
      if (!s.dead) out.add(regionIdAt(s.pos.x, s.pos.z));
    }
    return out;
  }

  // Regions within reach of at least one player -> players near them.
  nearbyRegions() {
    const out = new Map();
    const add = (id, s) => {
      if (!id) return;
      if (!out.has(id)) out.set(id, []);
      const list = out.get(id);
      if (!list.includes(s)) list.push(s);
    };
    for (const s of this.game.players.values()) {
      if (s.dead) continue;
      add(regionIdAt(s.pos.x, s.pos.z), s);
      for (const r of [80, 150]) {
        for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
          const a = (k / 8) * Math.PI * 2;
          add(regionIdAt(s.pos.x + Math.cos(a) * r, s.pos.z + Math.sin(a) * r), s);
        }
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  farFromPlayers(x, z, min) {
    for (const s of this.game.players.values()) {
      const dx = s.pos.x - x;
      const dz = s.pos.z - z;
      if (dx * dx + dz * dz < min * min) return false;
    }
    return true;
  }

  // A region with a player in it fills up to CONFIG.monsters.perRegion (50),
  // spread over the whole region; a region a player is only close to gets a
  // smaller group near them, so walking across a border never feels empty.
  // Regions nobody is near stay empty (see cleanup), which keeps the server
  // and every client's work bounded by where players actually are.
  spawnTick(now) {
    const game = this.game;
    if (game.players.size === 0) return;
    const C = CONFIG.monsters;
    const active = game.expansion.active;
    const counts = {};
    for (const m of this.list.values()) if (!m.spot && !m.event) counts[m.region] = (counts[m.region] || 0) + 1;
    const occupied = this.occupiedRegions();
    const nearby = this.nearbyRegions();
    for (const [regionId, near] of nearby) {
      if (!active.has(regionId)) continue;
      const inside = occupied.has(regionId);
      const target = inside ? C.perRegion : C.neighbourRegion;
      // fill quickly when a region is mostly empty, then top up more slowly
      const have = counts[regionId] || 0;
      let groups = have < target * 0.6 ? 6 : have < target * 0.9 ? 3 : 1;
      if (now < (this.regionSpawnAt[regionId] || 0)) continue;
      this.regionSpawnAt[regionId] = now + 700;
      const region = REGION_BY_ID[regionId];
      while (groups-- > 0 && (counts[regionId] || 0) < target && this.list.size < this.cap()) {
        const sp = this.pickSpecies(regionId);
        if (!sp) break;
        const anchor = near[Math.floor(this.rng() * near.length)];
        // inside a region half of them go anywhere in it, half near a player
        const anywhere = inside && this.rng() < 0.5;
        const pt = this.findSpawnPoint(sp, regionId, anywhere ? null : anchor.pos, 34, C.spawnMaxPlayerDist);
        if (!pt) continue;
        const [g0, g1] = sp.spawn.group || [1, 1];
        const n = Math.min(Math.round(rand(this.rng, g0, g1)), target - (counts[regionId] || 0));
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const q = i === 0 ? pt : randomGroundPoint(this.world, regionId, this.rng, { near: pt, minR: 2, maxR: 7, anyWater: true }) || pt;
          this.spawn(sp, this.pickLevel(region), q.x, q.z, { region: regionId });
          counts[regionId] = (counts[regionId] || 0) + 1;
        }
      }
    }
    this.spotTick(now);
    this.game.events.spawnTick(now);
  }

  findSpawnPoint(sp, regionId, near, minR, maxR) {
    const water = !!sp.spawn.water;
    const canSwim = sp.ai.swims || sp.ai.move === 'swim';
    const flies = FLYERS.has(sp.ai.move);
    for (let t = 0; t < 4; t++) {
      const opts = near ? { near, minR, maxR } : {};
      if (water) opts.water = true;
      else if (canSwim || flies) opts.anyWater = true;
      let pt = randomGroundPoint(this.world, regionId, this.rng, opts);
      if (!pt && water && sp.ai.move !== 'swim') pt = randomGroundPoint(this.world, regionId, this.rng, { near, minR, maxR });
      if (!pt) pt = randomGroundPoint(this.world, regionId, this.rng, water ? { water: true } : canSwim || flies ? { anyWater: true } : {});
      if (pt && this.farFromPlayers(pt.x, pt.z, CONFIG.monsters.spawnMinPlayerDist)) return pt;
    }
    return null;
  }

  spotTick(now) {
    const game = this.game;
    const night = game.isNight();
    for (const sp of this.spotSpecies) {
      const live = this.spotLive[sp.id];
      if (live && this.list.has(live)) continue;
      if (now < (this.spotNext[sp.id] || 0)) continue;
      const spot = SPOT_BY_ID[sp.spawn.spot];
      if (!spot || !game.expansion.active.has(spot.region)) continue;
      const t = sp.spawn.time;
      if (t === 'night' && !night) continue;
      if (t === 'day' && night) continue;
      if (sp.spawn.requiresPuzzle && !game.puzzles.isOpen()) continue;
      let someone = false;
      for (const s of game.players.values()) {
        if ((s.pos.x - spot.x) ** 2 + (s.pos.z - spot.z) ** 2 < 230 * 230) someone = true;
      }
      if (!someone) continue;
      if (this.rng() > (sp.spawn.chance ?? 1)) {
        this.spotNext[sp.id] = now + (sp.spawn.respawnMs || 60000) * 0.5;
        continue;
      }
      const region = REGION_BY_ID[spot.region];
      let pt;
      if (sp.spawn.water) pt = randomGroundPoint(this.world, spot.region, this.rng, { near: spot, minR: spot.r + 2, maxR: spot.r + 22, water: true });
      if (!pt) pt = randomGroundPoint(this.world, spot.region, this.rng, { near: spot, minR: 0, maxR: Math.max(2, spot.r * 0.55), anyWater: true });
      if (!pt) pt = { x: spot.x, z: spot.z };
      const lvl = Math.min(region.levels[1] + 2, this.pickLevel(region) + 2);
      const m = this.spawn(sp, lvl, pt.x, pt.z, { spot: spot.id, region: spot.region });
      m.territory = Math.max(m.territory, spot.r + 4);
      this.spotNext[sp.id] = now + (sp.spawn.respawnMs || 60000);
    }
  }

  devSpawn(s, speciesId) {
    const sp = SPECIES_BY_ID[speciesId] || SPECIES[Math.floor(this.rng() * SPECIES.length)];
    const a = s.yaw;
    const x = s.pos.x + Math.sin(a) * 8;
    const z = s.pos.z + Math.cos(a) * 8;
    const region = regionIdAt(x, z) || 'plains';
    return this.spawn(sp, REGION_BY_ID[region].levels[0], x, z, { region });
  }

  // Spawns a rare monster for a Lucky Block clue or encounter.
  spawnSpecial(s, kind) {
    const regionId = s.region;
    const region = REGION_BY_ID[regionId];
    let pool;
    if (kind === 'encounter' && this.game.events.isActive('luckyLucky')) pool = [SPECIES_BY_ID.luckitty];
    else {
      pool = SPECIES.filter((sp) => (sp.spawn.regions.includes(regionId) || (sp.spawn.spot && SPOT_BY_ID[sp.spawn.spot]?.region === regionId))
        && RARITIES[sp.rarity].order >= 1 && sp.category !== 'boss' && !sp.spawn.event);
      if (!pool.length) pool = this.tables[regionId];
    }
    if (!pool.length) return null;
    const sp = pool[Math.floor(this.rng() * pool.length)];
    const near = kind === 'encounter' ? { minR: 10, maxR: 18 } : { minR: 50, maxR: 130 };
    const pt = randomGroundPoint(this.world, regionId, this.rng, { near: s.pos, ...near, anyWater: true })
      || randomGroundPoint(this.world, regionId, this.rng, { anyWater: true });
    if (!pt) return null;
    const m = this.spawn(sp, this.pickLevel(region) + 1, pt.x, pt.z, { region: regionId, clueFor: s.id, event: sp.spawn.event || null });
    m.lastNearAt = this.game.now() + 60000;
    return m;
  }

  remove(m, reason, extra = {}) {
    if (!this.list.delete(m.id)) return;
    if (m.spot && this.spotLive[m.sp] === m.id) {
      delete this.spotLive[m.sp];
      this.spotNext[m.sp] = this.game.now() + (m.species.spawn.respawnMs || 60000);
    }
    this.game.broadcastNear(m.x, m.z, CONFIG.interestRadius + 20, 'mGone', { id: m.id, reason, ...extra });
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ queries

  get(id) {
    return this.list.get(id);
  }

  isAlive(m) {
    return m.state !== MS.defeated && m.state !== MS.recover;
  }

  // May this player hit this monster? (Another player's arena monster: no.)
  canHit(s, m) {
    return !s || !m.challengeFor || m.challengeFor === s.id;
  }

  findInArc(pos, yaw, reach, arcDeg, max, who = null) {
    const out = [];
    const half = (arcDeg / 2) * (Math.PI / 180);
    for (const m of this.list.values()) {
      if (!this.isAlive(m) || !this.canHit(who, m)) continue;
      const dx = m.x - pos.x;
      const dz = m.z - pos.z;
      const dy = m.y - pos.y;
      if (Math.abs(dy) > 3 + m.height) continue;
      const d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
      if (d - m.radius > reach) continue;
      if (d > m.radius + 0.6 && angleDiff(Math.atan2(dx, dz), yaw) > half) continue;
      out.push({ m, d });
    }
    out.sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d);
    return out.slice(0, max).map((o) => o.m);
  }

  nearestTo(m0, range, exclude, who = null) {
    let best = null;
    let bd = range * range;
    for (const m of this.list.values()) {
      if (exclude.has(m) || !this.isAlive(m) || !this.canHit(who, m)) continue;
      const d = (m.x - m0.x) ** 2 + (m.z - m0.z) ** 2;
      if (d < bd) {
        bd = d;
        best = m;
      }
    }
    return best;
  }

  sessionByPn(pn) {
    for (const s of this.game.players.values()) if (s.pn === pn) return s;
    return null;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ damage

  damage(m, dmg, s, opts = {}) {
    if (!this.isAlive(m)) return;
    const now = this.game.now();
    m.hp -= dmg;
    m.damageBy.set(s.id, (m.damageBy.get(s.id) || 0) + dmg);
    m.lastNearAt = now;
    const temper = m.species.ai.temper;
    if (temper === 'shy') {
      m.provokedUntil = now + 9000;
    }
    if (m.state !== MS.windup && m.state !== MS.strike) {
      m.target = s.pn;
      m.aggroUntil = now + 12000;
      if (m.state === MS.sleep || m.state === MS.idle || m.state === MS.wander || m.state === MS.flee || m.state === MS.quirk) m.state = MS.chase;
    }
    if (m.hp <= 0) {
      m.hp = 0;
      this.defeat(m, s);
    }
  }

  knockback(m, from, force) {
    if (m.species.ai.boss) force *= 0.3;
    const dx = m.x - from.x;
    const dz = m.z - from.z;
    const d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) || 1;
    m.kb = { vx: (dx / d) * force * 4, vz: (dz / d) * force * 4, until: this.game.now() + 250 };
  }

  defeat(m, s) {
    m.state = MS.defeated;
    m.attack = null;
    m.dash = null;
    m.target = null;
    m.burn = null;
    for (const p of this.projectiles.values()) if (p.owner === m.id) p.until = 0;
    this.game.broadcastNear(m.x, m.z, CONFIG.interestRadius + 20, 'mDefeated', { id: m.id, by: s.pn });
    this.game.recruitment.onDefeated(m, s);
  }

  // A defeated monster nobody recruited wakes up and runs off.
  recover(m) {
    if (!this.list.has(m.id)) return;
    m.state = MS.recover;
    m.stateUntil = this.game.now() + 2500;
    m.hp = m.maxHp;
    m.eligible = null;
    const a = this.rng() * Math.PI * 2;
    m.moveTarget = { x: m.x + Math.cos(a) * 20, z: m.z + Math.sin(a) * 20 };
    m.moveSpeed = m.speed * 1.1;
    this.game.broadcastNear(m.x, m.z, CONFIG.interestRadius + 20, 'mRecover', { id: m.id });
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ AI

  tick(dt, now) {
    if (now - this.lastSpawnCheck > 1000) {
      this.lastSpawnCheck = now;
      this.spawnTick(now);
      this.cleanup(now);
    }
    this.thinkFlip ^= 1;
    for (const m of this.list.values()) {
      this.update(m, dt, now, ((m.id & 1) ^ this.thinkFlip) === 1);
    }
    this.tickProjectiles(dt, now);
  }

  cleanup(now) {
    const active = this.game.expansion.active;
    const occupied = this.occupiedRegions();
    for (const m of [...this.list.values()]) {
      if (m.state === MS.defeated) continue;
      // a monster stays while someone is on its island or close to it
      let near = occupied.has(m.region);
      if (!near) for (const s of this.game.players.values()) {
        const dx = s.pos.x - m.x;
        const dz = s.pos.z - m.z;
        if (dx * dx + dz * dz < CONFIG.monsters.activationRadius ** 2) {
          near = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      if (near) m.lastNearAt = now;
      if (!active.has(m.region) || now - m.lastNearAt > CONFIG.monsters.dormantAfterMs) this.remove(m, 'despawn');
      else if (m.event && !this.game.events.isActive(m.event) && m.state !== MS.chase) this.remove(m, 'despawn');
    }
  }

  playerTargetable(s, m) {
    if (s.dead) return false;
    if (m.challengeFor) return m.challengeFor === s.id;
    if (s.pos.x * s.pos.x + s.pos.z * s.pos.z < (PLAZA.r + 2) ** 2) return false; // the plaza is a safe zone
    if (s.inBases.size) return false;                                              // so are bases
    const dy = s.pos.y - m.y;
    return dy < 10 && dy > -10;
  }

  update(m, dt, now, think) {
    if (m.state === MS.defeated) return;
    if (m.state === MS.recover) {
      this.moveMonster(m, dt);
      if (now > m.stateUntil) this.remove(m, 'recovered');
      return;
    }
    if (m.burn && m.burn.until > now) {
      m.burn.acc += m.burn.dps * dt;
      if (m.burn.acc >= 2) {
        const d = Math.floor(m.burn.acc);
        m.burn.acc -= d;
        if (m.burn.by && this.game.players.has(m.burn.by.sid)) {
          this.damage(m, d, m.burn.by, { dot: true });
          this.game.broadcastNear(m.x, m.z, 100, 'hits', { pn: m.burn.by.pn, hits: [{ id: m.id, dmg: d, burn: true, hp: Math.round((100 * m.hp) / m.maxHp) }] });
          if (m.state === MS.defeated) return;
        }
      }
    }
    if (m.kb) {
      if (now > m.kb.until) m.kb = null;
      else this.stepTo(m, m.x + m.kb.vx * dt, m.z + m.kb.vz * dt);
    }
    if (m.stunnedUntil > now) {
      if (m.state !== MS.stunned) {
        m.state = MS.stunned;
        m.attack = null;
        m.dash = null;
      }
      return;
    } else if (m.state === MS.stunned) {
      m.state = m.target !== null ? MS.chase : MS.idle;
    }
    if (m.state === MS.windup || m.state === MS.strike) {
      this.updateAttack(m, dt, now);
      return;
    }
    if (think) this.think(m, now);
    this.moveMonster(m, dt);
  }

  think(m, now) {
    const ai = m.species.ai;
    const players = this.game.players;
    let nearest = null;
    let nd = Infinity;
    for (const s of players.values()) {
      if (!this.playerTargetable(s, m)) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot(s.pos.x - m.x, s.pos.z - m.z);
      if (d < nd) {
        nd = d;
        nearest = s;
      }
    }
    const detect = ai.detect * (0.8 + 0.2 * m.species.size);
    // keep or drop the current target
    if (m.target !== null) {
      const s = this.sessionByPn(m.target);
      const leash = m.territory * CONFIG.combat.leashFactor + 10;
      const homeD = Math.hypot(m.x - m.home.x, m.z - m.home.z);
      if (!s || !this.playerTargetable(s, m) || homeD > leash || (now > (m.aggroUntil || 0) && ai.temper !== 'aggressive' && ai.temper !== 'territorial')) {
        m.target = null;
        m.state = MS.return;
      }
    }
    if (m.target === null && m.challengeFor) {
      // an arena monster always comes back for its challenger
      const s = this.game.byProfile.get(m.challengeFor);
      if (s && this.playerTargetable(s, m)) {
        m.target = s.pn;
        m.aggroUntil = now + 1e9;
      }
    }
    if (m.target === null && m.state !== MS.return) {
      const night = this.game.isNight();
      const aggressive = ai.temper === 'aggressive' && (!ai.nightAggro || night);
      if (nearest && aggressive && nd < detect) {
        m.target = nearest.pn;
        m.aggroUntil = now + 8000;
      } else if (nearest && ai.temper === 'territorial') {
        const hd = Math.hypot(nearest.pos.x - m.home.x, nearest.pos.z - m.home.z);
        if (hd < m.territory + 2 && nd < detect * 1.4) {
          m.target = nearest.pn;
          m.aggroUntil = now + 8000;
        }
      } else if (nearest && ai.temper === 'shy' && nd < detect * 0.8 && m.provokedUntil < now) {
        m.state = MS.flee;
        m.stateUntil = now + 2500;
        const dx = m.x - nearest.pos.x;
        const dz = m.z - nearest.pos.z;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
        m.moveTarget = { x: m.x + (dx / d) * 16, z: m.z + (dz / d) * 16 };
        m.moveSpeed = m.speed * 1.05;
        return;
      }
    }
    if (m.target !== null) {
      const s = this.sessionByPn(m.target);
      m.state = MS.chase;
      const dx = s.pos.x - m.x;
      const dz = s.pos.z - m.z;
      const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
      const edge = d - m.radius - CONFIG.player.radius;
      // pick an attack that is ready and in range (longest cooldown first)
      let best = -1;
      for (let i = 0; i < m.species.attacks.length; i++) {
        const a = m.species.attacks[i];
        if (now < m.cooldowns[i]) continue;
        const reach = a.kind === 'slam' ? Math.max(a.range, a.radius * 0.7) : a.range;
        if (edge > reach || edge < (a.minRange || 0) - 0.5) continue;
        if (best < 0 || a.cooldownMs > m.species.attacks[best].cooldownMs) best = i;
      }
      if (best >= 0 && Math.abs(s.pos.y - m.y) < 4 + m.height) {
        this.startAttack(m, best, s, now);
        return;
      }
      const stop = m.radius + CONFIG.player.radius + 1.2;
      if (d > stop) {
        m.moveTarget = { x: s.pos.x - (dx / d) * stop * 0.9, z: s.pos.z - (dz / d) * stop * 0.9 };
        m.moveSpeed = m.speed;
      } else {
        m.moveTarget = null;
        m.yaw = Math.atan2(dx, dz);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (m.state === MS.flee) {
      if (now > m.stateUntil) m.state = MS.idle;
      return;
    }
    if (m.state === MS.return) {
      const d = Math.hypot(m.x - m.home.x, m.z - m.home.z);
      if (d < 3 || !m.moveTarget) {
        m.state = MS.idle;
        m.hp = m.maxHp;
        m.damageBy.clear();
        m.stateUntil = now + 1000;
      } else {
        m.moveSpeed = m.speed * 0.7;
      }
      if (m.state === MS.return) m.moveTarget = { ...m.home };
      return;
    }
    // idle behaviours
    if (now < m.stateUntil) return;
    const r = this.rng();
    const sleepy = m.species.personality.idles.includes('sleepy') || this.game.isNight();
    if (r < 0.55) {
      const a = this.rng() * Math.PI * 2;
      const dist = this.rng() * m.territory;
      m.moveTarget = { x: m.home.x + Math.cos(a) * dist, z: m.home.z + Math.sin(a) * dist };
      m.moveSpeed = m.speed * 0.35;
      m.state = MS.wander;
      m.stateUntil = now + rand(this.rng, 3000, 7000);
    } else if (r < 0.85 || !sleepy) {
      m.moveTarget = null;
      m.state = this.rng() < 0.5 ? MS.quirk : MS.idle;
      m.quirk = Math.floor(this.rng() * 8);
      m.stateUntil = now + rand(this.rng, 2000, 5000);
    } else {
      m.moveTarget = null;
      m.state = MS.sleep;
      m.stateUntil = now + rand(this.rng, 6000, 14000);
    }
  }

  // Moves toward m.moveTarget, respecting regions, safe zones, water and props.
  moveMonster(m, dt) {
    const t = m.moveTarget;
    if (!t) return;
    const dx = t.x - m.x;
    const dz = t.z - m.z;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz);
    if (d < 0.4) {
      m.moveTarget = null;
      if (m.state === MS.wander) m.state = MS.idle;
      return;
    }
    const slow = m.slowUntil > this.game.now() ? 0.6 : 1;
    const step = Math.min(d, m.moveSpeed * slow * dt);
    const ok = this.stepTo(m, m.x + (dx / d) * step, m.z + (dz / d) * step);
    const want = Math.atan2(dx, dz);
    let diff = want - m.yaw;
    while (diff > Math.PI) diff -= Math.PI * 2;
    while (diff < -Math.PI) diff += Math.PI * 2;
    m.yaw += diff * Math.min(1, dt * 10);
    if (!ok && m.state === MS.wander) {
      m.moveTarget = null;
      m.state = MS.idle;
    }
  }

  stepTo(m, nx, nz) {
    if (m.plat) {
      // never off the edge of its floating platform
      const lim = m.plat.half - m.radius * 0.6;
      if (Math.abs(nx - m.plat.x) > lim || Math.abs(nz - m.plat.z) > lim) return false;
      m.x = nx;
      m.z = nz;
      m.y = this.groundY(m, nx, nz);
      return true;
    }
    if (regionIdAt(nx, nz) !== m.region) return false;
    if (nx * nx + nz * nz < (PLAZA.r + 6) ** 2) return false;
    for (const b of this.world.bases) if (isInsideBase(b, nx, nz, 2)) return false;
    const g = this.world.groundHeight(nx, nz);
    if (!m.fly && !m.swims && g < WATER_Y - 0.7) return false;
    if (this.world.isLava(nx, nz, g) && m.species.element !== 'fire') return false;
    const pos = { x: nx, y: g, z: nz };
    this.world.colliders.resolve(pos, m.radius, m.height);
    if (regionIdAt(pos.x, pos.z) !== m.region) return false;
    m.x = pos.x;
    m.z = pos.z;
    m.y = this.groundY(m, m.x, m.z);
    return true;
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ attacks

  startAttack(m, i, s, now) {
    const a = m.species.attacks[i];
    m.state = MS.windup;
    m.moveTarget = null;
    m.attack = { i, a, t0: now, pn: s.pn, aim: { x: s.pos.x, z: s.pos.z }, struck: false };
    m.yaw = Math.atan2(s.pos.x - m.x, s.pos.z - m.z);
    this.game.broadcastNear(m.x, m.z, CONFIG.interestRadius, 'mAttack', {
      id: m.id, i, kind: a.kind, windupMs: a.windupMs, tx: Math.round(s.pos.x * 10) / 10, tz: Math.round(s.pos.z * 10) / 10,
    });
  }

  updateAttack(m, dt, now) {
    const atk = m.attack;
    if (!atk) {
      m.state = MS.chase;
      return;
    }
    const a = atk.a;
    const s = this.sessionByPn(atk.pn);
    const t = now - atk.t0;
    if (m.state === MS.windup) {
      if (s && t < a.windupMs * 0.6) {
        atk.aim = { x: s.pos.x, z: s.pos.z };
        m.yaw = Math.atan2(atk.aim.x - m.x, atk.aim.z - m.z);
      }
      if (t >= a.windupMs) this.strike(m, now);
      return;
    }
    // strike / recovery
    if (m.dash) {
      const d = m.dash;
      if (now < d.until) {
        const ok = this.stepTo(m, m.x + d.vx * dt, m.z + d.vz * dt);
        if (!ok) d.until = now;
        for (const p of this.game.players.values()) {
          if (d.hit.has(p.pn) || !this.playerTargetable(p, m)) continue;
          const dist = Math.hypot(p.pos.x - m.x, p.pos.z - m.z);
          if (dist < m.radius + CONFIG.player.radius + 0.6) {
            d.hit.add(p.pn);
            this.hitPlayer(m, a, p, now);
          }
        }
        return;
      }
      m.dash = null;
    }
    if (now >= m.stateUntil) {
      m.attack = null;
      m.state = m.target !== null ? MS.chase : MS.idle;
    }
  }

  hitPlayer(m, a, p, now) {
    const dmg = m.atk * a.power * (0.9 + this.rng() * 0.2);
    const dx = p.pos.x - m.x;
    const dz = p.pos.z - m.z;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
    const kb = a.knockback ? { x: (dx / d) * a.knockback, z: (dz / d) * a.knockback, up: Math.min(10, a.knockback * 0.5) } : null;
    this.game.combat.damagePlayer(p, dmg, { from: m.id, kb, effect: a.effect });
  }

  strike(m, now) {
    const atk = m.attack;
    const a = atk.a;
    atk.struck = true;
    m.cooldowns[atk.i] = now + a.cooldownMs;
    m.state = MS.strike;
    m.stateUntil = now + 380;
    const fx = Math.sin(m.yaw);
    const fz = Math.cos(m.yaw);
    this.game.broadcastNear(m.x, m.z, CONFIG.interestRadius, 'mStrike', { id: m.id, i: atk.i });
    const reachOf = (p) => Math.hypot(p.pos.x - m.x, p.pos.z - m.z) - m.radius - CONFIG.player.radius;
    switch (a.kind) {
      case 'melee':
        for (const p of this.game.players.values()) {
          if (!this.playerTargetable(p, m)) continue;
          if (reachOf(p) > a.range + 0.6) continue;
          if (angleDiff(Math.atan2(p.pos.x - m.x, p.pos.z - m.z), m.yaw) > 0.8 * Math.PI / 2 + 0.3) continue;
          this.hitPlayer(m, a, p, now);
        }
        break;
      case 'slam':
        for (const p of this.game.players.values()) {
          if (!this.playerTargetable(p, m)) continue;
          if (Math.hypot(p.pos.x - m.x, p.pos.z - m.z) > a.radius + CONFIG.player.radius) continue;
          this.hitPlayer(m, a, p, now);
        }
        break;
      case 'breath':
        for (const p of this.game.players.values()) {
          if (!this.playerTargetable(p, m)) continue;
          if (reachOf(p) > a.range) continue;
          if (angleDiff(Math.atan2(p.pos.x - m.x, p.pos.z - m.z), m.yaw) > (a.arc / 2) * (Math.PI / 180)) continue;
          this.hitPlayer(m, a, p, now);
        }
        break;
      case 'projectile': {
        if (this.projectiles.size >= CONFIG.monsters.maxProjectiles) break;
        const dx = atk.aim.x - m.x;
        const dz = atk.aim.z - m.z;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
        const y = m.y + m.height * 0.55;
        const proj = {
          id: this.nextProj++, owner: m.id, a, m,
          x: m.x + (dx / d) * m.radius, y, z: m.z + (dz / d) * m.radius,
          vx: (dx / d) * a.speed, vz: (dz / d) * a.speed,
          radius: a.radius || 0.9,
          until: now + ((a.range * 1.35) / a.speed) * 1000,
        };
        this.projectiles.set(proj.id, proj);
        this.game.broadcastNear(m.x, m.z, CONFIG.interestRadius + 20, 'proj', {
          id: proj.id, x: proj.x, y: proj.y, z: proj.z, vx: proj.vx, vz: proj.vz, r: proj.radius, life: proj.until - now, color: a.color || '#ffffff', from: m.id,
        });
        break;
      }
      case 'lunge': {
        const dx = atk.aim.x - m.x;
        const dz = atk.aim.z - m.z;
        const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
        const dist = Math.min(a.range + 3, d + 2);
        const dur = (dist / a.dashSpeed) * 1000;
        m.dash = { vx: (dx / d) * a.dashSpeed, vz: (dz / d) * a.dashSpeed, until: now + dur, hit: new Set() };
        m.stateUntil = now + dur + 350;
        break;
      }
      default:
        break;
    }
    void fx;
    void fz;
  }

  tickProjectiles(dt, now) {
    for (const p of this.projectiles.values()) {
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.z += p.vz * dt;
      let end = now >= p.until;
      let hit = null;
      if (!end) {
        const g = this.world.groundHeight(p.x, p.z);
        if (g > p.y + 0.5) end = true;
      }
      if (!end) {
        for (const s of this.game.players.values()) {
          if (s.dead || !this.canHit(s, p.m)) continue;
          const dx = s.pos.x - p.x;
          const dz = s.pos.z - p.z;
          const dy = s.pos.y + 2 - p.y;
          if (dx * dx + dz * dz < (p.radius + CONFIG.player.radius) ** 2 && Math.abs(dy) < 3) {
            hit = s;
            end = true;
            break;
          }
        }
      }
      if (end) {
        this.projectiles.delete(p.id);
        if (hit && this.list.has(p.owner)) this.hitPlayer(p.m, p.a, hit, now);
        else if (hit) this.game.combat.damagePlayer(hit, p.m.atk * p.a.power, { from: p.owner, effect: p.a.effect });
        this.game.broadcastNear(p.x, p.z, CONFIG.interestRadius + 20, 'projEnd', { id: p.id, x: p.x, z: p.z, hit: !!hit });
      }
    }
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ snapshots

  snapshotFor(s) {
    const out = [];
    const R = CONFIG.interestRadius;
    const r1 = (v) => Math.round(v * 10) / 10;
    for (const m of this.list.values()) {
      const dx = m.x - s.pos.x;
      const dz = m.z - s.pos.z;
      if (dx * dx + dz * dz > R * R) continue;
      let flags = 0;
      const now = this.game.now();
      if (m.burn && m.burn.until > now) flags |= 1;
      if (m.stunnedUntil > now) flags |= 2;
      if (m.clueFor === s.id) flags |= 4;
      if (m.event) flags |= 8;
      if (m.species.category === 'elite' || m.species.category === 'boss' || m.species.category === 'legendary' || m.species.category === 'mythic') flags |= 16;
      if (m.target === s.pn) flags |= 32;
      if (m.dash) flags |= 64;
      if (m.slowUntil > now) flags |= 128;
      out.push([m.id, m.idx, r1(m.x), r1(m.y), r1(m.z), Math.round(m.yaw * 100) / 100, m.state, Math.round((100 * m.hp) / m.maxHp), m.level, flags, m.state === MS.quirk ? m.quirk : 0]);
    }
    return out;
  }

  // Rare/hidden monsters within radar range of a player (Monster Radar item).
  radarFor(s, radius) {
    const out = [];
    for (const m of this.list.values()) {
      if (RARITIES[m.species.rarity].order < 1 || !this.isAlive(m)) continue;
      if (Math.hypot(m.x - s.pos.x, m.z - s.pos.z) > radius) continue;
      out.push({ id: m.id, sp: m.sp, x: Math.round(m.x), z: Math.round(m.z) });
    }
    return out;
  }
}

FILE: server/services/moonSecret.js

// The secret of Cute Monster Island (layout in shared/moonSecret.js).
//
//   1. Five small moon buttons are hidden around the island. Stepping on one
//      lights it up blue for that player ("Moon button 2/5") and the
//      progress is saved in the profile.
//   2. With all five found, a portal appears near the middle of the island
//      (the client shows an arrow to it). Walking into it starts a run in the
//      Moon Sky Arena.
//   3. The arena is a jumping course of floating stones with four battle
//      platforms. Reaching platform k in round k calls that round's monster:
//      one Uncommon, then a Rare, an Epic and a Legendary cute monster. It
//      only fights the player who called it. Falling off sends you back to
//      the last platform you reached.
//   4. Winning round four gives the secret monster straight to your base.

import { SPECIES, SPECIES_BY_ID, RARITIES } from '#shared/monsters.js';
import { ARENA, arenaPlatformAt } from '#shared/moonSecret.js';
import { newOwnedMonster } from './playerData.js';

const LEAVE_AFTER_WIN_MS = 3500;
const REPLAY_REWARD = { money: 25000, gems: 12 };

export class MoonSecret {
  constructor(game) {
    this.game = game;
    this.def = game.world.moon;
    // the cute monsters each round picks from
    this.pools = this.def.rounds.map((r) => SPECIES.filter((sp) => sp.island === 'cute' && sp.rarity === r));
  }

  state(s) {
    const m = s.profile.moon;
    const run = s.moonRun;
    return {
      found: [...m.found],
      won: m.won,
      run: run ? { round: run.round, done: !!run.wonAt, monster: run.monster?.id ?? null } : null,
    };
  }

  push(s) {
    this.game.send(s, 'moon', this.state(s));
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ the buttons

  afterMove(s) {
    if (s.region === 'cute') {
      this.checkButtons(s);
      this.checkPortal(s);
    } else if (s.region === ARENA.id) {
      this.checkArena(s);
    }
  }

  checkButtons(s) {
    const moon = s.profile.moon;
    if (moon.found.length >= this.def.buttons.length) return;
    const r = this.def.buttonRadius;
    for (const b of this.def.buttons) {
      if (moon.found.includes(b.id)) continue;
      if ((s.pos.x - b.x) ** 2 + (s.pos.z - b.z) ** 2 > r * r || Math.abs(s.pos.y - b.y) > 2.5) continue;
      moon.found.push(b.id);
      this.game.markProfile(s);
      const n = moon.found.length;
      const total = this.def.buttons.length;
      this.game.send(s, 'moonButton', { id: b.id, found: n, total });
      if (n >= total) {
        this.game.toast(s, `🌕 You found all ${total} moon buttons! A secret portal has appeared — follow the arrow!`, 'good');
      } else {
        this.game.toast(s, `🌙 You found a moon button! ${n}/${total}`, 'good');
      }
      this.push(s);
    }
  }

  portalOpen(s) {
    return s.profile.moon.found.length >= this.def.buttons.length;
  }

  checkPortal(s) {
    if (!this.portalOpen(s)) return;
    const p = this.def.portal;
    if ((s.pos.x - p.x) ** 2 + (s.pos.z - p.z) ** 2 > p.r * p.r) return;
    const now = this.game.now();
    if (now < (s.moonPortalReadyAt || 0)) return;
    s.moonPortalReadyAt = now + 2500;
    this.enter(s);
  }

  enter(s) {
    const game = this.game;
    if (s.dead) return;
    if (s.carrying) return game.toast(s, 'You cannot take a stolen monster into the Moon Sky Arena.', 'warn');
    const prof = s.profile;
    if (!prof.moon.won && prof.monsters.length >= prof.base.slots) {
      return game.toast(s, 'Your base is full! Free a slot first so the secret monster has somewhere to live.', 'warn');
    }
    s.moonRun = { round: 0, monster: null, checkpoint: this.def.start, wonAt: 0 };
    const st = this.def.start;
    game.teleport(s, st.x, st.y, st.z, 'moon', Math.PI);
    game.toast(s, `🌙 Moon Sky Arena! Jump across the stones. Round 1: defeat the ${RARITIES.uncommon.name} monster on the first big platform.`, 'info');
    this.push(s);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ the arena

  checkArena(s) {
    const run = s.moonRun;
    if (!run) {
      // nobody gets here without the portal; send strays back
      return this.sendBack(s, 'stray');
    }
    if (run.wonAt) return;
    // fell off: back to the last platform reached
    if (s.pos.y < this.def.fallY) {
      const c = run.checkpoint;
      this.game.teleport(s, c.x, c.y, c.z, 'moon_fall');
      this.game.toast(s, 'Whoops, you fell! Back to the last platform.', 'warn');
      return;
    }
    const k = arenaPlatformAt(s.pos.x, s.pos.z);
    if (k < 0) return;
    const plat = this.def.platforms[k];
    if (Math.abs(s.pos.y - plat.top) > 1.5) return;
    if (k <= run.round) run.checkpoint = { x: plat.x, y: plat.top, z: plat.z };
    if (k === run.round && !run.monster) this.callMonster(s, k);
  }

  callMonster(s, k) {
    const game = this.game;
    const pool = this.pools[k];
    const sp = pool[Math.floor(game.rng() * pool.length)];
    const plat = this.def.platforms[k];
    // across the platform from where the player stands
    const dx = plat.x - s.pos.x;
    const dz = plat.z - s.pos.z;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
    const off = Math.min(plat.half - 2.5, 5);
    const x = plat.x + (dx / d) * off;
    const z = plat.z + (dz / d) * off;
    const m = game.monsters.spawn(sp, this.def.roundLevels[k], x, z, { region: ARENA.id, challengeFor: s.id, plat });
    m.target = s.pn;
    m.state = 2; // MS.chase
    m.aggroUntil = game.now() + 1e9;
    m.lastNearAt = game.now() + 1e9;
    s.moonRun.monster = m;
    const r = RARITIES[sp.rarity];
    game.send(s, 'moonRound', { round: k, monster: m.id, species: sp.id, rarity: sp.rarity });
    game.toast(s, `Round ${k + 1}: ${r.name} ${sp.name} appears! Defeat it!`, 'warn');
    this.push(s);
  }

  // A challenge monster was defeated (called from Recruitment.onDefeated).
  onDefeated(m) {
    const game = this.game;
    const s = game.byProfile.get(m.challengeFor);
    m.removeAt = game.now() + 1600;
    if (!s || !s.moonRun || s.moonRun.monster !== m) return;
    const run = s.moonRun;
    run.monster = null;
    const plat = this.def.platforms[run.round];
    run.checkpoint = { x: plat.x, y: plat.top, z: plat.z };
    run.round++;
    if (run.round < this.def.rounds.length) {
      const next = RARITIES[this.def.rounds[run.round]].name;
      game.toast(s, `Round ${run.round} won! Now jump on to the next platform for round ${run.round + 1}: a ${next} monster.`, 'good');
      this.push(s);
      return;
    }
    this.win(s);
  }

  win(s) {
    const game = this.game;
    const prof = s.profile;
    const run = s.moonRun;
    run.wonAt = game.now();
    const sp = SPECIES_BY_ID[this.def.secretSpecies];
    if (!prof.moon.won) {
      prof.moon.won = true;
      const owned = newOwnedMonster(sp.id, 10, 'gift', game.now());
      prof.monsters.push(owned);
      game.ledger.set(owned.id, prof.id, owned.species, owned.level);
      game.recruitment.discover(s, sp.id);
      game.bases.checkMilestones(s);
      game.refreshPerks(s);
      game.send(s, 'moonWin', { species: sp.id, owned: owned.id, first: true });
      game.toast(s, `🌕 You won all four rounds! The secret ${sp.name} joins your base!`, 'good');
      game.broadcast('announce', { text: `${prof.name} solved the moon secret of Cute Monster Island and got the Secret ${sp.name}!`, kind: 'rare' });
    } else {
      game.economy.credit(s, REPLAY_REWARD.money, 'moon');
      game.economy.creditGems(s, REPLAY_REWARD.gems, 'moon');
      game.send(s, 'moonWin', { species: sp.id, first: false, money: REPLAY_REWARD.money, gems: REPLAY_REWARD.gems });
      game.toast(s, `🌕 Arena cleared again! +${REPLAY_REWARD.money} Money, +${REPLAY_REWARD.gems} Gems`, 'good');
    }
    game.markProfile(s);
    game.saveNow(s);
    this.push(s);
  }

  sendBack(s, reason) {
    const r = this.def.returnTo;
    this.endRun(s);
    this.game.teleport(s, r.x, r.y, r.z, reason === 'won' ? 'moon_win' : 'moon');
  }

  endRun(s) {
    const run = s.moonRun;
    if (!run) return;
    s.moonRun = null;
    if (run.monster && this.game.monsters.list.has(run.monster.id)) this.game.monsters.remove(run.monster, 'vanish');
    this.push(s);
  }

  onLeave(s) {
    this.endRun(s);
  }

  tick(dt, now) {
    for (const s of this.game.players.values()) {
      const run = s.moonRun;
      if (!run) continue;
      if (s.region !== ARENA.id && !s.dead) {
        // left through H, a respawn, ... : the run is over
        this.endRun(s);
        continue;
      }
      if (run.wonAt && now - run.wonAt > LEAVE_AFTER_WIN_MS) this.sendBack(s, 'won');
    }
    // defeated challenge monsters fade away (they are never recruited)
    for (const m of this.game.monsters.list.values()) {
      if (m.challengeFor && m.removeAt && now > m.removeAt) this.game.monsters.remove(m, 'vanish');
    }
  }
}

FILE: server/services/playerData.js

// Player profiles: creation, schema migration, sanitizing loaded data,
// levels, perks, and the ownership ledger that keeps monster ownership
// consistent across crashes.

import { CONFIG, SAVE_SCHEMA_VERSION, xpForLevel, maxHpForLevel } from '#shared/config.js';
import { SPECIES_BY_ID, PERKS, perkValue, incomePerSecond } from '#shared/monsters.js';
import { SWORD_BY_ID } from '#shared/weapons.js';
import { ITEM_BY_ID } from '#shared/items.js';
import { COSMETIC_BY_ID } from '#shared/lucky.js';
import { DECOR_BY_ID, DECOR_SPOTS, DECOR_MAX_OWNED } from '#shared/decor.js';
import { REGION_BY_ID } from '#shared/regions.js';
import { MOON } from '#shared/moonSecret.js';
import { COSTUME_BY_ID, POWER_UPGRADE, LEGEND_POWERS } from '#shared/costumes.js';
import { GUARDS } from '#shared/guards.js';
import { randomId } from '#shared/rng.js';
import { sha256Hex } from '#shared/sha256.js';

// The client keeps a random secret token; the profile id is derived from it so
// nobody can load someone else's profile without their token.
export function profileIdFromToken(token) {
  if (typeof token !== 'string' || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,128}$/.test(token)) return null;
  return 'p_' + sha256Hex('steal-a-monster:' + token).slice(0, 32);
}

export function newProfile(id, name, now) {
  const items = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(CONFIG.startingItems)) items[k] = v;
  return {
    schemaVersion: SAVE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    id,
    name,
    color: null,
    createdAt: now,
    lastSeen: now,
    money: CONFIG.startingMoney, // granted exactly once, here
    gems: 0,
    xp: 0,
    level: 1,
    sword: CONFIG.startingSword,
    swords: [CONFIG.startingSword],
    items,
    monsters: [],
    base: { slots: CONFIG.startingSlots, laserLevel: 0, guardLevel: 0, decor: new Array(DECOR_SPOTS).fill(null) },
    decor: { owned: {} },
    storedIncome: 0,
    discoveries: { species: {}, spots: {} },
    regionsVisited: ['plains'],
    tutorial: { step: 0, done: false },
    moon: { found: [], won: false }, // the moon buttons of Cute Monster Island
    costumes: { owned: [], equipped: null, power: null }, // power: the Legend Master's chosen power
    powerLevel: 0,                    // "Upgrade your power" levels (+130 each)
    cosmetics: { owned: [], equipped: null },
    coupons: { recruitDiscount: 0 },
    stats: { defeated: 0, recruited: 0, stolen: 0, lost: 0, luckyOpened: 0, deaths: 0 },
    milestones: {},
  };
}

// Upgrade older save files to the current schema.
const MIGRATIONS = {
  // 0 -> 1: early prototype saves had no schemaVersion and no ledger fields
  0: (p) => {
    p.schemaVersion = 1;
    p.discoveries = p.discoveries || { species: {}, spots: {} };
    p.coupons = p.coupons || { recruitDiscount: 0 };
    return p;
  },
  // 1 -> 2: Monster Gems and base decorations
  1: (p) => {
    p.schemaVersion = 2;
    p.gems = 0;
    p.decor = { owned: {} };
    p.base = { ...(p.base || {}), decor: new Array(DECOR_SPOTS).fill(null) };
    return p;
  },
};

export function migrateProfile(p) {
  let v = Number.isInteger(p.schemaVersion) ? p.schemaVersion : 0;
  while (v < SAVE_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
    const m = MIGRATIONS[v];
    if (!m) throw new Error(`no migration from schema ${v}`);
    p = m(p);
    v = p.schemaVersion;
  }
  if (v > SAVE_SCHEMA_VERSION) throw new Error(`profile schema ${v} is newer than this server (${SAVE_SCHEMA_VERSION})`);
  return p;
}

const num = (v, d, lo = 0, hi = 1e12) => (typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v) ? Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, v)) : d);
// timestamps (ms since 1970): never later than "now" (today's clock is
// already above num()'s default 1e12 limit, which would turn every save into
// "last seen in 2001")
const time = (v, now = Date.now()) => num(v, now, 0, now);

// Repairs anything inconsistent in a loaded profile instead of trusting it.
export function sanitizeProfile(p, id, now = Date.now()) {
  const out = newProfile(id, typeof p.name === 'string' ? p.name.slice(0, 16) : 'Player', time(p.createdAt, now));
  out.money = Math.floor(num(p.money, 0, 0, CONFIG.economy.maxMoney));
  out.gems = Math.floor(num(p.gems, 0, 0, CONFIG.gems.max));
  out.createdAt = time(p.createdAt, now);
  out.lastSeen = time(p.lastSeen, now);
  out.xp = Math.floor(num(p.xp, 0));
  out.level = Math.floor(num(p.level, 1, 1, CONFIG.progression.maxLevel));
  out.color = Number.isInteger(p.color) ? p.color & 0xffffff : null;
  out.swords = Array.isArray(p.swords) ? [...new Set(p.swords.filter((s) => SWORD_BY_ID[s]))] : [CONFIG.startingSword];
  if (!out.swords.includes(CONFIG.startingSword)) out.swords.unshift(CONFIG.startingSword);
  out.sword = out.swords.includes(p.sword) ? p.sword : out.swords[0];
  out.items = {};
  if (p.items && typeof p.items === 'object') {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(p.items)) {
      const def = ITEM_BY_ID[k];
      if (def) {
        const n = Math.floor(num(v, 0, 0, def.maxStack));
        if (n > 0) out.items[k] = n;
      }
    }
  }
  const b = p.base || {};
  out.base = {
    slots: Math.floor(num(b.slots, CONFIG.startingSlots, CONFIG.startingSlots, CONFIG.bases.maxSlots)),
    laserLevel: Math.floor(num(b.laserLevel, 0, 0, CONFIG.security.lockDurationsSec.length - 1)),
    guardLevel: Math.floor(num(b.guardLevel, 0, 0, GUARDS.maxLevel)),
    decor: new Array(DECOR_SPOTS).fill(null),
  };
  // decorations: known ids, bounded counts, never more placed than owned
  out.decor = { owned: {} };
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(p.decor?.owned || {})) {
    const n = Math.floor(num(v, 0, 0, DECOR_MAX_OWNED));
    if (DECOR_BY_ID[k] && n > 0) out.decor.owned[k] = n;
  }
  const placed = {};
  (Array.isArray(b.decor) ? b.decor : []).slice(0, DECOR_SPOTS).forEach((id, i) => {
    if (!DECOR_BY_ID[id] || (placed[id] || 0) >= (out.decor.owned[id] || 0)) return;
    placed[id] = (placed[id] || 0) + 1;
    out.base.decor[i] = id;
  });
  out.storedIncome = num(p.storedIncome, 0);
  // monsters: valid species, unique ids, unique slots within capacity
  const seen = new Set();
  const usedSlots = new Set();
  out.monsters = [];
  for (const m of Array.isArray(p.monsters) ? p.monsters : []) {
    if (!m || typeof m.id !== 'string' || seen.has(m.id) || !SPECIES_BY_ID[m.species]) continue;
    seen.add(m.id);
    let slot = Number.isInteger(m.slot) && m.slot >= 0 && m.slot < out.base.slots && !usedSlots.has(m.slot) ? m.slot : null;
    if (slot !== null) usedSlots.add(slot);
    out.monsters.push({
      id: m.id,
      species: m.species,
      level: Math.floor(num(m.level, 1, 1, 60)),
      obtainedAt: time(m.obtainedAt, now),
      origin: ['recruited', 'stolen', 'event', 'gift', 'returned'].includes(m.origin) ? m.origin : 'recruited',
      slot,
      following: !!m.following,
      team: !!m.team,
      stolenFrom: typeof m.stolenFrom === 'string' ? m.stolenFrom.slice(0, 16) : undefined,
      // who it was stolen from (for the admin's "return to owner")
      stolenFromId: typeof m.stolenFromId === 'string' ? m.stolenFromId.slice(0, 40) : undefined,
      stolenFromAccount: typeof m.stolenFromAccount === 'string' ? m.stolenFromAccount.slice(0, 128) : undefined,
    });
  }
  // at most five companions (monsters that walk with you; never on a pad)
  let followers = 0;
  for (const m of out.monsters) {
    if (m.following && m.slot === null && followers < 5) followers++;
    else m.following = false;
    if (!m.following) m.team = false;
  }
  const d = p.discoveries || {};
  out.discoveries = {
    species: d.species && typeof d.species === 'object' ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(d.species).filter(([k]) => SPECIES_BY_ID[k])) : {},
    spots: d.spots && typeof d.spots === 'object' ? { ...d.spots } : {},
  };
  out.regionsVisited = Array.isArray(p.regionsVisited) ? [...new Set(p.regionsVisited.filter((r) => REGION_BY_ID[r]))] : ['plains'];
  if (!out.regionsVisited.includes('plains')) out.regionsVisited.unshift('plains');
  out.tutorial = { step: Math.floor(num(p.tutorial?.step, 0, 0, 20)), done: !!p.tutorial?.done };
  const found = Array.isArray(p.moon?.found) ? p.moon.found.filter((i) => Number.isInteger(i) && i >= 0 && i < MOON.buttons.length) : [];
  out.moon = { found: [...new Set(found)], won: !!p.moon?.won };
  const costumes = Array.isArray(p.costumes?.owned) ? [...new Set(p.costumes.owned.filter((c) => COSTUME_BY_ID[c]))] : [];
  out.costumes = { owned: costumes, equipped: costumes.includes(p.costumes?.equipped) ? p.costumes.equipped : null, power: LEGEND_POWERS[p.costumes?.power] ? p.costumes.power : null };
  out.powerLevel = Math.floor(num(p.powerLevel, 0, 0, POWER_UPGRADE.maxLevel));
  const owned = Array.isArray(p.cosmetics?.owned) ? p.cosmetics.owned.filter((c) => COSMETIC_BY_ID[c]) : [];
  out.cosmetics = { owned: [...new Set(owned)], equipped: owned.includes(p.cosmetics?.equipped) ? p.cosmetics.equipped : null };
  out.coupons = { recruitDiscount: num(p.coupons?.recruitDiscount, 0, 0, 0.5) };
  out.stats = { ...out.stats };
  for (const k of Object.keys(out.stats)) out.stats[k] = Math.floor(num(p.stats?.[k], 0));
  out.milestones = p.milestones && typeof p.milestones === 'object' ? { ...p.milestones } : {};
  if (typeof p.account === 'string' && p.account) out.account = p.account.slice(0, 128);
  // level must match xp
  out.level = levelForXp(out.xp);
  return out;
}

export function levelForXp(xp) {
  let level = 1;
  let need = 0;
  while (level < CONFIG.progression.maxLevel) {
    need += xpForLevel(level);
    if (xp < need) break;
    level++;
  }
  return level;
}

export function xpProgress(xp) {
  let level = 1;
  let floor = 0;
  while (level < CONFIG.progression.maxLevel) {
    const need = xpForLevel(level);
    if (xp < floor + need) return { level, into: xp - floor, need };
    floor += need;
    level++;
  }
  return { level, into: 0, need: 0 };
}

// Perks from monsters placed in the base, with caps.
export function computePerks(profile) {
  const perks = {};
  for (const k of Object.keys(PERKS)) perks[k] = 0;
  let income = 0;
  for (const m of profile.monsters) {
    if (m.slot === null || m.slot === undefined) continue;
    const sp = SPECIES_BY_ID[m.species];
    perks[sp.perk.kind] += perkValue(sp, m.level);
    income += incomePerSecond(sp, m.level);
  }
  for (const k of Object.keys(PERKS)) perks[k] = Math.min(PERKS[k].cap, Math.round(perks[k] * 1000) / 1000);
  return { perks, baseIncome: income, income: Math.round(income * (1 + perks.income) * 10) / 10 };
}

export function playerMaxHp(profile, perks) {
  return Math.round(maxHpForLevel(profile.level) * (1 + (perks?.hp || 0)));
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Ownership ledger: monsterId -> { owner, species, level }.
// It is written BEFORE profiles whenever ownership changes, so after a crash
// a profile's stale copy of a transferred monster is dropped and a missing
// one is restored.

export class OwnershipLedger {
  constructor(store, log) {
    this.store = store;
    this.log = log;
    this.map = new Map();
    this.dirty = false;
    this.loaded = false;
  }

  async load() {
    const data = await this.store.loadLedger();
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(data || {})) {
      if (v && typeof v.owner === 'string' && SPECIES_BY_ID[v.species]) this.map.set(k, { owner: v.owner, species: v.species, level: v.level | 0 || 1 });
    }
    this.loaded = true;
  }

  owner(monsterId) {
    return this.map.get(monsterId)?.owner ?? null;
  }

  set(monsterId, owner, species, level) {
    this.map.set(monsterId, { owner, species, level });
    this.dirty = true;
  }

  remove(monsterId) {
    if (this.map.delete(monsterId)) this.dirty = true;
  }

  async save() {
    this.dirty = false;
    await this.store.saveLedger(Object.fromEntries(this.map));
  }

  // Starting over: the player's monsters are let go.
  removeOwner(owner) {
    for (const [mid, e] of [...this.map]) {
      if (e.owner === owner) {
        this.map.delete(mid);
        this.dirty = true;
      }
    }
  }

  // An online account's profile is the truth (it may have changed in other
  // rooms): the ledger takes its monsters as they are and forgets the old
  // entries for this owner.
  adopt(profile) {
    const ids = new Set(profile.monsters.map((m) => m.id));
    for (const [mid, e] of [...this.map]) {
      if (e.owner === profile.id && !ids.has(mid)) this.map.delete(mid);
    }
    for (const m of profile.monsters) this.map.set(m.id, { owner: profile.id, species: m.species, level: m.level });
    this.dirty = true;
  }

  // Makes a freshly loaded profile agree with the ledger.
  reconcile(profile) {
    const fixes = [];
    const ids = new Set();
    profile.monsters = profile.monsters.filter((m) => {
      const owner = this.owner(m.id);
      if (owner === null) {
        this.set(m.id, profile.id, m.species, m.level);
        fixes.push(`claimed ${m.id}`);
      } else if (owner !== profile.id) {
        fixes.push(`dropped ${m.id} (owned by ${owner})`);
        return false;
      }
      ids.add(m.id);
      return true;
    });
    for (const [mid, e] of this.map) {
      if (e.owner === profile.id && !ids.has(mid)) {
        profile.monsters.push({ id: mid, species: e.species, level: e.level, obtainedAt: Date.now(), origin: 'recruited', slot: null, following: false });
        fixes.push(`restored ${mid}`);
      }
    }
    return fixes;
  }
}

// The profile id of an account (the same in every room and on every device).
export function accountProfileId(account) {
  return 'p_' + sha256Hex('steal-a-monster-account:' + account).slice(0, 32);
}

export function newOwnedMonster(speciesId, level, origin, now, extra = {}) {
  return { id: randomId('m', 12), species: speciesId, level, obtainedAt: now, origin, slot: null, following: false, ...extra };
}

FILE: server/services/puzzles.js

// The Ancient Ruins puzzle: step on the three pressure plates in the right
// order (the order is carved on the temple: Moon, Star, Sun) within the time
// window to open the vault. While it is open the guardian Titanub can appear
// inside. The vault interior is a sealed zone the server refuses to let
// anyone walk into while the door is closed.

export class Puzzles {
  constructor(game) {
    this.game = game;
    this.def = game.world.puzzle;
    this.progress = [];
    this.lastStepAt = 0;
    this.openUntil = 0;
  }

  isOpen() {
    return this.openUntil > this.game.now();
  }

  state() {
    return { progress: [...this.progress], openUntil: this.openUntil, order: this.def.order };
  }

  insideVault(x, z) {
    const c = this.def.center;
    return Math.abs(x - c.x) < 10.4 && Math.abs(z - c.z) < 10.4;
  }

  mayMove(s, nx, nz) {
    if (this.isOpen()) return true;
    return !(this.insideVault(nx, nz) && !this.insideVault(s.pos.x, s.pos.z));
  }

  checkPlates(s) {
    const r = this.def.plateRadius;
    let on = null;
    for (const p of this.def.plates) {
      if ((s.pos.x - p.x) ** 2 + (s.pos.z - p.z) ** 2 < r * r && Math.abs(s.pos.y - p.y) < 3) on = p;
    }
    if (!on) {
      s.onPlate = null;
      return;
    }
    if (s.onPlate === on.id) return;
    s.onPlate = on.id;
    this.step(on.id, s);
  }

  step(id, s) {
    const game = this.game;
    if (this.isOpen()) return;
    const expected = this.def.order[this.progress.length];
    if (id === expected) {
      this.progress.push(id);
      this.lastStepAt = game.now();
      if (this.progress.length === this.def.order.length) {
        this.openUntil = game.now() + this.def.openMs;
        this.progress = [];
        game.broadcast('announce', { text: `${s.profile.name} opened the Temple vault! The Guardian stirs...`, kind: 'world' });
      }
    } else if (this.progress[this.progress.length - 1] !== id) {
      this.progress = [];
      game.toast(s, 'The plates go dark. Wrong order! (Hint: look at the temple carvings)', 'warn');
    }
    game.broadcast('puzzle', this.state());
  }

  tick(dt, now) {
    if (this.progress.length && now - this.lastStepAt > this.def.windowMs) {
      this.progress = [];
      this.game.broadcast('puzzle', this.state());
    }
    if (this.openUntil && now > this.openUntil) {
      this.openUntil = 0;
      this.game.broadcast('puzzle', this.state());
    }
  }
}

FILE: server/services/recruitment.js

// Defeat -> Pay -> Recruit.
//
// Defeating a monster never makes it yours. When a wild monster is defeated
// it sits dazed for CONFIG.combat.defeatedWindowMs. Every player who did a
// meaningful share of the damage gets a recruitment offer; the top fighter
// has a short priority window. Recruiting is a single synchronous server
// transaction: checks -> take Money -> grant ownership -> remove the monster
// from the world. A request id makes retries safe (no double payment).

import { CONFIG } from '#shared/config.js';
import { RARITIES, recruitPrice, monsterStats, incomePerSecond, perkValue, monsterPower, defeatRewards, recruitReqReason } from '#shared/monsters.js';
import { SWORD_BY_ID } from '#shared/weapons.js';
import { isObj, int, fail } from '../validate.js';
import { MS } from './monsterAI.js';
import { newOwnedMonster } from './playerData.js';
import { MAX_COMPANIONS } from './companions.js';

export class Recruitment {
  constructor(game) {
    this.game = game;
  }

  discountFor(s) {
    return Math.min(0.3, (s.perks?.discount || 0) + (s.profile.coupons.recruitDiscount || 0));
  }

  priceFor(s, m) {
    return recruitPrice(m.species, m.level, this.discountFor(s));
  }

  onDefeated(m, killer) {
    const game = this.game;
    const now = game.now();
    if (m.challengeFor) return this.onChallengeDefeated(m);
    m.defeatedAt = now;
    m.deadline = now + CONFIG.combat.defeatedWindowMs;
    const min = CONFIG.combat.assistShare * m.maxHp;
    const eligible = new Set();
    let top = null;
    let topDmg = -1;
    for (const [pid, dmg] of m.damageBy) {
      if (dmg >= min) eligible.add(pid);
      if (dmg > topDmg) {
        topDmg = dmg;
        top = pid;
      }
    }
    eligible.add(killer.id);
    m.eligible = eligible;
    m.top = top || killer.id;
    m.exclusiveUntil = now + CONFIG.combat.exclusiveRecruitMs;
    const rewards = defeatRewards(m.species, m.level);
    for (const pid of eligible) {
      const s = game.byProfile.get(pid);
      if (!s) continue;
      const xp = game.addXp(s, rewards.xp);
      game.economy.credit(s, rewards.money, 'defeat');
      const gems = game.economy.creditGems(s, this.rollGems(m), 'defeat');
      s.profile.stats.defeated++;
      this.discover(s, m.sp);
      game.tutorialEvent(s, 'defeat');
      game.send(s, 'reward', { xp, money: rewards.money, gems, monsterId: m.id });
      game.send(s, 'recruitOffer', this.offerFor(s, m));
    }
  }

  // A Moon Sky Arena monster: the challenger gets the usual rewards, but it is
  // never recruited (the prize is the secret monster at the end).
  onChallengeDefeated(m) {
    const game = this.game;
    m.defeatedAt = game.now();
    m.deadline = Infinity;
    m.eligible = null;
    const s = game.byProfile.get(m.challengeFor);
    if (s) {
      const rewards = defeatRewards(m.species, m.level);
      const xp = game.addXp(s, rewards.xp);
      game.economy.credit(s, rewards.money, 'defeat');
      const gems = game.economy.creditGems(s, this.rollGems(m), 'defeat');
      s.profile.stats.defeated++;
      this.discover(s, m.sp);
      game.send(s, 'reward', { xp, money: rewards.money, gems, monsterId: m.id });
    }
    game.moonSecret.onDefeated(m);
  }

  // Monster Gems from a defeat: by rarity, plus a bonus in gem-rich regions.
  rollGems(m) {
    const rng = this.game.rng;
    const d = CONFIG.gems.drops[m.species.rarity];
    let n = 0;
    if (d && rng() < d.chance) n += d.min + Math.floor(rng() * (d.max - d.min + 1));
    n += CONFIG.gems.regionBonus[m.region] || 0;
    return n;
  }

  discover(s, speciesId) {
    const d = s.profile.discoveries.species;
    if (!d[speciesId]) {
      d[speciesId] = this.game.now();
      this.game.markProfile(s);
    }
  }

  offerFor(s, m) {
    const st = monsterStats(m.species, m.level);
    return {
      monsterId: m.id,
      species: m.sp,
      level: m.level,
      price: this.priceFor(s, m),
      basePrice: recruitPrice(m.species, m.level),
      discount: this.discountFor(s),
      rarity: m.species.rarity,
      stats: { hp: st.maxHp, atk: Math.round(st.atk), def: Math.round(st.def), speed: st.speed },
      income: incomePerSecond(m.species, m.level),
      perk: { kind: m.species.perk.kind, value: perkValue(m.species, m.level) },
      power: monsterPower(m.species, m.level),
      deadline: m.deadline,
      priorityUntil: s.id === m.top ? 0 : m.exclusiveUntil,
      requirement: m.species.recruitReq?.text || null,
      requirementMissing: this.requirementMissing(s, m),
    };
  }

  bestSwordTier(s) {
    return Math.max(1, ...s.profile.swords.map((id) => SWORD_BY_ID[id]?.tier || 1));
  }

  requirementMissing(s, m) {
    return recruitReqReason(m.species, s.profile, this.bestSwordTier(s));
  }

  handleRecruit(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || !int(p.monsterId, 1, 1e12)) return fail('bad');
    const cached = s.recall(p.reqId);
    if (cached) return cached;
    const game = this.game;
    const now = game.now();
    const m = game.monsters.get(p.monsterId);
    const no = (code, msg) => s.remember(p.reqId, fail(code, msg));
    if (!m || m.state !== MS.defeated) return no('gone', 'That monster is no longer waiting to be recruited.');
    if (now > m.deadline) return no('expired', 'Too late — it recovered!');
    if (!m.eligible || !m.eligible.has(s.id)) return fail('not_eligible', 'You need to help defeat a monster to recruit it.');
    if (s.id !== m.top && now < m.exclusiveUntil) {
      return fail('priority', `The top fighter has first pick for ${Math.ceil((m.exclusiveUntil - now) / 1000)}s.`);
    }
    if (s.dead) return fail('dead', 'You are knocked out.');
    if (Math.hypot(s.pos.x - m.x, s.pos.z - m.z) > CONFIG.recruitment.maxDistance) return fail('too_far', 'Get closer to the monster.');
    const missing = this.requirementMissing(s, m);
    if (missing) return fail('requirement', missing);
    const profile = s.profile;
    if (profile.monsters.length >= profile.base.slots) {
      return fail('base_full', 'Your base is full! Upgrade your base for more slots, or release a monster.');
    }
    const price = this.priceFor(s, m);
    if (profile.money < price) return fail('money', `You need ${price} Money (you have ${Math.floor(profile.money)}).`);

    // ---- commit (synchronous: nothing can interleave) ----
    if (!game.economy.debit(s, price, `recruit:${m.sp}`)) return fail('money');
    if (profile.coupons.recruitDiscount) profile.coupons.recruitDiscount = 0;
    const owned = newOwnedMonster(m.sp, m.level, m.event ? 'event' : 'recruited', now);
    // it comes along with you if there is room among your companions
    owned.following = profile.monsters.filter((o) => o.following && o.slot === null).length < MAX_COMPANIONS;
    profile.monsters.push(owned);
    game.ledger.set(owned.id, profile.id, owned.species, owned.level);
    profile.stats.recruited++;
    this.discover(s, m.sp);
    const others = [...m.eligible].filter((pid) => pid !== s.id);
    m.eligible = null;
    m.state = MS.recover; // no longer recruitable, even for a moment
    game.monsters.remove(m, 'recruited', { by: s.pn, owned: owned.id });
    for (const pid of others) {
      const o = game.byProfile.get(pid);
      if (o) game.send(o, 'offerGone', { monsterId: m.id, by: profile.name });
    }
    game.tutorialEvent(s, 'recruit');
    game.bases.checkMilestones(s);
    if (s.inBases.has(s.baseIndex)) game.bases.autoPlace(s);
    game.markProfile(s);
    game.saveNow(s);
    const rarity = RARITIES[m.species.rarity];
    if (rarity.order >= 3) game.broadcast('announce', { text: `${profile.name} recruited a ${rarity.name} ${m.species.name}!`, kind: 'rare' });
    return s.remember(p.reqId, { ok: true, owned, price, money: profile.money });
  }

  handleDecline(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || !int(p.monsterId, 1, 1e12)) return fail('bad');
    const m = this.game.monsters.get(p.monsterId);
    if (!m || m.state !== MS.defeated || !m.eligible) return { ok: true };
    m.eligible.delete(s.id);
    if (m.eligible.size === 0) this.game.monsters.recover(m);
    else if (m.top === s.id) m.exclusiveUntil = 0;
    return { ok: true };
  }

  onLeave(s) {
    for (const m of this.game.monsters.list.values()) {
      if (m.state !== MS.defeated || !m.eligible) continue;
      if (m.eligible.delete(s.id) && m.eligible.size === 0) this.game.monsters.recover(m);
    }
  }

  tick(dt, now) {
    for (const m of this.game.monsters.list.values()) {
      if (m.state === MS.defeated && now > m.deadline) {
        if (m.eligible) {
          for (const pid of m.eligible) {
            const o = this.game.byProfile.get(pid);
            if (o) this.game.send(o, 'offerGone', { monsterId: m.id, expired: true });
          }
        }
        this.game.monsters.recover(m);
      }
    }
  }
}

FILE: server/services/security.js

// Base security lasers.
//
// The owner switches the lasers on at their base (lock pad or L key). While
// they are on, rivals cannot enter the base and nothing can be stolen. They
// switch off by themselves after a while, so bases are only safe while their
// owner keeps coming back to re-lock them.

import { CONFIG } from '#shared/config.js';
import { isInsideBase } from '#shared/world.js';
import { fail } from '../validate.js';

export class Security {
  constructor(game) {
    this.game = game;
    this.lockedUntil = new Array(12).fill(0);
    this.relockAt = new Array(12).fill(0);
  }

  resetBase(i) {
    this.lockedUntil[i] = 0;
    this.relockAt[i] = 0;
  }

  isLocked(i) {
    return this.lockedUntil[i] > this.game.now();
  }

  mayEnter(s, baseIndex) {
    if (baseIndex === s.baseIndex) return true;
    return !this.isLocked(baseIndex);
  }

  lockDurationMs(s) {
    const d = CONFIG.security.lockDurationsSec[s.profile.base.laserLevel] || CONFIG.security.lockDurationsSec[0];
    return d * 1000 * (1 + (s.perks?.security || 0));
  }

  handleLock(s) {
    if (CONFIG.security.requireAtBaseToLock) {
      const b = this.game.world.bases[s.baseIndex];
      const nearPad = (s.pos.x - b.lockPad.x) ** 2 + (s.pos.z - b.lockPad.z) ** 2 < 25;
      if (!isInsideBase(b, s.pos.x, s.pos.z, 1) && !nearPad) return fail('not_at_base', 'Lock your lasers at your base.');
    }
    return this.lock(s);
  }

  lock(s) {
    const game = this.game;
    const now = game.now();
    const i = s.baseIndex;
    if (s.dead) return fail('dead');
    if (this.isLocked(i)) return fail('already', 'Lasers are already on.');
    if (now < this.relockAt[i]) return fail('cooldown', `Lasers recharging (${Math.ceil((this.relockAt[i] - now) / 1000)}s)`);
    this.lockedUntil[i] = now + this.lockDurationMs(s);
    // anybody else inside gets pushed out; a thief inside drops the monster
    const b = game.world.bases[i];
    for (const o of game.players.values()) {
      if (o === s || !isInsideBase(b, o.pos.x, o.pos.z, 0.5)) continue;
      if (o.carrying && o.carrying.baseIndex === i) game.stealing.interrupt(o, 'lasers', 'returnToOwner');
      game.stealing.cancelPending(o);
      const jitter = (game.rng() - 0.5) * 6;
      o.inBases.delete(i);
      game.teleport(o, b.outside.x + b.tu.x * jitter, b.y, b.outside.z + b.tu.z * jitter, 'lasers');
      game.toast(o, 'The security lasers pushed you out!', 'bad');
    }
    for (const o of game.players.values()) {
      if (o.stealPending && o.stealPending.baseIndex === i) game.stealing.cancelPending(o, 'Lasers switched on!');
    }
    game.bases.broadcastBase(i);
    game.tutorialEvent(s, 'lock');
    return { ok: true, until: this.lockedUntil[i] };
  }

  tick(dt, now) {
    for (let i = 0; i < this.lockedUntil.length; i++) {
      if (this.lockedUntil[i] && this.lockedUntil[i] <= now) {
        this.lockedUntil[i] = 0;
        this.relockAt[i] = now + CONFIG.security.relockCooldownSec * 1000;
        const owner = this.game.bases.ownerSession(i);
        if (owner) this.game.toast(owner, 'Your security lasers are OFF! Return to your base to lock it again.', 'warn');
        this.game.bases.broadcastBase(i);
      }
    }
  }
}

FILE: server/services/stealing.js

// Multiplayer monster stealing.
//
// 1. A rival walks into a base whose lasers are OFF and holds E next to a
//    placed monster (stealBegin ... stealConfirm, the server times the hold).
// 2. The thief carries the monster (slower, can't teleport home). Ownership
//    does NOT change yet: the monster still belongs to the victim.
// 3. If the thief reaches their own base, ownership transfers exactly once.
// 4. If the thief is hit by a gadget, defeated, disconnects or runs out of
//    time, the theft is interrupted and the monster goes back according to
//    CONFIG.stealing.dropRule:
//      'returnToOwner'   - it flies straight back to its pad
//      'dropRecoverable' - it is dropped on the ground for a few seconds; the
//                          owner can touch it to send it home, another rival
//                          can grab it, otherwise it flies home by itself.

import { CONFIG } from '#shared/config.js';
import { SPECIES_BY_ID } from '#shared/monsters.js';
import { isObj, id as isId, fail } from '../validate.js';

export class Stealing {
  constructor(game) {
    this.game = game;
    this.away = new Map();     // owned monster id -> { kind: 'carried' | 'dropped', by: profile id }
    this.dropped = new Map();  // owned monster id -> drop record
  }

  isAway(ownedId) {
    return this.away.has(ownedId);
  }

  // Finds a placed monster in an online player's base.
  findPlaced(ownedId) {
    for (const owner of this.game.players.values()) {
      const m = owner.profile.monsters.find((x) => x.id === ownedId);
      if (m) return m.slot !== null ? { owner, m } : null;
    }
    return null;
  }

  handleBegin(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || !isId(p.ownedId)) return fail('bad');
    const game = this.game;
    const now = game.now();
    if (s.dead) return fail('dead');
    if (s.fx.frozenUntil > now || s.fx.rootedUntil > now) return fail('stuck');
    if (s.carrying) return fail('carrying', 'You are already carrying a monster.');
    if (s.stealPending) return fail('busy', 'Already grabbing a monster.');
    const found = this.findPlaced(p.ownedId);
    if (!found) return fail('not_found', 'That monster is not on a pad.');
    const { owner, m } = found;
    if (owner === s) return fail('own', 'That monster is already yours!');
    if (this.isAway(m.id)) return fail('busy', 'Someone else is already stealing it.');
    if (game.security.isLocked(owner.baseIndex)) return fail('lasers', 'The security lasers are on!');
    if (CONFIG.stealing.victimProtectionMs && now - owner.joinedAt < CONFIG.stealing.victimProtectionMs) return fail('protected', 'That player just arrived.');
    if (this.padDistance(s, owner.baseIndex, m.slot) > CONFIG.stealing.maxDistance) return fail('too_far', 'Get closer.');
    if (s.profile.monsters.length >= s.profile.base.slots) return fail('base_full', 'Your base is full — no room for a stolen monster!');
    for (const o of game.players.values()) {
      if (o !== s && o.stealPending && o.stealPending.ownedId === m.id) return fail('busy', 'Someone else is grabbing it.');
    }
    s.stealPending = { ownedId: m.id, baseIndex: owner.baseIndex, startedAt: now, victim: owner.id, species: m.species };
    const sp = SPECIES_BY_ID[m.species];
    game.send(owner, 'theft', { stage: 'grab', thief: s.profile.name, species: m.species, name: sp.name });
    return { ok: true, holdMs: CONFIG.stealing.holdMs };
  }

  // Distance from a player to a pad; a pad on another floor is out of reach.
  padDistance(s, baseIndex, slotIndex) {
    const b = this.game.world.bases[baseIndex];
    const slot = b.slots[slotIndex];
    if (Math.abs(s.pos.y - (b.y + slot.y)) > 3) return Infinity;
    return Math.hypot(s.pos.x - slot.x, s.pos.z - slot.z);
  }

  handleConfirm(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || !isId(p.ownedId)) return fail('bad');
    const game = this.game;
    const now = game.now();
    const pend = s.stealPending;
    if (!pend || pend.ownedId !== p.ownedId) return fail('no_pending');
    if (now - pend.startedAt < CONFIG.stealing.holdMs - CONFIG.stealing.holdToleranceMs) return fail('too_soon', 'Keep holding!');
    // from here on the grab ends either way; on failure the owner hears it is safe
    const abort = (code, message) => {
      this.cancelPending(s);
      return fail(code, message);
    };
    if (s.dead || s.carrying) return abort('cant');
    if (s.fx.frozenUntil > now || s.fx.rootedUntil > now) return abort('stuck');
    const found = this.findPlaced(p.ownedId);
    if (!found || found.owner.id !== pend.victim) return abort('gone', 'The monster is gone.');
    const { owner, m } = found;
    if (this.isAway(m.id)) return abort('busy');
    if (game.security.isLocked(owner.baseIndex)) return abort('lasers', 'The security lasers switched on!');
    if (this.padDistance(s, owner.baseIndex, m.slot) > CONFIG.stealing.maxDistance + 1) return abort('too_far');
    if (s.profile.monsters.length >= s.profile.base.slots) return abort('base_full');
    s.stealPending = null;
    s.carrying = { ownedId: m.id, victimId: owner.id, baseIndex: owner.baseIndex, species: m.species, level: m.level, since: now };
    this.away.set(m.id, { kind: 'carried', by: s.id });
    const name = SPECIES_BY_ID[m.species].name;
    game.send(owner, 'theft', { stage: 'carry', thief: s.profile.name, species: m.species, name });
    game.broadcast('announce', { text: `${s.profile.name} is stealing ${owner.profile.name}'s ${name}!`, kind: 'theft' });
    game.bases.broadcastBase(owner.baseIndex);
    if (s.inBases.has(s.baseIndex)) this.completeTheft(s);
    return { ok: true, carrying: m.id };
  }

  handleCancel(s) {
    this.cancelPending(s);
    return { ok: true };
  }

  // A grab that ended without a theft (let go, interrupted, timed out, the
  // thief left): the owner's alarm is cleared.
  cancelPending(s, message) {
    const pend = s.stealPending;
    if (!pend) return;
    s.stealPending = null;
    if (message) this.game.toast(s, message, 'bad');
    const victim = this.game.byProfile.get(pend.victim);
    const sp = SPECIES_BY_ID[pend.species];
    if (victim && sp) this.game.send(victim, 'theft', { stage: 'safe', thief: s.profile.name, species: pend.species, name: sp.name });
  }

  // Delivery: the thief made it home.
  completeTheft(s) {
    const game = this.game;
    const c = s.carrying;
    if (!c) return false;
    s.carrying = null; // cleared first: this can only ever run once per theft
    this.away.delete(c.ownedId);
    const victim = game.byProfile.get(c.victimId);
    const victimProfile = victim ? victim.profile : game.profileCache.get(c.victimId);
    const vm = victimProfile && victimProfile.monsters.find((x) => x.id === c.ownedId);
    if (!vm || game.ledger.owner(c.ownedId) !== c.victimId) {
      game.toast(s, 'The monster slipped away.', 'bad');
      return false;
    }
    if (s.profile.monsters.length >= s.profile.base.slots) {
      game.toast(s, 'Your base is full — the monster ran home!', 'bad');
      if (victim) game.bases.broadcastBase(victim.baseIndex);
      return false;
    }
    // ledger first, then both profiles
    game.ledger.set(c.ownedId, s.id, vm.species, vm.level);
    victimProfile.monsters = victimProfile.monsters.filter((x) => x.id !== c.ownedId);
    const free = game.bases.freeSlots(s.profile);
    const moved = {
      ...vm, slot: free.length ? free[0] : null, following: false, team: false, origin: 'stolen', obtainedAt: game.now(),
      // who it belongs to, for the admin's "return to owner"
      stolenFrom: victimProfile.name, stolenFromId: victimProfile.id, stolenFromAccount: victimProfile.account,
    };
    s.profile.monsters.push(moved);
    s.profile.stats.stolen++;
    victimProfile.stats.lost++;
    game.saveNow(s, victimProfile);
    const name = SPECIES_BY_ID[vm.species].name;
    game.toast(s, `You stole ${victimProfile.name}'s ${name}!`, 'good');
    if (victim) {
      game.send(victim, 'theft', { stage: 'stolen', thief: s.profile.name, species: vm.species, name });
      game.refreshPerks(victim);
      game.markProfile(victim);
      game.bases.broadcastBase(victim.baseIndex);
    }
    game.refreshPerks(s);
    game.markProfile(s);
    game.bases.broadcastBase(s.baseIndex);
    game.bases.checkMilestones(s);
    game.broadcast('announce', { text: `${s.profile.name} stole a ${name} from ${victimProfile.name}!`, kind: 'theft' });
    return true;
  }

  // The thief was hit / defeated / left. rule overrides CONFIG.stealing.dropRule.
  interrupt(s, reason, rule) {
    const game = this.game;
    const c = s.carrying;
    if (!c) return false;
    s.carrying = null;
    const how = rule || CONFIG.stealing.dropRule;
    const victim = game.byProfile.get(c.victimId);
    if (how === 'dropRecoverable' && victim) {
      const now = game.now();
      const d = {
        ownedId: c.ownedId, victimId: c.victimId, baseIndex: c.baseIndex, species: c.species, level: c.level,
        x: s.pos.x, y: game.world.surfaceHeight(s.pos.x, s.pos.z, s.pos.y), z: s.pos.z,
        until: now + CONFIG.stealing.dropRecoverMs, regrabAt: now + CONFIG.stealing.regrabCooldownMs, by: s.id,
      };
      this.dropped.set(c.ownedId, d);
      this.away.set(c.ownedId, { kind: 'dropped', by: null });
      game.broadcast('dropped', this.dropInfo(d));
      game.send(victim, 'theft', { stage: 'dropped', thief: s.profile.name, species: c.species, name: SPECIES_BY_ID[c.species].name });
    } else {
      this.returnHome(c.ownedId, c.victimId, c.baseIndex);
      if (victim) game.send(victim, 'theft', { stage: 'saved', thief: s.profile.name, species: c.species, name: SPECIES_BY_ID[c.species].name });
    }
    game.toast(s, reason === 'defeated' ? 'You were knocked out and dropped the monster!' : 'You dropped the stolen monster!', 'bad');
    game.broadcast('theftInterrupted', { pn: s.pn, reason });
    return true;
  }

  returnHome(ownedId, victimId, baseIndex) {
    this.away.delete(ownedId);
    if (this.dropped.delete(ownedId)) this.game.broadcast('droppedGone', { ownedId, home: true });
    const victim = this.game.byProfile.get(victimId);
    if (victim) this.game.bases.broadcastBase(victim.baseIndex);
