    else if (baseIndex >= 0) this.game.bases.broadcastBase(baseIndex);
  }

  dropInfo(d) {
    return { ownedId: d.ownedId, species: d.species, level: d.level, x: d.x, y: d.y, z: d.z, until: d.until, baseIndex: d.baseIndex };
  }

  droppedList() {
    return [...this.dropped.values()].map((d) => this.dropInfo(d));
  }

  handleGrabDropped(s, p) {
    if (!isObj(p) || !isId(p.ownedId)) return fail('bad');
    const game = this.game;
    const now = game.now();
    const d = this.dropped.get(p.ownedId);
    if (!d) return fail('gone');
    if (s.dead || s.carrying) return fail('cant');
    if (Math.hypot(s.pos.x - d.x, s.pos.z - d.z) > 4) return fail('too_far');
    if (s.id === d.victimId) {
      this.returnHome(d.ownedId, d.victimId, d.baseIndex);
      game.toast(s, 'Rescued! It ran back to its pad.', 'good');
      return { ok: true, rescued: true };
    }
    if (now < d.regrabAt) return fail('cooldown', 'It is still dizzy...');
    if (s.profile.monsters.length >= s.profile.base.slots) return fail('base_full');
    this.dropped.delete(d.ownedId);
    game.broadcast('droppedGone', { ownedId: d.ownedId });
    s.carrying = { ownedId: d.ownedId, victimId: d.victimId, baseIndex: d.baseIndex, species: d.species, level: d.level, since: now };
    this.away.set(d.ownedId, { kind: 'carried', by: s.id });
    const victim = game.byProfile.get(d.victimId);
    if (victim) game.send(victim, 'theft', { stage: 'carry', thief: s.profile.name, species: d.species, name: SPECIES_BY_ID[d.species].name });
    if (s.inBases.has(s.baseIndex)) this.completeTheft(s);
    return { ok: true, carrying: d.ownedId };
  }

  tick(dt, now) {
    const game = this.game;
    for (const s of game.players.values()) {
      if (s.carrying && now - s.carrying.since > CONFIG.stealing.carryTimeoutMs) this.interrupt(s, 'timeout', 'returnToOwner');
      if (s.stealPending && now - s.stealPending.startedAt > CONFIG.stealing.holdMs + 4000) this.cancelPending(s);
    }
    for (const d of [...this.dropped.values()]) {
      const owner = game.byProfile.get(d.victimId);
      if (!owner) {
        this.returnHome(d.ownedId, d.victimId, d.baseIndex);
        continue;
      }
      if (now > d.until) {
        this.returnHome(d.ownedId, d.victimId, d.baseIndex);
        continue;
      }
      if (!owner.dead && Math.hypot(owner.pos.x - d.x, owner.pos.z - d.z) < 3) {
        this.returnHome(d.ownedId, d.victimId, d.baseIndex);
        game.toast(owner, 'Rescued! It ran back to its pad.', 'good');
      }
    }
  }

  onLeave(s) {
    // the thief left: the monster goes home
    if (s.carrying) {
      const c = s.carrying;
      s.carrying = null;
      this.returnHome(c.ownedId, c.victimId, c.baseIndex);
      const victim = this.game.byProfile.get(c.victimId);
      if (victim) this.game.send(victim, 'theft', { stage: 'saved', thief: s.profile.name, species: c.species, name: SPECIES_BY_ID[c.species].name });
    }
    this.cancelPending(s);
    // the victim left: every theft of their monsters is cancelled
    for (const o of this.game.players.values()) {
      if (o === s) continue;
      if (o.carrying && o.carrying.victimId === s.id) {
        const c = o.carrying;
        o.carrying = null;
        this.away.delete(c.ownedId);
        this.game.toast(o, 'The owner left — the monster ran home.', 'bad');
      }
      if (o.stealPending && o.stealPending.victim === s.id) o.stealPending = null;
    }
    for (const d of [...this.dropped.values()]) {
      if (d.victimId === s.id) this.returnHome(d.ownedId, d.victimId, -1);
    }
  }
}

FILE: server/services/worldExpansion.js

// Population-based world expansion.
//
// Every region has a minPopulation. When enough players are online, the
// expansion islands open (their portals light up, monsters and Lucky Blocks
// appear there) and the server raises its monster capacity. When players
// leave, regions close again after a delay (hysteresis), players inside are
// warned and then brought back to the plaza. Everything stays bounded: a
// fixed set of region templates, a hard monster cap, and cleanup on close.

import { CONFIG } from '#shared/config.js';
import { REGIONS, REGION_BY_ID, regionIdAt } from '#shared/regions.js';

export class WorldExpansion {
  constructor(game, thresholds) {
    this.game = game;
    this.minPop = {};
    for (const r of REGIONS) this.minPop[r.id] = r.minPopulation || 0;
    // optional override, e.g. EXPANSION_THRESHOLDS="2,4" for bloomveil,starfall
    if (Array.isArray(thresholds)) {
      const exp = REGIONS.filter((r) => r.expansion);
      exp.forEach((r, i) => {
        if (Number.isFinite(thresholds[i])) this.minPop[r.id] = thresholds[i];
      });
    }
    this.active = new Set(REGIONS.filter((r) => this.minPop[r.id] <= 0).map((r) => r.id));
    this.closing = new Map(); // region id -> { at, warned }
  }

  population() {
    return this.game.players.size;
  }

  tier() {
    return REGIONS.filter((r) => r.expansion && this.active.has(r.id)).length;
  }

  state() {
    return {
      active: [...this.active],
      population: this.population(),
      tier: this.tier(),
      monsterCap: this.game.monsters ? this.game.monsters.cap() : 0,
      minPop: this.minPop,
      closing: Object.fromEntries([...this.closing].map(([id, c]) => [id, c.at])),
    };
  }

  update(silent = false) {
    const pop = this.population();
    const now = this.game.now();
    let changed = false;
    for (const r of REGIONS) {
      const want = this.minPop[r.id] <= pop;
      if (want && !this.active.has(r.id)) {
        this.active.add(r.id);
        changed = true;
        if (!silent) this.game.broadcast('announce', { text: `${r.name} has opened! (${pop} players online)`, kind: 'world' });
      }
      if (want && this.closing.has(r.id)) {
        this.closing.delete(r.id);
        changed = true;
      }
      if (!want && this.active.has(r.id) && !this.closing.has(r.id)) {
        this.closing.set(r.id, { at: now + CONFIG.expansion.shrinkDelayMs, warned: false });
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    if (changed && !silent) this.game.broadcast('world', this.state());
  }

  tick(dt, now) {
    for (const [id, c] of [...this.closing]) {
      const region = REGION_BY_ID[id];
      if (!c.warned && now >= c.at - CONFIG.expansion.closeWarningMs) {
        c.warned = true;
        for (const s of this.game.players.values()) {
          if (s.region === id) this.game.toast(s, `${region.name} is closing soon — not enough players online!`, 'warn');
        }
      }
      if (now >= c.at) {
        this.closing.delete(id);
        this.active.delete(id);
        for (const s of this.game.players.values()) {
          if (regionIdAt(s.pos.x, s.pos.z) === id) {
            const portal = this.game.world.portals.find((p) => p.region === 'plains' && regionIdAt(p.x, p.z) === id);
            const dest = portal ? portal.to : { x: 10, y: 3.6, z: -10 };
            this.game.stealing.interrupt(s, 'closed', 'returnToOwner');
            this.game.teleport(s, dest.x, dest.y, dest.z, 'region_closed');
            this.game.toast(s, `${region.name} closed. You were sent back to the plaza.`, 'warn');
          }
        }
        this.game.broadcast('world', this.state());
        this.game.broadcast('announce', { text: `${region.name} has closed until more players join.`, kind: 'world' });
      }
    }
  }
}

FILE: server/storage.js

// Persistent storage.
//
// JsonFileStore is the DEVELOPMENT storage: one JSON file per player plus an
// ownership ledger, written atomically (write to a temp file, keep the
// previous version as .bak, then rename). It is safe against crashes in the
// middle of a write, but it is a single-process store: run one server per
// data directory. For production, implement the same four methods on top of
// a database (see README "Durable storage").
//
// Store interface:
//   async loadProfile(id)        -> object | null (null = no such profile)
//                                    throws ProfileLoadError if it exists but is unreadable
//   async saveProfile(id, data)
//   async loadLedger()           -> { [monsterId]: { owner, species, level } }
//   async saveLedger(data)

import fs from 'node:fs';
import fsp from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';

export class ProfileLoadError extends Error {
  constructor(message, cause) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ProfileLoadError';
    this.cause = cause;
  }
}

const SAFE_ID = /^[a-z0-9_]{4,64}$/;

async function readJson(file) {
  const text = await fsp.readFile(file, 'utf8');
  return JSON.parse(text);
}

async function atomicWrite(file, data) {
  const tmp = `${file}.${process.pid}.${Date.now()}.tmp`;
  const text = JSON.stringify(data);
  const fh = await fsp.open(tmp, 'w');
  try {
    await fh.writeFile(text, 'utf8');
    await fh.sync();
  } finally {
    await fh.close();
  }
  try {
    await fsp.copyFile(file, `${file}.bak`);
  } catch (e) {
    if (e.code !== 'ENOENT') throw e;
  }
  await fsp.rename(tmp, file);
}

async function readWithBackup(file) {
  let primaryError = null;
  try {
    return await readJson(file);
  } catch (e) {
    if (e.code === 'ENOENT') {
      // fall through to the backup (a crash between copy and rename)
      try {
        return await readJson(`${file}.bak`);
      } catch (e2) {
        if (e2.code === 'ENOENT') return null;
        throw new ProfileLoadError(`Could not read ${path.basename(file)} or its backup`, e2);
      }
    }
    primaryError = e;
  }
  try {
    const data = await readJson(`${file}.bak`);
    try {
      await fsp.rename(file, `${file}.corrupt-${Date.now()}`);
    } catch { /* keep going */ }
    return data;
  } catch (e2) {
    throw new ProfileLoadError(`Profile file ${path.basename(file)} is unreadable`, primaryError || e2);
  }
}

export class JsonFileStore {
  constructor(dir) {
    this.dir = dir;
    this.playersDir = path.join(dir, 'players');
    fs.mkdirSync(this.playersDir, { recursive: true });
    this.queues = new Map(); // serialize writes per file
  }

  fileFor(id) {
    if (!SAFE_ID.test(id)) throw new Error('invalid profile id');
    return path.join(this.playersDir, `${id}.json`);
  }

  serial(key, fn) {
    const prev = this.queues.get(key) || Promise.resolve();
    const next = prev.then(fn, fn);
    this.queues.set(key, next.catch(() => {}));
    return next;
  }

  async loadProfile(id) {
    return readWithBackup(this.fileFor(id));
  }

  async saveProfile(id, data) {
    const file = this.fileFor(id);
    const snapshot = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data));
    return this.serial(file, () => atomicWrite(file, snapshot));
  }

  async loadLedger() {
    const file = path.join(this.dir, 'ownership.json');
    const data = await readWithBackup(file);
    return data && typeof data === 'object' ? data : {};
  }

  async saveLedger(data) {
    const file = path.join(this.dir, 'ownership.json');
    const snapshot = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data));
    return this.serial(file, () => atomicWrite(file, snapshot));
  }

  // accounts (server/accounts.js) and bans (the admin's)
  async loadAccounts() {
    return (await readWithBackup(path.join(this.dir, 'accounts.json'))) || {};
  }

  async saveAccounts(data) {
    const file = path.join(this.dir, 'accounts.json');
    const snapshot = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data));
    return this.serial(file, () => atomicWrite(file, snapshot));
  }

  async loadBans() {
    return (await readWithBackup(path.join(this.dir, 'bans.json'))) || {};
  }

  async saveBans(data) {
    const file = path.join(this.dir, 'bans.json');
    const snapshot = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data));
    return this.serial(file, () => atomicWrite(file, snapshot));
  }
}

// In-memory store for tests and throwaway servers.
export class MemoryStore {
  constructor() {
    this.profiles = new Map();
    this.ledger = {};
    this.failSaves = false;
    this.saveCount = 0;
  }

  async loadProfile(id) {
    const p = this.profiles.get(id);
    if (p === 'CORRUPT') throw new ProfileLoadError('corrupt (test)');
    return p ? JSON.parse(p) : null;
  }

  async saveProfile(id, data) {
    if (this.failSaves) throw new Error('simulated save failure');
    this.saveCount++;
    this.profiles.set(id, JSON.stringify(data));
  }

  async loadLedger() {
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.ledger));
  }

  async saveLedger(data) {
    if (this.failSaves) throw new Error('simulated save failure');
    this.ledger = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data));
  }

  async loadAccounts() {
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.accounts || {}));
  }

  async saveAccounts(data) {
    this.accounts = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data));
  }

  async loadBans() {
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.bans || {}));
  }

  async saveBans(data) {
    this.bans = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data));
  }
}

FILE: server/validate.js

// Input validation helpers. Every client payload goes through these; anything
// that does not match is rejected before it reaches gameplay code.

export function isObj(v) {
  return v !== null && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v);
}

export function finite(v, min = -1e7, max = 1e7) {
  return typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v) && v >= min && v <= max;
}

export function str(v, maxLen = 64) {
  return typeof v === 'string' && v.length > 0 && v.length <= maxLen;
}

export function id(v) {
  return typeof v === 'string' && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,48}$/.test(v);
}

export function int(v, min = 0, max = 1e9) {
  return Number.isInteger(v) && v >= min && v <= max;
}

export function sanitizeName(v) {
  const s = String(v ?? '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_ -]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 16);
  return s.length >= 2 ? s : null;
}

export function sanitizeText(v, max = 160) {
  // eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex
  return String(v ?? '').replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f<>]/g, '').trim().slice(0, max);
}

export function color(v) {
  return Number.isInteger(v) && v >= 0 && v <= 0xffffff;
}

export const fail = (error, message) => ({ ok: false, error, message: message || error });

FILE: shared/collision.js

// 2D collision shapes on the ground plane (x/z) with a vertical extent.
//
//   circle: { kind: 'circle', x, z, r, y0, y1 }
//   box:    { kind: 'box', x, z, hw, hd, ax, az, y0, y1 }
//           (ax, az) is the unit axis of the half-width hw; the half-depth hd
//           runs along the perpendicular (-az, ax).

export class ColliderGrid {
  constructor(cellSize = 16) {
    this.cell = cellSize;
    this.cells = new Map();
    this.all = [];
  }

  key(cx, cz) {
    return cx * 73856093 ^ cz * 19349663;
  }

  add(c) {
    if (c.kind === 'box') c.br = Math.sqrt(c.hw * c.hw + c.hd * c.hd);
    else c.br = c.r;
    if (c.y0 === undefined) c.y0 = -1e9;
    if (c.y1 === undefined) c.y1 = 1e9;
    if (c.enabled === undefined) c.enabled = true;
    this.all.push(c);
    const s = this.cell;
    const x0 = Math.floor((c.x - c.br) / s);
    const x1 = Math.floor((c.x + c.br) / s);
    const z0 = Math.floor((c.z - c.br) / s);
    const z1 = Math.floor((c.z + c.br) / s);
    for (let cx = x0; cx <= x1; cx++) {
      for (let cz = z0; cz <= z1; cz++) {
        const k = this.key(cx, cz);
        let list = this.cells.get(k);
        if (!list) this.cells.set(k, (list = []));
        list.push(c);
      }
    }
    return c;
  }

  // Calls fn(collider) for colliders whose cells overlap the circle (x, z, r).
  query(x, z, r, fn) {
    const s = this.cell;
    const x0 = Math.floor((x - r) / s);
    const x1 = Math.floor((x + r) / s);
    const z0 = Math.floor((z - r) / s);
    const z1 = Math.floor((z + r) / s);
    const seen = x0 === x1 && z0 === z1 ? null : new Set();
    for (let cx = x0; cx <= x1; cx++) {
      for (let cz = z0; cz <= z1; cz++) {
        const list = this.cells.get(this.key(cx, cz));
        if (!list) continue;
        for (const c of list) {
          if (seen) {
            if (seen.has(c)) continue;
            seen.add(c);
          }
          fn(c);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Pushes a circle of radius r at pos {x, y, z} out of every collider it
  // overlaps. y is the bottom of the moving body, h its height.
  // Returns true if anything was hit.
  resolve(pos, r, h = 4) {
    let hit = false;
    for (let iter = 0; iter < 3; iter++) {
      let moved = false;
      this.query(pos.x, pos.z, r + 1, (c) => {
        if (!c.enabled) return;
        if (pos.y + h < c.y0 || pos.y > c.y1) return;
        if (c.kind === 'circle') {
          const dx = pos.x - c.x;
          const dz = pos.z - c.z;
          const min = r + c.r;
          const d2 = dx * dx + dz * dz;
          if (d2 < min * min) {
            const d = Math.sqrt(d2) || 0.0001;
            const push = min - d;
            pos.x += (dx / d) * push;
            pos.z += (dz / d) * push;
            moved = hit = true;
          }
        } else {
          // into box space
          const dx = pos.x - c.x;
          const dz = pos.z - c.z;
          const lu = dx * c.ax + dz * c.az;
          const lv = -dx * c.az + dz * c.ax;
          const cu = Math.max(-c.hw, Math.min(c.hw, lu));
          const cv = Math.max(-c.hd, Math.min(c.hd, lv));
          let nu = lu - cu;
          let nv = lv - cv;
          const d2 = nu * nu + nv * nv;
          if (d2 < r * r) {
            let push;
            if (d2 > 1e-8) {
              const d = Math.sqrt(d2);
              push = r - d;
              nu /= d;
              nv /= d;
            } else {
              // centre inside the box: leave through the closest face
              const pu = c.hw - Math.abs(lu);
              const pv = c.hd - Math.abs(lv);
              if (pu < pv) {
                nu = Math.sign(lu) || 1;
                nv = 0;
                push = pu + r;
              } else {
                nu = 0;
                nv = Math.sign(lv) || 1;
                push = pv + r;
              }
            }
            pos.x += (nu * c.ax - nv * c.az) * push;
            pos.z += (nu * c.az + nv * c.ax) * push;
            moved = hit = true;
          }
        }
      });
      if (!moved) break;
    }
    return hit;
  }

  // True if a circle of radius r moving in a straight line from (x0, z0) to
  // (x1, z1) runs into a collider that it was not already touching at the
  // start (so you can always step out of something). y0..y1 is the height
  // range of the moving body. Used by the server to check player moves.
  segmentBlocked(x0, z0, x1, z1, r, y0, y1) {
    const len = Math.hypot(x1 - x0, z1 - z0);
    const steps = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(len / 0.3));
    let blocked = false;
    this.query((x0 + x1) / 2, (z0 + z1) / 2, len / 2 + r + 0.5, (c) => {
      if (blocked || !c.enabled || y1 < c.y0 || y0 > c.y1) return;
      if (overlaps(c, x0, z0, r)) return;
      for (let i = 1; i <= steps; i++) {
        const t = i / steps;
        if (overlaps(c, x0 + (x1 - x0) * t, z0 + (z1 - z0) * t, r)) {
          blocked = true;
          return;
        }
      }
    });
    return blocked;
  }
}

// Does a circle of radius r at (x, z) overlap collider c (ignoring height)?
function overlaps(c, x, z, r) {
  const dx = x - c.x;
  const dz = z - c.z;
  if (c.kind === 'circle') return dx * dx + dz * dz < (r + c.r) * (r + c.r);
  const lu = dx * c.ax + dz * c.az;
  const lv = -dx * c.az + dz * c.ax;
  const nu = lu - Math.max(-c.hw, Math.min(c.hw, lu));
  const nv = lv - Math.max(-c.hd, Math.min(c.hd, lv));
  return nu * nu + nv * nv < r * r;
}

export function boxCollider(x, z, hw, hd, angle, y0, y1, extra = {}) {
  return { kind: 'box', x, z, hw, hd, ax: Math.cos(angle), az: Math.sin(angle), y0, y1, ...extra };
}

export function circleCollider(x, z, r, y0, y1, extra = {}) {
  return { kind: 'circle', x, z, r, y0, y1, ...extra };
}

  dayLengthMs: 12 * 60 * 1000,

// Allow a few overrides through environment variables on the server.
export function applyEnvOverrides(env = {}) {
  if (env.LUCKY_EVENT_FIRST_MS) CONFIG.events.luckyLucky.firstDelayMs = Number(env.LUCKY_EVENT_FIRST_MS);
  if (env.LUCKY_EVENT_INTERVAL_MS) CONFIG.events.luckyLucky.intervalMs = Number(env.LUCKY_EVENT_INTERVAL_MS);
  if (env.MAX_PLAYERS) CONFIG.maxPlayers = Math.max(1, Math.min(12, Number(env.MAX_PLAYERS) | 0));
}

export function xpForLevel(level) {
  const p = CONFIG.progression;
  return Math.round(p.xpBase * Math.pow(level, p.xpExponent));
}

export function maxHpForLevel(level) {
  return CONFIG.player.baseHp + CONFIG.player.hpPerLevel * (level - 1);
}

});

export const LEGEND_MOVES = 10; // sword moves in a row before they start again

// The costume as it looks and fights with the chosen power (Legend Master).
export function costumeWithPower(costume, powerId) {
  if (!costume?.choosePower) return costume;
  const el = LEGEND_POWERS[powerId] || LEGEND_POWERS.fire;
  return {
    ...costume,
    colors: el.colors,
    look: { ...costume.look, cape: el.colors.cape },
    element: powerId in LEGEND_POWERS ? powerId : 'fire',
    power: {
      ...costume.power, name: el.power, shape: el.shape, color: el.fx[0],
      radius: el.radius, range: el.range, arc: el.arc, maxTargets: el.maxTargets,
      burn: el.burn, freezeMs: el.freezeMs, heal: el.heal,
    },
  };
}

export const COSTUME_BY_ID = Object.fromEntries(COSTUMES.map((c) => [c.id, c]));
export const COSTUME_INDEX = Object.fromEntries(COSTUMES.map((c, i) => [c.id, i]));

// Damage of a costume's master power with the player's power upgrades.
export function powerDamage(costume, level = 0) {
  return costume.power.damage + POWER_UPGRADE.bonus * level;
}

// How many copies of each decoration are currently placed.
export function placedCounts(placed) {
  const n = {};
  for (const id of placed || []) if (id) n[id] = (n[id] || 0) + 1;
  return n;
}

// The seven monster islands. Each one is a region (see regions.js) reached
// through the Island Gate in the plaza, and each has its own 50 species, from
// Common up to Mythic (generated by speciesGen.js from the data below):
//   16 Common · 13 Uncommon · 10 Rare · 6 Epic · 3 Legendary · 2 Mythic
// Legendary monsters live in the island's lair and Mythic ones at its shrine.
//
// templates: model "families" (existing species whose 3D recipe is reused and
// recoloured), in the order the island prefers them.
// top: the hand-picked Epic/Legendary/Mythic monsters ([template, name]).

export const ISLAND_BY_ID = Object.fromEntries(ISLANDS.map((i) => [i.id, i]));

export function islandCenter(island) {
  const a = (island.angle * Math.PI) / 180;
  return { x: Math.round(Math.cos(a) * ISLAND_RING_R), z: Math.round(Math.sin(a) * ISLAND_RING_R) };
}

// Points along the island's side that faces the continent.
export function islandPoint(island, fromCenter, sideways = 0) {
  const c = islandCenter(island);
  const a = (island.angle * Math.PI) / 180;
  const dx = -Math.cos(a);
  const dz = -Math.sin(a);
  return { x: c.x + dx * fromCenter - dz * sideways, z: c.z + dz * fromCenter + dx * sideways };
}

// Region definitions for regions.js.
export function islandRegions() {
  return ISLANDS.map((isl) => {
    const c = islandCenter(isl);
    return {
      id: isl.id,
      name: isl.name,
      blurb: isl.blurb,
      shape: { kind: 'island', cx: c.x, cz: c.z, r: ISLAND_R },
      levels: isl.levels,
      unlock: isl.unlock > 1 ? { level: isl.unlock } : {},
      minPopulation: 0,
      monsterIsland: true,
      terrain: isl.terrain,
      colors: isl.colors,
      fog: isl.fog,
      props: isl.props,
      music: isl.music,
    };
  });
}

// Lucky Blocks, their reward tables, and cosmetics.
// Rewards are always rolled on the server; the client only shows the result.

export const LUCKY_KINDS = {
  lucky: { name: 'Lucky Block', color: 0xffc23a, color2: 0xfff27a, moneyMult: 1 },
  super: { name: 'Super Lucky Block', color: 0x7a5aff, color2: 0xff7af0, moneyMult: 2.5 },
  mythic: { name: 'Mythic Lucky Block', color: 0xff3d6a, color2: 0xffe23a, moneyMult: 5 },
  // not a Lucky Block: a rock full of Monster Gems in the gem-rich regions
  geode: { name: 'Gem Geode', color: 0x6a4a3a, color2: 0xff6af0, moneyMult: 1, geode: true },
};

// weight: base chance weight; luckWeight: extra weight per point of luck
// (luck = 0 normally, up to ~1 with perks; event blocks add luck too).
export const LUCKY_TABLE = [
  { kind: 'money', weight: 34, luckWeight: -8, min: 60, max: 180 },
  { kind: 'money', weight: 12, luckWeight: 6, min: 250, max: 600, big: true },
  { kind: 'xp', weight: 12, luckWeight: 0, min: 40, max: 120 },
  { kind: 'item', weight: 14, luckWeight: 0, pool: ['sticky_trap', 'slippery_gel', 'shield', 'speed_boost', 'detector'], qty: [1, 3] },
  { kind: 'tool', weight: 3, luckWeight: 2, pool: ['knockback', 'capture_net', 'freeze'] },
  { kind: 'discount', weight: 8, luckWeight: 3, value: 0.25 },
  { kind: 'clue', weight: 7, luckWeight: 4 },
  { kind: 'encounter', weight: 5, luckWeight: 4 },
  { kind: 'cosmetic', weight: 4, luckWeight: 3 },
  { kind: 'sword', weight: 1.5, luckWeight: 2.5 },
  { kind: 'gems', weight: 6, luckWeight: 3, min: 1, max: 3 },
];

export const COSMETICS = [
  { id: 'party_hat', name: 'Party Hat', color: 0xff5a9a },
  { id: 'lucky_crown', name: 'Lucky Crown', color: 0xffd23a },
  { id: 'flower_crown', name: 'Flower Crown', color: 0xff9fd8 },
  { id: 'monster_ears', name: 'Monster Ears', color: 0xffa23a },
  { id: 'halo', name: 'Starlight Halo', color: 0xfff7a8 },
  { id: 'top_hat', name: 'Fancy Top Hat', color: 0x2a2a3a },
  { id: 'propeller', name: 'Propeller Cap', color: 0x4fb8ff },
  { id: 'horns', name: 'Dragon Horns', color: 0xd8452a },
];

export const COSMETIC_BY_ID = Object.fromEntries(COSMETICS.map((c) => [c.id, c]));
export const COSMETIC_INDEX = Object.fromEntries(COSMETICS.map((c, i) => [c.id, i]));

export function rollLucky(rng, luck = 0) {
  let total = 0;
  const weights = LUCKY_TABLE.map((e) => {
    const w = Math.max(0.5, e.weight + e.luckWeight * luck);
    total += w;
    return w;
  });
  let r = rng() * total;
  for (let i = 0; i < LUCKY_TABLE.length; i++) {
    r -= weights[i];
    if (r <= 0) return LUCKY_TABLE[i];
  }
  return LUCKY_TABLE[0];
}

// Monster species registry.
//
// Every species is pure data: gameplay stats, AI temperament, attacks, the
// perk it gives at your base, where and when it spawns, its personality
// animations, and a "model recipe" that client/monsterRenderer.js turns into a
// 3D model. Adding a species means adding an entry here; the combat engine,
// AI, recruitment and UI pick it up automatically.
//
// Model units: the ground is y = 0 and the monster faces +z. A typical baby
// monster is about 2.2 units tall before `size` is applied (a player is 4.6).

    },

    legs: { count: 4, style: 'paw', size: [0.24, 0.26], color: 'body', gapX: 0.38, gapZ: 0.34, tip: 'accent' },
    tail: { style: 'comet', size: 0.8, color: 'accent2', color2: 'accent' },
    back: { style: 'stars', color: 'accent2', count: 5 },
    extras: [{ kind: 'halo', color: 'glow' }, { kind: 'satellites', color: 'accent2', count: 3 }],
    aura: { kind: 'star', color: 0xbfe3ff },
  },
};

export const SPECIES = [...BASE_SPECIES, ...generateIslandSpecies(BASE_SPECIES), LUNAMOCHI];

export const SPECIES_BY_ID = Object.fromEntries(SPECIES.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
export const SPECIES_INDEX = Object.fromEntries(SPECIES.map((s, i) => [s.id, i]));

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Level scaling (shared so the UI shows exactly what the server uses).

export function monsterStats(species, level) {
  const L = Math.max(1, level | 0);
  const s = species.stats;
  return {
    maxHp: Math.round(s.hp * (1 + 0.2 * (L - 1))),
    atk: s.atk * (1 + 0.12 * (L - 1)),
    def: s.def * (1 + 0.08 * (L - 1)),
    speed: s.speed,
  };
}

// Extra conditions some rare monsters set before they can be recruited
// (beyond defeating them and paying). Returns null when met, else the reason.
// bestSwordTier: the highest tier among the swords the player owns.
export function recruitReqReason(species, profile, bestSwordTier) {
  const r = species.recruitReq;
  if (!r) return null;
  if (r.swordTier && bestSwordTier < r.swordTier) return `Needs a Tier ${r.swordTier} sword (you have Tier ${bestSwordTier}).`;
  const found = Object.keys(profile.discoveries?.species || {}).length;
  if (r.discoveries && found < r.discoveries) return `Discover ${r.discoveries} species first (you have ${found}).`;
  return null;
}

export function recruitPrice(species, level, discount = 0) {
  const base = species.price * (1 + 0.12 * (Math.max(1, level) - 1));
  return Math.max(1, Math.round(base * (1 - Math.min(0.3, Math.max(0, discount)))));
}

export function incomePerSecond(species, level) {
  return Math.round(species.income * (1 + 0.08 * (Math.max(1, level) - 1)) * 10) / 10;
}

export function defeatRewards(species, level) {
  const r = RARITIES[species.rarity] || RARITIES.common;
  return {
    xp: Math.round(12 * Math.max(1, level) * r.xp),
    money: Math.round(recruitPrice(species, level) * 0.06 + 4),
  };
}

export function perkValue(species, level) {
  return species.perk.value * (1 + 0.03 * (Math.max(1, level) - 1));
}

// A single number for comparing monsters in the UI.
export function monsterPower(species, level) {
  const st = monsterStats(species, level);
  return Math.round(st.maxHp * 0.5 + st.atk * 6 + st.def * 4 + species.stats.speed * 2);
}

FILE: shared/moonSecret.js

// The secret of Cute Monster Island:
//   1. find the five small moon buttons hidden on the island and step on
//      them (each one turns blue: 1/5, 2/5 ...),
//   2. a portal appears out of nowhere (an arrow points the way),
//   3. it leads to the Moon Sky Arena: floating platforms with four battle
//      platforms in a row: an Uncommon, a Rare, an Epic and a Legendary
//      monster, one per round,
//   4. win all four rounds and the Secret monster joins you.
// This file holds the shared layout; the rules live in server/services/moonSecret.js.

import { ISLAND_BY_ID, islandPoint } from './islands.js';

const CUTE = ISLAND_BY_ID.cute;

export const MOON = {
  buttonRadius: 1.6,           // how close you must step
  buttons: [
    islandPoint(CUTE, 62, 78),
    islandPoint(CUTE, -38, 104),
    islandPoint(CUTE, -112, -18),
    islandPoint(CUTE, 18, -112),
    islandPoint(CUTE, 96, -64),
  ].map((p, id) => ({ id, ...p })),
  portal: { ...islandPoint(CUTE, 28, 34), r: 3.2 },
  // where you land when you come back
  returnTo: islandPoint(CUTE, 36, 40),
  secretSpecies: 'cute_lunamochi',
  rounds: ['uncommon', 'rare', 'epic', 'legendary'],
  roundLevels: [4, 5, 6, 7],
  fallY: 3,                    // below this in the arena you are caught and sent back
};

// The Moon Sky Arena is its own little region far out at sea (see regions.js).
export const ARENA = { id: 'moonsky', cx: 0, cz: 1700, r: 120 };

const A = (u, v) => ({ x: ARENA.cx + u, z: ARENA.cz + v });

// Battle platforms (round 1..4) and the start platform. top = walking height.
export const ARENA_START = { ...A(0, 72), half: 6, top: 6 };
export const ARENA_PLATFORMS = [
  { round: 0, ...A(0, 26), half: 9, top: 10 },
  { round: 1, ...A(-36, -8), half: 9, top: 13 },
  { round: 2, ...A(4, -44), half: 9, top: 16 },
  { round: 3, ...A(42, -12), half: 11, top: 19 },
];

// Stepping stones between two platforms: about one jump apart, rising evenly.
function stones(from, to, n, seed) {
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
    const t = i / (n + 1);
    const wobble = Math.sin((i + seed) * 1.7) * 3.2;
    const dx = to.x - from.x;
    const dz = to.z - from.z;
    const len = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
    out.push({
      x: from.x + dx * t + (-dz / len) * wobble,
      z: from.z + dz * t + (dx / len) * wobble,
      half: 2.2,
      top: from.top + (to.top - from.top) * t,
    });
  }
  return out;
}

export const ARENA_STONES = [
  ...stones(ARENA_START, ARENA_PLATFORMS[0], 5, 0),
  ...stones(ARENA_PLATFORMS[0], ARENA_PLATFORMS[1], 5, 2),
  ...stones(ARENA_PLATFORMS[1], ARENA_PLATFORMS[2], 5, 4),
  ...stones(ARENA_PLATFORMS[2], ARENA_PLATFORMS[3], 6, 6),
];

export function arenaRegionDef() {
  return {
    id: ARENA.id,
    name: 'Moon Sky Arena',
    blurb: 'Floating platforms under a giant moon. Only the moon buttons open the way.',
    shape: { kind: 'island', cx: ARENA.cx, cz: ARENA.cz, r: ARENA.r },
    levels: [4, 8],
    unlock: {},
    minPopulation: 0,
    arena: true,
    terrain: { style: 'void', base: -14 },
    colors: { low: 0x2a2a6a, high: 0x3a3a8a, cliff: 0x1a1a4a, path: 0x9a8aff, accent: 0xb8a0ff },
    fog: { color: 0x3a3a8a, near: 90, far: 300 },
    props: [],
    music: 'stars',
  };
}

// Walkable boxes for world.js: { x, z, half, top }.
export function arenaSurfaces() {
  return [ARENA_START, ...ARENA_PLATFORMS, ...ARENA_STONES];
}

// Which battle platform (index) is under (x, z), or -1.
export function arenaPlatformAt(x, z) {
  for (let i = 0; i < ARENA_PLATFORMS.length; i++) {
    const p = ARENA_PLATFORMS[i];
    if (Math.abs(x - p.x) <= p.half && Math.abs(z - p.z) <= p.half) return i;
  }
  return -1;
}

FILE: shared/names.js

// Player names and accounts, shared by the server and the browser.
//
// Names are unique: "Mira Fox", "mira fox" and "Mira   Fox" are the same name
// (nameKey). Spaces are allowed. The accounts named "daniel", "nadine",
// "naddd" (Nadine's account), "prabu" and "shallom" are the admins of every server (server/services/admin.js).
// The same list is in firebase-database.rules.json (keep them in step).
//
// Online (Firebase) accounts sign in with Firebase Authentication using an
// email made from the name, so the name is also unique there and the
// database rules can check who is who (firebase-database.rules.json).

export const ADMIN_NAMES = ['daniel', 'nadine', 'naddd', 'prabu', 'shallom'];
export const ACCOUNT_EMAIL_DOMAIN = 'players.steal-a-monster.game';
export const PASSWORD_MIN = 6;

// The displayed name: 2-16 letters, numbers, spaces, _ or -.
export function cleanName(v) {
  const s = String(v ?? '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_ -]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 16).trim();
  return s.length >= 2 ? s : null;
}

// What makes two names "the same".
export function nameKey(name) {
  return String(name ?? '').toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

export function isAdminName(name) {
  return ADMIN_NAMES.includes(nameKey(name));
}

// "Mira Fox" -> "mira.fox@players.steal-a-monster.game"
export function accountEmail(name) {
  return `${nameKey(name).replace(/ /g, '.')}@${ACCOUNT_EMAIL_DOMAIN}`;
}

// the seven monster islands (islands.js), reached through the Island Gate
REGIONS.push(...islandRegions());
// and the Moon Sky Arena, only reached through the secret portal on Cute
// Monster Island (moonSecret.js)
REGIONS.push(arenaRegionDef());

export const REGION_BY_ID = Object.fromEntries(REGIONS.map((r) => [r.id, r]));
export const REGION_INDEX = Object.fromEntries(REGIONS.map((r, i) => [r.id, i]));

function angleDeg(x, z) {
  let a = (Math.atan2(z, x) * 180) / Math.PI;
  if (a < 0) a += 360;
  return a;
}

function inSector(a, a0, a1) {
  return a0 <= a1 ? a >= a0 && a < a1 : a >= a0 || a < a1;
}

// Returns the region id at a world position, or null outside the world.
export function regionIdAt(x, z) {
  for (const r of REGIONS) {
    if (r.shape.kind === 'island') {
      const dx = x - r.shape.cx;
      const dz = z - r.shape.cz;
      if (dx * dx + dz * dz < r.shape.r * r.shape.r) return r.id;
    }
  }
  const d = Math.sqrt(x * x + z * z);
  if (d < RING.hub) return 'plains';
  if (d >= RING.edge) return null;
  const a = angleDeg(x, z);
  if (d >= RING.outer) return 'legendary';
  const r1 = d < RING.inner ? RING.hub : RING.inner;
  for (const r of REGIONS) {
    if (r.shape.kind === 'sector' && r.shape.r1 === r1 && inSector(a, r.shape.a0, r.shape.a1)) return r.id;
  }
  return null;
}

export function regionAt(x, z) {
  const id = regionIdAt(x, z);
  return id ? REGION_BY_ID[id] : null;
}

// Center point of a region (used for the minimap labels and teleports).
export function regionCenter(region) {
  const s = region.shape;
  if (s.kind === 'disc') return { x: 0, z: 0 };
  if (s.kind === 'island') return { x: s.cx, z: s.cz };
  if (s.kind === 'ring') return { x: (s.r1 + s.r2) / 2, z: 0 };
  let a1 = s.a1;
  if (a1 < s.a0) a1 += 360;
  const a = (((s.a0 + a1) / 2) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const r = (s.r1 + s.r2) / 2;
  return { x: Math.cos(a) * r, z: Math.sin(a) * r };
}

// What a player needs to enter a region. Returns null when allowed, otherwise
// a short human readable reason.
export function regionLockReason(region, player, activeRegionIds) {
  if (!region) return 'The edge of the world';
  if (activeRegionIds && !activeRegionIds.has(region.id)) {
    return `${region.name} opens when ${region.minPopulation}+ players are online`;
  }
  const u = region.unlock || {};
  if (u.level && (player.level || 1) < u.level) return `${region.name} requires Level ${u.level}`;
  if (u.swordTier && (player.swordTier || 0) < u.swordTier) return `${region.name} requires a Tier ${u.swordTier} sword`;
  return null;
}

FILE: shared/rng.js

// Deterministic hashing, random numbers and value noise.
//
// The server and every browser must generate exactly the same world, so these
// helpers only use integer math (Math.imul) and plain +,-,*,/ which give
// identical results in every JavaScript engine.

export function hashString(str) {
  let h = 1779033703 ^ str.length;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    h = Math.imul(h ^ str.charCodeAt(i), 3432918353);
    h = (h << 13) | (h >>> 19);
  }
  h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 16), 2246822507);
  h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 3266489909);
  return (h ^= h >>> 16) >>> 0;
}

// Small fast PRNG (mulberry32). Returns a function producing floats in [0, 1).
export function mulberry32(seed) {
  let a = seed >>> 0;
  return function next() {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let t = a;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

export function rngFor(...parts) {
  return mulberry32(hashString(parts.join('|')));
}

// Integer lattice hash -> [0, 1)
export function hash2(ix, iz, seed) {
  let h = Math.imul(ix | 0, 374761393) ^ Math.imul(iz | 0, 668265263) ^ Math.imul(seed | 0, 2147483647);
  h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 1274126177);
  h ^= h >>> 16;
  return (h >>> 0) / 4294967296;
}

const smooth = (t) => t * t * (3 - 2 * t);

// 2D value noise in [-1, 1]
export function valueNoise(x, z, seed) {
  const ix = Math.floor(x);
  const iz = Math.floor(z);
  const fx = smooth(x - ix);
  const fz = smooth(z - iz);
  const a = hash2(ix, iz, seed);
  const b = hash2(ix + 1, iz, seed);
  const c = hash2(ix, iz + 1, seed);
  const d = hash2(ix + 1, iz + 1, seed);
  const top = a + (b - a) * fx;
  const bot = c + (d - c) * fx;
  return (top + (bot - top) * fz) * 2 - 1;
}

// Fractal value noise in roughly [-1, 1]
export function fbm(x, z, seed, octaves = 3) {
  let sum = 0;
  let amp = 1;
  let freq = 1;
  let norm = 0;
  for (let o = 0; o < octaves; o++) {
    sum += valueNoise(x * freq, z * freq, seed + o * 1013) * amp;
    norm += amp;
    amp *= 0.5;
    freq *= 2.03;
  }
  return sum / norm;
}

// Ridged noise in [0, 1], peaks along ridges (mountains, dunes).
export function ridged(x, z, seed, octaves = 3) {
  let sum = 0;
  let amp = 1;
  let freq = 1;
  let norm = 0;
  for (let o = 0; o < octaves; o++) {
    const n = 1 - Math.abs(valueNoise(x * freq, z * freq, seed + o * 7919));
    sum += n * n * amp;
    norm += amp;
    amp *= 0.5;
    freq *= 2.1;
  }
  return sum / norm;
}

export function clamp(v, lo, hi) {
  return v < lo ? lo : v > hi ? hi : v;
}

export function lerp(a, b, t) {
  return a + (b - a) * t;
}

export function smoothstep(e0, e1, x) {
  const t = clamp((x - e0) / (e1 - e0), 0, 1);
  return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
}

// Random id for owned monsters, requests and tokens (not used for world generation).
export function randomId(prefix = '', bytes = 9) {
  const alphabet = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789';
  let out = prefix;
  const g = globalThis.crypto;
  if (g && g.getRandomValues) {
    const buf = new Uint8Array(bytes);
    g.getRandomValues(buf);
    for (const b of buf) out += alphabet[b % alphabet.length];
  } else {
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes; i++) out += alphabet[Math.floor(Math.random() * alphabet.length)];
  }
  return out;
}

// SHA-256 of a string (UTF-8), as lowercase hex. Plain JavaScript so the same
// code works on the server and when the game runs entirely in the browser.

const K = new Uint32Array([
  0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,
  0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
  0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
  0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
  0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
  0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
  0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
  0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2,
]);

export function sha256Hex(str) {
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(str);
  const len = bytes.length;
  const total = Math.ceil((len + 9) / 64) * 64;
  const buf = new Uint8Array(total);
  buf.set(bytes);
  buf[len] = 0x80;
  const bits = len * 8;
  const dv = new DataView(buf.buffer);
  dv.setUint32(total - 8, Math.floor(bits / 0x100000000));
  dv.setUint32(total - 4, bits >>> 0);
  const h = new Uint32Array([0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19]);
  const w = new Uint32Array(64);
  const rotr = (x, n) => (x >>> n) | (x << (32 - n));
  for (let off = 0; off < total; off += 64) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) w[i] = dv.getUint32(off + i * 4);
    for (let i = 16; i < 64; i++) {
      const s0 = rotr(w[i - 15], 7) ^ rotr(w[i - 15], 18) ^ (w[i - 15] >>> 3);
      const s1 = rotr(w[i - 2], 17) ^ rotr(w[i - 2], 19) ^ (w[i - 2] >>> 10);
      w[i] = (w[i - 16] + s0 + w[i - 7] + s1) >>> 0;
    }
    let [a, b, c, d, e, f, g, hh] = h;
    for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
      const S1 = rotr(e, 6) ^ rotr(e, 11) ^ rotr(e, 25);
      const ch = (e & f) ^ (~e & g);
      const t1 = (hh + S1 + ch + K[i] + w[i]) >>> 0;
      const S0 = rotr(a, 2) ^ rotr(a, 13) ^ rotr(a, 22);
      const maj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
      const t2 = (S0 + maj) >>> 0;
      hh = g;
      g = f;
      f = e;
      e = (d + t1) >>> 0;
      d = c;
      c = b;
      b = a;
      a = (t1 + t2) >>> 0;
    }
    h[0] += a; h[1] += b; h[2] += c; h[3] += d; h[4] += e; h[5] += f; h[6] += g; h[7] += hh;
  }
  return Array.from(h, (x) => x.toString(16).padStart(8, '0')).join('');
}

FILE: shared/speciesGen.js

// Generates the 50 species of every monster island (islands.js) from the
// hand-made species: each new species reuses a "template" species' 3D recipe,
// recoloured with the island's palette, with extra features by rarity (marks,
// crests, horns, wings, halos), its own name, stats, attacks, perk and spawn
// rules. Everything is deterministic (seeded), so the server and every client
// build exactly the same 350 species.

import { rngFor } from './rng.js';
import {
  ISLANDS, RARITY_SLOTS, TEMPLATE_STEMS, TEMPLATE_NOUNS, BIG_TEMPLATES, NO_TEMPLATE, NOT_CUTE,
} from './islands.js';

const RARITY_ORDER = ['mythic', 'legendary', 'epic', 'rare', 'uncommon', 'common'];
const ORDER_INDEX = { common: 0, uncommon: 1, rare: 2, epic: 3, legendary: 4, mythic: 5 };

const BASE = {
  common: { hp: 70, atk: 6, def: 3, price: 220, size: 1.0, perk: 0.04, category: 'common' },
  uncommon: { hp: 105, atk: 8, def: 4.5, price: 700, size: 1.06, perk: 0.06, category: 'common' },
  rare: { hp: 190, atk: 11, def: 7, price: 3200, size: 1.2, perk: 0.09, category: 'rare' },
  epic: { hp: 420, atk: 14, def: 9, price: 13000, size: 1.85, perk: 0.13, category: 'elite' },
  legendary: { hp: 800, atk: 18, def: 11, price: 60000, size: 2.2, perk: 0.2, category: 'legendary' },
  mythic: { hp: 1300, atk: 22, def: 14, price: 160000, size: 2.7, perk: 0.28, category: 'mythic' },
};

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ colour

function hexToHsl(hex) {
  const r = ((hex >> 16) & 255) / 255;
  const g = ((hex >> 8) & 255) / 255;
  const b = (hex & 255) / 255;
  const max = Math.max(r, g, b);
  const min = Math.min(r, g, b);
  let h = 0;
  let s = 0;
  const l = (max + min) / 2;
  if (max !== min) {
    const d = max - min;
    s = l > 0.5 ? d / (2 - max - min) : d / (max + min);
    if (max === r) h = (g - b) / d + (g < b ? 6 : 0);
    else if (max === g) h = (b - r) / d + 2;
    else h = (r - g) / d + 4;
    h /= 6;
  }
  return [h, s, l];
}

function hslToHex(h, s, l) {
  const f = (n) => {
    const k = (n + h * 12) % 12;
    const a = s * Math.min(l, 1 - l);
    return Math.round(255 * (l - a * Math.max(-1, Math.min(k - 3, 9 - k, 1))));
  };
  return (f(0) << 16) | (f(8) << 8) | f(4);
}

function jitter(hex, rng, dh = 0.03, ds = 0.08, dl = 0.06) {
  const [h, s, l] = hexToHsl(hex);
  const c = (v) => Math.min(1, Math.max(0, v));
  return hslToHex((h + (rng() - 0.5) * 2 * dh + 1) % 1, c(s + (rng() - 0.5) * 2 * ds), c(l + (rng() - 0.5) * 2 * dl));
}

function mix(a, b, t) {
  const ch = (x, sh) => (x >> sh) & 255;
  const m = (sh) => Math.round(ch(a, sh) + (ch(b, sh) - ch(a, sh)) * t);
  return (m(16) << 16) | (m(8) << 8) | m(0);
}

const hexStr = (n) => `#${n.toString(16).padStart(6, '0')}`;
const pick = (rng, list) => list[Math.floor(rng() * list.length) % list.length];
const clone = (o) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o));
const niceNumber = (v) => {
  const p = 10 ** Math.max(0, Math.floor(Math.log10(v)) - 1);
  return Math.round(v / p) * p;
};

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ models

const SWAP_EYES = new Set(['gloss', 'gloss-white', 'sparkle', 'lashes', 'happy', 'fierce', 'fierce-white', 'liner', 'sleepy', 'glow', 'cat']);
const SCARY_MOUTHS = new Set(['fangs', 'chomp', 'croc', 'grin']);
const BACK_SHAPES = new Set(['ellipsoid', 'egg', 'pear', 'bean', 'roundbox']);
const BACK_COUNT = { spikes: 5, stars: 7, spots: 4, stripes: 3, crystals: 5, scutes: 5, fur: 4, armor: 4, runes: 4, cracks: 4, quills: 18, ribs: 4, elytra: 2 };

function recolor(model, isl, rng) {
  const pal = isl.palette;
  const main = jitter(pick(rng, pal.main), rng);
  let second = jitter(pick(rng, pal.second), rng);
  if (second === main) second = mix(main, 0x000000, 0.3);
  const c = model.colors;
  const out = { ...c };
  out.body = main;
  out.belly = mix(main, 0xffffff, isl.cute ? 0.65 : 0.55);
  out.accent = second;
  out.accent2 = mix(second, 0xffffff, 0.35);
  out.inner = mix(second, 0xffc8d8, 0.6);
  out.cheek = pal.cheek;
  out.glow = pal.glow;
  if ('wing' in c) out.wing = mix(second, 0xffffff, 0.45);
  if ('face' in c) out.face = mix(main, 0xffffff, 0.4);
  if ('horn' in c) out.horn = mix(second, 0x202020, 0.25);
  if ('shell' in c) out.shell = mix(second, 0xffffff, 0.2);
  model.colors = out;
  if (model.face?.eyes?.color !== undefined) model.face.eyes.color = pal.eye;
}

function mutate(model, isl, rarity, rng) {
  const order = ORDER_INDEX[rarity];
  const face = model.face || (model.face = {});
  // eyes and (on Cute Monster Island) a friendly mouth
  if (face.eyes && SWAP_EYES.has(face.eyes.style) && (isl.cute || rng() < 0.5)) face.eyes.style = pick(rng, isl.eyes);
  if (isl.cute && face.mouth && SCARY_MOUTHS.has(face.mouth.style)) {
    face.mouth = { style: pick(rng, ['smile', 'cat']), size: Math.min(0.14, face.mouth.size || 0.12), y: face.mouth.y ?? -0.2 };
  }
  if (isl.cute && !face.cheeks && face.eyes) face.cheeks = { size: 0.12, gap: (face.eyes.gap || 0.35) + 0.12, y: (face.eyes.y || 0) - 0.18 };
  // a mark on the forehead
  if (order >= 1 && face.eyes && rng() < 0.55 + order * 0.08) {
    const kind = pick(rng, isl.marks);
    face.mark = face.mark
      ? { ...face.mark, kind, color: 'glow', glow: order >= 3 }
      : { kind, color: 'glow', y: (face.eyes.y || 0.1) + 0.33, size: 0.12 + order * 0.01, glow: order >= 3 };
  }
  // back decoration
  if (order >= 1 && BACK_SHAPES.has(model.body?.shape) && rng() < 0.35 + order * 0.1) {
    const style = pick(rng, isl.backs);
    model.back = { style, color: 'accent', color2: 'accent2', count: BACK_COUNT[style] || 4 };
  }
  // crest (Epic and up always, sometimes for Rare)
  if (order >= 3 || (order === 2 && rng() < 0.4)) {
    const style = order >= 4 && rng() < 0.6 ? 'crown' : pick(rng, isl.crests);
    model.crest = { style, color: order >= 4 ? 'glow' : 'accent', tip: 'glow', size: style === 'crown' ? 0.5 : 0.6 };
  }
  // horns
  if (order >= 2 && !model.horns && rng() < 0.3 + order * 0.08) {
    const style = pick(rng, isl.horns);
    model.horns = { style, size: style === 'unicorn' ? 0.55 : 0.5, color: 'accent2', gap: 0.34, tilt: -0.35, count: 2 };
  }
  // wings for the legends
  if (order >= 4 && !model.wings) {
    model.wings = { style: pick(rng, isl.wings), size: order === 5 ? 1.0 : 0.85, color: 'accent', color2: 'accent2', y: (model.body?.y || 1) + 0.1, z: -0.2 };
  }
  const extras = model.extras || [];
  const has = (k) => extras.some((e) => e.kind === k);
  if (order === 5 || (order === 4 && rng() < 0.5)) if (!has('halo')) extras.push({ kind: 'halo', color: 'glow' });
  if (order === 5 && rng() < 0.6 && !has('satellites')) extras.push({ kind: 'satellites', color: 'glow', count: 3 });
  if (extras.length) model.extras = extras;
  model.aura = { kind: pick(rng, isl.auras), color: isl.palette.glow };
}

// Every generated species must look different from all others, not only in
// colour: the combination of template and features (the parts the renderer
// builds) is kept unique, adding variations until it is.
const MARK_KINDS = ['star', 'diamond', 'gem', 'crescent', 'rune', 'dots', 'clover', 'freckles', 'bolt'];
const BACK_STYLES = ['spots', 'stripes', 'stars', 'spikes', 'crystals', 'scutes', 'fur', 'runes', 'cracks', 'quills'];
const EYE_STYLES = ['gloss', 'sparkle', 'lashes', 'happy', 'gloss-white', 'liner', 'glow', 'cat', 'fierce', 'sleepy'];
const CUTE_EYES = ['gloss', 'sparkle', 'lashes', 'happy', 'gloss-white', 'liner'];

function featureKey(templateId, m) {
  const f = m.face || {};
  return [
    templateId, f.eyes?.style, f.mouth?.style, f.cheeks ? 1 : 0, f.mark?.kind, m.back?.style, m.crest?.style,
    m.horns?.style, m.wings?.style, (m.extras || []).map((e) => e.kind).sort().join('+'),
  ].join('|');
}

function applyVariant(model, i, isl) {
  const step = Math.floor(i / 4);
  const face = model.face || {};
  switch (i % 4) {
    case 0:
      if (face.eyes) {
        const kind = MARK_KINDS[step % MARK_KINDS.length];
        face.mark = face.mark ? { ...face.mark, kind } : { kind, color: 'glow', y: (face.eyes.y || 0.1) + 0.33, size: 0.13 };
      }
      break;
    case 1:
      if (BACK_SHAPES.has(model.body?.shape)) {
        const style = BACK_STYLES[step % BACK_STYLES.length];
        model.back = { style, color: 'accent', color2: 'accent2', count: BACK_COUNT[style] || 4 };
      }
      break;
    case 2:
      if (face.eyes && SWAP_EYES.has(face.eyes.style)) {
        const list = isl.cute ? CUTE_EYES : EYE_STYLES;
        face.eyes.style = list[step % list.length];
      }
      break;
    default: {
      const extras = model.extras || (model.extras = []);
      const kind = ['medallion', 'collar'][step % 2];
      if (!extras.some((e) => e.kind === kind)) extras.push({ kind, color: 'accent2', gem: 'glow' });
    }
  }
}

function makeUnique(templateId, model, keys, isl) {
  let key = featureKey(templateId, model);
  for (let i = 0; keys.has(key) && i < 200; i++) {
    applyVariant(model, i, isl);
    key = featureKey(templateId, model);
  }
  keys.add(key);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ species

function attacksFor(template, isl, rarity, rng) {
  const order = ORDER_INDEX[rarity];
  const color = hexStr(mix(isl.palette.glow, isl.palette.second[0], 0.35));
  const list = clone(template.attacks).map((a) => {
    const words = isl.attackWords[a.kind] || isl.attackWords.melee;
    const out = { ...a, name: pick(rng, words), color };
    if (isl.effect && !a.effect && (a.kind === 'projectile' || a.kind === 'breath' || a.kind === 'slam') && rng() < 0.6) out.effect = isl.effect;
    return out;
  });
  if (order >= 4 && !list.some((a) => a.kind === 'slam')) {
    list.push({ kind: 'slam', name: pick(rng, isl.attackWords.slam), range: 3.5, radius: order === 5 ? 8 : 6.5, power: 1.6, windupMs: 1000, cooldownMs: 5600, knockback: 16, color, ...(isl.effect ? { effect: isl.effect } : {}) });
  }
  // names must differ within one monster
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const a of list) {
    if (seen.has(a.name)) a.name = `${a.name} II`;
    seen.add(a.name);
  }
  return list;
}

function temperFor(isl, rarity, rng) {
  const order = ORDER_INDEX[rarity];
  if (order >= 4) return 'territorial';
  if (isl.cute) return order >= 3 ? 'territorial' : order >= 2 ? pick(rng, ['neutral', 'territorial']) : pick(rng, ['shy', 'neutral', 'shy']);
  if (order === 3) return pick(rng, ['aggressive', 'territorial']);
  if (order === 2) return pick(rng, ['aggressive', 'territorial', 'neutral']);
  return pick(rng, ['neutral', 'shy', 'neutral', 'aggressive']);
}

function makeSpecies(isl, template, rarity, name, rng, usedIds, keys) {
  const order = ORDER_INDEX[rarity];
  const B = BASE[rarity];
  const T = 1 + 0.35 * isl.tier;
  const j = () => 0.9 + rng() * 0.2;
  let id = `${isl.id}_${name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '')}`;
  while (usedIds.has(id)) id += 'x';
  usedIds.add(id);
  const noun = TEMPLATE_NOUNS[template.id] || 'Monster';
  const adj = pick(rng, isl.adjectives);
  const price = niceNumber(B.price * T * T * (0.9 + rng() * 0.25));
  const model = clone(template.model);
  recolor(model, isl, rng);
  mutate(model, isl, rarity, rng);
  makeUnique(template.id, model, keys, isl);
  const ai = { ...clone(template.ai), temper: temperFor(isl, rarity, rng) };
  if (order >= 4) ai.boss = true;
  else delete ai.boss;
  ai.detect = Math.max(ai.detect || 12, 12 + order);
  const spawn = order === 5
    ? { regions: [isl.id], spot: `${isl.id}_shrine`, chance: 0.6, respawnMs: 300000, weight: 0 }
    : order === 4
      ? { regions: [isl.id], spot: `${isl.id}_lair`, chance: 0.7, respawnMs: 150000, weight: 0 }
      : { regions: [isl.id], weight: [10, 5, 2.2, 0.8][order], group: order === 0 ? [1, 3] : order === 1 ? [1, 2] : [1, 1] };
  if (template.spawn.water && order <= 3) spawn.water = true;
  const element = pick(rng, isl.elements);
  const rarityWord = rarity[0].toUpperCase() + rarity.slice(1);
  const trait = pick(rng, isl.traits);
  return {
    id,
    name,
    title: order >= 4 ? `${rarityWord} ${noun} of ${isl.name}` : `${adj} ${noun}`,
    element,
    rarity,
    category: B.category,
    island: isl.id,
    template: template.id,
    description: order >= 4
      ? `One of the ${rarityWord} monsters of ${isl.name}. It ${trait}, and it does not let just anyone recruit it.`
      : `A ${adj.toLowerCase()} ${noun.toLowerCase()} from ${isl.name}. It ${trait}.`,
    spawn,
    stats: {
      hp: Math.round(B.hp * T ** 0.8 * j()),
      atk: Math.round(B.atk * T ** 0.5 * j()),
      def: Math.round(B.def * T ** 0.5 * j()),
      speed: Math.round((template.stats.speed + order * 0.4) * 10) / 10,
    },
    size: Math.round(B.size * (0.95 + rng() * 0.1) * 100) / 100,
    ai,
    attacks: attacksFor(template, isl, rarity, rng),
    price,
    income: Math.round((price / (90 + 35 * order)) * 10) / 10,
    perk: { kind: pick(rng, isl.perks), value: B.perk },
    personality: clone(template.personality),
    model,
  };
}

// Deal the remaining templates over the rarities so that every rarity gets
// some of the island's most typical monsters.
function dealSlots(templates, counts) {
  const left = { ...counts };
  const total = Object.values(counts).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const out = [];
  for (const t of templates) {
    if (out.length >= total) break;
    let best = null;
    for (const r of Object.keys(left)) {
      if (left[r] <= 0) continue;
      const share = left[r] / counts[r];
      if (!best || share > best.share) best = { r, share };
    }
    left[best.r]--;
    out.push([t, best.r]);
  }
  return out;
}

export function generateIslandSpecies(baseSpecies) {
  const byId = Object.fromEntries(baseSpecies.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
  const usedIds = new Set(baseSpecies.map((s) => s.id));
  const usedNames = new Set(baseSpecies.map((s) => s.name.toLowerCase()));
  const keys = new Set(baseSpecies.map((s) => featureKey(s.id, s.model)));
  const all = [];
  for (const isl of ISLANDS) {
    const rng = rngFor('island-species', isl.id);
    const prefixes = [...isl.prefixes];
    for (let i = prefixes.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const k = Math.floor(rng() * (i + 1));
      [prefixes[i], prefixes[k]] = [prefixes[k], prefixes[i]];
    }
    let pi = 0;
    const nameFor = (template) => {
      for (let tries = 0; tries < prefixes.length * 2; tries++) {
        const p = prefixes[pi++ % prefixes.length];
        const n = p + TEMPLATE_STEMS[template];
        if (!usedNames.has(n.toLowerCase())) return n;
      }
      return `${prefixes[0]}${TEMPLATE_STEMS[template]}${all.length}`;
    };
    const take = (name) => usedNames.add(name.toLowerCase());
    const used = new Map(); // template -> times used on this island
    const use = (t) => used.set(t, (used.get(t) || 0) + 1);
    const list = [];
    for (const r of ['mythic', 'legendary']) {
      for (const [t, name] of isl.top[r]) {
        take(name);
        use(t);
        list.push(makeSpecies(isl, byId[t], r, name, rng, usedIds, keys));
      }
    }
    for (const t of isl.top.epic) {
      const name = nameFor(t);
      take(name);
      use(t);
      list.push(makeSpecies(isl, byId[t], 'epic', name, rng, usedIds, keys));
    }
    // the rest: Rare, Uncommon and Common from the island's template list
    const counts = { rare: RARITY_SLOTS.rare, uncommon: RARITY_SLOTS.uncommon, common: RARITY_SLOTS.common };
    const need = counts.rare + counts.uncommon + counts.common;
    const ok = (t) => byId[t] && !BIG_TEMPLATES.has(t) && !NO_TEMPLATE.has(t) && !(isl.cute && NOT_CUTE.has(t));
    const pool = [];
    for (let round = 0; pool.length < need && round < 3; round++) {
      for (const t of isl.templates) {
        if (pool.length >= need) break;
        if (!ok(t) || (used.get(t) || 0) > round) continue;
        use(t);
        pool.push(t);
      }
    }
    for (const [t, r] of dealSlots(pool, counts)) {
      const name = nameFor(t);
      take(name);
      list.push(makeSpecies(isl, byId[t], r, name, rng, usedIds, keys));
    }
    // strongest first within the island, like the Monsterdex shows them
    list.sort((a, b) => ORDER_INDEX[b.rarity] - ORDER_INDEX[a.rarity]);
    all.push(...list);
  }
  return all;
}

export { RARITY_ORDER };

export const SWORD_INDEX = Object.fromEntries(SWORDS.map((s, i) => [s.id, i]));

// Returns null if the player may buy/equip the sword, else a reason.
export function swordLockReason(sword, player) {
  const u = sword.unlock || {};
  if (u.level && (player.level || 1) < u.level) return `Requires Level ${u.level}`;
  if (u.discovered && !(player.regionsVisited || []).includes(u.discovered)) return `Discover the ${regionNameHint(u.discovered)} first`;
  return null;
}

function regionNameHint(id) {
  return REGION_BY_ID[id]?.name || id;
}

export function swordDps(sword) {
  return Math.round((sword.damage / (sword.cooldownMs / 1000)) * 10) / 10;
}
